title: Ngwá ọrụ [Resources] Onye mmepụta [Developer]
description: Ngwá ọrụ ndị ị chọrọ iji wuo ihe na Zcash, ekewara ha dabere n'ihe nke ọ bụla ji arụ ọrụ kama idepụta ha n'otu ikpo.
text: Ngwá ọrụ [Resources] Onye mmepụta [Developer] Ngwá ọrụ ndị ị chọrọ iji wuo ihe na Zcash, ekewara ha dabere n'ihe nke ọ bụla ji arụ ọrụ kama idepụta ha n'otu ikpo. Nchịkọta teknụzụ ahụ gbanwere nke ukwuu n'afọ 2026. zcashd, nke na-agba netwọk [network] ahụ n'ọtụtụ akụkọ ndụ ya, rutere ngwụcha ndụ ya na 18 Julaị 2026 n'ịdị elu block 3417100, node ọ bụla a na-agbanweghị emechiri n'ịdị elu ahụ ma ga-ajụ ịmalite ọzọ. Nduzi e dere maka zcashd bụzi akụkọ ihe mere eme kama ịbụ ebe a ga-amalite, ya mere a haziri peeji a gburugburu ihe dochiri ya. Nchịkọta teknụzụ ahụ n'ile anya Oyi akwa Ihe ị ga-eji Malite na :-- :-- :-- Full node Zebra ma ọ bụ Zakura Akwụkwọ Zebra, zakura.com E-akpa ego [wallet] full node Zallet, nọ na beta Akwụkwọ Zallet Sava e-akpa ego light Zaino ma ọ bụ lightwalletd Zaino, lightwalletd Ọbá akwụkwọ e-akpa ego Crates librustzcash librustzcash Mkpanaaka SDKs Android na iOS Android, iOS Nkọwapụta Nkọwapụta protocol na ZIPs zips.z.cash Nodes Node na-enyocha consensus ma na-edobe chain. E nwere mmejuputa abụọ a ka na-emepụta nke ọma. Zebra bụ node nke Zcash Foundation, edere ya na Rust, ma bụrụkwa nke ọtụtụ nduzi na-eche ugbu a. Akwụkwọ Zebra na-akọwa otu esi wụnye ma gbaa ya, ebe repository bụ ebe mmepe na-eme. Zakura bụ node ọhụrụ, nke ndị dere ya kọwara dịka “full node Zcash kwekọrọ na consensus, nke e wuru maka ogo”, nwere sync ngwa ngwa, ịkpụchapụ block na ọnọdụ ndakọrịta zcashd. Ọ bụ Sean Bowe, onye na-arụkọ Zcash, na Dev Ojha na-edu ya. Ọ bụ open source n'okpuru Apache 2.0 na zakura-core/zakura. ZecHub nwere peeji Full Nodes nke na-akọwa ọdịiche dị n'etiti ha. E-akpa ego full node zcashd jikọtara e-akpa ego na node. E-akpa ego ahụ adịkwaghị, ma Zallet bụ ihe dochiri ya. Akwụkwọ Zallet kọwara ya dịka “e-akpa ego Zcash full-node e dere na Rust” nke “a na-ewu dịka ihe dochiri e-akpa ego zcashd”. Gụọ ịdọ aka ná ntị gbasara nchekwa tupu ịdabere na ya. Zallet nọ na beta, “enyochabeghị ya nke ọma”, mgbanwe na-emebi emebi “nwere ike ime n'oge ọ bụla, chọrọ ka ị hichapụ ma mepụta ọzọ e-akpa ego Zallet gị”, ọ bụghịkwa ụzọ RPC zcashd ọ bụla ka e bugorola. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ebufe nhazi dị adị, ZecHub nwere nduzi mbufe site na zcashd gaa na Zebra na Zallet yana ntụaka ngwa ngwa Zallet. Sava e-akpa ego light Ọtụtụ e-akpa ego anaghị agba node. Ha na-agwa sava na-edobe chain okwu, nke na-eweghachikwara ha nlele kọmpat nke ya. lightwalletd bụ ọrụ mbụ, edere na Go, nke akọwara dịka “ọrụ backend na-enye ihu ọma na-echekwa bandwidth nye blockchain Zcash”. Zaino bụ indexer ọhụrụ, edere na Rust, ma na-agụ site na full validator kama iburu nke ya nke chain. Akwụkwọ Light Client Protocol na-akọwa protocol ahụ n'onwe ya. Peeji Lightwallet Nodes na-akọwa ihe sava ndị a nwere ike ịhụ na ihe ha na-enweghị ike ịhụ gbasara onye ọrụ, nke kwesịrị ka a ghọta tupu ịhọrọ otu. Iwulite e-akpa ego Ọtụtụ ọrụ e-akpa ego na-eme na crates Rust dị n'okpuru librustzcash, nke SDK mkpanaaka na ọtụtụ e-akpa ego desktọpụ na-ewukwasị. A na-edepụta crate ọ bụla na docs.rs. Crate Ihe ọ bụ maka ya :-- :-- zcashclientbackend “APIs maka imepụta light clients Zcash nke e chebere echebe [shielded]”, gụnyere sync na iwu Azụmahia [transaction] zcashclientsqlite “Light client Zcash dabere na SQLite”, oyi akwa nchekwa maka nke dị n'elu zcashkeys “Njikwa igodo na Adreesị akpa ego [address] Zcash” zcashprimitives “Mmejuputa Rust nke primitives Zcash” zcashprotocol “Constants netwọk protocol Zcash na ụdị uru” orchard “Protocol Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Orchard” sapling-crypto “Ọbá akwụkwọ cryptographic maka Zcash Sapling” pczt “Ngwá ọrụ maka ịrụ ọrụ na Azụmahia Zcash e mepụtara akụkụ ụfọdụ”, eji maka hardware na ịbinye signature n'ọtụtụ ngwaọrụ zip321 URIs arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment], dịka e kwuru na ZIP 321 Maka mkpanaaka, SDK Android na iOS SDK na-ekpuchi ọbá akwụkwọ ndị ahụ. A na-akpọbu repository iOS ahụ ZcashLightClientKit, ya mere njikọ na isiokwu ochie na-eji aha ahụ. Nkọwapụta na cryptography Nkọwapụta protocol bụ ikike kacha elu gbasara otu Zcash si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere

title: Ego Mmepe Zcash (Development Fund)
description: Zcash enweghị ụlọ ọrụ nwe ya. Mana mmadụ ka ga-akwụrịrị ụgwọ maka e-akpa ego (wallet), ngwanrọ node, nchọpụta na agụmakwụkwọ. Kama ịchịkọta ego n'aka ndị…
text: Ego Mmepe Zcash (Development Fund) Nchịkọta nkenke (TL;DR) Zcash na-akwụ ụgwọ mmepe nke ya site n'ụgwọ ọrụ block (otu ngwugwu azụmahịa e dekọrọ n'ime blockchain), ya mere ndị na-ewu ya adịghị adabere na ndị ọchụnta ego si n'èzí Taa, 8% nke ụgwọ ọrụ block ọ bụla na-aga na Zcash Community Grants, 12% na-agakwa n'otu ego nke ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego na-achịkwa. Onye na-egwụputa (miner) na-ewere ihe fọdụrụ Ego a agbanweela na halving (mgbe a na-ebelata ụgwọ ọrụ block ọkara) ọ bụla: ụgwọ ọrụ ndị guzobere (founders' reward) mgbe a malitere, Ego Mmepe site na 2020, igbe nchekwa (lockbox) site na 2024, na njikwa ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego kemgbe Nọvemba 2025 Ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego na-atụ vootu banyere otu a ga-esi jiri ego 12% ahụ. Zcash Community Grants na-ekpebi ikike (grant) nke ya Unu chọrọ ego? Tinyenụ akwụkwọ arịrịọ na Zcash Community Grants maka ọrụ ọhụrụ, ma ọ bụ na ikike azụ (retroactive grants) nke ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego maka ọrụ unu rụchaala Onye ka nke a bụ maka Ndị ọhụrụ na-eji Zcash chọrọ ịmata onye na-akwụ ụgwọ maka Zcash Ndị na-ewu ihe, ndị edemede na ndị ntụgharị asụsụ na-achọ ego Ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego chọrọ ịghọta ihe ha na-atụ vootu na ya Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa Zcash enweghị ụlọ ọrụ nwe ya. Mana mmadụ ka ga-akwụrịrị ụgwọ maka e-akpa ego (wallet), ngwanrọ node, nchọpụta na agụmakwụkwọ. Kama ịchịkọta ego n'aka ndị ọchụnta ego, Zcash na-edebe akụkụ nke ụgwọ ọrụ block ọhụrụ ọ bụla maka mmepe. Nke a na-eme ka ndị na-ewu Zcash lekwasị anya n'ebe ndị ọrụ ya nọ na n'ebumnobi Nzuzo (privacy) ya. Otu o si gbanwee Oge Ihe mere Nkesa nke ụgwọ ọrụ block ọ bụla --- --- --- 2016 ruo 2020 Ụgwọ ọrụ ndị guzobere. Kwụrụ ndị guzobere Zcash, ndị ọchụnta ego mbụ, ndị ọrụ na Zcash Foundation ụgwọ, ruo mgbe halving mbụ 20% gaa n'ụgwọ ọrụ ndị guzobere Nọv 2020 ruo Nọv 2024 Ego Mmepe, nke Canopy mepụtara (ZIP 1014) 7% Electric Coin Company, 5% Zcash Foundation, 8% Ikike Ndị Bụ Isi (Major Grants) (emesịa Zcash Community Grants) Nọv 2024 ruo Nọv 2025 Igbe nchekwa, nke NU6 mepụtara (ZIP 1015) 8% Zcash Community Grants, 12% banye n'Igbe Nchekwa Ego Mmepe A Na-egbu Oge (Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox), e debere ruo mgbe obodo kpebiri otu a ga-esi jiri ya Nọv 2025 ruo ugbu a Njikwa ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego, nke NU6.1 guzobere (ZIP 1016) 8% Zcash Community Grants, 12% gaa n'Ego Ndị Nwe Mkpụrụ Ego Na-achịkwa (Coinholder-Controlled Fund), nke e ji ego dị n'igbe nchekwa malite N'oge ọ bụla, onye na-egwụputa na-ewere 80% fọdụrụ. Otu o si arụ ọrụ taa Kemgbe NU6.1 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Nọvemba 24, 2025, ụzọ abụọ ego si na-esi n'ụgwọ ọrụ block ọ bụla: 8% na-aga na Zcash Community Grants (ZCG). Otu kọmitii nwere onwe ya na-akwụ ụgwọ maka ọrụ ọhụrụ n'ime usoro Zcash: e-akpa ego, ngwá ọrụ, nchọpụta, agụmakwụkwọ na mmemme. 12% na-aga n'Ego Ndị Nwe Mkpụrụ Ego Na-achịkwa. Ọ malitere site na mkpụrụ ego e chekwara n'igbe nchekwa. Ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego na-atụ vootu ma a ga-esi na ya kwụọ ikike ma ọ bụ hapụ ya ka ọ nọrọ. Òtù Ndị Na-ejide Igodo (Key-Holder Organizations) na-ejide ego ahụ, iwu na-ejikọkwa ha iji ya naanị dịka ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego si kpebie (ZIP 1016). Usoro a ga-aga n'ihu ruo halving nke atọ nke Zcash. ZIP 1016 na-ekwe ka ụbọchị ahụ gbanwee, n'ihi na NU7 na-agbanwe oge block. Obodo ga-ekpebi mgbe ahụ ma a ga-edobe ya, gbanwee ya ma ọ bụ kwụsị ya. Onye na-ekpebi Zcash Community Grants na-enyocha akwụkwọ arịrịọ ma na-atụ vootu na ikike ọ bụla. Ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego na-eji ZEC ha atụ vootu na atụmatụ maka ego 12% ahụ. Ha anaghị akpọchi mkpụrụ ego ha iji tụọ vootu. Mgbanwe n'ego n'onwe ya chọrọ ZIP ọhụrụ na network upgrade (mmelite netwọk), mgbe obodo kparịtachara ya na Zcash Ebe Mkparịta Ụka Obodo. Maka nghọta zuru oke, lee Zcash Gọọmentị (governance) na Otu e si hazie Zcash. Otu esi enweta ego Ọrụ ọhụrụ unu chọrọ ịrụ: tinyenụ akwụkwọ arịrịọ na Zcash Community Grants. Ọrụ unu rụchaala: tinyenụ akwụkwọ arịrịọ na Ikike Azụ Ndị Nwe Mkpụrụ Ego Na-eduzi, nke na-eme kwa ọnwa atọ. Obere onyinye n'ime wiki a: ZecHub na-enye ndị na-enye aka obere ụgwọ na ZEC. title: Otu esi ahazi Zcash
description: Ịghọta nhazi ahụ na-eme ka ihe ọ bụla ọzọ dị mfe. Ọ na-agwa gị onye na-elekọta koodu ị na-adabere na ya, onye ị ga-agakwuru maka ikike [grant], na onye na-ahụ…
text: Otu esi ahazi Zcash Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa Ọ bụghị otu ụlọ ọrụ wuru Zcash; ọtụtụ òtù nọọrọ onwe ha wuru ya, nke ọ bụla nwekwara akụkụ ọrụ dị iche N'ime ọtụtụ akụkọ ihe mere eme ya, òtù abụọ duru mmepe: Electric Coin Company na Zcash Foundation Na Jenụwarị 2026, ndị otu Electric Coin Company niile gbara arụkwaghịm mgbe esemokwu Gọọmentị [governance] gasịrị, ekosistem ahụ wee hazigharịa ghọọ ọtụtụ ndị otu nọọrọ onwe ha Taa, òtù dị iche iche na-ahụ maka protocol, sọftụwia node, e-akpa ego, nchọpụta, scaling, na nkwado ego Ọ nweghị otu òtù na-achịkwa Zcash; netwọk ahụ bụ koodu mepere emepe [open source] na permissionless, ọ gara n'ihu na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'oge mgbanwe ọ bụla Ònye ka nke a bụ maka ya Ndị ọhụrụ na-achọ ịghọta onye na-ewu ma na-elekọta Zcash n'ezie Onye ọ bụla aha ọtụtụ òtù dị na ekosistem na-agbagwoju anya Ndị na-enye aka na-ekpebi onye ha ga-arụkọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ebe ha ga-eziga atụmatụ Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa Ịghọta nhazi ahụ na-eme ka ihe ọ bụla ọzọ dị mfe. Ọ na-agwa gị onye na-elekọta koodu ị na-adabere na ya, onye ị ga-agakwuru maka ikike [grant], na onye na-ahụ maka akụkụ netwọk ị na-eche banyere ya. Ọ na-ekpughekwa otu n'ime ike dị jụụ nke Zcash: ebe ọrụ ahụ gbasara n'etiti otu ndị nọọrọ onwe ha, ọ nweghị otu ebe ọdịda pụrụ ijide ma ọ bụ kwụsị ọrụ ahụ. Peeji a bụ maapụ. Maka òtù ọ bụla nweela peeji zuru ezu na wiki a, ị ga-ahụ nkọwa dị mkpirikpi na njikọ iji gụkwuo, kama ikwughachi ihe e dere ebe ahụ. Otu o si arụbu ọrụ N'ime ọtụtụ akụkọ ihe mere eme nke Zcash, òtù abụọ duru ụzọ. Electric Coin Company malitere Zcash na 2016 ma were ọtụtụ ndị otu mmepe isi n'ọrụ. Bootstrap, bọọdụ na-abụghị maka uru e kere iji kwado Zcash, na-elekọta ya. Zcash Foundation rụkọrọ ọrụ n'akụkụ ya dị ka òtù nọọrọ onwe ya na-abụghị maka uru, na-elekwasị anya n'ilekọta protocol na iwulite node nọọrọ onwe ya. Ọtụtụ n'ime nkwado ego ha sitere n'otu akụkụ nke ụgwọ ọrụ block e wepụtara maka mmepe. Nhazi ogidi abụọ a dịgidere ọtụtụ afọ, ma ọ dabere na nkwado ego ha kesara na ka òtù abụọ ahụ na-adị n'otu. Ka nkwado ego mmepe mbụ ahụ si gbanwee na ọdịnihu ya ogologo oge ghọrọ nke na-edoghị anya, ajụjụ banyere otu e si akwụ ụgwọ maka ọrụ na-aga n'ihu ghọrọ ihe dị mkpa karị. Ajụjụ nkwado ego ahụ dị n'azụ ọtụtụ n'ime ihe gbanwere mgbe e mesịrị, ọ bụkwa akụkụ nke ihe mere ụfọdụ ndị otu ji achịkọta isi ego n'èzí ebe ndị ọzọ dabere na ikike. Nhazigharị 2026 Na Jenụwarị 2026, nhazi ahụ gbanwere nke ukwuu. Na Jenụwarị 7, onye isi nchịkwa Electric Coin Company, Josh Swihart, kwupụtara na X na ndị otu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ niile agbaala arụkwaghịm. Bootstrap bụ òtù na-abụghị maka uru e kere na 2020 iji chịkwaa Electric Coin Company, nke ghọrọ ụlọ ọrụ enyemaka nke ya nwe kpamkpam. Esemokwu dị n'etiti ndị otu ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na bọọdụ a na-arị elu ka oge na-aga, metụrụkwa ọtụtụ okwu aka, gụnyere ntụziaka òtù ahụ, otu ekwesịrị isi kwado mmepe ego, na ọdịnihu e-akpa ego Zashi, nke ndị otu ahụ chọrọ ibuga n'ime ụlọ ọrụ nkeonwe iji nweta isi ego n'èzí. Swihart kọwara ọpụpụ ahụ dị ka constructive discharge, okwu iwu pụtara na a gbanwere ọnọdụ nke ukwuu nke mere na agbụrụ arụkwaghịm ghọrọ ihe a manyere n'eziokwu, ma kwuo na ọtụtụ ndị bọọdụ ahụ esila n'usoro ebumnuche Zcash pụọ. Akụkụ nke ọzọ nke akụkọ ahụ dị mkpa maka ikpe ziri ezi. Bootstrap kọwara esemokwu ahụ dịka okwu Gọọmentị na nrubeisi n'iwu òtù na-abụghị maka uru. Onye guzobere Zcash, Zooko Wilcox, gbachitere ndị otu bọọdụ a kpọrọ aha n'esemokwu ahụ n'ihu ọha, na-ekwu na ya na ha arụkọla ọrụ ọtụtụ afọ ma were ha dịka ndị nwere ntụkwasị obi dị elu, ebe o mere ka o doo anya na ọ naghị akwado akụkụ ọ bụla n'esemokwu ahụ n'onwe ya. Ihe abụọ enweghị esemokwu. Ọ nweghị akụkụ kwuru na e mere omume mpụ ọ bụla, ya mere nke a bụ esemokwu ụlọ ọrụ na Gọọmentị kama ịbụ ikpe iwu. Netwọk Zcash n'onwe ya emetụtaghị ya; ọ nọgidere bụrụ koodu mepere emepe, permissionless, dị nchebe, ma na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'oge ahụ niile, isiokwu Swihart na Wilcox mesiri ndị ọrụ ike. Ihe sochirinụ bụ nhazigharị kama ọdịda. Ndị otu ụlọ ọrụ mbụ gara n'ihu g

title: Zcash Ntuziaka Maka Onye Ọrụ Ọhụrụ
description: Ị bụ onye ọhụrụ na Zcash? Ntuziaka a ga-eduga gị n’usoro ịmalite dị ka onye ọrụ Zcash na onye ji ZEC.
text: Zcash Ntuziaka Maka Onye Ọrụ Ọhụrụ Na nchịkọta Zụta ZEC n’otu exchange akwadoro (Gemini, BitcoinVN, wdg.) Hazie e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe (a na-akwado Zodl, Zingo, ma ọ bụ Zkool) Wepụ ZEC gị na exchange tinye ya n’e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe gị Zipụ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe — Kwụọ ụhwọ Nzuzo mbụ gị na Zcash Soro obodo na forum ma ọ bụ Discord --- Ị bụ onye ọhụrụ na Zcash? Ntuziaka a ga-eduga gị n’usoro ịmalite dị ka onye ọrụ Zcash na onye ji ZEC. --- Zụta ZEC Iji jiri netwọk Zcash, ị ga-azụta ego ya, bụ ZEC. Ụzọ kachasị mfe iji nweta ZEC bụ ịzụ ya na Gemini ma ọ bụ nke ọ bụla n’ime exchange ndị a. Otu ihe dị mkpa ịmara bụ na ịkwesịghị ịzụta ZEC zuru ezu 1. A pụrụ ikewa ZEC, ma ị nwere ike bido site n’ịzụta naanị akụkụ nke mkpụrụ ego ahụ. --- Hazie e-akpa ego Mgbe ị zụtachara ụfọdụ ZEC, ị nwere ike ịchọ ibuga ya n’e-akpa ego Zcash. Isiokwu a na-akọwa ihe mere idobe ZEC n’e-akpa ego ji dị mkpa. Anyị na-akwado iji e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe n’ihi na e-akpa ego ndị a na-enye atụmatụ Nzuzo ndị na-eme ZEC pụrụ iche. Nke a bụ vidio na-enyocha e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe nke oge a: --- Wepụ ZEC Mgbe ị mepụtara e-akpa ego gị, ị ga-achọ iwepụ ZEC gị tinye ya n’e-akpa ego ahụ. Nke a bụ nkuzi banyere otu esi eme nke ahụ. --- Zipụ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Mgbe ị tinyela ụfọdụ ZEC n’e-akpa ego gị, ị dịla njikere izipu Azụmahia zuru oke nke e chebere echebe, nke nzuzo. Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe bụ mgbanwe ZEC na-echekwa Nzuzo nke onye ọ bụla sonyere n’uju. Nke a bụ ụfọdụ ndụmọdụ bara uru mgbe ị na-eji ZEC nke e chebere echebe. --- Soro forum Forum Obodo Zcash bụ ebe ndị otu obodo Zcash na-atụle ihe niile metụtara Zcash. Anyị nwekwara sava discord. Zcash Forum Obodo Zcash Ụwa Nile. Obodo a nwere mmasị siri ike ma na-anabatakwa ndị otu ọhụrụ nke ọma. Mgbe ụfọdụ mkparịta ụka nwere ike ịbụ nke teknụzụ, mana echegbula onwe gị! Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ajụjụ ọ bụla, ị nwere ike ịjụ. --- Peeji Ndị Metụtara Ya Gịnị bụ ZEC na Zcash — Ghọta isi ihe tupu ịmalite Ịzụta ZEC — Ndepụta zuru ezu nke exchange na-akwado mwepụ nke e chebere echebe E-akpa ego — Tụnyere e-akpa ego Zcash niile site n’atụmatụ na ikpo okwu Pool Nke E Chebere Echebe — Mụta ihe mere Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe ji dị mkpa Azụmahia — Otu esi ezipu ma nata ZEC na Nzuzo

title: Isi Mmalite nke Zcash
description: ZEC bụ ego dijitalụ dabere na blockchain Zcash. Ọ bụ ihe kacha yie ego nkịtị n’ịntanetị. Ọ bụ ezie na o nwere ọtụtụ atụmatụ yiri nke Bitcoin, ọ na-edozi nnukwu…
text: Isi Mmalite nke Zcash N’ụzọ dị mkpirikpi ZEC bụ ego dijitalụ na-ebute Nzuzo [privacy] ụzọ, nke e wuru n’elu blockchain [blockchain] Zcash N’adịghị ka Bitcoin, ZEC na-akwado Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe (nke nzuzo) zuru oke site n’iji zero-knowledge proof Ị na-achịkwa nzuzo ego gị: họrọ ihe ị ga-ekpughe, na onye ị ga-ekpughere ya Zcash bụ open-source, permissionless, na decentralized --- Gịnị bụ ZEC? --- ZEC bụ ego dijitalụ dabere na blockchain Zcash. Ọ bụ ihe kacha yie ego nkịtị n’ịntanetị. Ọ bụ ezie na o nwere ọtụtụ atụmatụ yiri nke Bitcoin, ọ na-edozi nnukwu adịghị ike Bitcoin site n’ime ka ndị ọrụ nwee ike ịme Azụmahia ego nzuzo zuru oke. Gịnị mere ego nzuzo ji dị mkpa? ZEC na-enye ndị mmadụ ohere izipu data n’enweghị ikikere. Inwe usoro ego peer-to-peer, permissionless na-enye ndị mmadụ ikike ịchekwa uru, ma ọ bụ iso ndị ọzọ zụọ ahịa, n’enweghị ịdabere n’aka ụlọ ọrụ centralized. ZEC na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka ịhọrọ mgbe ha chọrọ ikpughere ndị ọzọ ozi gbasara ego ha. Akụrụngwa Ikpe banyere Zcash na Nzuzo Ecosystem E Chebere Echebe Nkwado Nzuzo nke Zcash Gịnị bụ Zcash? Zcash bụ mmejuputa protocol “Zerocash”. Ọ bụ ledger open-source, dabere na blockchain, nke nwere usoro zero-knowledge proving dị mgbagwoju anya. Dabere na code Bitcoin, ọ bụ ọkachamara n’inye ọkwa Nzuzo dị elu site n’usoro proving ya nke na-echekwa nzuzo nke metadata Azụmahia. N’obi ya, Zcash bụ nwe data nzuzo nke a na-ebufe n’enweghị ikikere mgbe e mere Azụmahia. Gịnị mere o ji dị mkpa? Zcash na-edozi nnukwu adịghị ike Bitcoin; nwe na mbufe data nzuzo. N’ụwa ebe a na-anabata ngwa blockchain na cryptocurrencies n’ụzọ sara mbara, Azụmahia pseudonymous anaghịzi ezu iji chebe Nzuzo ndị ọrụ. A na-eji ngwa surveillance eme nyocha Azụmahia blockchain n’ụzọ sara mbara karị. title: Gịnị bụ ZecHub?
description: ZecHub bụ ọdụ mmụta decentralized maka Zcash. Ebumnuche nke ZecHub bụ ịnye ikpo okwu mmụta ebe ndị otu obodo nwere ike ịrụkọ ọrụ n'ịmepụta, ịkwado izi ezi, na…
text: Gịnị bụ ZecHub? --- ZecHub bụ ọdụ mmụta decentralized maka Zcash. Ebumnuche nke ZecHub bụ ịnye ikpo okwu mmụta ebe ndị otu obodo nwere ike ịrụkọ ọrụ n'ịmepụta, ịkwado izi ezi, na ịkwalite ọdịnaya nke na-akwado usoro gburugburu ebe obibi [ecosystem] nke Zcash. Anyị na-eme nke a site n’ụfọdụ usoro. Nkuzi Akwụkwọ wiki Pọdkastị na-agba ndị otu obodo ajụjụ ọnụ. Akwụkwọ Akụkọ Zcash kwa izu. Nkuzi, blọọgụ dị mkpirikpi, na Akwụkwọ Akụkọ bụ ndị e meghere isi mmalite [open sourced] ma debe ha na GitHub, nke pụtara na onye ọ bụla n’obodo nwere ike inye onyinye. Nke a bụ iji hụ na ọdịnaya ziri ezi nakwa na ọwa ahụ n’onwe ya enweghị otu ebe ọdịda [single point of failure]. Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ onye ọhụrụ na Zcash, jiri ntuziaka a. Otu esi eme mgbanwe na ZecHub --- Gaa na ebe nchekwa ZecHub nke GitHub Mepụta akaụntụ GitHub ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ jiri nke gị banye Soro ntuziaka a ka ịmụta otu esi eme pull request: Ntuziaka maka ndị na-enye onyinye --- Iji chekwaa ọdịdị otu nke ZecHub, e nwere ndebiri [template] ị nwere ike iji mgbe ị na-agbakwunye ibe na ebe nchekwa ahụ. Onyinye: ebe a NKWUPỤTA: ZecHub bụ atụmatụ nọọrọ onwe ya kpamkpam ma mepere emepe nke ndị otu obodo Zcash hibere. E kwesịghị iwere ihe ọ bụla dị na ebe nchekwa GitHub a dị ka ndụmọdụ gbasara ego ma ọ bụ itinye ego — ọ bụ naanị maka ebumnuche ozi. --- Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-achọ itinye ihe, ma ọ bụ tụọ aro mgbanwe na ibe wiki a, biko gaa na ebe nchekwa github ZecHub ma nyefee pull request.

title: Ònye Pụrụ Ịhụ Kwụọ ụhwọ [Payment] Zcash Gị?
description: N’ọtụtụ blockchain, enweghị nhọrọ ị ga-eme. Ihe niile ị zitere bụ nke ọhaneze, ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, nye onye ọ bụla lere anya.
text: Ònye Pụrụ Ịhụ Kwụọ ụhwọ [Payment] Zcash Gị? Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa Zcash na-enye gị ụdị Adreesị akpa ego [address] abụọ: Oha [transparent] (t) na nke e chebere echebe [shielded] (z ma ọ bụ u). Ogo ihe ọhaneze na-ahụ dabere n’ụdị ndị Kwụọ ụhwọ gị na-agafe n’etiti ha. Naanị Kwụọ ụhwọ site na nke e chebere echebe gaa na nke e chebere echebe na-ezo onye zitere ya, onye natara ya, na ego ole ọ bụ. Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe abụghị otu igodo. Ọ bụ obere nchịkọta igodo, ị nwekwara ike inye nnweta naanị ịgụ ihe n’enyeghị ike imefu ego. Enweghị ike iweghachi viewing key ozugbo ị kesara ya. --- Otu ihe ị ga-ebu ụzọ ghọta N’ọtụtụ blockchain, enweghị nhọrọ ị ga-eme. Ihe niile ị zitere bụ nke ọhaneze, ruo mgbe ebighị ebi, nye onye ọ bụla lere anya. Zcash na-enye gị nhọrọ kama nke ahụ. A na-eme nhọrọ ahụ ugboro abụọ: otu ugboro mgbe ị họrọ Adreesị akpa ego ị ga-ezigara, otu ugboro ọzọ mgbe ị kpebiri onye ga-enweta igodo iji gụọ akụkọ gị. Foto dị n’okpuru na-ekpuchi ha abụọ. --- Nhọrọ nke mbụ: Adreesị akpa ego nke ị ga-eji Kwụọ ụhwọ Zcash ọ bụla na-agagharị n’etiti Adreesị akpa ego abụọ, nke ọ bụla nwekwara ike ịbụ Oha ma ọ bụ nke e chebere echebe. Nke a na-enye ụzọ anọ, nke ọ bụla na-ekpughe ego dị iche. Ụkpụrụ ahụ dị mfe karịa ka ọ dị: ihe ọ bụla metụrụ Adreesị akpa ego Oha aghọọ nke ọhaneze. Kwụọ ụhwọ nke nọrọ n’ime pool nke e chebere echebe n’ụzọ ya dum anaghị ekpughe ihe ọ bụla ma e wezụga ugwo [fee]. Nke a kacha dị mkpa mgbe ị na-ewepụ ego n’ụlọ exchange. Ọtụtụ exchange na-eziga naanị na Adreesị akpa ego Oha, ya mere iwepụ ego ahụ bụ nke ọhaneze. Chebe ego ahụ n’onwe gị ozugbo ọ bịarutere, tupu i mefuo ya. Maka ilebakwu anya nke ọma n’ihe kpọmkwem onye nyocha na-agụ, lee Ihe onye nyocha block pụrụ ịhụ. --- Nhọrọ nke abụọ: onye na-enweta igodo Nzuzo [privacy] nke ị na-enweghị ike iwepụ adịghị aba uru. Mgbe ụfọdụ, ị ga-achọ igosi onye na-ahụ maka ndekọ ego, onye nyocha, ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ ụtụ isi ihe. Zcash na-eme nke a n’emeghị ka ị hapụ ikike ịchịkwa ya. Igodo ego [spending key]. Ọ na-ahụ ihe niile ma na-ebugharị ego. Nke a bụ ego ahụ. Ọ na-anọnyere gị, a naghị ekesakwa ya onye ọ bụla, n’ihi ihe ọ bụla. Full Viewing Key. Naanị ịgụ ihe. title: Blossom
description: Blossom bidoro ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash na block 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC).
text: Blossom Blossom bidoro ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash na block 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: otu Blossom siri mee ka blocks Zcash bịarute ihe dị ka ugboro abụọ ọsọ, n’agbanweghị oke ZEC nke network ahụ na-emepụta ka oge na-aga. Blossom bụ Zcash network upgrade. E tinyere ya n’ọrụ site na ZIP 206, a kọwakwara mgbanwe consensus ya bụ isi na ZIP 208. Blossom bụ upgrade maka scaling: o mere ka oge e lekwasịrị anya n’etiti blocks dị mkpụmkpụ site na sekọnd 150 ruo sekọnd 75, ya mere blocks na-abịa ihe dị ka ugboro abụọ karịa. Electric Coin Company duziri ma kwupụta Blossom. Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa. Mgbe ị zitere ZEC, ị na-eche ka network kwado ya n’ime block. Ọ bụrụ na blocks adịghị ọsọ, ị ga-eche ogologo oge. Tupu Blossom, a na-atụ anya block ọhụrụ ihe dị ka kwa sekọnd 150. Blossom belatara ebumnuche ahụ ọkara, ruo sekọnd 75, ya mere nkwenye na-abịa ngwa ngwa ma chain nwere ike ibu Azụmahia ndị ọzọ n’otu oge ahụ. O mere nke a n’emepụtaghị ZEC ọzọ ma ọ bụ gbanwee oge halving ndị ga-abịa. Nchịkọta dị mkpirikpi (TL;DR) Blossom bụ network upgrade nke atọ nke Zcash, nke malitere ọrụ na mainnet block 653,600 (December 11, 2019 UTC). E jiri ZIP 206 wepụta ya, mgbanwe bụ isi ya dịkwa na ZIP 208. O mere ka oge ezubere n’etiti block (target block spacing) si na sekọnd 150 daa ruo sekọnd 75. Blocks na-abịa ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ karịa ka ha na-abịa na mbụ, ya mere nkwenye mbụ (confirmation) na-abịa ngwa ngwa, ọnụ ọgụgụ Azụmahia network nwere ike ịrụ (throughput) amụbaa ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ. Iji mee ka ọnụego e ji ewepụta ego ọhụrụ (issuance) kwụsie ike, o kewara ụgwọ ọrụ e nyere maka otu block ọkara. O mekwara ka oge n’etiti halving abụọ (halving interval) mụbaa okpukpu abụọ, si na blocks 840,000 ruo blocks 1,680,000. Ngụkọta ZEC a na-emepụta n’ime otu oge agbanweghị. Oge halving ndị na-abịa ga-eme n’ezie agbanwekwaghị. Ọ bụ mgbanwe ọ dị mkpa ka onye ọ bụla mee, nke na-emetụta akụkụ abụọ (bilateral change). Node ọ bụla aghaghị ịkwalite (upgrade) ka ọ nọgide na chain. Ihe atụ a na-ahụ anya Blossom dị ka netwọk ụgbọ ala bọs nke na-amụba ọpụpụ ya okpukpu abụọ. Ugbu a, bọs na-abịa kwa sekọnd 75 kama kwa sekọnd 150, ya mere ị na-eche naanị ọkara oge ahụ (nkwenye ngwa ngwa [faster confirmations]), netwọk ahụ na-ebukwa ndị njem okpukpu abụọ (ike ibu [throughput]). Iji debe ego ụgwọ ọnwa ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ ala otu ka ọ dị, a na-ebelata ụgwọ onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ọ bụla na-enweta n’otu njem ka ọ bụrụ ọkara — otu ego ụgwọ ọnwa ahụ a na-emefu n’ozuzu, naanị na a na-akwụ ya n’ọtụtụ njem okpukpu abụọ. Blocks ọsọ karịa Mgbanwe bụ isi nke Blossom dị mfe. Oghere oge ezubere n’etiti block [target block spacing] nke Zcash, ya bụ oge network na-achọ ka ọ dị n’etiti otu block na nke na-esote, si na sekọnd 150 daa ruo sekọnd 75 (ZIP 208). A na-achọta blocks site n’ọrụ proof [proof of work], ya mere ezigbo oghere oge dị n’etiti ha na-adịgasị iche, mana network ugbu a na-achọ block ihe dị ka kwa sekọnd 75 kama kwa sekọnd 150. Ihe abụọ na-esite na nke a: Blocks na-abịa ihe dị ka ugboro abụọ karịa, ya mere chain nwere ike ibu Azụmahia ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ n’otu nkeji oge. Azụmahia gị na-enweta nkwenye mbụ ya ngwa ngwa, n’ihi na ị naghị eche ogologo oge maka block na-esote. Idebe mwepụta n’otu ọkwa Blocks ọsọ karịa na-ebute ajụjụ. Ọ bụrụ na Zcash mepụtara blocks okpukpu abụọ karịa, block ọ bụla akwụkwaa otu ụgwọ ọrụ block [block reward], network ahụ ga-emepụta ZEC ọsọ okpukpu abụọ. Blossom na-egbochi nke ahụ. Ọ kewara ụgwọ a na-akwụ kwa block ọkara, ma mụbaa etiti halving ụgwọ ọrụ block [halving interval] site na 840,000 ruo 1,680,000 blocks (ZIP 208). Blocks okpukpu abụọ karịa, nke ọ bụla na-akwụ ọkara, na-eduga n’otu oke ZEC a na-emepụta n’otu nkeji oge. Usoro ngụkọta mwepụta na oge halving ndị ga-adị n’ọdịnihu, mgbe a tụrụ ha n’oge n’ezie, agbanweghị. Upgrade amanyere amanye Blossom bụ mgbanwe consensus abụọ na ibe ya [bilateral consensus change], nke pụtara na node ọ bụla ga-eme upgrade iji nọgide na-eso chain (ZIP 206). title: Canopy
description: Canopy malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 1,046,400 (November 18, 2020 UTC).
text: Canopy Canopy malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 1,046,400 (November 18, 2020 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: otu Zcash siri gaa n'ihu na-akwado mmepe nke ya mgbe ụgwọ ndị malitere ya kwụsịrị, na otu Canopy siri guzobe nkewa ego nke network upgrade ndị sochirinụ ka na-ewukwasị n'elu ya. Canopy bụ network upgrade nke ise nke Zcash, a na-akpọkwa ya Network Upgrade 4 (NU4). E tinyere ya n'ọrụ site na ZIP 251, ọ malitekwara ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet block 1,046,400 na November 18, 2020 (UTC), n'otu oge ahụ na halving mbụ nke ụgwọ block nke Zcash. Canopy bụkarị network upgrade gbasara Gọọmentị [governance] na ego. Ọ kwụsịrị ụgwọ mbụ nke ndị malitere ọrụ ahụ ma malite Development Fund [Development Fund] ọhụrụ nke Zcash, nke na-akwụ Electric Coin Company, Zcash Foundation, na ndị natara ikike [grant] nọọrọ onwe ha. Atụmatụ dị n'azụ ego ahụ sitere n'usoro Gọọmentị obodo gbatịrị agbatị na 2019. Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa. Zcash na-akwado mmepe nke ya site n'ụgwọ block, n'ihi na o nweghị ụlọ ọrụ n'azụ ya. E debere ụgwọ ndị malitere ọrụ ahụ, nke kwụrụ ụgwọ maka afọ mbụ ya, ka ọ kwụsị na halving mbụ. Canopy bụ ihe nọchiri ya: ọ duziri akụkụ e debere nke ụgwọ block ọ bụla n'ime Development Fund ma kpebie ndị ga-anata ya. Network upgrade ndị sochirinụ mezigharịrị usoro ahụ, ruo NU6.1. Ego mmepe Canopy kwụsịrị ụgwọ mbụ nke ndị malitere ọrụ ahụ ma jiri Development Fund nke Zcash dochie ya. Mgbanwe ahụ mere n'otu block ahụ na halving mbụ nke Zcash, mgbe ụgwọ block dara site na 6.25 ZEC ruo 3.125 ZEC. Ya mere, ndị na-egwụputa [miners] hụrụ ka e belatara ụgwọ ha ọkara n'otu ụbọchị ahụ akụkụ ọhụrụ nke obere ụgwọ ahụ malitere ịga n'ime mmepe. E debere ego ahụ ka ọ rụọ ọrụ afọ anọ, site na halving mbụ a na November 2020 ruo halving nke abụọ na 2024. Edepụtara amụma ekwenyere na ya dịka ZIP 1014. Usoro consensus [consensus] nke na-ebugharị ego ahụ n'ezie bụ usoro funding stream: ZIP 207 webatara ụzọ zuru oke iji duzie akụkụ nke subsidy block gaa n'aka ndị natara akọwapụtara, ebe ZIP 214 debere iwu kpọmkwem na Adreesị akpa ego ndị nnata maka Development Fund. Otu e si ekewa ego ahụ Development Fund na-ewere pasent 20 nke ụgwọ block ọ bụla. Ndị na-egwụputa na-edobe pasent 80 fọdụrụ. A na-ekewa pasent 20 ahụ ụzọ atọ, dịka ZIP 1014 siri dị. Pasent 35 gaa na Project Bootstrap, nzukọ nne nke Electric Coin Company. Pasent 25 gaa na Zcash Foundation. Pasent 40 gaa na Major Grants, nke na-akwado ọrụ nọọrọ onwe ya ma Zcash Foundation na-elekọta ya. Major Grants mechara ghọọ Zcash Community Grants (ZCG). Mgbe e jiri ụgwọ block niile tụọ ya kama naanị ego ahụ, oke ndị a ghọrọ pasent 7 maka Electric Coin Company, pasent 5 maka Zcash Foundation, na pasent 8 maka Major Grants. Ụzọ abụọ a e si akọwa ya na-enye otu ọnụọgụ ahụ. Mgbanwe pool nke Sprout Canopy malitekwara ịkwụsị pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded] kacha ochie. Sprout bụ pool nke e chebere echebe mbụ nke Zcash, ma Canopy malitere ibelata ya site na ZIP 211. Site n'oge Canopy malitere ịrụ ọrụ, enweghị ike itinye uru ọhụrụ n'ime pool Sprout. N'asụsụ teknụzụ, ubi vpubold nke JoinSplit ọ bụla ga-abụrịrị efu. A ka nwere ike iwepụ ego dịlarị na Sprout, yabụ enweghị onye a na-egbochi, mana pool ahụ nwere ike ịdalata naanị site ugbu a gawa. Nke a bụ nzọụkwụ mbụ iji mesịa kwụsị pool Sprout ochie ma họrọ pool ndị ọhụrụ nke e chebere echebe. Ihe mgbakwunye teknụzụ N'akụkụ mgbanwe ego, Canopy bu ZIP teknụzụ abụọ pere mpe. ZIP 212 gbanwere otú onye nnata si amepụta ihe nzuzo ephemeral nke Sapling, site n'ịmepụta ya n'okwu nkịtị note [note]. ZIP 215 depụtara iwu doro anya maka ịkwado signatures [signatures] Ed25519, ka node ọ bụla kwekọrịta kpọmkwem signatures ndị a na-ewere dị ka ndị ziri ezi. Nchịkọta dị mkpirikpi (TL;DR) Canopy (NU4) malitere ọrụ na block 1,046,400 nke mainnet (November 18, 2020 UTC). Ọ bụ otu block ahụ ka halving mbụ nke Zcash mere, nke belatara ụgwọ block site na 6.25 ruo 3.125 ZEC. title: Crosslink Protocol
description: Protocol Crosslink bụ mmepe dị mkpa n'ime mmalite Zcash, na-eduga ya n'ebe ụdị Proof-of-Stake (PoS) Ngwakọ na Proof-of-Work (PoW) dị. PoW ọdịnala, n'agbanyeghị…
text: Crosslink Protocol TL;DR Protocol Crosslink bụ atụmatụ a tụrụ aro maka ogbo Proof-of-Work/Proof-of-Stake (PoW/PoS) ngwakọ nke Zcash. Ọ na-ejikọta PoW na protocol Nnagide Njehie Byzantine (Byzantine Fault Tolerance, BFT), na-eme ka njedebe a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi kwe omume ma ọ bụrụhaala na PoW ma ọ bụ PoS ka dị nchebe. PoS ngwakọ na-ewebata ndị notary na-akwado blocks dabere na ZEC e tinyere na Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ — na mbụ ha anaghị agbanwe agbanwe, emesịa a họpụta ha dabere na ZEC e tinyere na Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ. Crosslink na-achọ inye akwụkwọ ndekọ abụọ: akwụkwọ ndekọ emechara (finalized ledger, LOGfin) maka nchekwa megide iweghachi azụ, na akwụkwọ ndekọ nwere obere oge nchere (lower-latency ledger, LOGba) nke na-agbatị ya n'ihe na-erughị L blocks. Ụdị Nchekwa (Safety Mode) na-arụ ọrụ ma ọ bụrụ na akwụkwọ ndekọ emechara ada azụ karịa L blocks: PoW na-aga n'ihu, mana ọrụ akụ na ụba na-akwụsị ruo mgbe a doziri nsogbu ahụ. Ka oge na-aga, ndị nkwado PoS ga-enweta akụkụ na-abawanye nke ụgwọ ọrụ, nke ga-ebelata ego ndị onye na-egwụputa PoW na-enweta; protocol ahụ na-ewebata mgbanwe nwayọọ nwayọọ. Shielded Labs na-emepụta protocol ahụ, yana ụzọ nhazi maka ijikọta Crosslink 2 n'ime client Zebra nke Zcash. Crosslink anaghị arụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash. Ọ na-arụ na Feature Net nke Shielded Labs, bụ network nnwale nke onye ọ bụla nwere ike isonye na ya. Lee “Ebe Crosslink ruru” n'okpuru. Nkọwa Isi Mmeghe: PoS Ngwakọ Zcash na Protocol Crosslink Protocol Crosslink bụ mmepe dị mkpa n'ime mmalite Zcash, na-eduga ya n'ebe ụdị Proof-of-Stake (PoS) Ngwakọ na Proof-of-Work (PoW) dị. PoW ọdịnala, n'agbanyeghị na ọ bụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi n'ichekwa network, na-eche nkatọ ihu maka oriri ume na ihe ize ndụ nke ịchịkọta ike metụtara ịgwụputa ụlọ ọrụ. Crosslink na-ewebata usoro ngwakọ, na-ejikọta ike egosipụtara nke PoW na uru arụmọrụ na Gọọmentị nke PoS. Mgbanwe a dabara n'usoro zuru ụwa ọnụ nke mmepụta ọhụrụ na blockchain, ebe ọrụ na-agbanwe gaa n'usoro ndị dịgide gburugburu ebe obibi ma bụrụ decentralized. Ụdị consensus abụọ nke Crosslinks na-ahụ na Zcash na-edobe nkwa Nzuzo kriptografik ya siri ike ka ọ na-agbanwe iji zute ihe ịma aka nke oge a. Ụzọ Proof-of-Stake (PoS) ngwakọ na-ejikọta Proof-of-Work (PoW) ọdịnala na PoS, na-achọ idozi adịghị ike dịka mwakpo 51% ebe ọ na-edobe decentralized ma na-ebelata oriri ume. PoS ngwakọ na-ewebata ndị notary na-akwado blocks dabere na ZEC e tinyere na Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ. E mere usoro a iji melite nchekwa chain na nkwado checkpoint, na-enye nhọrọ siri ike karịa usoro PoW dị ọcha. Gịnị mere PoS/PoW ngwakọ ji bụrụ nnwale mbụ? Ọ na-eme ka e nwee ọganihu n'ebe PoS dị ọcha nọ. Ọ na-eme ka Ojiji ịgwụputa na Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ na-aga n'otu oge, yana njikọta gburugburu ebe obibi, kwe omume. Ọ na-ebelata nsogbu nchekwa nwere ike ịdị na protocol PoS ruo mgbe o nwetara nnukwu ego ndị nkwado tinyere na ntụkwasị obi ka ukwuu. Ethereum egosila ụzọ izugbe a n'ọrụ mmepụta. Ihe Crosslink bụ Protocol Crosslink bụ atụmatụ a tụrụ aro maka ogbo Proof-of-Work/Proof-of-Stake (PoW/PoS) ngwakọ nke Zcash. Ọ na-ejikọta PoW na protocol Nnagide Njehie Byzantine (BFT), na-eme ka njedebe a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi kwe omume ma ọ bụrụhaala na PoW ma ọ bụ PoS ka dị nchebe. Atụmatụ a na-achọ ime ka nchekwa network na decentralized sie ike site n'itinye nkwado e tinyere na Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ, ebe ọ na-edobe isonye nke ndị onye na-egwụputa. Otu njirimara dị mkpa nke atụmatụ a, a kpọrọ Crosslink 2, na-eme ka nhazi ahụ dị mfe site n'ijikọta ndị na-atụ aro BFT na ndị onye na-egwụputa. Ụzọ a e mere ka ọ dị nkenke na-ebelata mgbanwe nhazi ma na-enye ohere iji oyi akwa BFT “adịgboroja”, na-eme ka ọ dị mfe ịnwale ma tinye n'ọrụ ebe a na-edobe ụkpụrụ nchekwa dị elu. Atụmatụ mmejuputa gụnyere ụzọ nhazi nwere ụgwọ injinịa e mere atụmatụ maka ijikọta Crosslink 2 n'ime client Zebra nke Zcash. Nbugharị a n'usoro na-elekwasị anya n'ịhazigharị mkpali ndị metụtara ya, ibelata ọgbaghara, na ime ka ọ dabara n'ebumnuche Zcash maka scaling, ịdị mfe iji, na decentr

title: FROST
description: Schnorr signature dijitalụ bụ otu algọridim: (KeyGen, Sign, Verify).
text: FROST Na nkenke FROST (Signature Oke Ọnụọgụ Schnorr Nke Emebere Maka Oge) bụ signature oke ọnụọgụ na usoro imepụta igodo ekesara ekesa: ọtụtụ ndị na-abinye aka n'aka na-ejide òkè nke otu igodo nzuzo, ma ọnụ ọgụgụ a kara aka n'ime ha ga-arụkọ ọrụ iji mepụta otu signature. N'ihi na nsonaazụ ya bụ otu Schnorr signature, Azụmahia e mere n'ụzọ a na-adị ka Azụmahia nkịtị na netwọkụ. Ọ chọrọ obere oge nkwukọrịta, ọ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n'otu oge, ma nwee ike ịchọpụta ma wepụ onye sonyere na-adịghị akpa àgwà ọma. Maka Zcash, nke a pụtara na FROST na-enyere ọtụtụ ndị dị n'ebe dị iche iche aka ijikwa ikike imefu nke ZEC nke e chebere echebe — nke bara uru maka nlekọta ego, escrow, ọrụ ndị na-abụghị Onye nlekota, na Zcash Shielded Assets (ZSA). Chelsea Komlo (Mahadum Waterloo, Zcash Foundation) na Ian Goldberg (Mahadum Waterloo) mepụtara ya. Nkọwa Isi Gịnị bụ Schnorr signature? Schnorr signature dijitalụ bụ otu algọridim: (KeyGen, Sign, Verify). Schnorr signature nwere ọtụtụ uru. Otu uru dị mkpa bụ na mgbe eji ọtụtụ igodo binye otu ozi aka, enwere ike ijikọta signature ndị si na ya pụta ka ọ bụrụ otu signature. Nke a nwere ike ibelata oke Kwụọ ụhwọ multisig na Azụmahia ndị ọzọ metụtara multisig nke ukwuu. Gịnị bụ FROST? Signature Oke Ọnụọgụ Schnorr Nke Emebere Maka Oge - Chelsea Komlo (Mahadum Waterloo, Zcash Foundation) na Ian Goldberg (Mahadum Waterloo) mepụtara ya. FROST bụ signature oke ọnụọgụ na usoro imepụta igodo ekesara ekesa nke chọrọ obere oge nkwukọrịta ma nwee ike ịrụ ọrụ n'otu oge. Usoro FROST bụ ụdị oke ọnụọgụ nke atụmatụ signature Schnorr. N'adịghị ka signature n'ọnọdụ otu onye, signature oke ọnụọgụ chọrọ mmekorita n'etiti ọnụ ọgụgụ a kara aka nke ndị na-abinye aka n'aka, onye ọ bụla na-ejide òkè nke otu igodo nzuzo. Gịnị bụ Signature Oke Ọnụọgụ? Chelsea Komlo - Zcon3 N'ihi ya, imepụta signature n'ọnọdụ oke ọnụọgụ na-ebute mgbakwunye ọrụ n'ihi oge netwọkụ n'etiti ndị na-abinye aka n'aka, nke na-eme ka ọ dị ọnụ mgbe echekwara òkè nzuzo n'ime ngwaọrụ nwere oke netwọkụ ma ọ bụ mgbe nhazi na-eme n'elu netwọkụ ndị na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi. A na-ebelata mgbakwunye ọrụ netwọkụ n'oge ọrụ ịbanye aka site n'iji usoro ọhụrụ na-echebe megide mwakpo ụgha ma nwekwara ike itinye n'ọrụ n'atụmatụ ndị ọzọ. FROST na-eme ka usoro signature oke ọnụọgụ ka mma site n'ikwe ka e rụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ na-enweghị oke nke ọrụ signature n'enweghị nsogbu n'otu oge (concurrency). Enwere ike iji ya dị ka usoro nke oge 2, ebe ndị na-abinye aka n'aka na-eziga ma nata ozi 2 n'ozuzu, ma ọ bụ dị ka usoro ịbanye aka nke otu oge emeziworo nke nwere ọkwa nhazi tupu oge eruo. FROST na-enweta mmelite arụmọrụ ya n'akụkụ ụfọdụ site n'ikwe ka usoro ahụ kwụsị ma ọ bụrụ na onye sonyere na-adịghị akpa àgwà ọma nọ, nke a na-achọpụta ma wepụ ya n'ọrụ ndị ga-abịa. A na-enye proofs nchekwa na-egosi na FROST nwere nchekwa megide mwakpo ozi a họọrọ, ma ọ bụrụ na nsogbu logarithm discrete siri ike, na onye mmegide na-achịkwa ndị sonyere dị ole na ole karịa oke ọnụọgụ, ebe a. Kedu ka FROST si arụ ọrụ? Usoro FROST nwere akụkụ abụọ dị mkpa: Nke mbụ, ndị sonyere n na-eme usoro imepụta igodo ekesara ekesa (DKG) iji mepụta otu igodo nkwenye. Na ngwụcha, onye sonyere ọ bụla na-enweta òkè igodo nzuzo na òkè igodo nkwenye ọha. Mgbe e mesịrị, ndị sonyere t-n'ime-n ọ bụla nwere ike ịme usoro ịbanye aka oke ọnụọgụ iji rụkọọ ọrụ mepụta signature Schnorr ziri ezi. Ihe Nlereanya / Ntụnyere Chee FROST dịka igbe nchekwa nke na-emeghe naanị mgbe ọtụtụ ndị ejidere igodo nwere ikike tụgharịrị igodo ha ọnụ — mana ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla ji igodo ka achọrọ; naanị ọnụ ọgụgụ e debere (dịka ọmụmaatụ, 3 n'ime 5 ọ bụla). Ozugbo igbe ahụ mepere, onye na-ekiri n'èzí enweghị ike ịmata ndị ji igodo pụtara, ma ọ bụ ọbụna na ihe karịrị otu onye sonyere. N'otu ụzọ ahụ, otu nwere ike ikwenye Azụmahia Zcash ọnụ ebe netwọkụ na-ahụ naanị otu signature dị ka nke nkịtị. Nkọwa Miri Emi Imepụta igodo ekesara ekesa (DKG) Ebumnuche nke ọkwa a bụ imepụta òkè igodo nzuzo na-adịte aka na otu igodo nkwenye. Ndị sonyere n na-eme ọkwa a. FRO

title: FROST & Nlekọta Nchekwa Nso Maka ZEC Nke E Chebere Echebe
description: Maka nkọwa zuru ezu gbasara cryptography nke protocol FROST, lee peeji teknụzụ FROST.
text: FROST & Nlekọta Nchekwa Nso Maka ZEC Nke E Chebere Echebe Maka nkọwa zuru ezu gbasara cryptography nke protocol FROST, lee peeji teknụzụ FROST. Nlekọta nchekwa nso [threshold custody] nke FROST na-apụta ugboro ugboro na mkparịta ụka Zcash — ọ bụ ụzọ kacha elu na Hackathon 2026 nke ZecHub — mana anaghị akọwa echiche a mgbe niile n'asụsụ dị mfe. Peeji a na-akọwa ihe ọ pụtara, mgbe ị chọrọ ya n'ezie, uru na ọghọm ya, yana ngwá ọrụ ndị na-akwado ya taa. --- Na nkenke FROST na-enye ìgwè ndị ji mkpịsị ugodi ohere ijikọ ọnụ chịkwaa Adreesị akpa ego [address] Zcash nke e chebere echebe, na-enweghị onye ọ bụla ijide mkpịsị ugodi nzuzo zuru ezu. Nso t-n'ime-n [t-of-n] pụtara: mmadụ t ga-ebinye signature ọnụ iji mefu ego; mmadụ t-1 ma ọ bụ ole na ole karịa nke ahụ enweghị ike ịkwaga ego ahụ naanị ha. Azụmahia [transaction] ndị ahụ dị ka Azụmahia ọ bụla ọzọ nke e chebere echebe — enweghị akara on-chain na-egosi na ejiri mbinye signature nọ nso mee ya. Nke a dị iche kpamkpam na multisig Oha [transparent] (nke bụ nke ọha on-chain ma Zcash akwadowo ya ogologo oge) — FROST na-arụ ọrụ n'ime pool nke e chebere echebe. Ọ bara uru maka DAO, exchange, ọrụ nlekọta nchekwa, nchekwa ego jikọtara ọnụ, na Ebe nchekwa ego [treasury] nke otu — ebe ọ bụla ọdịda nke otu mkpịsị ugodi na-adịghị anabata. --- Gịnị bụ FROST n'asụsụ dị mfe? Chee na ndị mmekọ azụmahịa atọ ji nke ọ bụla n'ime ha otu akụkụ nke mkpịsị ugodi. Iji mefu ego sitere na e-akpa ego ha jikọtara ọnụ, mmadụ abụọ ọ bụla n'ime ha atọ ga-ekwenye ma binye signature ọnụ. Azụmahia ga-esi na ya pụta yiri izipu ego nke onye ọ bụla mgbe niile — onye na-ekiri enweghị ike ịmata site na blockchain na ọtụtụ mmadụ sonyere. FROST (Flexible Round-Optimized Schnorr Threshold Signatures) bụ protocol cryptography na-eme ka nke a kwe omume maka Zcash nke e chebere echebe. Chelsea Komlo (Mahadum Waterloo / Zcash Foundation) na Ian Goldberg mepụtara ya. Njirimara ndị bụ isi: Nso [Threshold]: naanị ndị binye signature t-n'ime-n kwesịrị isonye (dịka 2-n'ime-3, 3-n'ime-5) Nke e chebere echebe [Shielded]: ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ime pool Nzuzo [privacy] nke Orchard — ọnụọgụ ego, onye zitere, na onye natara na-anọgide na nzuzo Enweghị ike ịmata ọdịiche [Indistinguishable]: signature ikpeazụ yiri Azụmahia Zcash nke e chebere echebe ọ bụla ọzọ Na-enweghị onye nlekota [Non-custodial]: ọ dịghị otu akụkụ ọ bụla na-ejide mkpịsị ugodi zuru ezu — ọbụnadị onye nhazi --- Kedu mgbe ị kwesịrị iji nlekọta nchekwa nso? Nlekọta nchekwa nso bara uru mgbe ịla n'iyi otu mkpịsị ugodi ma ọ bụ otu onye ekwesịghị ịpụta ịla n'iyi ego ahụ. Ọnọdụ Ihe mere nlekọta nchekwa nso ji enyere aka ----------- ---------------------------- DAO ma ọ bụ Ebe nchekwa ego otu Ọ dịghị otu admin nwere ike ịwepụ ego naanị ya; ọ chọrọ consensus [consensus] Exchange ma ọ bụ onye nlekota Ọ na-ekesa ihe ize ndụ mkpịsị ugodi n'etiti mpaghara nchekwa ma ọ bụ ndị ọrụ Nchekwa oyi nke onwe (ya na ezinụlọ ntụkwasị obi) 2-n'ime-3 n'etiti gị na ndị ezinụlọ abụọ — ọ bụrụ na ị nwụọ ma ọ bụ tufuo ohere, ego ahụ agaghị efu Escrow Onye zụrụ, onye rere, na onye ikpe nke ọ bụla ji otu òkè; a na-ahapụ ego mgbe mmadụ abụọ kwenyere Nkesa ikike [grant] bara nnukwu uru Ụdị ZCG: ọ chọrọ ọtụtụ ndị binye signature nọọrọ onwe ha tupu a kwụọ ụgwọ Nlekọta mkpịsị ugodi onye mmepụta [developer] Gbochie egwu sitere n'ime — ọ dịghị otu injinia nwere ike ịwepụ ego protocol naanị ya O yikarịrị ka ị anaghị achọ nlekọta nchekwa nso maka e-akpa ego nke onwe ị na-achị naanị gị, ego ole na ole, ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ ebe mgbakwunye nhazi karịrị mbelata ihe ize ndụ. --- Kedu ka ọ si dị iche na multisig Oha? Zcash akwadowo multisig Oha ogologo oge — ọtụtụ mkpịsị ugodi chọrọ iji mefu ego sitere na t-address.
