title: Full Nodes
description: Full Node bụ sọftụwia na-arụ otu zuru ezu nke blockchain cryptocurrency, nke na-enye gị ohere iji atụmatụ protocol ahụ.
text: Full Nodes TL;DR full node na-edobe otu zuru ezu nke Zcash blockchain ma na-enyocha block ọhụrụ na Azụmahia [transaction] ọ bụla megide iwu consensus. Zebra (zebrad) bụ node a ga-etinye taa. Zakura bụ mmejuputa nke abụọ, nke e wepụtara site na Zebra. zcashd alala ezumike nka. A ruru nkwụsị End-of-Support ya na 18 Julaị 2026 n'ogo block 3417100, node ndị ahụ anaghịkwa amalite. node na e-akpa ego [wallet] bụzi mmemme dị iche iche. Zallet na-arụ ọrụ megide node ma na-edobe igodo. Ịrụ node nke gị na-enye gị nkwenye nọọrọ onwe ya ma wepụ mkpa ịtụkwasị sava onye ọzọ obi. Nkọwa Isi Full Node bụ sọftụwia na-arụ otu zuru ezu nke blockchain cryptocurrency, nke na-enye gị ohere iji atụmatụ protocol ahụ. Ọ na-edobe ndekọ zuru ezu nke Azụmahia ọ bụla mere kemgbe genesis, ya mere ọ nwere ike ikwenye izi ezi nke Azụmahia na block ọhụrụ ndị a gbakwunyere na blockchain. Mmejuputa Node Zebra Zebra bụ mmejuputa full node nọọrọ onwe ya, dị njikere maka mmepụta, nke protocol Zcash, nke Zcash Foundation mepụtara ma dee ya na Rust. Ebe zcashd lara ezumike nka, Zebra (zebrad) bụ full node akwadoro maka ntinye ọhụrụ. Zebra na-akwado block na Azụmahia, na-esonye na netwọk peer-to-peer, ma na-ekpughe interface RPC maka ngwa. e-akpa ego bụzi akụrụngwa dị iche: Zallet na-arụ ọrụ megide node Zebra ma na-ahụ maka igodo na nguzozi. Nke a na-edochi zcashd, nke jikọtara node na e-akpa ego n'otu usoro. Iji jeere e-akpa ego ọkụ nke e chebere echebe [shielded] ozi, node na-arụkọ ọrụ na indexer, ma ọ bụ lightwalletd e guzobeworo ma ọ bụ Zaino ọhụrụ. Jide n'aka na ị gụrụ akwụkwọ Zebra maka ntụziaka nhazi, ma sonye na sava R&D Discord maka nkwado. GitHub Akwụkwọ Zebra Lee Zebra Full Node maka usoro nrụnye, nhazi, na ihe achọrọ maka ngwaike. Zakura Zakura bụ full node nke abụọ dabara na consensus, nke e wepụtara site na Zebra ma Valar Group na Project Tachyon mepụtara ọnụ. Ọ na-agbaso otu iwu protocol ahụ ma tinye mmekọrịta ngwa ngwa, ihichapụ block, na oyi akwa ndakọrịta RPC zcashd. Lee Zakura Node. zcashd (lara ezumike nka) Rịba ama: zcashd alala ezumike nka. Electric Coin Company kwuputara ịkwụsị ya, ma a ruru nkwụsị End-of-Support akpaka na 18 Julaị 2026 n'ogo block 3417100. Node zcashd 6.20.0 ọ bụla a na-agbanweghị kwụsịrị n'ogo ahụ ma jụ ịmaliteghachi, sọftụwia ahụ anaghịkwa akwado NU6.3. Jiri Zebra. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere zcashd wallet.dat, soro Ntuziaka Mbugharị: zcashd gaa zebrad/Zallet. zcashd bụ mmejuputa Full Node mbụ maka Zcash, nke Electric Coin Company mepụtara ma na-elekọta. A na-edobe ntụziaka iwu dị n'okpuru maka ntụaka na maka ndị ọrụ na-ahapụ zcashd. zcashd na-ekpughe otu API site na interface RPC ya. API ndị a na-enye ọrụ na-eme ka ngwa ndị dị n'èzí nwee ike iso node na-emekọrịta. lightwalletd bụ ọmụmaatụ ngwa na-eji full node eme ka ndị mmepụta nwee ike iwulite ma lekọta e-akpa ego ọkụ nke e chebere echebe dabara maka ekwentị na-enweghị iso zcashd na-emekọrịta ozugbo. Ndepụta zuru ezu nke iwu RPC akwadoro Akwụkwọ zcashd Malite Node (Linux) Wụnye Ihe Ndị A Chọrọ sudo apt update sudo apt-get install \ build-essential pkg-config libc6-dev m4 g++-multilib \ autoconf libtool ncurses-dev unzip git python3 python3-zmq \ zlib1g-dev curl bsdmainutils automake libtinfo5 Clone mwepụta kachasị ọhụrụ, checkout, hazie ma wuo: git clone https://github.com/zcash/zcash.git cd zcash/ git checkout v5.4.1 ./zcutil/fetch-params.sh ./zcutil/clean.sh ./zcutil/build.sh -j$(nproc) Mekọrịta Blockchain (nwere ike iwe ọtụtụ awa) Iji malite node, gbaa: ./src/zcashd A na-echekwa Igodo Nzuzo na /.zcash/wallet.dat Ntuziaka maka zcashd na Raspberry Pi Mmetụta Bara Uru Netwọk Site n'ịrụ full node, ị na-enyere aka ime ka netwọk zcash sie ike site n'ịkwado decentralized [decentralized] ya. Nke a na-enyere aka igbochi njikwa ndị iro ma mee ka netwọk ahụ nwee ike iguzogide ụdị ụfọdụ nke ọgba aghara. DNS seeders na-ekpughe ndepụta node ndị ọzọ a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi site na sava arụnyere n'ime ya. Nke a na-eme ka Azụmahia gbasaa na netwọk dum. Ọnụọgụ Netwọk Ndị a bụ ikpo okwu ọmụmaatụ na-eny

title: Halo
description: Halo bụ usoro proof zero-knowledge na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi, nke na-emeghachi onwe ya, nke Sean Bowe chọpụtara na Electric Coin Co. Ọ na-ewepụ mkpa trusted…
text: Halo Na nkenke Halo bụ usoro proof zero-knowledge na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi, nke na-emeghachi onwe ya, nke Sean Bowe chọpụtara na Electric Coin Co. Ọ na-ewepụ mkpa trusted setup ma mee ka nchikọta proof na-emeghachi onwe ya bụrụ ihe bara uru, nke bụ ntọala nke atụmatụ scaling na nchekwa ugbu a nke Zcash. Ihe ọ bụ: ihe owuwu zk-SNARK nwere recursion dị irè na-enweghị emume trusted setup. Ihe mere o ji dị mkpa: pool nke e chebere echebe Orchard nke Zcash, nke e mere ka ọ rụọ ọrụ na NU5 n’afọ 2022, na-arụ ọrụ na Halo 2 — mmejuputa nyocha a maka iji n’ezi ụwa. Njirimara dị mkpa: enweghị “toxic waste” sitere n’emume nhazi, yana proof ndị nwere ike ịgba akaebe maka proof ndị ọzọ na-enweghị oke a pụrụ itinye n’ọrụ. Ikikere: Halo 2 bụ open source n’okpuru MIT na Apache 2.0, ya mere onye ọ bụla nọ n’usoro gburugburu nwere ike iwulite n’elu ya. --- Nkọwa Isi Halo bụ usoro proof zero-knowledge na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi, nke na-emeghachi onwe ya, nke Sean Bowe chọpụtara na Electric Coin Co. Ọ na-ewepụ trusted setup ma kwe ka blockchain Zcash nweta scaling ka ukwuu. Halo bụ usoro proof zero-knowledge mbụ nke dị irè ma na-emeghachi onwe ya — nke a na-elekarị anya dịka nnukwu ọganihu sayensị. Akụkụ abụọ ahụ Atụmatụ Polynomial Commitment dị mkpirikpi. Ọ na-enye onye na-eme commitment ohere ime commitment na polynomial site n’ahịrịokwu dị mkpirikpi nke onye na-enyocha nwere ike iji kwado nlele a kwupụtara maka polynomial e mere commitment na ya. Polynomial Interactive Oracle Proof. Onye na-enyocha na-arịọ onye na-enye proof (algọridim) ka o mepee commitment niile n’ebe ọ họọrọ, site n’iji atụmatụ polynomial commitment, wee nyochaa na njirimara ahụ bụ eziokwu n’etiti ha. Enweghị trusted setup Ụfọdụ nhazi zk-SNARK, dịka Groth16, chọrọ trusted setup iji mepụta parampita ọha ha, nke a na-akpọkarị ahịrịokwu ntụaka nkịtị (common reference string, CRS). A na-ekekọrịta CRS ahụ na ndị na-enye proof na ndị na-enyocha proof; ọ bụghị ihe nzuzo a ga-ebibi. A ghaghị ịtụfu ihe etiti nzuzo (“toxic waste”) sitere na nhazi dị otú ahụ. Mgbakọ nchekwa nke ọtụtụ ndị sonyere nwere ike ikesa ntụkwasị obi ahụ: emume ahụ dị nchebe ma ọ bụrụ na opekata mpe otu onye sonyere na-agbaso protocol ma bibie onyinye nzuzo ya. Lee ECC nkọwa banyere parampita ọha na toxic waste. Pool nke e chebere echebe Sprout na Sapling mbụ nke Zcash jiri usoro proving trusted setup, BCTV14 na Groth16 n'otu n'otu. Parameeta ọha ha [public parameters] ka dị maka ịmepụta proof na nyocha. Ihe na-echegbu bụ ma echekwala ihe nzuzo e ji hazie usoro ahụ, nke nwere ike ikwe ka e mepụta proof ụgha; ibipụta CRS n'onwe ya bụ ihe a na-atụ anya ya, ọ naghị ekpughe ihe nzuzo ahụ. Halo na-ejikọta nhazi proof na-alaghachi n’onwe ya [recursive proof composition] na atụmatụ commitment polynomial [polynomial commitment scheme] dabere na arụmụka inner product. Oke ọhaneze ya [public parameters] anaghị achọ emume trusted setup ma ọ bụ mbibi trapdoor nzuzo nke nhazi mbụ [secret setup trapdoor]. Akwụkwọ Halo 2 na-akọwa oke group ndị a nke ọhaneze. Nke a dị iche na ime ka structured reference string nke emume mepụtara nwee ike imelite. Iwepụ ihe a chọrọ maka nhazi a na-ezere ịdabere na mbibi nke ihe nzuzo e ji eme emume maka proof Halo. Ọ naghị egosi na emume Sprout ma ọ bụ Sapling gara aga enweghị mmebi, ma ọ bụ kwado na mgbanwe protocol niile e mere mgbe e mesịrị dị nchebe. Proof recursive na-agba akaebe banyere mgbako ndị etinyere na sekit ha, n'okpuru echiche nke usoro proof. Sekit na mmejuputa ziri ezi ka dị mkpa; nkọwa mbugharị Halo 2 nke ECC na-ekwu kpọmkwem maka ihe ize ndụ nke bugs ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ntụpọ dị na nhazi. Sean Bowe's nkọwa na Dystopia Labs --- Ihe Anya / Ntụnyere Chain onye notary Chee maka zk-SNARK nkịtị dị ka akwụkwọ notari kwadoro: otu stampụ, otu nyocha, agwụla. Ugbu a chee na ị chọrọ igosi na mkpokọta akwụkwọ puku iri bụ nke eziokwu. Enweghị ntughari [recursion], onye na-enyocha ga-enyocha stampụ ọ bụla. Halo na-atụgharị akwụkwọ ọ bụla a nyochara ka ọ bụrụ stampụ n’akwụkwọ na-esote, ruo mgbe ikpo a

title: Heartwood
description: Heartwood malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 903,000 (Julaị 16, 2020 UTC).
text: Heartwood Heartwood malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 903,000 (Julaị 16, 2020 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: otu Heartwood si kwe ka ndị na-egwụputa [miners] nata ụgwọ block ha ozugbo n'ime Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe [shielded addresses], na otu o si mee ka light client nwee ike lelee proof-of-work nke Zcash. Heartwood bụ Zcash network upgrade, hard fork nke iwu consensus ya, bụ nke e kọwara mbinye ya n'ime ZIP 250. O jikọtara mgbanwe atụmatụ abụọ: ZIP 213 (Shielded Coinbase) na ZIP 221 (FlyClient). Heartwood bụ network upgrade ukwu nke anọ nke Zcash, ma Electric Coin Company na Zcash Foundation kwadoro ya ọnụ. Dị ka network upgrade Zcash ọ bụla, o setịpụrụ consensus branch id ọhụrụ, tag nke na-enye nchebe replay ụzọ abụọ ka Azụmahia [transaction] e wuru n'okpuru iwu ọhụrụ ghara imegharị na chain ochie, na nke ọzọkwa. Heartwood na-arụ ọrụ na elu block e setịpụrụ (903,000), ọ bụghị n'oge elekere e debere, ya mere nkeji kpọmkwem ị hụrụ na dashboard nwere ike ịdịtụ iche site n'otu ebe ruo ebe ọzọ. Block ahụ, na oge ahụ, bụ otu. Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa. Ndị na-egwụputa [miners] na-enweta ZEC ndị e mepụtara ọhụrụ oge ọ bụla ha na-egwupụta [mining] block. Tupu Heartwood, ego mbata ahụ ga-abanyerịrị n’Adreesị akpa ego Oha [transparent], nke mmadụ niile pụrụ ịhụ. Onye ọ bụla nwere ike ilele ego onye na-egwụputa nwetara na ebe mkpụrụ ego ndị ahụ gara ọzọ. Heartwood mere ka ụgwọ ọrụ ahụ banye ozugbo n’Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe [shielded] kama, ya mere ụgwọ onye na-egwụputa pụrụ ịnọgide na-adị Nzuzo [privacy]. Ọ mekwara ka o kwe omume ka e-akpa ego dị fechaa [lightweight wallets] na chain ndị ọzọ lelee proof-of-work nke Zcash n’enweghị ibudata chain ahụ dum. Shielded coinbase Azụmahia coinbase [coinbase transaction] bụ Azụmahia pụrụ iche na-akwụ ụgwọ block. Tupu Heartwood, outputs ya aghaghị ịbụ Oha, ya mere ZEC ZEC onye na-egwụputa gwupụtara ọhụrụ na-amalite ndụ ya mgbe niile na Adreesị akpa ego ọha. Heartwood gbanwere iwu consensus ka, n'okwu ZIP 213, Azụmahia coinbase nwee ike ịnwe Sapling outputs. N'okwu dị mfe, ndị na-egwụputa nwere ike ịnata ụgwọ ozugbo n'ime Adreesị akpa ego Sapling nke e chebere echebe. A ka na-akwado outputs coinbase Oha, ya mere nke a bụ nhọrọ ọhụrụ, ọ bụghị mgbanwe a manyere. Gịnị mere Sapling ji buru ụzọ Shielded coinbase na-elekwasị anya kpọmkwem na Sapling outputs, ma e nwere ihe kpatara ya. ZIP 213 kọwara na network upgrade Sapling wetara mgbanwe n'ọrụ nhazi na mmelite arụmọrụ nke mere ka ichebe ego ozugbo n'ime Azụmahia coinbase kwe omume. Pool nke e chebere echebe mbụ nke Sprout chọrọ ihe onwunwe karịrị akarị iji chebe ego ozugbo n'ime coinbase. Usoro proof na note format nke Sapling dị irè karị mere ka ọ dị mfe ime. Sapling n'onwe ya agbatịkwala iwu ochie nke machibidoro outputs coinbase nke e chebere echebe ka iwu ahụ kpuchiekwa Sapling outputs, ma Heartwood mere ka iwu ahụ dị mfe iji kwe ha. Nke a bụ ezigbo ihe atụ nke otu network upgrade Zcash si ewu n'elu ibe ha: plumbing nke otu upgrade na-aghọ ntọala nke nke ọzọ. FlyClient Heartwood gbanwere kwa ihe header block na-eme commitment na ya. A gbanwere ma kpọgharịa field header a na-akpọbu hashFinalSaplingRoot ka ọ bụrụ hashLightClientRoot. Ugbu a, o na-eme commitment na root nke Merkle Mountain Range (MMR), usoro na-aga n'ihu e wuru n'elu data header na metadata nke block ndị gara aga, dịka timestamps, difficulty targets, roots Sapling, ọrụ a chịkọtara, na ọnụ ọgụgụ Azụmahia. Commitment ahụ na-enye light client, ma ọ bụ chain dị n'èzí, ohere ịkwado proof-of-work nke Zcash site na obere proof nke nha ya na-eto naanị logarithmically dabere n'ogologo chain. Uru ya bụ e-akpa ego light client ka mma na njikọ third-party na cross-chain dị mfe, n'ihi na client agaghịzi ebudata block ọ bụla iji tụkwasị ọrụ dị n'azụ chain obi. Ebe Heartwood dabara Heartwood bụ otu nzọụkwụ n'usoro network upgrade Zcash, nke nke ọ bụla na-agbakwunye akụkụ nke nke na-esote na-adabere na ya. Overwinter na Sapling bịara na 2018, Blossom na 2019, na Heart

title: Ntụle Indexer: Zaino megide Ztreamer
description: Zaino na Ztreamer bụ indexer abụọ na-enye ụkpụrụ lightwallet gRPC, API nke Zcash e-akpa ego dị mfe [light wallets] ji emekọrịta. Peeji a chịkọtara ntụnyere…
text: Ntụle Indexer: Zaino megide Ztreamer Zaino na Ztreamer bụ indexer abụọ na-enye ụkpụrụ lightwallet gRPC, API nke Zcash e-akpa ego dị mfe [light wallets] ji emekọrịta. Peeji a chịkọtara ntụnyere onwe ya, nke a pụrụ imegharị, nke abụọ ahụ: ma ha na-ewepụta otu azịza, oge ha na-ewe iwulite index ha, na ọsọ ha ji eje ozi maka e-akpa ego. Nchịkọta Nkenke Indexer abụọ ahụ na-eweghachi data chain ziri ezi. Azịza ọ bụla enwere ike ịlele megide Zebra kwekọrọ, ya mere e-akpa ego nwere ike iji nke ọ bụla n'ime ha. Ndịiche a chọpụtara bụ nkwekọrịta na ọnọdụ pụrụ iche: koodu njehie, usoro byte nke otu hash, otu esi agụta Adreesị akpa ego oyiri, na ụdị ole na ole nke nzaghachi JSON-RPC. Ztreamer na-ewuli index ya ihe dịka ugboro 6 ngwa ngwa n'otu CPU ahụ. Zaino na-amalite ịza azịza mgbe sekọnd 6 gasịrị site n'ibufe arịrịọ gaa na Zebra ka ọ na-ewuli ya. Ztreamer na-enye ọrụ ngwa ngwa n'ọnọdụ ọ bụla atụnyere: block kwa sekọnd ji ugboro 13–17 karịa maka nbudata e-akpa ego zuru ezu. Ọtụtụ n'ime oge igbu oge nke Zaino sitere n'otu ntọala socket na-efu efu (TCPNODELAY), nke na-agbakwunye ihe dịka 40 ms n'ọtụtụ arịrịọ. Ọ bụ mmezi otu ahịrị. Ihe Atụnyere Wulite Node ndabere Ihe kpatara ya :-- :-- :-- Zaino 0.10.1 Zebra 6.4.2 (backend direct) Mwepụta Zaino kwụsiri ike kachasị ọhụrụ Zaino 0.9.0 Zebra 6.4.2 (backend direct) Ụdị atụnyere na ntụnyere nke Ztreamer bipụtara n'onwe ya Ztreamer v0.1.0 Node Zakura agbakwunyere Tag Ztreamer kachasị ọhụrụ Ztreamer master Zakura 1.5.1 agbakwunyere Ihe ntuziaka nrụnye nke Ztreamer na-ewuli Ha abụọ na-eji atụmatụ dị iche iche: Zaino na-agba dị ka usoro dị iche n'akụkụ full node Zebra, na-agụ ọnọdụ Zebra, ma na-edobe index nke ya. Ọ bụ indexer dị na Z3 stack. Lee Zaino. Ztreamer na-agbakwụnye node Zakura (fork Zebra) n'otu usoro ahụ ma na-edobe index compact-block. Otu Esi Tụọ Ya Otu data maka onye ọ bụla. Wulite ọ bụla malitere site n'otu snapshot testnet Zcash Foundation, nke akpọchiri na elu 4,382,897, ya mere ha niile depụtara kpọmkwem otu chain. Onye ọ bụla nwere ike imegharị ya. Ihe niile na-agba na runners nke GitHub na-akwado n'efu: fork repository ahụ ma gbaa otu workflow. Ọsọ atọ kwa wulite, nke ọ bụla sitere na index efu. Sava na ngwa nrụpụta ibu rụrụ ọrụ na CPU cores dị iche iche. Ndakọrịta: usoro gRPC lightwallet-protocol 20 niile (ọnọdụ ule 274), atụnyere byte maka byte n'etiti wulite ma nyochaa megide JSON-RPC nke Zebra. A nyochakwara usoro JSON-RPC 28 nke Zaino na-enye. Ịrụ ọrụ: oge na akụrụngwa iji wulite index, oge nzaghachi kwa arịrịọ, throughput oke block, ndị ahịa 1 ruo 128 na-arụkọ ọrụ, na nbudata e-akpa ego zuru ezu site na mmalite Sapling ruo n'ọnụ chain. Nsonaazụ Iwulite index Etiti ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ọsọ atọ: Wulite Index zuru oke Azịza mbụ Ogo index na diski :-- --: --: --: Zaino 0.10.1 1,395 s 6 s 22.06 GiB Zaino 0.9.0 1,211 s 6 s 22.06 GiB Ztreamer v0.1.0 216 s 210 s 1.44 GiB Ztreamer master 159 s 158 s 1.44 GiB Zaino bara uru ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ozugbo n'ihi na ọ na-ebufe arịrịọ na Zebra ka ọ na-ewuli. Ztreamer anaghị enye ihe ọ bụla ruo mgbe index ya zuru oke. N'otu ụdị CPU ahụ, Zaino 0.10.1 were oge ji ugboro 6–6.5 karịa Ztreamer v0.1.0 ma jiri oge CPU ji ugboro 7.5–8 karịa (gụnyere Zebra). Inye ọrụ Etiti ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ọsọ atọ, na block kwa sekọnd ma e wezụga ebe ekwuru: Ọnọdụ Zaino 0.10.1 Ztreamer v0.1.0 :-- --: --: Oke block nke block 1,000 11,414 179,486 Nbudata e-akpa ego zuru ezu (280,000 → n'ọnụ) 11,124 189,041 Oke block nke block 1,000, ndị ahịa 128 110,093 229,527 Otu block, ndị ahịa 128 (arịrịọ/s) 6,843 11,044 Site na ndị ahịa 128, ọdịiche ahụ na-adị ihe dịka ugboro 2, n'ihi na sava abụọ ahụ nwere oke CPU cores abụọ. Ala 40 ms Na Zaino, RPC isii n'ime iri na abụọ nwere etiti oge igbu oge ihe dịka 40 ms, RPC ọ bụla nwekwara percentile nke 99 gburugburu 41 ms. Ihe kpatara ya bụ otu Zaino si ahazi onye na-ege gRPC ya: a naghị agbanye nhọrọ socket TCPNODELAY, ya mere sistemụ arụmọrụ na-egbochi obere nzaghachi ruo ihe dịka 40 ms. Ịgbanye nhọrọ ahụ site n'èzí, na-agbanweghị bina

title: Ironwood
description: Ironwood rụrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 3,428,143 n'ụbọchị Julaị 28, 2026 UTC, ma ọ nọgidela na-arụ ọrụ kemgbe ahụ.
text: Ironwood Ironwood rụrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 3,428,143 n'ụbọchị Julaị 28, 2026 UTC, ma ọ nọgidela na-arụ ọrụ kemgbe ahụ. Ihe ị ga-amụta: ihe Ironwood gbanwere, ihe mere ahụhụ dị n'ego zoro ezo ji dị njọ, na otú turnstile si eme ka onye ọ bụla kwado na ọ nweghị ZEC e mepụtara n'ụzọ aghụghọ. Ironwood bụ Zcash network upgrade, nke a na-akpọ n’ụzọ iwu NU6.3, nke na-ewebata pool ọhụrụ nke e chebere echebe nwere otu aha ahụ. A pool nke e chebere echebe bụ nchịkọta ego ndị ọnụego ha na ndị nwe ha na-adị ezoro ezo site na zero-knowledge cryptography. Ironwood dị iji gbochie ma nyochaa mmejọ soundness achọpụtara na pool nke e chebere echebe Orchard dị ugbu a, ma nye obodo ụzọ siri ike karị isi lelee na mkpokọta ọkọnọ nke ZEC bụ eziokwu. Edepụtara iwu consensus ya na ZIP 258. Ihe mere nke a ji dị mkpa. N'ego Oha dịka Bitcoin, onye ọ bụla nwere ike nyochaa na a kpaghị ego n'ụzọ aghụghọ site n'ịgụ ledger ọha. Ego e chebere echebe na-ezo ego ole dị, ya mere ị pụghị ile anya naanị. Kama nke ahụ, cryptography n'onwe ya aghaghị ikwe nkwa na ọ dịghị onye nwere ike imepụta ego na nzuzo. Ironwood dị mkpa n'ihi na achọtara ahụhụ n'ime nkwa ahụ maka pool Orchard. Upgrade ahụ mechiri oghere ahụ ma nye onye ọ bụla ụzọ isi kwado na mkpokọta ọkọnọ ZEC ka bụ eziokwu. Ị dị ọhụrụ na Zcash? Bido na Gịnị bụ ZEC na Zcash na Shielded Pools, wee laghachi ebe a. Ihe mere e ji chọọ Ironwood N'ọgwụgwụ Mee 2026, onye nyocha nchekwa onwe ya bụ Taylor Hornby, mgbe ọ na-eme nyocha protocol maka Shielded Labs, kpughere n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị ahụhụ soundness dị na pool nke e chebere echebe Orchard. Orchard bụ pool ọhụrụ kachasị ọhụrụ nke e chebere echebe nke Zcash n'oge ahụ, mmejọ ahụ dịkwa n'akụkụ elliptic-curve nke circuit zero-knowledge ya, nke ji Halo 2 proving system. Ahụhụ soundness pụtara na mgbakọ na mwepụ nke na-egosi na Azụmahia dị irè anaghị ekwe nkwa ya nke ọma n'ụzọ zuru oke. N'echiche, onye mwakpo nwere ike iji mmejọ ahụ mepụta uru na-adịghị irè n'ime pool Orchard ma mefuo ego na-abụghị nke ya n'ezie, n'enweghị akara node nkịtị ga-ahụ. Turnstile nke Zcash ka machibidoro uru ole nwere ike isi na Orchard pụọ, ya mere a pụghị ịbawanye mkpokọta ọkọnọ, mana cryptography nke pool ahụ n'onwe ya anaghịzi ekwe nkwa na mkpụrụ ego niile zoro ezo dị n'ime ya bụ eziokwu. Ọnụọgụ ndị dị n'elu bụ nkọwa dị mfe. Mmejọ n'ezie dị n'otu akụkụ kpọmkwem nke mgbakọ na mwepụ circuit ahụ, ọ bụghị ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ ego na-abanye na ndị na-apụ n'ezie. Naanị isi ihe ị ga-amụta bụ na ahụhụ soundness nwere ike ikwe ka e mepụta uru n'ime pool n'enweghị nchọpụta. N'ụzọ dị mkpa, ọ nweghị ihe akaebe na e jirila ahụhụ ahụ mee ihe, ọ nweghị ihe akaebe na ego ndị ọrụ metụtara, ọ nweghịkwa ihe akaebe na mkpokọta ọkọnọ ZEC gbanwere. Achọpụtara ya site na nyocha nchekwa ma dozie ya tupu mmerụ ọ bụla a maara. Nzaghachi Obodo Zcash wepụtara mmezi n'ọkwa dị iche iche kama ime ha niile n'otu oge. Ná mmalite Juun 2026, usoro nwa oge kwụsịrị pool Orchard mgbe a na-akwado mmezi zuru oke. Upgrade NU6.2 doziri circuit Orchard n'onwe ya, mechie adịghị ike soundness dị n'okpuru. Upgrade NU6.3, Ironwood, na-ewebata pool ọhụrụ nke e chebere echebe na ebe nlele ọha ka uru wee si n'ọdọ pool Orchard pụọ n'okpuru nyocha zuru oke. Ihe pool Ironwood na-eme NU6.2 chebere circuit Orchard maka Azụmahia ọhụrụ niile, mana uru e mepụtara n'okpuru iwu ochie ka nọ na pool Orchard. Ironwood na-enye uru ahụ ebe ọhụrụ dị ọcha na ụzọ isi nyochaa ya ka ọ na-agagharị. Pool Ironwood bụ pool uru e chebere echebe nke NU6.3 mepụtara na block 3,428,143. Ewubere ya n'elu circuit a doziri ma jiri ụdị note nke enwere ike iweghachite mgbe quantum (nhazi nke na-eme ka e nwee ike iweghachite ego ma ọ bụrụ na quantum computers emebie cryptography nke taa) kọwara na ZIP 2005. Mgbe arụchara ya, pool ochie Orchard na-adị naanị maka mmefu, ya mere uru ọhụrụ enweghị ike ịbanye na ya. Uru ọhụrụ e chebere echebe na-abanye na Ironwood kama. N'ime Ironwood, Azụmahia e chebere echebe ZEC na-edobe Nzuzo nke na-ezo onye zitere, onye natara, na e

title: Zcash Ò Bụ Post-Quantum?
description: Kemgbe network upgrade Ironwood, Zcash bụ nke a pụrụ iweghachite site na quantum [quantum-recoverable] maka ego e jidere na pool Ironwood. Nke ahụ bụ ezigbo…
text: Zcash Ò Bụ Post-Quantum? Azịza dị mkpirikpi Mba, ọ bụghị ugbu a. Kemgbe network upgrade Ironwood, Zcash bụ nke a pụrụ iweghachite site na quantum [quantum-recoverable] maka ego e jidere na pool Ironwood. Nke ahụ bụ ezigbo nzọụkwụ, mana ọ bụghị otu ihe na ịdị nchebe megide post-quantum. ZIP 2005, nkọwapụta dị n'azụ ya, kwuru nke a ozugbo: mgbanwe ahụ "adịghị n'onwe ya eme ka protocol ahụ bụrụ nke e chebere megide ndị mmegide quantum". Ọ na-akwadebe ego Ironwood ka e nwee ike ibugharị ha site na Recovery Protocol n'ọdịnihu mgbe a gbanyụrụ cryptography dị ugbu a. Peeji a na-ekewa ihe Zcash na-echebe taa, ihe Ironwood gbanwere, ihe ka na-ekpughere, na ihe bụ naanị aro. Tebụl ọnọdụ status table dị nso na njedebe na-egosi ebe akụkụ ọ bụla guzo na mgbe e nyochara ya ikpeazụ. Ònye ka nke a bụ maka Onye ọ bụla hụrụ "quantum-recoverable" ma gụọ ya dịka "quantum-proof" Ndị ji ego na-ekpebi ma ha ga-ebuga ego n'ime Ironwood Ndị ode akwụkwọ na ndị nhazi chọrọ azịza e nwere isi mmalite ha pụrụ iduga ndị mmadụ na ya Maka ndabere gbasara quantum computing n'onwe ya, malite na Nchekwa Post-Quantum na Zcash. Ihe mere ajụjụ a ji agbagwoju anya A na-eji "Post-quantum" eme ihe dị ka a ga-asị na ọ bụ otu njirimara. Maka Zcash, ọ dịkarịa ala ọ bụ ajụjụ anọ dị iche, ha nwekwara azịza dị iche: Nzuzo [Privacy]. Onye mwakpo quantum ọ pụrụ ịhụ onye kwụrụ onye na ego ole? Mmefu ego [Spending]. Onye mwakpo quantum ọ pụrụ imefu mkpụrụ ego na-abụghị nke ya? Mmụba ego [Inflation]. Onye mwakpo quantum ọ pụrụ imepụta ZEC site n'ihe efu? Iweghachi [Recovery]. Ọ bụrụ na a ga-agbanyụ cryptography dị ugbu a, ndị ọrụ eziokwu ka ga-enwe ike iwepụta ego ha? Ironwood na-agbanwe naanị azịza nke ajụjụ nke anọ, naanịkwa maka notes nọ na pool Ironwood. Ihe iyi egwu dị n'azụ ihe ndị a niile bụ onye mwakpo nwere ike ịgbakọ discrete logarithms na elliptic curves Zcash na-eji. Kọmpụta quantum buru oke nke na-arụ Shor's algorithm ga-abụ otu ụzọ isi mee nke ahụ. ZIP 2005 rụtụrụ aka na ịchọta otu discrete logarithm zuru ezu iji kpatara mmụba ego na-akparaghị ókè ma ọ bụ zuo ego. Ihe Zcash na-echebe taa Tebụl a na-akọwa protocol ahụ dịka ọ na-arụ ugbu a, megide onye mwakpo nwere ike imebi discrete logarithms. Ọ metụtara pool ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe, gụnyere Ironwood, n'ihi na Ironwood na-eji otu circuit Orchard, proofs Halo 2 na signatures RedPallas dịka Orchard. Njirimara Megide onye mwakpo quantum taa Ihe Ironwood gbanwere --- --- --- Nzuzo Ọ na-adị ma ọ bụrụ na onye mwakpo amaghị Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe gị. Proofs na signatures e megharịrị randomization anaghị ekpughe ihe ọzọ. Ọ bụrụ na onye mwakpo maara Adreesị akpa ego ahụ, ọ nwere ike ịmepe notes e zigara ya, gụnyere ndị ochie echekwara site na chain. Ọ nweghị. ZIP 2005: "Ọnọdụ gbasara Nzuzo agbanweghị maka pool ọ bụla." Mmefu ego E chebeghị ya. Onye mwakpo pụrụ ịmepụta proofs adịgboroja ma ọ bụ signatures mmefu ma zuo ihe sitere na pool ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe, ọbụna maka Adreesị akpa ego ndị ọ hụbeghị. Ọ nweghị ugbu a. Nchedo ahụ ga-abịa naanị mgbe a gbanwere n'ọdịnihu gaa na Recovery Protocol. Mmụba ego E chebeghị ya. Onye mwakpo pụrụ ịmepụta proof nke yiri nke ziri ezi wee kee ZEC n'ime pool ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe, ikekwe na-enweghị onye ọ bụla achọpụta. Naanị oke bụ turnstile: pool ọ bụla enweghị ike ịkwụpụta karịa nguzo ya e dekọrọ. Ọ nweghị ugbu a. Notes Ironwood ugbu a na-eme commitment maka ọdịnaya ha niile n'ụzọ onye mwakpo quantum ekwesịghị inwe ike ịgha, nke bụ ihe Recovery Protocol n'ọdịnihu chọrọ iji mee ka ọnụọgụ ego guzosie ike. Iweghachi Notes Sprout, Sapling na Orchard enweghị ụzọ iweghachi. Mgbe a gbanyụrụ protocols ha, ihe ọ bụla fọdụrụ n'ime ha agaghị enwe ike iru. Note Ironwood ọ bụla nwere ike iweghachi na ụkpụrụ. Ọ dịghị note Sapling ma ọ bụ Orchard nwere ike. ZEC Oha bụ ikpe dị iche. Enwere ike ịgha signatures ECDSA ya ozugbo a maara public key. Maka Adreesị akpa ego Oha nkịtị, nke ahụ na-eme oge mbụ ị na-emefu site na ya, ma enwekwara obere oge mgbe Azụmahia nọ na mempool

title: Zcash Lightwallet Nodes
description: Ọtụtụ ndị na-eji Zcash site n’e-akpa ego dị mfe, nke na-adịghị ebudata blockchain dum. Kama nke ahụ, ọ na-agwa sava nke rụgoro ọrụ ahụ. Peeji a na-akọwa ihe…
text: Zcash Lightwallet Nodes Na nkenke Ọtụtụ ndị na-eji Zcash site n’e-akpa ego [wallet] dị mfe, nke na-adịghị ebudata blockchain dum. Kama nke ahụ, ọ na-agwa sava nke rụgoro ọrụ ahụ. Akụrụngwa abụọ na-eje ozi e-akpa ego dị mfe taa: lightwalletd, ọrụ mbụ e dere na Go, na Zaino, indexer ọhụrụ e dere na Rust. Igodo gị anaghị ahapụ ngwaọrụ gị, sava ahụ enweghị ike imefu ego gị ma ọ bụ gụọ ọnụego na memo ndị dị n’ime Azụmahia [transaction] nke e chebere echebe [shielded] kpamkpam. Ihe sava ahụ nwere ọnọdụ ọma iji mata bụ adreesị IP gị na oge ọrụ gị — Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na-echebe ihe na-eme na blockchain, ọ bụghị njikọ gị na sava ahụ. Tor na-ewepụ njirimara IP; ọ dị na e-akpa ego ndị e wuru na zcashclientbackend, ma na ZODL ọ bụ ntọala dị na Advanced Settings. Ị nwere ike ịgbanwe sava e-akpa ego gị ji, ma ọ bụ mee nke gị — ma lightwalletd na Zaino bụ open source. Nkọwa Isi Ọtụtụ ndị na-eji Zcash site n’e-akpa ego dị mfe, nke na-adịghị ebudata blockchain dum. Kama nke ahụ, ọ na-agwa sava nke rụgoro ọrụ ahụ. Peeji a na-akọwa ihe sava ndị ahụ bụ, ihe ha nwere na enweghị ike ịhụ gbasara gị, otu esi agafe njikọ gị n’elu Tor, na otu esi agbanwe sava e-akpa ego gị ji. Akụrụngwa abụọ na-eje ozi e-akpa ego dị mfe taa. lightwalletd bụ ọrụ mbụ, e dere na Go. Zaino bụ indexer ọhụrụ e dere na Rust, e wuru dịka akụkụ nke ọrụ ịkwụsị zcashd. Ihe sava e-akpa ego dị mfe na-eme Sava e-akpa ego dị mfe na-anọdụ n’etiti e-akpa ego gị na blockchain Zcash ma nye ya nlele chain [chain] na-eji bandwidth rụọ ọrụ nke ọma. Ọ na-emere gị ihe atọ. Ọ na-eje ozi block [block] kọmpat. Kama block dum, ọ na-eziga ụdị kọmpat nke na-ebu naanị ihe e-akpa ego chọrọ iji chọpụta Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] na Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe ya, chọpụta mmefu note [note] ya, ma melite ndị akaebe ya. Ọ na-ebufe Azụmahia gị. Mgbe ị zitere, e-akpa ego gị na-enye sava ahụ Azụmahia emechara, sava ahụ ebusaa ya na netwọk. Ọ na-aza ajụjụ chain, dịka elu ugbu a na ozi ugwo [fee] e-akpa ego gị chọrọ. E-akpa ego gị ka na-arụ ọrụ nzuzo ahụ na mpaghara. Ọ na-edobe igodo gị, na-anwale izopụ block iji chọta note gị, ma na-ewu ma bịanye aka na Azụmahia n’ọrụ ngwaọrụ gị. Ihe sava ahụ nwere na enweghị ike ịhụ Nke a bụ akụkụ dị mfe ịghọtahie. Igodo gị anaghị ahapụ ngwaọrụ gị, mana nke ahụ apụtaghị na sava ahụ amụghị ihe ọ bụla gbasara gị. Ntụaka ebe a bụ ụdị egwu nke ngwa e-akpa ego Zcash, nke kwesịrị ka ị gụọ ya dum ma ọ bụrụ na nke a dị gị mkpa. Ọ na-akọwa ụdị ndị mmegide dị iche iche. Nke dị mkpa na peeji a bụ onye mmegide nwere ike ilele okporo data dị n’etiti e-akpa ego gị na ịntanetị, yana n’etiti sava ahụ na ịntanetị. Onye ọ bụla na-agba sava ahụ nọ n’ọnọdụ a n’otu akụkụ, n’ihi na e-akpa ego gị na-ejikọ ha ozugbo. Bido n’ihe echebere. Megide onye mmegide ọ bụla dị na ụdị ahụ, gụnyere onye mebiri sava ahụ, ọ “enweghị ike ịmụta ihe ọ bụla gbasara ihe igodo kriptografik onye ọrụ nwere (igodo ego, viewing key, Mkpuru mgbake [seed phrase], na ihe ndị ọzọ)”, enweghị ike izuru ego gị, ọ pụghịkwa ime ka ị ziga ego ị na-achọghị iziga. Ọnụego na memo dị n’ime Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe kpamkpam na-anọgide na Nzobe ederede [encryption]. Mgbe ahụ, e nwere ihe ndị na-adịghị echebe. Ụdị egwu ahụ depụtara ndị a dịka adịghị ike amaara megide onye mmegide na-ekiri okporo data: Adịghị ike Otu o si eme :-- :-- Ịmata onye ị bụ “Onye mmegide maara adreesị IP onye ọrụ, nke nwere ike iduga ha n’ezi njirimara onye ọrụ” Ịmata ebe ị nọ n’ụdị mkpokọta Ịchọ IP gị “n’ebe nchekwa data geolocation iji tụọ ebe ha nọ” Ịmata na mgbe ị zitere ma ọ bụ natara Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Izipu “na-eji bandwidth karịa, nke a na-ahụ anya ọbụna ma njikọ ahụ ezoro ezo”. Ụdị ahụ kwuru na sava n’onwe ya na-ahụ omume izipu na ịnata Ịgụ ọnụ ọgụgụ Azụmahia i meela ka oge na-aga Otu ụkpụrụ bandwidth ahụ, a hụrụ n’oge dị ogologo Ịhụ ụkpụrụ Kwụọ ụhwọ na-eme ugboro ugboro Ileba anya mgbe ọrụ na-eme Ịchọpụta ma Adreesị akpa ego bụ nke gị Onye mmegide maralarị Adreesị akpa ego nwere ike “iziga ego na Adreesị akpa ego ahụ wee le

title: NU5
description: NU5 malitere na Zcash mainnet na block 1,687,104 (Mee 31, 2022 UTC).
text: NU5 NU5 malitere na Zcash mainnet na block 1,687,104 (Mee 31, 2022 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: otu NU5 siri nye Zcash pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded] ọhụrụ nke na-achọghị trusted setup, tinyere otu ụdị Adreesị akpa ego nke na-arụ ọrụ n'ofe pool dị iche iche. NU5 (Network Upgrade 5) bụ network upgrade nke isii nke Zcash network upgrade, nke ZIP 252 tinyere n'ọrụ. Ọ bụ nnukwu mmelite cryptographic. Ọ webatara usoro Kwụọ ụhwọ nke e chebere echebe Orchard, nke e wuru n'elu sistemụ proving Halo 2, tinyere Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ na usoro Azụmahia ụdị 5 ọhụrụ. NU5 pụtara na mwepụta Electric Coin Company v5.0.0 nke zcashd. Ihe mere nke a ji dị mkpa. Pool nke e chebere echebe na-atụkwasị obi naanị ruo n'ókè trusted setup nke mepụtara ya si dị. Pool abụọ mbụ nke e chebere echebe nke Zcash, Sprout na Sapling, nke ọ bụla chọrọ emume trusted setup nke otu oge iji mepụta parampat nzuzo ha. Ọ bụrụ na e debeere parampat ndị ahụ kama ibibi ha, mmadụ pụrụ imepụta ZEC adịgboroja n'enweghị onye ọ bụla hụrụ ya. Pool Orchard nke NU5 na-ewepụ nchegbu ahụ site n'iji sistemụ proving Halo 2, nke na-achọghị emume dị otu a. trusted setup Orchard bụ usoro nke e chebere echebe nke NU5 webatara, nke akọwara na ZIP 224. E wuru ya n'elu sistemụ proving Halo 2, nke na-eji usoro a na-akpọ PLONKish arithmetization na okirikiri Pallas na Vesta. Uru ya bara uru dị mfe: Halo 2 achọghị trusted setup ma ọ bụ structured reference string, ya mere enweghị parampat nzuzo a pụrụ iji n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi. Sprout na Sapling ha abụọ dabere na trusted setup. Otu ìgwè mmadụ mere emume iji wuo parampat pool ọ bụla, onye ọ bụla aghaghịkwa ịtụkwasị obi na opekata mpe otu n'ime ha bibiri òkè nzuzo ya. Orchard na-ewepụ echiche ahụ. Pool ndị ochie ka dị mgbe NU5 gachara, ya mere nkwa enweghị-setup ahụ metụtara ego ị jidere na pool Orchard. Ihe NU5 gbanwere NU5 chịkọtara ọtụtụ mgbanwe consensus, nke ha niile malitere ọnụ na block 1,687,104. Ọ gbakwụnyere pool nke e chebere echebe Orchard (ZIP 224), usoro dabere na Halo 2 a kọwara n'elu. Ọ gbakwụnyere usoro Azụmahia ụdị 5 (ZIP 225), nhazi e mezigharịrị nke nwere mpaghara dị iche maka data Oha [transparent], Sapling, na Orchard ọhụrụ. E wepụrụ mpaghara Sprout, usoro ụdị 4 ochie ka dịkwa irè mgbe mbido gasịrị. Ọ webatara Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ na viewing key jikọtara ọnụ (ZIP 316), nke akụkụ na-esote na-akọwa. Ọ nakweere enweghị ike ịgbanwe ihe nchọpụta Azụmahia (ZIP 244), ụzọ ọhụrụ e si agbakọ id nke Azụmahia nke na-ekewa ihe Azụmahia na-eme n'aka proof na signature ndị nyere ya ikike. Ọ nakweere encodings Jubjub point nke canonical (ZIP 216) iji wepụ encodings na-abụghị ọkọlọtọ ma mee ka iwu banyere ihe a na-ewere dịka Azụmahia ziri ezi sie ike. Ọ mere ka nnyefe Azụmahia ụdị 5 n'ofe netwọk peer-to-peer kwe omume (ZIP 239). NU5 mekwara ka ọtụtụ ZIP ndị dị adị (32, 203, 209, 212, 213, 221, na 401) dị ọhụrụ ka ha nwee ike ịza ajụjụ gbasara pool Orchard ọhụrụ. Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ Tupu NU5, pool ọ bụla nwere ụdị Adreesị akpa ego nke ya, onye zitere ego aghaghịkwa ịma ụdị nke ị chọrọ. Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ, nke akọwara na ZIP 316, gbanwere nke ahụ. Otu Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ nwere ike ijikọta receivers maka ihe karịrị otu pool, ya mere e-akpa ego onye zitere ego na-ahọrọ nke kacha mma ọ na-akwado. Viewing key jikọtara ọnụ na-arụkwa otu a maka ilele. Ha na-enye ọhụhụ naanị maka ịgụ n'ofe pool ndị Adreesị akpa ego kpuchiri. Maka ihe ndị ọzọ gbasara nke a, lee peeji Viewing Keys. Ebe NU5 nọ NU5 soro mmelite mbụ nke Zcash: Overwinter, Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, na Canopy. Ọ malitere na mainnet na Mee 31, 2022. A họpụtara okirikiri Orchard n'ihi na ọ na-akwado recursion, nke bụ ntọala maka ọrụ scaling n'ọdịnihu. NU5 bụ onye butere usoro mmelite NU6 na NU6.x ozugbo, nke wuru n'elu pool Orchard ma mechaa dozie ya. Nchịkọta ọsọ ọsọ NU5 malitere na mainnet na block 1,687,104 (May 31, 2022 UTC) — nkwalite cryptographic kasị ukwuu nke Zcash kemgbe Sapling, nke ZIP 252 tinyere n'ọrụ. Ọ malitere pool nke e chebere

title: NU6
description: NU6 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 2,726,400 (Nọvemba 23, 2024 UTC).
text: NU6 NU6 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 2,726,400 (Nọvemba 23, 2024 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: ka Zcash si anọgide na-akwado mmepe nke ya mgbe halving gachara, ihe mere o ji dobe nchekwa nke ọ maghị ka a ga-esi mefuo ya, na ka o siri mee ka mkpokọta ZEC dị kpọmkwem nke a pụrụ ibu amụma. NU6 bụ Zcash network upgrade, nke ZIP 253 wepụtara, nke malitere ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet n’ọnwa Nọvemba 2024 na block 2,726,400. Ọ bụ mmelite ego na ego maka mmepe: o mere ka òkè nke nkwado block na-aga n’ihu na mmepe gafee halving nke Nọvemba 2024, guzobe nchekwa dị n’ime protocol maka ojiji ndị obodo ga-ekpebi n’ọdịnihu, ma mee ka usoro a na-agụta ZEC ọhụrụ sie ike. NU6 nwetara nkwado n'aka Electric Coin Company na Zcash Foundation abụọ ahụ. Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa. E mere atụmatụ ka Zcash's Ego Mmepe kwụsị n'akụkụ halving nke Nọvemba 2024, nke bụ nke abụọ n'akụkọ ya. NU6 mere ka nkwado ahụ gaa n'ihu, mana kama inye ndị nnata e debere ego mkpụrụ ego ọ bụla, ọ debere otu òkè n'ime protocol ka obodo nwee ike ikpebi n'ọdịnihu ihe ha ga-eme ya. Ọ mekwara ka oghere nta dị na ndekọ ego mechie, ya mere ugbu a a pụrụ ibu amụma kpọmkwem mkpokọta ZEC ga-adịrị mgbe niile. TL;DR (Nchịkọta mkpirikpi) NU6 malitere ọrụ na mainnet na block 2,726,400 (Nọvemba 23, 2024 UTC), site na ZIP 253. Ọ mere ka 20% nke block subsidy gaa n'ihu na-aga na mmepe mgbe halving nke Nọvemba 2024 gachara: 8% gaara Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), 12% gaara n'ime Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox ọhụrụ (ZIP 2001). Lockbox ahụ bụ nchekwa dị n'ime protocol nke na-enweghị onye akọwapụtara ka o mefuo ya. NU6 ji ebumnuche hapụ ajụjụ Gọọmentị (governance) ahụ ka o meghere, NU6.1 (2025) wee zaa ya emesia. ZIP 236 na-achọ ugbu a ka Azụmahia (transaction) coinbase ọ bụla kwekọọ kpọmkwem, ya mere ndị na-egwụputa (miners) enweghịzi ike ịnara ihe na-erughị ihe ruuru ha wee were amaghị ama kpọọ ZEC ọkụ. Ngụkọta ego a ga-enwe n'ọdịnihu na-aghọ ihe a ga-ebu amụma ya kpọmkwem. Ọ dịghị ihe gbanwere n'ego dị n'akaụntụ, Nzuzo (privacy), na iwu Azụmahia: NU6 bụ nkwalite gbasara ego nkwado na ndekọ ego. Ihe atụ a na-ahụ anya Chee echiche maka NU6 dị ka ezinụlọ nke na-akwụ ndị na-ewu ya ego enyemaka a kwadoro akwado, ma mara na a haziri ka ụbọchị ịkwụ ụgwọ ahụ kwụsị. Kama ịkwụsị Kwụọ ụhwọ (payment), NU6 na-ekewa ego enyemaka ahụ: otu akụkụ na-aga n'ihu na kọmitii ikike (grant) obodo, akụkụ nke ọzọ na-abanye n'igbe nchekwa ezinụlọ nke a ka na-ekwupụtabeghị koodu ya. Igbe nchekwa ahụ na-edowe ego ahụ iche ruo mgbe ezinụlọ ahụ ga-emesịa kwekọrịta n'iwu maka imeghe ya — nkwekọrịta ahụ bụ NU6.1. Ihe NU6 gbanwere NU6 gara n'ihu iziga 20% nke block subsidy gaa na nkwado mmepe mgbe halving nke Nọvemba 2024 gachara, iwu akọwara na ZIP 1015. Ọ kewara 20% ahụ ụzọ abụọ. 8% nke block subsidy na-aga Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), nke na-akwado ọrụ ndị obodo na-arụ nakwa ọrụ a na-arụ maka obodo. 12% na-abanye n'ime lockbox ọhụrụ dị n'ime protocol, nke e jidere maka ojiji ndị obodo ga-ekpebi n'ọdịnihu. Nke fọdụrụ na block subsidy, tinyere ugwo Azụmahia, na-aga ndị na-egwụputa nke na-echekwa network. NU6 mekwara ka iwu funding-stream na dev-fund dịbu (ZIP 207 na ZIP 214) dabara n'usoro ọhụrụ a. Lockbox e yigharịrị Òkè 12% bụ echiche ọhụrụ dị na NU6. Kama ịkwụ ya n'otu Adreesị akpa ego onye nnata, a na-etinye uru ahụ ozugbo n'ime pool dị n'ime protocol a na-akpọ Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox, nke akọwara na ZIP 2001. Lockbox bụ ụdị funding-stream ọhụrụ (DEFERREDPOOL), ebe uru block-reward na-abanye n'ime protocol n'onwe ya, ọ bụghị n'aka mmadụ ma ọ bụ òtù. Network na-edekọ ya dị ka nguzozi pool uru chain nke ya, n'otu ụzọ ọ na-edekọ nguzozi nke pool ndị nke e chebere echebe. NU6 kpachaara anya mepụta lockbox ahụ ma hapụ ajụjụ siri ike ahụ ghe oghe: onye na-achịkwa ego ndị ahụ, oleekwa ka e si ahapụ ha? NU6.1 zara ajụjụ ahụ mgbe e mesịrị, nke guzobere Gọọmentị: ọ gara n'ihu na 8% block-subsidy stream na-aga Zcash Community Grants ma duzie 12% stream n'ime ego ndị ndị ji coin na-achịkwa, nke lockbox kụrụ mkpụrụ mbụ ya. Idozi ndekọ

title: NU6.1
description: NU6.1 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash na block 3,146,400 (Nọvemba 24, 2025 UTC).
text: NU6.1 NU6.1 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash na block 3,146,400 (Nọvemba 24, 2025 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: otu Zcash si akwụ ụgwọ maka mmepe nke ya n’enweghị ụlọ ọrụ na-achị ya, na otu NU6.1 si nye obodo na ndị nwere mkpụrụ ego ohere ikwu okwu kpọmkwem banyere ego ahụ. NU6.1 bụ Zcash network upgrade, nke akọwara na ZIP 255, nke guzobere usoro ọhụrụ maka itinye ego na Gọọmentị maka mmepe Zcash. Ọ na-ekpebi ebe akụkụ nke ụgwọ ọrụ block ga-aga na onye na-achịkwa ya, ma tinyekwara mmezi nka ole na ole dị nta. Ndị Electric Coin Company na Zcash Foundation kwadoro NU6.1. Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa. Ọtụtụ sọftụwia na-enweta ego site n’ụlọ ọrụ. Zcash bụ network decentralized nke na-enweghị otu onye nwe ya, ya mere ọ na-eche ajụjụ siri ike ihu: olee otú ọ ga-esi kwụọ ndị na-aga n’ihu iwulite ya ụgwọ, n’ụzọ obodo tụkwasịrị obi? NU6.1 bụ azịza Zcash ugbu a. Ọ na-eduga akụkụ nke ụgwọ ọrụ block ọ bụla n’ime pool abụọ, otu maka ikike obodo na otu nke ndị nwere mkpụrụ ego n’onwe ha na-achịkwa. TL;DR (Nchịkọta nkenke) NU6.1 malitere ọrụ na mainnet na block 3,146,400 (November 24, 2025 UTC), a kọwara ya na ZIP 255. O guzobere usoro ego e ji eme ihe taa: ihe dị ka 80% nke ụgwọ ọrụ block ọ bụla na-aga n'aka ndị na-egwụputa (miners), 8% na-aga n'aka Zcash Community Grants, 12% na-aga n'ego nke ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego na-achịkwa, nke e ji ego si na Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox malite ya. Iwu ndị a (ZIP 1016) ga-adị ruo mgbe halving nke atọ nke Zcash, iji nye obodo oge nyochaa ha tupu e mee ka ha bụrụ nke na-adịgide adịgide ma ọ bụ gbanwee ha. Ndị nwe mkpụrụ ego na-ekpebi ọnụ ma a ga-ewepụta ego 12% ahụ maka ọrụ ecosystem ma ọ bụ debe ya ka o kpọchiri — olu kpọmkwem n'otú Zcash si akwado ọdịnihu ya. E zipụkwara mmezi teknụzụ abụọ n'otu oge ahụ: ịmata nke ọma unshielding Orchard na RPC balances, na zcashd iji usoro Azụmahia (transaction) version 5 dị ka ndabara. Ihe atụ a na-ahụ anya NU6.1 na-eme ka igbe ego ezinụlọ ahụ si n'akụkọ NU6 ghọọ akaụntụ a na-elekọta nke nwere iwu e dere ede. Òkè 12% ahụ akwụsịghị ịbụ "ego onye ọ bụla na-enweghị ike imetụ aka" wee ghọọ "ego ndị nwe òkè na-atụ vootu banyere ya": ma ọ bụ ịhapụ ya maka ọrụ gburugburu Zcash ma ọ bụ idowe ya ka a kpọchiri ya. Ego 8% na-aga n'ikike obodo (community grants) na-aga n'ihu na-asọba n'onwe ya, dị ka iwu ịkwụ ụgwọ a na-ekwughachi oge niile (standing order). Ọ dịghị mkpa ịtụ vootu. Usoro itinye ego NU6.1 na-ekewa ụgwọ ọrụ block ọ bụla n’akụkụ atọ. Akụkụ kasị ukwuu, ihe dịka pasent 80, na-aga n’aka ndị onye na-egwụputa na-echekwa network ahụ. Pasent 8 na-aga Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), nke na-akwado ọrụ nke obodo na maka obodo. Pasent 12 na-aga n’ime ego ọhụrụ nke ndị nwere mkpụrụ ego na-achịkwa, nke Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox nyere mmalite. A kọwara iwu nke usoro a na ZIP 1016, ha ga-adịgidekwa ruo halving nke atọ Zcash, nke na-enye obodo oge ịhụ ka ọ si arụ ọrụ tupu ha eme ya ka ọ bụrụ nke na-adịgide adịgide ma ọ bụ gbanwee ya. Onye na-achịkwa ego ndị nwere mkpụrụ ego Usoro pasent 12 ahụ bụ echiche ọhụrụ. Kama ụlọ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ntọala ikpebi otu esi emefu ya, ndị nwere mkpụrụ ego na-ekpebi ọnụ ma hà ga-ahapụ ego ahụ ma ọ bụ debe ya. Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox, nke e kere na network upgrade NU6 gara aga, na-enye ego a mmalite. Ndị nwere mkpụrụ ego na-ekpebi ọnụ ma hà ga-ekesa ego ahụ maka ọrụ ecosystem ma ọ bụ debe ya ka akpọchiri. Nke a na-enye ndị na-enwe ZEC olu kpọmkwem n’ụzọ Zcash si akwado ọdịnihu ya. Mmezi ndị nta NU6.1 mekwara ka ihe nka abụọ dị ọcha. Tupu NU6.1, ụfọdụ usoro RPC anaghị amata ego a na-ewepụ na nchebe nke ọma site na pool Orchard, ya mere nguzozi na ugwo nwere ike ịpụta ezighị ezi na e-akpa ego na ndị na-enyocha azụmahịa. NU6.1 doziri nke ahụ. Ọ gbanwere ndabara e-akpa ego zcashd ka o wuo Azụmahia ụdị 5, usoro e webatara mbụ na NU5, kama ụdị 4. Azụmahia ụdị 4 ka dị irè. Otu itinye ego Zcash si gbanwee NU6.1 bụ otu nzọụkwụ n’akụkọ ogologo banyere otu Zcash si akwụ ụgwọ maka mmepe nke ya. Canopy (2020) kwụsịrị ụgwọ ọrụ ndị guzobere mbụ ma kee ego mmepe. NU6 (2024) guzobere D

title: NU6.2
description: NU6.2 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC).
text: NU6.2 NU6.2 malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: ihe NU6.2 doziri, ihe mere Zcash ji kwụsị Azụmahia [transaction] nke e chebere echebe [shielded] ruo ihe dị ka otu ụbọchị, na otú network si mechie oghere ahụ n'enweghị ego ọ bụla furu efu. NU6.2 bụ Zcash network upgrade, nke akọwara n'usoro iwu na ZIP 257, nke nyeere protocol nke Orchard nke e chebere echebe aka ịrụ ọrụ ọzọ mgbe nkwụsị mberede gasịrị. Ọ doziri njehie izi-ezi [soundness bug] n'ime circuit zero-knowledge nke Orchard ma weghachite Azụmahia shielded. Were ya dị ka isiakwụkwọ nrụzi mberede nke akụkọ njehie Orchard. Network upgrade sochirinụ, Ironwood (NU6.3), mechara tinye pool ọhụrụ na nyocha ọhaneze nke nke ochie. Ihe kpatara nke a ji dị mkpa. Orchard bụ ebe ọtụtụ Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] nzuzo [privacy] Zcash na-eme. Mgbe achọpụtara ntụpọ na mgbakọ na mwepụ nke na-eme ka pool ahụ bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi, network chere nhọrọ siri ike ihu: ịhapụ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe ka ha na-aga n'ihu n'ihe ize ndụ a maara, ma ọ bụ kwụsị ha ruo mgbe nrụzi dị njikere. NU6.2 bụ otú Zcash si họrọ nchekwa mbụ ma ka weghachite Nzuzo n'ime otu ụbọchị. TL;DR (Nchịkọta dị mkpirikpi) NU6.2 malitere ọrụ na mainnet na block 3,364,600 (June 3, 2026 UTC), nke a kọwara na ZIP 257. Ọ mere ka Orchard rụọ ọrụ ọzọ mgbe a kwụsịrị ya nwa oge n'ihi ihe mberede: a chọpụtara njehie izi-ezi na Action circuit nke Orchard n'oge nyocha Shielded Labs, ma kọọ ya n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị na ngwụcha May 2026. Soft fork mberede na June 2, 2026 (zcashd v6.12.5, zebra v4.5.3) mere ka Azụmahia Orchard kwụsị nwa oge; Azụmahia Oha (transparent) na Sapling nọgidere na-arụ ọrụ. Hard fork nke NU6.2 dozire circuit ahụ (tinyere constraint ahụ na-efu efu), mepụta verifying key ọhụrụ nke na-ajụ proof ọjọọ ochie, ma mee ka ogologo proof ziri ezi bụrụ iwu consensus. O nweghị ego furu efu ma ọ bụ e kpọchiri akpọchi, o nweghịkwa ihe akaebe na e jiri njehie ahụ zuo ihe; ọrụ ịnyocha uru dị na circuit ochie bụ nke Ironwood (NU6.3), site na pool ọhụrụ na nyocha ọha. Ihe atụ a na-ahụ anya NU6.2 bụ isi nrụzi mberede nke akụkọ Orchard. Chee echiche otu ebe nchekwa ego n'ụlọ akụ nke a chọpụtara na mkpọchi ya nwere ntụpọ dị nzuzo: ụlọ akụ ahụ akwụsị iji ebe nchekwa ahụ otu ụbọchị (nkwụsịtụ ahụ), tinye mkpọchi e meziri emezi (circuit ọhụrụ na igodo nyocha [verifying key]), wee meghee ya ọzọ. Ihe niile e debere tupu nrụzi ahụ ka nọ ebe ahụ, ọ dịghịkwa onye metụrụ ha aka. Ma a ga-enyocha ha ma bufee ha n'ebe nchekwa ọhụrụ kpam kpam (pool ọhụrụ nke Ironwood) n'okpuru nlekọta ọha. Ihe mere Ihe kpalitere ya bụ njehie izi-ezi na Action circuit nke Orchard, bụ mgbakọ na mwepụ kwesịịrị igosi na Azụmahia ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe na-erube isi n'iwu. Onye nchọpụta nọọrọ onwe ya Taylor Hornby chọpụtara ya n'oge nyocha Shielded Labs ma kọọ ya n'ụzọ dị mkpa na ngwụcha May 2026. Ọ nọgidere na-ahụghị ya kemgbe Orchard malitere na 2022, ma n'echiche ọ pụrụ ikwe ka Azụmahia na-adịghị irè gafee dị ka nke dị irè, nke pụrụ ikwe ka ezuru ego ma ọ bụ mefuo ya ugboro abụọ n'ime pool Orchard. Nchịkọta turnstile nke Zcash ka na-egbochi oke uru ọ bụla pụrụ isi na Orchard pụọ, ya mere a pụghị ịbawanye ngụkọta ọkọnọ ZEC n'onwe ya, mana ntụpọ na mgbakọ na mwepụ nke na-eme ka ego e chebere echebe bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi dị njọ, ya mere network mere ihe n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole. Ibe Ironwood na-akọwa njehie ahụ na otú ọ pụrụ isi mepụta uru n'uju. Nkwụsị mberede Na June 2, 2026, soft fork mberede kwụsịrị Azụmahia Orchard niile nwa oge. E zipụrụ ya dịka hotfix na zcashd v6.12.5 na zebra v4.5.3. Ezumike Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Orchard na nnata ego kwụsịrị, ya mere enweghị proof ọhụrụ Orchard a pụrụ imepụta ma ọ bụ nabata. Azụmahia Oha [transparent] na Sapling nọgidere na-arụ ọrụ dịka ọ dị na mbụ. Ebugharịghị, kefriza, ma ọ bụ tufuo ego ọ bụla. Nkwụsị ahụ kwụsịrị naanị ọrụ ọhụrụ Orchard ka a na-emecha nrụzi n'ezie. Ihe NU6.2 gbanwere N'ụbọchị na-esote, June 3, 2026, hard fork NU6.2 malitere na block 3,364

text: Viewing Key Na-apụ Apụ (Outgoing Viewing Keys, OVKs) Viewing key na-apụ apụ (OVK) bụ uru byte 32 a na-eji naanị zoo ciphertext na-apụ apụ nke mmepụta nke e chebere echebe. Ọ na-eme ka otu nwere ike weghachite plaintext note ezitere (Adreesị akpa ego onye nnata, uru, na memo) n’enweghị ike imefu ego ma ọ bụ hụ note na-abata. Onye nnata na-eji viewing key nke ya na-abata wezobe note na-abata mgbe niile. Nhọrọ OVK anaghị agbanwe ihe onye nnata na-ahụ. Enweghị usoro nzuzo a na-ahụkarị maka OVK raw; ọ bụ naanị byte 32. Na nkenke OVK na-achịkwa naanị onye nwere ike weghachite plaintext na-apụ apụ nke Kwụọ ụhwọ nke e chebere echebe. E-akpa ego na-ahọrọ n’etiti iwu atọ: Onye zitere (weghachite nkịtị site na UFVK nke akaụntụ), Nke omenala (weghachite site na key ị nyere), ma ọ bụ Tụfuo (ọ dịghị onye nwere ike weghachite plaintext na-apụ apụ site na chain). Ọbụna ma ejiri Tụfuo ma ọ bụ OVK omenala, onye ji UFVK ka na-ahụ note ndị e mefuru wee nwee ike gbakọọ ego net hapụrụ akaụntụ ahụ. Nanị ụzọ a pụrụ ịdabere na ya iji mee ka ego ghara ịpụta ìhè nye UFVK akọwapụtara bụ ịhụ na note ndị ahụ abụghị nke akaụntụ ahụ (akaụntụ dị iche ma ọ bụ e-akpa ego dị iche). Iwu atọ ahụ adịlarị na zcashclientbackend; ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ e-akpa ego niile taa na-eji naanị iwu Onye zitere nke ndabara. --- Iwu atọ ahụ E-akpa ego ndị e wuru n’elu zcashclientbackend na-ahọrọ OvkPolicy mgbe ha na-ewu Azụmahia: Iwu Ciphertext na-apụ apụ Onye nwere ike weghachite plaintext na-apụ apụ ma emechaa -------- ---------------------- ---------------------------------------------- Onye zitere (ndabara) Eji OVK nkịtị nke akaụntụ zoo ya Unified Full Viewing Key nke akaụntụ na-eziga Nke omenala Eji key ị nyere zoo ya Onye ọ bụla ji key e nyere Tụfuo A naghị eji OVK (ovk = ⊥) Ọ dịghị onye (ọbụnadị onye zitere ya) Onye nrụpụta dị mfe na-emepụta iwu Custom site n’otu uru byte 32 ka OVK mpụga na nke ime bụrụ otu key ahụ. Lee akwụkwọ OvkPolicy na ZIP 310. Ihe iwu ọ bụla bara uru maka ya Onye zitere bụ omume e-akpa ego nkịtị. Mgbe a gwupụtara Azụmahia ahụ, onye ọ bụla ji UFVK nke akaụntụ nwere ike wezobe ciphertext na-apụ apụ wee weghachite Adreesị akpa ego ndị nnata, ego, na memo. Nke omenala na-enye gị ohere inye onye nke atọ (onye nyocha, onye nhazi Kwụọ ụhwọ, usoro risiti, ma ọ bụ ngwaọrụ dị iche) ikike iwezobe Kwụọ ụhwọ ndị a kapịrị ọnụ na-apụ apụ n’enyeghị ha viewing key zuru ezu. Ị nwekwara ike iji key ephemeral nke ị ga-atụfu mgbe Azụmahia gasịrị, ma ọ bụ jiri key dị iche iche maka ndị mmekọ dị iche iche ka otu key ghara ịhụ Kwụọ ụhwọ niile na-apụ apụ. Tụfuo pụtara na e-akpa ego na-eziga enweghị ike weghachite plaintext na-apụ apụ site na chain. Nke a bara uru mgbe ịchọrọ ibelata ihe a pụrụ iweghachite ma ọ bụrụ na UFVK emechaa daba n’aka ndị ọzọ, ma ọ bụ mgbe ị kpachaara anya achọghị ndekọ on-chain nke OVK akaụntụ nwere ike imeghe. Ihe onye ji UFVK ka na-ahụ Ọbụna mgbe ejiri Tụfuo ma ọ bụ OVK omenala, onye ji UFVK nke akaụntụ ka nwere ike: Chọpụta note nke akaụntụ ahụ e mefuru (site na nullifier). Mara uru note ntinye ndị ahụ. Weghachite note mgbanwe ọ bụla (eji viewing key na-abata nke ime zoo ha, ọ bụghị OVK). Ya mere, gbakọọ ego net hapụrụ akaụntụ ahụ. Ihe anaghị apụta ìhè bụ Adreesị akpa ego ndị nnata nke ọ bụla, nkewa ego ahụ, na memo. Akwụkwọ WalletWrite na-adọ aka ná ntị na data gbasara Azụmahia e kere n’okpuru Tụfuo (ma ọ bụ OVK omenala na-enweghị usoro) enweghị ike iweghachite site na data chain ma ọ bụrụ na ndekọ mpaghara efuo. title: Overwinter
description: Overwinter malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 347,500 (June 26, 2018 UTC).
text: Overwinter Overwinter malitere ịrụ ọrụ na Zcash mainnet na block 347,500 (June 26, 2018 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: otú Zcash siri mụta ịgbanwe iwu nke ya n'enweghị nsogbu, na ihe mere ntọala ahụ ji mee ka network upgrade [network upgrade] ọ bụla sochirinụ, malite na Sapling, kwe omume. Overwinter bụ Zcash network upgrade, nke mbụ mgbe network ahụ malitere. A kọwara ya n'ofe ọtụtụ Atụmatụ Mmezi Zcash: ZIP 200, ZIP 201, ZIP 202, ZIP 203, na ZIP 143. Overwinter etinyeghị atụmatụ ọhụrụ ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe [shielded]. Kama nke ahụ, ọ mere ka protocol ahụ sie ike ka e nwee ike iwepụta upgrades n'ọdịnihu n'enweghị nsogbu. Edekọrọ upgrade ahụ site na Electric Coin Company na peeji upgrade gọọmentị nke Zcash. Ihe mere nke a ji dị mkpa. Ịgbanwe iwu blockchain [blockchain] dị ndụ dị ize ndụ. Ọ bụrụ na e mehie ya, ụdị abụọ nke network nwere ike ghara ikwenye, ma ọ bụ Azụmahia [transaction] e bu n'uche maka otu chain nwere ike idetuo gaa na nke ọzọ. Tupu Overwinter, Zcash enweghị ụzọ ọkọlọtọ, nke nchekwa megide mmegharị ugboro abụọ, isi ahazi mgbanwe iwu. Overwinter doziri nke ahụ. O nyere Zcash usoro iwu maka upgrades ma, nke dịkwa oke mkpa, nchedo mmegharị ugboro abụọ n'akụkụ abụọ, ka Azụmahia nke ziri ezi n'okpuru otu nchịkọta iwu ghara imeghachi n'okpuru nke ọzọ. Ntọala ahụ bụ ihe mere Sapling, na upgrade ọ bụla sochirinụ, ji nwee ike ịmalite nke ọma. Usoro upgrade Overwinter webatara Usoro Network Upgrade, nke akọwara na ZIP 200. Ugbu a, upgrade ọ bụla na-akọwa ihe abụọ: id alaka consensus nke na-akpọ nchịkọta iwu dị ugbu a, na ogo mmalite, ya bụ block ebe iwu ọhụrụ na-amalite ịrụ ọrụ. Nke a na-enye onye ọ bụla na-agba Zcash software oge doro anya iji melite tupu mgbanwe ahụ. Overwinter n'onwe ya malitere ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet na block 347,500. ZIP 201 na-ahụ maka otú nodes si emekọrịta ibe ha n'oge upgrade. Tupu mmalite, nodes na-ahọrọ ijikọ na ndị otu na-agba otu ụdị software ahụ. N'oge mmalite, node na-apụ na ndị otu nọ n'alaka consensus dị iche, ka network kewaa nke ọma dabere n'iwu ọhụrụ kama ịgba mgbagwoju anya. Nchedo megide mmegharị ugboro abụọ Mmegharị ugboro abụọ bụ mgbe mmadụ were Azụmahia nke ziri ezi na otu chain gbasaa ya ọzọ na chain ọzọ. Overwinter mechiri ohere ahụ site na atụmatụ signature [signature] ọhụrụ, nke akọwara na ZIP 143. Mgbe e-akpa ego [wallet] bịanyere Azụmahia aka, signature ahụ ugbu a na-ejikọta ya na id alaka consensus nke chain dị ugbu a. Azụmahia e binyere aka maka otu alaka anaghị adị irè ma ọlị na alaka ọzọ, n'akụkụ ọ bụla. Nke ahụ bụ ihe nchedo mmegharị ugboro abụọ n'akụkụ abụọ pụtara. Nke a na-arụkọ ọrụ nke ọma na usoro Azụmahia ụdị 3 ọhụrụ sitere na ZIP 202, nke a na-akpọ mgbe ụfọdụ usoro Overwintered. Ọ na-agbakwunye akara fOverwintered na id otu ụdị nke na-eme ka o doo anya nchịkọta iwu consensus Azụmahia nọ na ya. Dị ka uru mgbakwunye, atụmatụ signature ọhụrụ ahụ mekwara ka e nwee ike ịkwado Azụmahia Oha [transparent] ngwa ngwa. Mmebi oge Azụmahia ZIP 203 gbakwunyere mmebi oge Azụmahia. Azụmahia nwere ike ugbu a ịtọ ogo block njedebe. Ọ bụrụ na a gwụpụtabeghị ya ruo n'ogo ahụ, nodes na-ewepụ ya na mempool, ebe echere Azụmahia ndị a na-ekwenyebeghị. Tupu nke a, Azụmahia nwere ike ịnọ ogologo oge n'enweghị nkwenye. Mmebi oge pụtara na Azụmahia rapaara ga-emecha wepụ onwe ya, nke na-ebelata ejighị n'aka maka gị ma na-egbochi mempool imeju Azụmahia ochie a na-egwupụtabeghị. Ebe ọ dabara Overwinter bụ network upgrade mbụ nke Zcash mgbe mbido mainnet nke October 2016, e wepụtakwara ya n'ebumnuche tupu Sapling. Ọrụ ya bụ akụrụngwa, ọ bụghị atụmatụ ọhụrụ. Site n'ibu ụzọ wụnye usoro upgrade na ngwaọrụ nchedo mmegharị ugboro abụọ, ọ nyere upgrade ọ bụla sochirinụ (Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, Canopy, NU5, na ndị sochirinụ) ụzọ dị nchebe isi malite ịrụ ọrụ. title: Proof nke e chebere echebe [shielded] nke Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] na mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ

text: Proof nke e chebere echebe [shielded] nke Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] na mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ Nchịkọta ID Azụmahia [transaction] na-achọpụta Azụmahia, mana ọ naghị ekpughe onye nnata nke e chebere echebe, ego, ma ọ bụ memo. E mere mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ iji mee ka onye zitere ya gosi nkọwa ahọpụtara nke otu Kwụọ ụgwọ na-ekpugheghị akụkọ e-akpa ego [wallet] ya ndị ọzọ. Viewing key [viewing key] na-enye ohere ịgụ na-adịgide adịgide maka Adreesị akpa ego [address] ma ọ bụ akaụntụ. Jiri ya maka nyocha na-aga n'ihu, ọ bụghị maka esemokwu nke otu Kwụọ ụgwọ. Mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ enweghị ike igosi na enyere ngwongwo, mata mmadụ n'onwe ya, weghachite Kwụọ ụgwọ, ma ọ bụ dochie nyocha nkwenye. ZIP 311 ka bụ Draft. Ederede ya ugbu a ahapụghị nkwado Orchard, nkwado ntinye Oha [transparent], nzobe ederede [encryption], ịnye ụdị, na iwu nhụta onye ọrụ ka e mechaa. Ihe kpatara ID Azụmahia anaghị ezuru Onye ọ bụla nwere ike inyocha nkọwa ọha nke Kwụọ ụgwọ Zcash Oha. Ihe nchọgharị block [block] nwere ike igosi Adreesị akpa ego ya, ego ya, na ọnọdụ nkwenye ya. Kwụọ ụgwọ nke e chebere echebe na-arụ ọrụ n'ụzọ dị iche. Chain [chain] na-egosi na Azụmahia soro iwu Zcash, mana ọ naghị ebipụta onye zitere nke e chebere echebe, onye nnata, ego, ma ọ bụ memo. Ikekọrịta ID Azụmahia nwere ike igosi na a gwupụtara Azụmahia, mana ọ nweghị ike igosi onye ahịa ma ọ bụ onye nke atọ Kwụọ ụgwọ nzuzo dị n'ime ya. Nke a na-ebute nsogbu bara uru. Onye ahịa nwere ike ịdị mkpa idozi esemokwu ya na onye na-ere ahịa, exchange [exchange] nwere ike ịdị mkpa igosi na ọ haziri mwepụ ego, ma ọ bụ onye nyere onyinye nwere ike ịchọ igosi otu onyinye. Ikekọrịta viewing key zuru ezu ga-ekpughe karịa ihe nke ọ bụla n'ime ọnọdụ ndị a chọrọ. ZIP 311: Zcash Mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ na-atụ aro azịza dị warara karị: kpughee ma kwadoo ozi ahọpụtara sitere n'otu Azụmahia. Otu mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ si arụ ọrụ Usoro bụ isi bụ: Onye nkwenye na-enye onye zitere ya ihe ịma aka pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ ntụaka, mgbe proof [proof] mmekọrịta dabara adaba. Onye zitere ya na-ahọrọ Azụmahia na mpụta nke e chebere echebe ma ọ bụ mpụta ndị a ga-ekpughe. Ngwanrọ e-akpa ego kwekọrọ na-emepụta mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ jikọtara na Azụmahia ahụ na, dịka nhọrọ, ihe ịma aka ahụ. Onye zitere ya na-enye onye nkwenye mkpughe ahụ. Onye nkwenye na-enweta ezigbo Azụmahia ahụ n'aka node [node] ntụkwasị obi Zcash, na-enyocha na a gwupụtara ya, ma na-akwado mkpughe ahụ megide ya. Nsonaazụ ziri ezi na-akwado naanị nkwupụta dị na mkpughe ahụ. Nhazi ZIP nke Sapling na-eji igodo cipher na-apụ apụ weghachite mpụta ọ bụla ahọpụtara. Nke a nwere ike ikpughe onye nnata mpụta ahụ, ego, na memo. Ọ chọkwara proof ikike imefu maka opekata mpe otu ntinye Azụmahia, ya mere onye hụrụ Azụmahia ahụ naanị enweghị ike ịmepụta mkpughe ziri ezi dịka a ga-asị na ọ zitere ya. Mkpughe Kwụọ ụgwọ Sapling agaghị ekpughe Adreesị akpa ego onye zitere ya. Ikike imefu nwere ike ịchịkwa ọtụtụ Adreesị dị iche iche, yabụ igosi njikwa nke mmefu anaghị amata otu Adreesị na-akpaghị aka. title: Zingo 2.0 - Mmekọrịta Pepper
description: Zingo 2.0 bụ ụdị kachasị ọhụrụ nke e-akpa ego Zingo!, e-akpa ego dị fechaa, nke mepere emepe e wuru maka obodo Zcash. Kpakpando nke mwepụta a bụ Mmekọrịta…
text: Zingo 2.0 - Mmekọrịta Pepper Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa Mmekọrịta Pepper bụ injin mmekọrịta e webatara na Zingo! 2.0, e-akpa ego (wallet) Zcash nke mepere emepe nke Zingo Labs wuru. Ọ na-eji mmekọrịta na-adịghị agbaso ahịrị kwụ ọtọ kama inyocha chain n'ime nnukwu iberibe n'usoro, ya mere nguzozi na Azụmahia (transaction) gị na-apụta ngwa ngwa karịa. A na-echekwa ọganihu mgbe niile. Ọ bụrụ na njikọ akwụsị ma ọ bụ ngwa ahụ emechie, mmekọrịta ga-aga n'ihu ebe ọ kwụsịrị kama ịmalite ọzọ. Ị nwere ike imefu ego tupu mmekọrịta agwụ. Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe (shielded) na-anọgide na Nzuzo (privacy) n'oge usoro ahụ dum. Nkọwa Isi Zingo 2.0 bụ ụdị kachasị ọhụrụ nke e-akpa ego Zingo!, e-akpa ego dị fechaa, nke mepere emepe e wuru maka obodo Zcash. Kpakpando nke mwepụta a bụ Mmekọrịta Pepper, nkwalite dị mkpa nke na-atụgharị kpamkpam otú e-akpa ego si ejikọta na blockchain. N'oge gara aga, mmekọrịta nwere ike ịdị ka nke na-adị nwayọ nke ukwuu, nke njehie na-adịkarị, ma na-achọ nnukwu akụrụngwa, mgbe ụfọdụ na-amanye ndị ọrụ ịmalite site na mbido. Mmekọrịta Pepper na-agbanwe ihe ahụ niile. Ọ na-eme ka mmekọrịta dị ngwa, dị nro, bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi karịa, ma na-achọ obere ihe n'aka ngwaọrụ gị, ebe ọ na-echekwa Nzuzo nke Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe nke ọma. Ma ị bụ onye ọrụ ọhụrụ na-anwale Zcash maka oge mbụ, ma ọ bụ onye otu obodo nọrọla ogologo oge nke na-elekọta ọtụtụ e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, Mmekọrịta Pepper na-eme ka ahụmịhe ahụ dịkwuo mfe ma dị ụtọ. Njirimara isi nke Mmekọrịta Pepper Mmekọrịta Pepper na-eweta ọtụtụ nkwalite: Mmekọrịta Dị Ngwa Karị - E-akpa ego gị na-adị njikere n'ime nkeji ole na ole, ọ bụghị awa. Mmelite Amamihe - A na-ahazi data n'ime obere iberibe, na-ezere nyocha zuru ezu ọzọ. Na-eguzogide Nkwụsị - Ọ bụrụ na njikọ gị akwụsị, mmekọrịta na-aga n'ihu ebe ọ kwụsịrị. Dị Fechaa & Dị Irè - Ahaziri ya maka ekwentị, laptọọpụ, na ngwaọrụ ndị ọzọ na-enweghị nnukwu ike. Nzaghachi Doro Anya Karị - Mmelite ọganihu ozugbo na-ebelata mgbagwoju anya. Na-echekwa Nzuzo - Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na-anọgide na Nzuzo n'oge usoro ahụ. Ihe ka mma karịa na mbụ Ụdị Zingo ndị ochie na-akụda ndị ọrụ mmụọ mgbe ụfọdụ n'ihi ogologo oge mmekọrịta, ijikwa njehie na-edoghị anya, na iji nnukwu akụrụngwa. Mmekọrịta Pepper na-edozi nsogbu ndị a na-ahụkarị: Njirimara Ụdị Zingo Gara Aga Zingo 2.0 nwere Mmekọrịta Pepper ------------------ -------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------- Ọsọ Mmekọrịta Nwayọ karị, ọkachasị na nhazi mbụ Mmekọrịta mbụ na nke na-aga n'ihu dị ngwa nke ukwuu Ijikwa Njehie Ịkwụsị mgbe ụfọdụ na ọdịda na-edoghị anya Nkwụsi ike ka mma nwere mgbake akpaka Ahụmịhe Onye Ọrụ Mmekọrịta dị ka …ihe nzuzo… nye ndị mbido Oha, nwere ọkwa na mmelite doro anya Ọrụ Ngwaọrụ Iji CPU/memory dị elu Ahaziri maka iji akụrụngwa nke ọma N'ikwu ya nkenke: mmekọrịta dị ugbu a ngwa ngwa, a pụrụ ịtụkwasị ya obi karị, ma dị mfe ịghọta. Anya / Ntụnyere Chee na mmekọrịta e-akpa ego ochie dị ka ịgụ akwụkwọ dị ogologo nke ukwuu site na peeji mbụ, n'olu dara ụda, tupu e kwe ka ị kwuo ihe ọ bụla gbasara ya. Kwụsị n'etiti, ị ga-amalitekwa ọzọ site na peeji mbụ. Mmekọrịta Pepper na-agụ otu akwụkwọ ahụ, mana ọ na-edobe akara akwụkwọ, gụọ isiakwụkwọ ndị dị gị mkpa mbụ, ma kwe ka ị kwuo gbasara akụkọ ahụ tupu ị gụchaa peeji ikpeazụ. Akara akwụkwọ ahụ bụ akụkụ dị mkpa. Ụdị ọ bụla gara aga weere mmekọrịta a kwụsịrị dịka ọrụ furu efu; Mmekọrịta Pepper na-ewere ya dịka nkwụsịtụ. Ntuziaka anya Usoro Nkọwa Zuru Ezu - Na-egosi usoro ahụ dum. Usoro Dị Mfe - Nlele ngwa ngwa maka ndị ọrụ kwa ụbọchị. Nyocha Miri Emi Otu Mmekọrịta Pepper si arụ ọrụ (nlele dị mfe) Kama inyocha blockchain ọzọ n'ime nnukwu iberibe na-adịghị mfe, Mmekọrịta Pepper na-arụ ọrụ n'ime obere nzọụkwụ ndị a pụrụ ijikwa—na-echekwa ebe gị mgbe niile ka ọ na-aga. Jikọọ - E-akpa ego na-enyocha netwọk. Nweta block - A na-ebudata data nwayọọ nwayọọ. Nyochaa - A na-akwado Azụmahia. Jikwaa note ndị E Chebere Echebe - A na-echekwa Nzuzo mgbe niile. Melite Nguzoz

title: Nchekwa Mgbe-Quantum Gasịrị [Post-Quantum Security] na Zcash
description: Maka ihe Ironwood gbanwere na ọnọdụ nke akụkụ ọ bụla nwere ụbọchị, lee Zcash Ọ̀ Bụ Post-Quantum?.
text: Nchekwa Mgbe-Quantum Gasịrị [Post-Quantum Security] na Zcash Na Nkenke Kọmpụta kwantum bụ ihe ize ndụ n’ọdịnihu n’ihi na ha nwere ike imebi ụfọdụ cryptography igodo ọha [public-key cryptography] a na-eji na blockchain taa. “Post-quantum” pụtara cryptography [cryptography] na-arụ ọrụ na kọmpụta nkịtị ma e mere ya iji guzogide mwakpo sitere na kọmpụta kwantum n’ọdịnihu. Zcash abụghị post-quantum n’uju taa. Nke e chebere echebe Zcash na-ebelata ole data Azụmahia ọha ndị mwakpo n’ọdịnihu nwere ike mụọ, mana iji nke e chebere echebe abụghị otu na nguzogide kwantum zuru ezu. Zcash na-akwado site na nyocha, ZIP, na atụmatụ network upgrade dịka ZIP 2005 na Project Tachyon. Mbugharị post-quantum dị nchebe ga-echebe ego, Nzuzo, e-akpa ego, exchange, na iwu consensus n’otu oge. Maka ihe Ironwood gbanwere na ọnọdụ nke akụkụ ọ bụla nwere ụbọchị, lee Zcash Ọ̀ Bụ Post-Quantum?. Gịnị Bụ Quantum Computing? Kọmputa nkịtị na-echekwa ozi dị ka bits. Bit ọ bụla bụ 0 ma ọ bụ 1. Kọmputa quantum na-eji quantum bits, nke a na-akpọ qubits. Enwere ike iji qubits rụọ algorithms pụrụ iche na-edozi ụfọdụ nsogbu mgbakọ na mwepụ ngwa ngwa karịa kọmputa nkịtị. Nke a apụtaghị na kọmputa quantum na-adị ngwa karịa n’ihe niile. Ihe ize ndụ ahụ bụ kpọmkwem. Ụfọdụ cryptography na-adabere na nsogbu mgbakọ na mwepụ siri ike nke ukwuu maka kọmputa nkịtị mana dị mfe karị maka kọmputa quantum buru ibu nke zuru ezu. Maka blockchain, ihe atụ kachasị mkpa bụ cryptography igodo ọhaneze. A na-eji igodo ọhaneze na signature gosi na onye ọrụ kwere ka e mefuo mkpụrụ ego. Ihe Mere Blockchain Ji Elekọta Ya Blockchain na-eji cryptography arụ ọrụ dị iche iche: Ngwá ọrụ cryptography Ihe ọ na-eme Mmetụta quantum --- --- --- Digital signature Gosi na onye nwe ya kwadoro mmefu Nnukwu ihe ize ndụ maka usoro elliptic-curve ndị a na-ahụkarị Hash functions Wuo Adreesị akpa ego, commitment, osisi Merkle, na challenges Ihe ize ndụ dị ala, mana oke nchekwa dị mkpa Zero-knowledge proof Gosi na Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe dị irè n’ebughị nkọwa ya Ọ dabere na usoro proof na echiche e ji wuo ya Nkwekọrịta igodo Na-enyere e-akpa ego aka izobe data note maka ndị natara ya Ọ chọrọ nlebara anya nke ọma n’okpuru ụdị iyi egwu quantum Kọmputa quantum nke nwere ike zuru ezu nwere ike iyi ọtụtụ atụmatụ signature egwu a na-eji taa, gụnyere signature elliptic-curve. Nke a dị mkpa n’ihi na signature bụ ihe na-eme ka network mata na ọ bụ igodo ziri ezi nyere ikike Azụmahia ahụ. Hash functions dị iche. Algorithm Grover nwere ike mee ka nchọ brute force dị ngwa, mana ọ naghị emebi hash functions n’otu ụzọ ahụ kpọmkwem. Oke nchekwa buru ibu nwere ike inye aka. Gịnị Bụ Post-Quantum Cryptography? Post-quantum cryptography bụ cryptography e mere ka ọ nọgide na-adị nchebe megide kọmputa nkịtị na kọmputa quantum nke ọdịnihu. Ọ pụtaghị na cryptography ahụ na-eji kọmputa quantum. Ọ pụtara na usoro ahụ dabere na nsogbu mgbakọ na mwepụ siri ike dị iche. N’afọ 2024, NIST wepụtara ụkpụrụ post-quantum mbụ emechara: ML-KEM maka ịtọlite igodo ML-DSA maka digital signature SLH-DSA maka digital signature dabere na hash Ụkpụrụ ndị a bụ nnukwu nzọụkwụ, mana blockchain enweghị ike ịgbanwe naanị otu algorithm gaa n’ọzọ n’abalị otu. A ghaghị ịtụle iwu consensus, e-akpa ego, hardware wallet, nha Azụmahia, ugwo, na Nzuzo niile. Otu Ihe Ize Ndụ Quantum Si Apụta On-Chain Ụzọ dị mfe isi ghọta ihe ize ndụ ahụ bụ: Onye ọrụ na-emepụta ụzọ igodo abụọ. Igodo ọhaneze ma ọ bụ data signature nwere ike ịpụta on-chain. Onye mwakpo quantum n’ọdịnihu nwere ike iji ihe ọhaneze ahụ mụta igodo nzuzo. Ọ bụrụ na ego ka dị n’okpuru njikwa igodo ahụ, ha nwere ike ịnọ n’ihe ize ndụ. Blockchain Oha na-ekpughe ọtụtụ ozi n’ime nhazi ha. Adreesị akpa ego, ọnụ ego, na njikọ Azụmahia bụ ọhaneze. Ihe igodo ọhaneze nwekwara ike ịpụta mgbe a na-emefu mkpụrụ ego. Nke a bụ otu ihe mere iji Adreesị akpa ego ugboro ugboro ji dị njọ. Iji ya ọzọ na-enye ndị na-ekiri data karịa nke ha ga-ejikọta taa, ma na-enye ndị mwakpo ọdịnihu ihe akụkọ ihe mere eme karịa ha ga-enyoch

title: Nnweta ozi nzuzo [Private information retrieval]
description: Zcash na-ezo onye Azụmahia bụ maka ya. Nzuzo ahụ na-eweta ajụjụ siri ike: ọ bụrụ na netwọk enweghị ike ịhụ Azụmahia ndị bụ nke gị, kedu ka e-akpa ego nke gị si…
text: Nnweta ozi nzuzo [Private information retrieval] TL;DR Nnweta ozi nzuzo, ma ọ bụ PIR, na-eme ka ngwaọrụ nweta otu ihe n’ebe nchekwa data sava dị na-enweghị ka sava ahụ mata ihe a rịọrọ Zcash chọrọ nke a n’ihi na e-akpa ego nzuzo [private wallet] enweghị ike ịjụ sava Azụmahia [transaction] ndị bụ nke ya n’emeghị ka a mata ya Taa, e-akpa ego na-ebudata ma na-enyocha data karịrị nke ha chọrọ, nke bụ nnukwu ihe mere mmekọrịta [syncing] ji adị nwayọ PIR ga-eme ka e-akpa ego nweta naanị data nke ya n’enweghị ikpughe ya, wepụ mgbochi ahụ ma debe Nzuzo [privacy] ahụ Ọ bụ mpaghara nyocha na-arụ ọrụ maka Zcash, nwere ike dị ukwuu n’usoro echiche, ma a na-eme ka ọ baa uru maka e-akpa ego n’ezi ndụ Ònye ka nke a bụ maka ya Onye ọ bụla jụrụ onwe ya otú e-akpa ego nwere Nzuzo [privacy] si achọta mkpụrụ ego nke ya n’enweghị ikpughe ndị ha bụ Ndị ọhụrụ na-ahụ PIR ka a na-ekwu maka ya n’akụkụ ọrụ scaling nke Zcash Ndị na-agụ chọrọ ibu ụzọ ghọta echiche ahụ, ma ghọta kriptografi [cryptography] dị n’okpuru ya emechaa Nsogbu PIR na-edozi maka Zcash Zcash na-ezo onye Azụmahia bụ maka ya. Nzuzo ahụ na-eweta ajụjụ siri ike: ọ bụrụ na netwọk enweghị ike ịhụ Azụmahia ndị bụ nke gị, kedu ka e-akpa ego nke gị si achọta ha? Taa, azịza ya dị kpọmkwem. E-akpa ego enweghị ike ịjụ sava Azụmahia ndị bụ nke m, n’ihi na ajụjụ ahụ ga-ekpughe kpọmkwem ihe Zcash na-achọ izo. Ya mere, e-akpa ego na-ebudata nnukwu data ma na-anwale ihe ọ bụla n’ime ya n’ime ngwaọrụ iji hụ ihe bụ nke ya. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ, ọ na-echebekwa Nzuzo, mana ọ dị nwayọ ma dị arọ. Nnyocha a bụ otu n’ime isi ihe mere mmekọrịta e-akpa ego ji enwe ike ịdị nwayọ. Ihe kachasị mma ga-abụ ụzọ e-akpa ego ga-eji rịọ sava kpọmkwem data nke ya, nata ya, na-enweghị ka sava ahụ mara ihe a rịọrọ. Nke ahụ bụ kpọmkwem ihe nnweta ozi nzuzo na-enye. Ihe PIR bụ Nnweta ozi nzuzo bụ usoro cryptography nke na-eme ka client gụọ otu ntinye sitere n’ebe nchekwa data sava dị na-enweghị ikpughe sava ahụ ntinye ọ gụrụ. Cheedị ọbá akwụkwọ ebe ị nwere ike ịnata kpọmkwem akwụkwọ ịchọrọ, mana onye na-elekọta ọbá akwụkwọ amaghị akwụkwọ o nyere gị. Ị na-enweta ihe gị, mmasị gị akwụgidere na nzuzo. PIR bụ ụdị mgbakọ na mwepụ nke echiche ahụ, etinyere n’ebe nchekwa data ọ bụla. A mụọla echiche a na cryptography kemgbe ọtụtụ iri afọ. Ebu ụzọ webata ya na 1995 site n’aka Chor, Goldreich, Kushilevitz, na Sudan, ndị kọwara usoro ọtụtụ sava, ebe ụdị sava otu mbụ sochiri na 1997 site n’aka Kushilevitz na Ostrovsky. Ọ bụghị ihe Zcash chepụtara, ọ bụ mpaghara e guzobeworo nke Zcash na-etinye ugbu a n’ọrụ maka nsogbu dị adị ma sie ike. Ka PIR si arụ ọrụ, n’ọkwa mbụ E nwere ụzọ abụọ sara mbara e si ewulite PIR, ọdịiche ha dịkwa mkpa. Nke mbụ na-eji ọtụtụ sava. Client na-eziga sava ọ bụla n’ime ọtụtụ sava otu akụkụ nke ajụjụ ahụ, ma jikọta azịza ha n’ime ngwaọrụ. Ọ nweghị otu sava na-ahụ zuru ezu iji mata ihe a rịọrọ. Nke a na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma, mana ọ dabere n’ịhụ na sava ndị ahụ anaghị arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ, nke siri ike ikwe nkwa n’ụwa n’ezi ndụ. Nke abụọ na-eji otu sava na cryptography nwere amamihe kama iji ọtụtụ ndị otu. N’ebe a, client na-adabere na ngwá ọrụ pụrụ iche a na-akpọ homomorphic encryption, nke a bụkwa ntụziaka kasị baa uru maka ntinye n’ọrụ n’ezi ndụ, n’ihi na ọ dịghị achọ ọtụtụ sava ndị na-adịghị arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ. Usoro ahụ: homomorphic encryption Homomorphic encryption bụ ụdị Nzobe ederede [encryption] nke na-eme ka sava rụọ mgbakọ na data mgbe data ahụ ka zoro ezo. Sava na-emepụta azịza ziri ezi e zoro ezo n’enweghị mgbe ọ bụla ọ hụrụ ụkpụrụ dị n’okpuru ya. Nke a bụ echiche dị n’azụ PIR nke sava otu e ji usoro a wuo. Client chọrọ ihe nọmba atọ n’ime ndepụta. Ọ na-ewulite ajụjụ nke, n’ezie, bụ ee e zoro ezo maka ọnọdụ nke atọ na mba e zoro ezo maka ọnọdụ ọ bụla ọzọ. Nye sava ahụ, ajụjụ a bụ naanị mkpọtụ enweghị isi; ọ nweghị ike ịmata ọnọdụ nke nwere ee ahụ. Sava ahụ na-ejikọta ebe nchekwa data ya na ajụjụ a e zoro ezo site n’iji njirimara pụrụ iche nke homomorphic encryption, na-amụba ihe ọ bụla echekwara site n’ee ma ọ bụ mba e zoro e

title: Ọrụ Tachyon
description: Zcash na-ezo onye Kwụọ ụhwọ bụ maka ya. Nke ahụ bụ ebumnuche ya niile, ọ na-emekwa ka e nwee nsogbu na-adịghị mfe: ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ịmata onye…
text: Ọrụ Tachyon Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa Tachyon bụ atụmatụ imegharị ụzọ Zcash e-akpa ego si achọta ma na-emefu ego nke e chebere echebe, nke e mere iji kwe ka netwọk ahụ too ruo n’ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ dị ukwuu Taa, e-akpa ego ga-anwa iwepu Nzobe ederede n’oke akụkụ nke blockchain iji chọpụta Kwụọ ụhwọ ndị bụ nke ya, nke a bụkwa isi ihe mere ịmekọrịta nke e chebere echebe ji adị nwayọ Tachyon ji mmekọrịta na-amaghị ama [oblivious synchronization] dochie nke a, ka e-akpa ego wee nweta ihe ọ chọrọ n’enweghị ịnyocha ihe niile ma ghara ịgwa sava akụkụ ndị ọ chọrọ Ọ na-ebufekwa nkọwa Kwụọ ụhwọ site na blockchain tinye ya n’arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ n’onwe ya, nke na-eme ka protocol dị mfe mana na-ebufe ọrụ ahụ n’aka e-akpa ego Ọ bụ atụmatụ, nke ebipụtara mbụ n’ọnwa Eprel 2025. Ọ abụghị akụkụ nke NU7 ma ewepụtabeghị ya, ọ chọkwara mgbalị injinịa hà ka nke network upgrade Sapling Ònye ka nke a bụ maka ya Onye ọ bụla hụrụ e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe ka ọ na-emekọrịta ma jụọ ihe mere o ji ewe ogologo oge Ndị ọhụrụ na-ahụkarị ka a na-ekwu maka Tachyon n’akụkụ scaling NU7 na Zcash Ndị na-agụ chọrọ ịghọta echiche ahụ mbụ, cryptography emesịa Nsogbu Tachyon na-edozi Zcash na-ezo onye Kwụọ ụhwọ bụ maka ya. Nke ahụ bụ ebumnuche ya niile, ọ na-emekwa ka e nwee nsogbu na-adịghị mfe: ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ịmata onye Kwụọ ụhwọ bụ nke ya, olee otú e-akpa ego nke gị ga-esi achọta nke gị? Na Bitcoin, nke a dị mfe. Adreesị akpa ego bụ nke ọha, ya mere e-akpa ego nwere ike ịjụ sava …gịnị ka ezitere na Adreesị akpa ego a?… ma nweta azịza. E-akpa ego Zcash enweghị ike ịjụ ajụjụ ahụ, n’ihi na ịjụ ya ga-ekpughe kpọmkwem ihe pool nke e chebere echebe ka e mere iji zoo. Ya mere Zcash na-eme ihe dị iche. Onye zitere ego na-eji Nzobe ederede zoo nkọwa Kwụọ ụhwọ ma tinye ha n’ime Azụmahia ahụ n’onwe ya. E-akpa ego gị na-agazi Azụmahia ndị dị na chain ma nwaa iwepu Nzobe ederede nke ọ bụla. Ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ mbọ niile anaghị aga nke ọma. Ole na ole gara nke ọma bụ Kwụọ ụhwọ gị. A na-akpọ nke a nnwale iwepu Nzobe ederede [trial decryption], ọ bụ nzuzo, ziri ezi, ma dị nwayọ. Ihe mgbagwoju anya dị na ya bụ ihe ọrụ ahụ dabere na ya. Mgbalị e-akpa ego gị na-eme dabere n’ibu chain ahụ, ọ bụghị n’ọnụọgụ Kwụọ ụhwọ ị natara n’eziokwu. Onye na-anatabeghị ọbụna otu Kwụọ ụhwọ na-arụ ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu ọrụ onye na-anata ha kwa ụbọchị na-arụ. Ka Zcash na-eto, nke a na-akawanye njọ maka onye ọ bụla. N’okwu atụmatụ ahụ, ọ …anaghị scaling ma ọlị.… Ihe Tachyon na-agbanwe Tachyon na-awakpo nsogbu ahụ n’isi mgbọrọgwụ ya: ọ kwụsịrị iji blockchain dị ka ụzọ e si ebufe ihe nzuzo Kwụọ ụhwọ. Kama nke ahụ, nkọwa ndị ị chọrọ na-eso arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ n’onwe ya, n’èzí band. Arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ, URI, ma ọ bụ QR code na-eburu ozi nke e ji Nzobe ederede zoo n’ime Azụmahia mbụ. Sean Bowe kọwara nke a dị ka ịnakwere Kwụọ ụhwọ n’èzí band [out-of-band payments] maka oge mbụ n’ime protocol Zcash nke e chebere echebe. Mgbe chain ahụ anaghịzi ebu ozi ahụ, e-akpa ego gị enweghịzi ihe mere ọ ga-eji chọọ ya, nsogbu nnwale iwepu Nzobe ederede ahụ akwụsịkwa. E-akpa ego gị ka kwesịrị ịma ọnọdụ chain dị ugbu a iji nwee ike imefu ego. Nke ahụ bụ ọkara nke abụọ nke imewe ahụ, mmekọrịta na-amaghị ama: ụzọ e-akpa ego si enweta ihe ndị ọ chọrọ kpọmkwem n’enweghị ikpughe sava ihe ndị ọ rịọrọ. Ihe ọ ga-apụtara onye na-eji e-akpa ego Ime mmekọrịta anaghịzi eto na chain. Oge e-akpa ego gị na-eji iru ọnọdụ ugbu a ga-adabere n’ọrụ gị n’onwe gị kama n’ibu Zcash. Kwụọ ụhwọ ga-adịkwu ka inye mmadụ akwụkwọ ụgwọ. Arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ na-ebu ihe onye natara ego chọrọ, ya mere mgbanwe dị n’etiti onye zitere na onye natara ego ga-adị mkpa karịa ka ọ dị taa. E-akpa ego na-ebu ọrụ ka ukwuu. Ebe chain anaghịzi ejide otu nzuzo nke nkọwa Kwụọ ụhwọ gị, ida data e-akpa ego gị dị mkpa karịa. Ndabere na mgbake na-esi n’ịbụ atụmatụ protocol ghọọ ihe software e-akpa ego ga-eme nke ọma. Ụfọdụ ihe ndị a maara nke ọma na-apụ ma ọ bụ na-apụ n’ọzọ.
