title: Sapling
description: Sapling malitere ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash na block 419,200 (Ọktoba 29, 2018, 02:15 UTC).
text: Sapling Sapling malitere ịrụ ọrụ na mainnet Zcash na block 419,200 (Ọktoba 29, 2018, 02:15 UTC). Ihe ị ga-amụta: Sapling mere ka ịkwụ ụgwọ Zcash nke onwe bụrụ nke dị ngwa ma dị mfe nke ga-arụ ọrụ na ekwentị ma ọ bụ hardware wallet. Sapling bụ network upgrade Zcash nke abụọ dị mkpa, nke malitere n'emume ncheta afọ abụọ nke Zcash. Ọ bụ consensus hard fork nke wughachiri otu e si ejikọta Azụmahia (transaction) nke e chebere echebe. A kọwara mwepụta ya site na ZIP 205, iwu signature Azụmahia ọhụrụ site na ZIP 243, ha abụọ dabere na ZIP 200, usoro network upgrade. Nkọwa zuru ezu dị na Protocol Specification nke Zcash. Electric Coin Company wuru upgrade ahụ wee wepụta ụdị mbụ kwadoro ya, zcashd 2.0.0, n'Ọgọọst 2018. Na chain, network na-eji consensus branch id ya amata iwu Sapling. Ihe mere nke a ji dị mkpa. Tupu Sapling, ime Kwụọ ụhwọ nkeonwe n'ezie pụtara ichere ọtụtụ nkeji ebe kọmputa gị ji gigabyte ọtụtụ nke ebe nchekwa rụọ proof (proof). Nke ahụ dị nwayọ ma dị arọ nke ukwuu maka ọtụtụ mmadụ, ya mere ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ, exchange, na ụlọ ahịa ahapụ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe ma ziga ZEC n'ihu ọha kama. Sapling belatara ọrụ ahụ ruo sekọnd ole na ole na ihe dị ka megabyte 40 nke ebe nchekwa. Mgbanwe ahụ naanị ya mere ZEC nke e chebere echebe bụrụ ihe bara uru iji na ndụ kwa ụbọchị, na ekwentị nkịtị na hardware wallet. Na nkenke Sapling bụ network upgrade Zcash ukwu nke abụọ, nke malitere na block 419,200 (Ọktoba 29, 2018, 02:15 UTC) — ụbọchị ncheta afọ nke abụọ nke Zcash. Ọ wughachiri Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe gburugburu circuit abụọ e wuru maka ọrụ kpọmkwem (Spend na Output), dochie otu circuit JoinSplit dị nwayọ nke Sprout (ZIP 205, ZIP 243). Ihe si na ya pụta: iwu proof siri n’ime nkeji na gigabyte ebe nchekwa gbadaa ruo sekọnd ole na ole na ihe dị ka 40 MB — dị mfe nke ukwuu maka ekwentị na hardware wallet. Njirimara ọhụrụ: Adreesị akpa ego dị iche iche (ọtụtụ Adreesị akpa ego Kwụọ ụhwọ Ihe na-apughi ijikọ ọnụ sitere n’otu igodo), viewing key maka nnweta naanị maka nyocha, na ikewapụ iwu proof na mbinye signature. Paramiita ya sitere n’emume nke akụkụ ọtụtụ nwere usoro abụọ (Powers of Tau + Sapling MPC); nchekwa na-adịgide ma ọ bụrụgodị na naanị otu onye sonyere mere ihe n’eziokwu. Ntụnyere anya Sprout bụ onye ozi nzuzo nke ji aka ya ebu akwụkwọ ozi ọ bụla gafee mba ahụ — nzuzo zuru oke, mana ọ dị nwayọ ma na-agwụ ike. Sapling mere ka otu onye ozi ahụ bụrụ onye na-agba igwe nke nwere obere akpa n'azụ ya: ka bụ nke nzuzo, mana ọ dị ngwa nke ọma maka nnyefe kwa ụbọchị. Igodo viewing key ọhụrụ dịkwa ka inye onye nyocha windo doro anya n'ime akwụkwọ ndekọ onye ozi ahụ, n'enyeghị ya Igodo ego nke ibu ahụ mgbe ọ bụla. Ihe gbanwere Obi Sapling bụ ụzọ ngwa ngwa iji wuo zero-knowledge proof nke na-eme ka Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe bụrụ nkeonwe. Nhazi mbụ Sprout ji otu proving circuit (JoinSplit circuit) nke dị nwayọ ma na-achọ ebe nchekwa dị ukwuu. Sapling jiri circuit abụọ e wuru maka ọrụ kpọmkwem dochie ya, Spend circuit na Output circuit, dịka akọwara na Protocol Specification nke Zcash. Ihe si na ya pụta bụ mbelata ọnụ ahịa dị ukwuu. Maka Electric Coin Company ọ bụla, enwere ike iwulite Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe n'ime sekọnd ole na ole site n'iji ihe dị ka megabyte 40 nke ebe nchekwa. Ntọala Sprout tupu Sapling dị arọ karịa nke ukwuu, ihe dị ka nkeji na gigabyte ọtụtụ nke ebe nchekwa (ọnụọgụ ndị a nke akụkụ Sprout bụ ntọala atụ a na-ekwukarị). Igodo ọhụrụ Sapling webatakwara usoro ọhụrụ nke Adreesị akpa ego na igodo nke e chebere echebe. Otu igodo nwere ike ịmepụta ọtụtụ Adreesị akpa ego dị iche iche, bụ Adreesị akpa ego Kwụọ ụhwọ dị iche iche nke onye na-ekiri n'èzí enweghị ike ijikọghachi ibe ha. Sapling gbakwụnyere viewing key kwa: viewing key zuru ezu ma ọ bụ nke na-abata na-enye gị ohere ịkekọrịta ike ịhụ nkọwa Azụmahia e-akpa ego na-enweghị inye ikike iji ego dị n'ime ya. Nke a bara uru maka nyocha, idekọ ego, ma ọ bụ naanị igosi na e mere Kwụọ ụhwọ. Mgbanwe metụtara ya bụ na Sapling kewapụrụ ọrụ iwulite proof na ọrụ

title: Ntuli Aka Ndị Nwere Ego Nke E Chebere Echebe
description: N’Ọgọọst 2026, Zcash mere ntuli aka ndị nwere ego nke edobere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ya na nzobe ederede, naanị mkpokọta ikpeazụ ka e kpughere, site n’iji…
text: Ntuli Aka Ndị Nwere Ego Nke E Chebere Echebe N’Ọgọọst 2026, Zcash mere ntuli aka ndị nwere ego nke edobere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ya na nzobe ederede, naanị mkpokọta ikpeazụ ka e kpughere, site n’iji usorontuli aka nke e chebere echebe nke Valar Group wuru. Ihe ị ga-amụta: otu esi eji ego ZEC ị nwere tụọ ibu ntuli aka, debe ya na nzuzo, ma ka gụọ ya nke ọma, na-enweghị onye ọ bụla ịmata otu ị si tụọ aka ma ọ bụ ego ị nwere. Ntuli aka ndị nwere ego nke e chebere echebe na-enye ndị ji Zcash ohere ịtụ aka n’ajụjụ gbasara gburugburu obibi ha site n’iji ZEC nke e chebere echebe ha. Ọ dịghị onye na-amụta ihe onye ọ bụla tụrụ aka ma ọ bụ ego ZEC ole ha nwere, ma onye ọ bụla ka nwere ike nyochaa na mkpokọta ahụ ziri ezi. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ na chain ntuli aka pụrụ iche nke Valar Group wuru, dị iche na mainnet Zcash, ya mere ego gị n’ezie anaghị agagharị. Maka otu Zcash si eme mkpebi n’ụzọ sara mbara, lee nkọwa Zcash Banyere Ego na Gọọmentị. Ibe a bụ naanị maka usorontuli aka cryptographic. Ị bụ onye ọhụrụ na Zcash? Malite na Gịnị bụ ZEC na Zcash, Pool Ndị E Chebere Echebe, na zk-SNARKs, ma lọghachi ebe a. Ihe mere ntuli aka nzuzo ji sie ike Ezigbo ntuli aka ndị nwere ego chọrọ ihe anọ n’otu oge, ụzọ doro anya isi nweta ha na-emegidekwa ibe ha. Tụọ ibu site na ego ejidere, nke mere na ịnwe ZEC karịa na-enye ibu karịa. Nzuzo nke nhọrọ, ka onye ọ bụla ghara ịma otu ị tụrụ aka. Nzuzo nke nguzo ego, ka onye ọ bụla ghara ịma ego ZEC ole i nwere. Ọgụgụ ziri ezi, a ga-enyochakwa ya, nke onye ọ bụla nwere ike ilele. Iji ego ejidere tụọ ibu, o yiri ka ị ga-achọ nguzo ego onye ọ bụla. Iji gụọ akwụkwọ ntuli aka, o yiri ka ị ga-achọ imeghe ha. Ime nke ọ bụla n’ụzọ dị mfe na-ekpughe kpọmkwem ozi nzuzo pool nke e chebere echebe dị iji chebe, ntuli aka ego ndị gara aga kpugherekwa ozi nguzo ego n’ihi nke a. Ntuli aka e chebere echebe na-edozi esemokwu ahụ site n’otu ngwá ọrụ na-akwado ịkwụ ụhwọ nke e chebere echebe: proof zero-knowledge, nullifier, na nzobe ederede. Echiche ahụ: igbe akwụkwọ ntuli aka na-agụ onwe ya Turnstile na-eme ka i nwee ike ịgụta ihe na-agafe n’ụlọ nchekwa akụ na-ahụghị ihe dị n’ime. Igbe akwụkwọ ntuli aka e chebere echebe na-aga n’ihu otu nzọụkwụ ọzọ: ọ na-agbakọta votu ndị e mechiri emechi n’emeghịghe ha. Cheedị igbe akwụkwọ ntuli aka nwere ikike atọ pụrụ iche. Ọ nwere ike itinye envelopu e mechiri emechi na mkpokọta na-aga n’ihu n’emeghịghe ya. Otu ìgwè ndị ọrụ, nke ọ dịghị onye ọ bụla n’ime ha ji igodo ahụ naanị ya, mechaa kpughee naanị mkpokọta ikpeazụ. Tupu e kwe ka ị tụba envelopu n’ime ya, ị na-egosi nwayọọ na i nwere ZEC n’oge gara aga a kara aka nakwa na ịtụbeghị aka mbụ, n’egosịghị mkpụrụ ego nke bụ nke gị. Ihe niile dị n’okpuru bụ otu esi ewu igbe ahụ n’ezie. Ikike itinye aka na snapshot Oge ntuli aka na-edobe elu snapshot, otu block mainnet Zcash, ibu gị bụkwa nguzo ego nke e chebere echebe ị nwere ike imefu n’ime pool Ironwood n’oge block ahụ. Iwu a dị mfe: otu Ironwood ZEC na snapshot hà otu votu. Maka ntuli aka gbasara oke ọrụ NU7, snapshot bụ mainnet block 3,459,350, ihe dị ka Ọgọọst 24, 2026 na 19:00 UTC, ebe ntuli aka meghere ruo Septemba 14, 2026 na 19:00 UTC. A na-elekọta ZEC Oha iche site n’ụzọ ochie, ọ bụghị site na protocol a. Ego gị anaghị agagharị ma ọ bụ kpọchie. A na-edobe ikike na snapshot, ya mere ị nwere ike imefu ma ọ bụ bugharịa ZEC ozugbo e mesịrị na-enweghị imetụta votu gị. Enweghị usoro ndebanye aha. Elu snapshot bụ naanị ihe a chọrọ, nke na-eme ka usoro ahụ dị mfe ma zere ikpughe onye bu n’obi ịtụ aka. Igosi nguzo ego gị n’ekpugheghị ya Mgbe ị tụrụ aka, e-akpa ego gị na-emepụta proof zero-knowledge na-egosi na na snapshot, ị na-achịkwa ụfọdụ ZEC nke e chebere echebe a na-emefubeghị. Ọ na-egosi igwe ọgụgụ nzuzo nguzo ego ziri ezi na oke ya, mana ọ naghị ekpughe note ọ bụla ma ọ naghị emepụta azụmahia na mainnet Zcash. Proof ahụ na-emepụta kredit ntuli aka na chain ntuli aka hà nguzo ego gị na snapshot, nke igodo ntuli aka ọhụrụ e-akpa ego gị mepụtara maka oge a naanị ya nwe. Ebe igodo ahụ dị ọhụrụ ma eji

title: Mbinye Aka Oyi Nke E Chebere Echebe
description: Isi echiche: E-akpa ego ibe ya na-ahụ ihe niile dị mkpa iji wuo ma nyochaa Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe. Naanị hardware wallet na-ejide ikike ịkwado mmefu…
text: Mbinye Aka Oyi Nke E Chebere Echebe Isi echiche: E-akpa ego ibe ya na-ahụ ihe niile dị mkpa iji wuo ma nyochaa Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe. Naanị hardware wallet na-ejide ikike ịkwado mmefu ego. Nkewa ahụ bụ isi ihe mbinye aka oyi nke e chebere echebe pụtara. Ichekwa ego na Zcash gụnyere ibufe ego site na Adreesị akpa ego Oha gaa na nke onwe, nke e chebere echebe, na-ezo nkọwa Azụmahia site n’iji atụmatụ Nzuzo [privacy] nke Zcash. Gịnị na-agbanwe mgbe ị chebere ZEC? Site na Azụmahia Zcash Oha, enwere ike ịhụ ozi dịka: Adreesị akpa ego onye zitere Adreesị akpa ego onye nata ego e bufere na blockchain. Mgbe ị na-echebe ZEC, ego gị na-abanye na pool nke onwe (dịka Ironwood). Blockchain nwere ike ikwenye na Azụmahia dị irè n’egosịghị nkọwa Azụmahia nkeonwe gị. Kemgbe mmelite NU6.3 na 28 Julaị 2026, ego a ka chebere ọhụrụ na-abanye na pool Ironwood ebe pool Orchard ochie anaghịzi anabata nkwụnye ego ọhụrụ, mana ọ ka na-ekwe ka a wepụta ego. Akụkụ Nke Azụmahia E Chebere Echebe Note (Ndekọ Ego Fọdụrụ Nke E Chebere Echebe) Note bụ ndekọ nzuzo, nke cryptographic, na-anọchi anya ego ZEC a na-emefubeghị nke onye ọrụ nwere. N’adịghị ka blockchain ọha, ebe a na-edepụta ego fọdụrụ n’ụzọ doro anya, note nke e chebere echebe na-ezochi uru na nkọwa nwe ya ka ndị na-ekiri on-chain ghara ịhụ onye nwere ego ahụ. Mgbe a malitere Azụmahia, e-akpa ego ibe ya na-enyocha ledger, na-achọpụta note onye ọrụ a na-emefubeghị, ma họrọ note ndị a ga-emefu. Nullifier (Usoro Ịchọpụta Mmefu Ugboro Abụọ) Ebe ọ bụ na ezoro nkọwa note n’aka ledger ọha, network chọrọ usoro iji chọpụta mmefu ugboro abụọ na-ekpugheghị note a na-emefu. Nullifier bụ akara cryptographic pụrụ iche esitere na note kpọmkwem. Mgbe a na-emefu note, a na-ebipụta nullifier ya na blockchain. Network na-achọpụta na edebeghị nullifier ahụ na mbụ. Ọ bụrụ na edebeghị ya, enwere ike ịnakwere mmefu ahụ. Nke dị mkpa bụ na onye na-ekiri n’èzí enweghị ike iji nullifier mata note kpọmkwem o siri na ya pụta. E-akpa ego ibe ya na-esite ma na-ewu nullifier kwesịrị ekwesị dị ka akụkụ nke ịchịkọta data Azụmahia. Igodo Igodo bụ mkpụrụ ozi cryptographic na-achịkwa ohere ịnweta ego gị ma kwe ka e-akpa ego gị rụọ ọrụ dịka ịnata, ịhụ, na imefu ZEC. E-akpa ego na-ejide ọtụtụ Igodo dị iche iche, nke ọ bụla nwere ebumnuche dị iche, dịka otu akaụntụ nwere ike inwe nzere dị iche maka ohere ịgụ na ohere ide. Igodo bụ etiti mmekọrịta dị n’etiti e-akpa ego ibe ya na hardware wallet, n’ihi na Igodo dị iche na-arụ ọrụ dị iche, ma naanị otu n’ime ha kwesịrị ịnọgide kpọchiri. Ọ dị mkpa ịmara na pool ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe na-ewu Igodo ya dịka osisi mwepụta, ebe akụ na-atụ aka site n’otu akụkụ gaa n’ihe ọ bụla a pụrụ isite na ya nweta. Ndị ọrụ chọrọ ịnata Kwụọ ụhwọ nke e chebere echebe ga-enwerịrị Adreesị akpa ego Kwụọ ụhwọ nke e chebere echebe, nke a na-emepụta site na Igodo ego. Ọkwa Igodo 1. Igodo ego Nke a bụ Igodo kacha metụta nchekwa. Ọ na-enye ikike cryptographic iji kwado mmefu ZEC. Nke a bụ Igodo a na-ekwu maka ya mgbe ọ bụla e kwuru na “hardware wallet na-ejide Igodo” n’akụkụ ndị ọzọ nke akụkọ a. N’usoro mbinye aka oyi, a na-edobe Igodo ego n’ime hardware wallet ma ghara ikpughere ya e-akpa ego ibe ya. E-akpa ego ibe ya ekwesịghị inwe Igodo a ma ọlị. Na Sapling na Orchard abụọ ahụ, ọkwa Igodo na-esite na Igodo ego mgbọrọgwụ wepụta ikike mmefu na ikike ịhụ dịka alaka abụọ dị iche: Sapling: Igodo ego a gbasapụrụ (𝑎𝑠𝑘,𝑛𝑠𝑘,𝑜𝑣𝑘) na-esitepụta Igodo ikikere proof (𝑎𝑘,𝑛𝑠𝑘) na Full Viewing Key (𝑎𝑘,𝑛𝑘,𝑜𝑣𝑘), ndị nke a na-esitepụta ọzọ viewing key mbata (𝑖𝑣𝑘) na Adreesị akpa ego dịgasị iche. Orchard: Igodo ego mgbọrọgwụ (𝑠𝑘) na-ekewa ozugbo gaa na Igodo ikikere mmefu (𝑎𝑠𝑘) na Full Viewing Key (𝑎𝑘,𝑛𝑘,𝑟𝑖𝑣𝑘). Nkewa nhazi a na-enye ntọala cryptographic iwu kwadoro maka ikewapụ Igodo hardware, nke gụnyere e-akpa ego ibupụ alaka viewing (UFVK) gaa na kọmputa nnabata maka imekọrịta ego fọdụrụ na iwulite Azụmahia, ebe a na-edobe alaka ikikere mmefu kpọchiri kpamkpam n’ime ngwaọrụ. Mwepụta Igod

title: Sprout
description: Zcash malitere na Ọktoba 28, 2016, site na Sprout nke e chebere echebe pool.
text: Sprout Zcash malitere na Ọktoba 28, 2016, site na Sprout nke e chebere echebe pool. Ịdọ aka ná ntị: NU7 na-eme ka ego ZEC ka nọ na Sprout pool ghara inwe ike imefu ozugbo ọ malitere ịrụ ọrụ (ogo mmegharị na mainnet bụ 3,543,405, a tụrụ anya ya maka 5 Nọvemba 2026; lee ZIP 259). Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ego Sprout, gụọ Ịweghachi ego ma bugharịa ha mbụ. Ihe ị ga-amụta: Sprout bụ ebe Zcash malitere, oge mbụ ego nzuzo [private], nke a pụrụ ịkwado, ji arụ ọrụ na blockchain dị ndụ. Sprout bụ mwepụta mbụ nke netwọk Zcash, ọ bụghị network upgrade nke mechara. Ọ malitere ịrụ ọrụ na genesis block n’Ọktoba 28, 2016. Ọ nweghị ZIP nwere nọmba nke na-akọwa Sprout: usoro ZIP malitere mgbe e mesịrị na Overwinter, ya mere a kọwara Sprout site na Nkọwapụta Usoro Zcash mbụ na usoro Zerocash nke e wuru ya n’elu ya. Electric Coin Company (nke bụ Zerocoin Electric Coin Company n’oge ahụ), nke Zooko Wilcox duziri, wuru ma wepụta ya. Sprout webatara Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe [shielded transactions] mbụ bara uru nke zk-SNARK na pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded pool] mbụ, ka ndị mmadụ nwee ike izipu ZEC ebe ezoro onye zitere, onye natara, na ego, ma netwọk ka na-enyocha na ngụkọta itule ha ziri ezi. Aha ahụ gosiri chain na-eto eto nke otu ahụ tụrụ anya na ọ ga-eto. Ihe mere nke a ji dị mkpa. Blockchain ọha niile tupu Sprout na-egosi Kwụọ ụhwọ gị n'ihu ọha: onye ọ bụla pụrụ ịhụ onye kwụrụ onye na ego ole. Sprout bụ netwọk permissionless mbụ dị ndụ nke zoro nkọwa ndị ahụ ma ka na-egosi na ọ dịghị onye na-aghọ aghụghọ. Nke a dị mkpa maka Nzuzo ego nkịtị, ụdị Nzuzo ị na-atụ anya n'aka ego nkịtị ma ọ bụ nkwupụta ụlọ akụ onye ọzọ na-enweghị ike ịgụ. Ọ gosikwara na Nzuzo on-chain siri ike pụrụ ịrụ ọrụ n'ezi ndụ, karịa atụmatụ dị na akwụkwọ. Emume trusted setup nke mere ka o kwe omume ghọrọ ebe nrụtụ aka maka ọrụ cryptography ndị mechara, na usoro proof dị nwayọ ma na-achọ ebe nchekwa ukwuu nke Sprout wepụtara bụ kpọmkwem ihe kpaliri ndị otu ahụ iwulite Sapling afọ abụọ ka e mesịrị. Nke e chebere echebe pool mbụ Sprout mepụtara ụdị Adreesị akpa ego abụọ. Adreesị Oha (t-addresses) na-arụ ọrụ dịka Bitcoin, ebe nkọwa ya na-apụta ìhè na ledger ọha. Adreesị nke e chebere echebe (z-addresses) na-eziga ego n'ime Sprout nke e chebere echebe pool, ebe onye zitere ya, onye natara ya, na ego ole ka na-ezo. Ihe nzuzo ya bụ zk-SNARKs, zero-knowledge proofs nke na-ekwe ka Azụmahia gosi na ọ dị irè, na-enweghị mmefu ugboro abụọ na ngụkọta ego ziri ezi, n'ekpugheghị nkọwa ọ bụla. Sprout bụ oge mbụ nke a ji arụ ọrụ n'ahịa na cryptocurrency dị ndụ. Emume ahụ zk-SNARKs dị na Sprout chọrọ otu mkpụrụọdụ ọha, ma imepụta ha n'enweghị nsogbu chọrọ nhazi otu ugboro a kpọrọ Emume ahụ. Ndị sonyere isii nọ n'ebe dị iche iche, ndị dị anya n'ebe ibe ha nọ, nke ọ bụla mepụtara mpempe nzuzo a kpọrọ toxic waste. Ọ bụrụ na onye ọ bụla achịkọta mpempe niile ọzọ, ha nwere ike ịmepụta ZEC n'enweghị ihe ọ bụla. Nhazi ahụ gbanwere ihe egwu ahụ ka ọ bụrụ iwu dị mfe: ọ bụrụhaala na opekata mpe otu onye sonyere bibiri mpempe ya, a pụghị iwughachi nzuzo zuru oke, ya mere ime ego adịgboroja agaghị ekwe omume. Ndị sonyere a kpọrọ aha n'ihu ọha gụnyere Zooko Wilcox, Andrew Miller, Peter Van Valkenburgh, Peter Todd, na Derek Hinch nke NCC Group. Otu onye sonyere họọrọ ịnọ n'amaghị aha. Mmalite Sprout bụ ntọala nke mgbanwe ọ bụla mechara na-ewukwasị. Mgbe usoro network upgrade bịara na Overwinter, ọ kpọrọ iwu mbụ ahụ consensus branch id 0, nke pụtara naanị na etinyebeghị network upgrade ọ bụla. Ihe niile kemgbe ahụ (Overwinter, Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, Canopy, NU5, NU6, na ihe ndị ọzọ) dị n'elu chain Sprout malitere. A mara ọkwa mmalite ahụ na Ọgọọst 2016 maka genesis n'Ọktoba 28, Emume ahụ mere n'izu ndị bu ya ụzọ, na timestamp e tinyere kpọmkwem na genesis block na-agụ Ọktoba 28, 2016, na 07:56 UTC. title: turnstile
description: Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Zcash na-ezo ego, ndị zitere ya, na ndị natara ya. Nzuzo ahụ bụ isi ihe ya. Mana ọ na-ebute ajụjụ siri ike: ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị…
text: turnstile Nchịkọta turnstile bụ iwu ndekọ ego ọha nke na-enyocha uru ole na-abanye ma na-apụ na pool nke ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe Ọ na-eme ka onye ọ bụla nwee ike nyochaa na pool anaghị akwụpụta uru karịrị nke etinyere n'ime ya, ọbụna ma Azụmahia ndị dị n'ime ya bụ nke nzuzo Nke a na-echebe ọkọnọ ZEC pụọ n'ajọ njehie zoro ezo, n'ihi na mkpụrụ ego adịgboroja agaghị apụ na pool n'emebighị ndekọ ahụ Kwụọ ụhwọ n'ime pool na-anọgide bụrụ nke nzuzo. Azụmahia nke na-ebufe ZEC n'etiti pool na-egosi ego ọ na-ebufe turnstile bụ ihe mere mbugharị Orchard gaa Ironwood ji nwee ike igosi na ọkọnọ nke e chebere echebe siri ike Onye ka nke a bụ maka ya Onye ọ bụla chọrọ ịghọta otu Zcash si eme ka a tụkwasị ọkọnọ nzuzo ya obi Ndị ọrụ na-eso mbugharị Orchard gaa Ironwood ma na-eche otu o si egosi na ọkọnọ ahụ bụ eziokwu Ndị mbido nwere mmasị ịmata otú usoro ego nzuzo ka nwere ike isi nyochaa Ihe ịma aka ahụ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Zcash na-ezo ego, ndị zitere ya, na ndị natara ya. Nzuzo ahụ bụ isi ihe ya. Mana ọ na-ebute ajụjụ siri ike: ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị onye nwere ike ịhụ ihe dị n'ime pool nke e chebere echebe, kedu ka onye ọ bụla ga-esi mara na ngụkọta ego ZEC ziri ezi? Kedu ka ị ga-esi nyochaa ego ị na-apụghị ịhụ? Ọ bụrụ na njehie ekwe ka mmadụ mepụta mkpụrụ ego adịgboroja n'ime pool nke e chebere echebe, aghụghọ ahụ ga-ezo site n'otu Nzuzo ahụ na-echebe ndị ọrụ eziokwu. Enweghị nchedo, ejighị n'aka ahụ ga-emebi ntụkwasị obi n'ọkọnọ dum. turnstile bụ nchedo na-edozi nke a. Ihe turnstile bụ Chee pool nke ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe dịka ụlọ nwere otu ọnụ ụzọ a na-agụ. Mgbe ọ bụla uru si n'èzí abanye na pool, ma ọ bụ hapụ ya gaa ebe ọzọ, ọ na-agafe ọnụ ụzọ ahụ, a na-agụkwa ya n'ihu ọha. Azụmahia dị n'ime ụlọ ahụ na-anọgide nzuzo, mana ngụkọta na-aga n'ihu n'ọnụ ụzọ ahụ na-ahụ onye ọ bụla. Iwu ahụ dị mfe: pool enweghị ike ịhapụ uru karịrị nke batara n'ime ya. Nodes na-ajụ block ọ bụla ga-eme ka nguzozi pool daa n'okpuru efu. A maara uru e kweere dị n'ime pool mgbe niile, n'ihi na ọ bụ naanị ngụkọta nke batara e wepụrụ ngụkọta nke hapụrụ. Ndekọ ọha a bụ turnstile. Otu o si arụ ọrụ Zcash enweela ọtụtụ pool nke e chebere echebe n'akụkọ ya, dịka Sprout, Sapling, na Orchard. Uru na-agagharị n'etiti chain Oha na pool ndị a, ma mgbe ụfọdụ n'etiti pool ndị ahụ n'onwe ha. turnstile na-ele mmegharị ndị ahụ anya: Mgbe ZEC batara n'ime pool nke e chebere echebe, a na-agbakwunye ego ahụ na nguzozi ọha pool ahụ Mgbe ZEC pụtara na pool, a na-ewepụ ego ahụ Network na-ajụ block ọ bụla ga-eme ka nguzozi pool ghọọ nọmba na-adịghị mma, nke pụtara na ihe hapụrụ karịrị ihe ọ bụla batara Azụmahia ọ bụla na-egosi naanị mmịgharị uru net ya n'ime ma ọ bụ n'èzí pool, ya bụ nguzozi uru ya. Maka Kwụọ ụhwọ n'ime otu pool, nke ahụ bụ naanị ugwo Network na-enyocha nguzozi maka value pool ọ bụla n'ụzọ a, gụnyere Sprout, Sapling, Orchard, pool ọhụrụ Ironwood, na nguzozi Oha na lockbox. N'ihi nke a, ọbụna ma kpọmkwem ihe dị n'ime pool zoro ezo, ihe kacha ukwuu nwere ike isi na ya pụta bụ nke batara n'ime ya. Ọ dịghị mbawanye ego zoro ezo nwere ike gbapụ banye n'ọrụ. Otu esi enyocha nguzozi uru Ndekọ dị n'ọnụ ụzọ ahụ bụ naanị nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi n'ihi na a na-amanye Azụmahia ọ bụla igosi na o bufere ego eziokwu, ọbụna ma ego ahụ n'onwe ya zoro ezo. Azụmahia ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe na-ebipụta otu nọmba eziokwu: uru net ọ na-ebuga n'ime ma ọ bụ n'èzí pool, a na-akpọ ya nguzozi uru [value balance]. Nguzozi uru dị mma pụtara na ego hapụrụ pool gaa n'akụkụ Oha, nke na-adịghị mma pụtara na ego batara. Nkọwa nzuzo na-anọgide mechiri emechi, mana ọnụ ọgụgụ net a bụ ọha, ọ bụkwa ya ka turnstile na-agbakọta. Akụkụ amamihe dị na ya bụ otú Azụmahia si egosi na nọmba ọha ahụ bụ eziokwu n'ekpugheghị ego nzuzo dị n'azụ ya. Usoro ahụ dị iche dabere na pool, nke a bụkwa ezigbo ọrụ igwe nke turnstile. N'ime pool Sprout mbụ, Azụmahia ọ bụla na-eji JoinSplit. JoinSplit na-emefu notes abụọ zoro ezo wee mepụta abụọ ọhụrụ, ma ọ na-eburu mpaghara ọha abụọ: vpubold, uru na-abanye na poo

title: Nkwado Adreesị Ejikọtara Ọnụ (Unified Address) (ZIP-316)
description: Nke a bụ ntuziaka mmụta, ọ bụghị decoder ejikọrọ ọnụ ma ọ bụ ọbá akwụkwọ Kwụọ ụhwọ a ga-edetuo ma mado. Ọ na-akọwa otú e si ahazi Adreesị Ejikọtara Ọnụ ka ị…
text: Nkwado Adreesị Ejikọtara Ọnụ (Unified Address) (ZIP-316) Nke a bụ ntuziaka mmụta, ọ bụghị decoder ejikọrọ ọnụ ma ọ bụ ọbá akwụkwọ Kwụọ ụhwọ a ga-edetuo ma mado. Ọ na-akọwa otú e si ahazi Adreesị Ejikọtara Ọnụ ka ị nwee ike ịghọta ihe ọbá akwụkwọ ndị a na-elekọta na-eme n'ime ya. Maka ihe ọ bụla na-ejikwa ezigbo ego, dabere na nkọwapụta ZIP-316 na mmejuputa gọọmentị e jikọtara n'okpuru. --- Nnukwu nkọwa Adreesị Ejikọtara Ọnụ (UA) bụ otu ahịrị Adreesị akpa ego nke na-ebu ọtụtụ ụdị receiver: Oha (Transparent), Sapling, Orchard, ma ọ bụ njikọta ha. E-akpa ego nke onye na-akwụ ụgwọ na-ahọrọ ozugbo pool receiver kacha mma ọ na-akwado. Chee UA dịka envelopu e mechiri emechi nke nwere ọtụtụ kaadị e debere akara. Kaadị ọ bụla na-anọchi anya ụzọ dị iche iji ruo gị. Iji lelee Adreesị akpa ego, ngwa ga-emerịrị: Mepee envelopu ahụ: Decode ahịrị ederede ahụ. Weghachite usoro ihe dị n'ime ya: Kagbuo ngwakọta nchedo (F4Jumble). Gụọ kaadị ọ bụla: Wepụ receiver nke ọ bụla. Mepụta iwu protocol: Leghara ma ọ bụ jụ entries anya dabere na typecode range ha. --- Ihe mere “nanị decode Bech32m” anaghị ezu UA na-eji usoro ederede Bech32m, mana naanị idecode Bech32m anaghị ekpughe receiver a pụrụ iji. ZIP-316 na-akpachapụ anya agwakọta payload site na iji F4Jumble tupu encoding. F4Jumble na-eme ka ịgbanwe ọbụna naanị otu mkpụrụedemede n'ime Adreesị akpa ego gbanwee kpamkpam output e decode-rụrụ. Nke a na-egbochi mwakpo mgbanwe Adreesị akpa ego ebe onye mwakpo na-agbanwe bytes n'etiti Adreesị akpa ego mgbe prefix na suffix ka na-adị ka ha dị mma. Iwu dị mkpa: Nchedo mgbanwe na-arụ ọrụ naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ngwa gị emee pipeline decode na nkwado zuru ezu. Decode nke ezughị ezu na-ewepụ nchekwa ma hapụ ihe ize ndụ niile. --- Pipeline decode, nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ Nzọụkwụ 1: Decode Bech32m ma lelee netwọk Akụkụ mmadụ nwere ike ịgụ (Human-readable part, HRP): u na-akọwa mainnet; utest na-akọwa testnet. (UA mainnet na-amalite na u1, ebe 1 bụ separator Bech32.) Oke ogologo: Bech32m ọkọlọtọ na-akwado oke mkpụrụedemede 90. UA na-agafekarị oke a, yabụ a ga-agbanyụrịrị nyocha ogologo ọkọlọtọ n'ime decoder. Gbanwee okwu Bech32m bit-5 laghachi na bytes bit-8 ọkọlọtọ. Nzọụkwụ 2: Tụgharịa F4Jumble F4Jumble bụ netwọk Feistel round-4 e wuru na BLAKE2b: Ogologo ọkara aka ekpe: min(64, floor(length / 2)) bytes. Oke bytes 64 kwekọrọ na oke output BLAKE2b nwere ike ịmepụta. Ọkara aka nri nwere payload fọdụrụ. Ọrụ hash: Na-atụgharị G na H site n'iji labels personalization a kapịrị ọnụ (UAF4JumbleG na UAF4JumbleH). Usoro round: Encoding n'ihu na-agba G(0) → H(0) → G(1) → H(1). Ntughari azụ (iwepu ngwakọta) na-agba H(1) → G(1) → H(0) → G(0). Nlele range: Jụ inputs dị n'èzí oke payload ZIP-316. Nzọụkwụ 3: Wepụ padding ma nyochaa HRP Tupu ngwakọta, encoder na-etinye bytes 16 nwere HRP, nke e ji zeros mejupụta. Wepụ bytes 16 ikpeazụ mgbe i wepụchara ngwakọta. Kwenye na HRP e tinyere n'ime ya dabara na netwọk a tụrụ anya ya (u ma ọ bụ utest). Nke a na-egbochi ịnakwere Adreesị akpa ego testnet na mainnet n'amaghị ama. Nzọụkwụ 4: Wepụ receivers Payload fọdụrụ nwere entries (typecode, length, content), ebe a na-echekwa typecode na ogologo dịka integers compact-size (otu byte maka obere values). Typecode receiver amaara: Typecode Ụdị receiver Ogologo ọdịnaya :------- :------------------ :------------- 0x00 Oha (P2PKH) bytes 20 0x01 Oha (P2SH) bytes 20 0x02 Sapling bytes 43 0x03 Orchard bytes 43 N'azụ ndị a, ZIP-316 debere ranges abụọ ọzọ maka ndakọrịta n'ọdịnihu: 0xC0–0xDF (metadata na-abụghị MUST-understand): consumers ga-eleghara items metadata ha anaghị amata n'ime range a anya. 0xE0 na 0xE1 (metadata expiry MUST-understand e kenyere): registry ZIP-316 dị ugbu a kenyere ndị a na height na oge expiry Adreesị akpa ego. Consumers ga-aghọta items ndị a ma ọ bụ jụ Adreesị akpa ego ahụ. 0xE2–0xFC (metadata MUST-understand e kenyebeghị): consumers ga-ajụ Adreesị akpa ego ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na ha zutere item ha anaghị amata n'ime range a. Maka ụdị receiver amaara, nyochaa na ogologo e encode-rụr

title: Igodo nlele [Viewing Keys]
description: Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe na-enye gị ohere ịzụmahia ebe ị na-ekpughe ntakịrị o kwere mee na Zcash blockchain. Ya mere, gịnị na-eme mgbe ọ dị gị…
text: Igodo nlele [Viewing Keys] Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe na-enye gị ohere ịzụmahia ebe ị na-ekpughe ntakịrị o kwere mee na Zcash blockchain. Ya mere, gịnị na-eme mgbe ọ dị gị mkpa igosi otu akụkụ kpọmkwem ihe ị nwere, ma ọ bụ ihe ị zitere? Viewing key na-enye ohere ịgụ na-enweghị inye ikike imefu ego. Viewing keys adịlarị maka Sprout; Sapling gbakwụnyere ikike dịka ịchọpụta mgbe e mefuru note anataara. ZIP 310 bụ edemede ozi mbụ nke na-edepụta njirimara nchekwa nke Sapling viewing keys, ọ bụghị network upgrade webatara viewing keys. Viewing key bụ ngwá ọrụ maka Mpughe ahọpụtara [selective disclosure]: ị na-ahọrọ onye ga-ahụ ihe, ọ dịghịkwa mgbe ị na-enyefe ikike imefu ego iji mee ya. Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa Viewing key na-enye ohere ịgụ naanị n'ihe omume nke Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe Zcash ma ọ bụ akaụntụ: onye ọbụla ji ya nwere ike ịhụ Azụmahia na-abata (na, maka full viewing keys, Azụmahia na-apụ), mana ọ nweghị mgbe ọ ga-enwe ike imefu ego. Ihe ọ bụ: ngwá ọrụ Mpughe ahọpụtara nke pool ndị e chebere echebe, nke ikike ya dị iche dabere na pool na ụdị key. ZIP 310 na-akọwa ihe Sapling full viewing key na-ekpughe na ozi nke a na-ekwe nkwa, nke ekwenyebeghị, nke akọwaghị, ma ọ bụ nke ekpughebeghị. Ihe ọ na-enye: ịchọpụta nkwụnye ego (uivk… incoming keys) ma ọ bụ ọhụhụ zuru ezu nke ihe na-abata/na-apụ maka akaụntụ (uview… unified full viewing keys), yana legacy Sapling zxviews… keys. Ihe ọ naghị enye: ikike imefu ego. Ọ nweghị ihe onye ji viewing key mee nwere ike ibugharị ego. Ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ taa: mbupụ/mwebata na Zallet (v0.1.0-beta.2+, zexportviewingkey / zimportviewingkey) yana akaụntụ watch-only n'ime e-akpa ego dịka Zkool; lee ibe Wallets maka matriks nkwado dị ugbu a. Iwu isi mkpịsị aka: họrọ key kacha warara nke na-aza ajụjụ a jụrụ, ma cheta na key e nyefere enweghị ike ịweghachi — naanị ibugharị ego nwere ike ime ka ọ kwụsị ịdị mkpa. --- Gịnị mere eji viewing key? Ihe Electric Coin Company dere gbasara isiokwu a na-akọwa ọnọdụ ndị na-emekarị, ha ka bụkwa ndị a na-ahụkarị taa: Exchange na-ele nkwụnye ego anya. Exchange ahụ na-ebunye incoming viewing key n'elu node nchọpụta nke jikọtara na ịntanetị ka ọ nwee ike ịhụ nkwụnye ego ndị ahịa na Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, ebe Igodo ego na-anọ na hardware nke na-adịghị emetụ network aka. Onye nlekọta ego na-egosi ihe o ji. Onye nlekọta ego ahụ na-enye onye nyocha full viewing key maka Adreesị akpa ego ọ bụla nke e chebere echebe. Onye nyocha ahụ nwere ike nyochaa nguzo ego ndị ahụ ma lelee ọrụ gara aga gaa na si na adreesị ndị ahụ apụta, ma ọ nweghị ihe ọzọ ọ pụrụ ime. Nyocha kwesịrị ekwesị maka onye mmekọ. Ebe exchange chọrọ inyocha akụkọ nke e chebere echebe nke onye ahịa dịka akụkụ nke nyocha siri ike, ọ nwere ike ịrịọ viewing key kama ego ahụ. Ihe viewing key na-ekpughe na ihe ọ naghị ekpughe E nwere ihe karịrị otu ụdị key, ọdịiche dị n'etiti ha na-ekpebi ókè ihe ị na-enye. Key Prefix Ihe ọ na-enye --- --- --- Unified full viewing key (UFVK) uview… Na-ahụ Azụmahia na-abata na na-apụ maka pool ọ bụla dị n'akaụntụ Unified incoming viewing key (UIVK) uivk… Na-ahụ naanị Azụmahia na-abata, maka pool ọ bụla dị n'akaụntụ Sapling extended full viewing key zxviews… Na-ahụ ihe omume Sapling na-abata na na-apụ maka adreesị nke key ahụ Ọ nweghị nke ndị a nwere ike imefu ego. Ha niile bụ ndị na-adịgide adịgide n'ụzọ dị mkpa: key ị nyefegoro enweghị ike ịweghachi, naanị ibugharị ego gaa n'akaụntụ nke akụkụ ọzọ enweghị keys ya pụrụ ime ka ọ ghara ịdị irè. E nwere ọnyà mkpughe abụọ kwesịrị ịma tupu ịkekọrịta ihe ọbụla. Incoming apụtaghị warara. Unified incoming viewing key metụtara akaụntụ dum, ọ bụghị naanị otu adreesị a jụrụ gị maka ya. Ịbupụ UIVK maka otu Adreesị akpa ego Sapling ka na-enye ọhụhụ nke ihe na-abata n'ofe pool ọ bụla dị n'akaụntụ ahụ, ya mere ọ na-ekpughe karịa adreesị ọ kpọrọ aha. Zallet Book na-ekwu nke a hoo haa. Adreesị e bipụtara ekpugheela incoming viewing key ya nye onye iro n'ọdịnihu. ZIP 326 na-ekwu na onye iro nwere quantum computer nwer

title: Ihe block explorer pụrụ ịhụ na Zcash
description: Zcash nwere ụdị Adreesị akpa ego [address] abụọ.
text: Ihe block explorer pụrụ ịhụ na Zcash Na nkenke Na Bitcoin, block explorer na-egosi ihe niile: onye zitere, onye natara, na ego ole. Na Zcash, nke a bụ naanị eziokwu maka ọrụ Oha [transparent] (t-address). Explorer nwere ike ịhụ ego na-abanye ma na-apụ na pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded], ma ọ pụghị ịhụ ihe na-eme n'ime ya. Azụmahia [transaction] e chebere echebe kpamkpam (z ruo z) anaghị ekpughe onye zitere, onye natara, ma ọ bụ ego ole. Ọnụọgụ ọ bụla ọha nke “shield rate” bụ opekempe, n'ihi na ọrụ nzuzo kpamkpam anaghị ahụ anya site n'èzí. --- Ụdị Adreesị akpa ego abụọ Zcash nwere ụdị Adreesị akpa ego [address] abụọ. Adreesị akpa ego Oha na-amalite na t ma na-arụ ọrụ dịka Adreesị akpa ego Bitcoin. Balans na Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] bụ ihe ọha. Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe na-amalite na z ma zero-knowledge proofs na-echebe ya. Netwọk ahụ nwere ike ikwenye na Kwụọ ụhwọ e chebere echebe dị irè n'ekpugheghị onye zitere, onye natara, ma ọ bụ ego ole. N'ihi na e nwere ụdị abụọ, uru nwere ike ịgagharị n'ụzọ anọ: Oha ruo Oha (t ruo t), Oha ruo nke e chebere echebe (t ruo z, a na-akpọ shielding), nke e chebere echebe ruo Oha (z ruo t, a na-akpọ deshielding), na nke e chebere echebe ruo nke e chebere echebe (z ruo z, nke nzuzo kpamkpam). Ihe explorer pụrụ ịhụ Explorer ọha dịka ZecBlock nwere ike ịgụ nke ọma: Kwụọ ụhwọ Oha kpamkpam ọ bụla (t ruo t), site na mmalite ruo na njedebe. Ego na-abanye na pool nke e chebere echebe (akụkụ Oha na ego ole). Ego na-apụ na pool nke e chebere echebe (akụkụ Oha na ego ole). Ngụkọta ZEC a na-edobe na pool nke e chebere echebe ọ bụla, nke bụ ihe ọha ka netwọk wee gosi na e keghị mkpụrụ ego site n'ihe efu. Na nkenke, a na-ahụ akụkụ mpụta nke pool nke e chebere echebe. Ị nwere ike ile uru ka ọ na-abanye ma na-apụ. Ihe explorer na-enweghị ike ịhụ Explorer ọha enweghị ike ịgụ: Azụmahia e chebere echebe kpamkpam (z ruo z). Onye zitere, onye natara, na ego ole na-anọgide zoro ezo. Onye zitere ma ọ bụ onye natara nọ n'azụ Kwụọ ụhwọ e chebere echebe ọ bụla. Balans nke otu Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe. Ihe na-eme ego ozugbo ha banyere n'ime pool. Jụọ data raw, ubi onye zitere na onye natara e chebere echebe ga-alọghachi na-enweghị ihe ọ bụla. Explorer anaghị ezo nke a n'ihi nhọrọ ya. Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ dị na chain ọha n'ụdị a pụrụ ịgụ. E ji Nzobe ederede [encryption] chekwaa ozi ahụ, ọ bụ naanị onye nwere viewing key ziri ezi nwere ike ịgụ ya. Ihe mere o ji dị mkpa Nzuzo [privacy] gị sitere na cryptography, ọ bụghị n'ịtụkwasị ụlọ ọrụ obi. Onye na-eweta data enweghị ike ileba n'ime Azụmahia e chebere echebe ọbụna ma ọ chọọ. Ọnụọgụ shield-rate ọha anaghị agụta Nzuzo niile. Ndị nchọpụta nwere ike ịtụ naanị ihe na-agafe ókè ọha, yabụ oke ọrụ nzuzo n'ezie dịkarịa ala ihe ha na-akọ, ma na-adịkarị karịa. Pool nke e chebere echebe buru ibu na-echebe mmadụ niile. Ka ọtụtụ mmadụ na-eji Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, ka igwe mmadụ Kwụọ ụhwọ nzuzo nke otu onye na-ezo n'ime ya na-ebuwanye ibu. Iji Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe na-enyere ichebe gị na onye ọ bụla ọzọ nọ na pool. Tinye ya n'ọrụ Jiri e-akpa ego [wallet] nke na-eji Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe na ndabara, dịka ZODL ma ọ bụ Zingo!. Mgbe ị natara ZEC na Adreesị akpa ego Oha, bugharịa ya n'ime Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe tupu i jiri ya. Kwụọ Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe ebe ị nwere ike. Kwụọ ụhwọ Oha ọ bụla bụ nke ọha kpamkpam; nke e chebere echebe abụghị. Akụrụngwa Zcash: ndụmọdụ Nzuzo na nchekwa Ecosystem e chebere echebe (Electric Coin Company) Otu teknụzụ Zcash si arụ ọrụ ZecBlock Peeji ndị metụtara ya Ihe ndabere Zcash E-akpa ego Pool nke e chebere echebe zk-SNARKs --- Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ịgbakwunye ma ọ bụ tụọ aro mgbanwe na peeji wiki a, biko gaa na ZecHub GitHub repo ma nyefee pull request.

title: Z3 Stack
description: Z3 Stack bụ ikpo okwu node nke Zcash Foundation chịkọtara: Zebra (full node) + Zallet (e-akpa ego full-node), yana indexer Zaino nhọrọ. Ọ bụ ihe e bu n'obi iji…
text: Z3 Stack Z3 Stack bụ ikpo okwu node nke Zcash Foundation chịkọtara: Zebra (full node) + Zallet (e-akpa ego full-node), yana indexer Zaino nhọrọ. Ọ bụ ihe e bu n'obi iji dochie usoro zcashd kwụụrụ onwe ya, nke jikọtara consensus na e-akpa ego n'otu binary ma kwụsị ndụ ya na 18 Julaị 2026. Mmejuputa ntụaka bụ ọrụ Compose nke Docker dị na github.com/ZcashFoundation/z3. --- Na nkenke Z3 abụghị onye ahịa consensus ọhụrụ. Ọ bụ ụzọ ị si agbaa stack mgbe-zcashd ọnụ: Zebra na-enyocha chain, Zallet na-edobe igodo ma na-enye wallet RPC, ebe Zaino (nhọrọ) na-ekwu protocol gRPC nke lightwalletd. zcashd jikọtara node + e-akpa ego. Z3 na-ekewa ọrụ ndị a. Exchanges, pool ịgwụputa, na ndị ọrụ e-akpa ego full node ndị ọzọ na-akwaga na njikọta a kama na Zebra naanị. Ọrụ Compose atọ kewapụrụ iche nwere ike ịgba n'otu host: mainnet, testnet, na regtest. Mmekọrịta mbụ nke mainnet na-ewe ihe dịka awa 24–72 ma chọọ ihe dịka 300 GB. Regtest na-ebili n'ime sekọnd ma bụrụ ebe kwesịrị ekwesị iji mụta stack ahụ. Zallet na-etinye ọba akwụkwọ indexer nke Zaino ma soro Zebra kparịta ụka site na JSON-RPC. A chọrọ ọrụ Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ endpoint kwekọrọ na lightwalletd maka e-akpa ego mpụta. Zallet nọ na beta. Mgbanwe na-akụda ndakọrịta nwere ike ịchọ ka ihichapụ ma mepụta e-akpa ego ọzọ. Ewerekwala ya dị ka sọftụwia nlekọta ego zuru oke maka nnukwu ego. --- Ihe mere Z3 ji dị N'ọtụtụ ndụ Zcash, zcashd bụ ma full node ntụaka ma naanị e-akpa ego full node mmepụta. Nhazi ahụ bụ nke exchanges, pools, na ndị nlekota jikọtara megide. zcashd alala ezumike nka. Consensus kwagara na Zebra (ma ugbu a kwa na Zakura). E-akpa ego agbakwunyere kwagara na Zallet. Ijere e-akpa ego light ozi na-apụ na lightwalletd gaa na Zaino. Akụkụ atọ ahụ bụ repository dị iche iche, usoro ntọhapụ dị iche iche, na config dị iche iche. Z3 bụ gluu: image akpọchiri, nyocha ahụike nke na-eme ka e-akpa ego ghara ịmalite ruo mgbe node mekọrịtara, ports na volumes maka netwọkụ nke ọ bụla, yana ụzọ onye ọrụ edere n'akwụkwọ. Aha ahụ bụ mkpirisi okwu nkịtị n'ọrụ gburugburu ebe obibi — Zebra, Zaino, Zallet — n'agbanyeghị na faịlụ Compose ndabara na-amalite naanị Zebra na Zallet. Zaino bụ profile Compose, ọ bụghị usoro nke atọ a chọrọ. --- Nhazi Akụkụ Ọrụ ya na Z3 A chọrọ ya? --- --- --- Zebra Na-emekọrịta ma na-enyocha chain, gossip, JSON-RPC, endpoint ahụike Ee Zallet E-akpa ego full node. Na-etinye ọba akwụkwọ Zaino. Na-ejikọ ozugbo na JSON-RPC nke Zebra. Ọ dịghị akpọ container Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya Ee Zaino Indexer kwụụrụ onwe ya. gRPC kwekọrọ na lightwalletd maka ndị ahịa light mpụta, tinyere proxy JSON-RPC maka explorers na faucets Mba — --profile indexer Z3 na-akpọchi nsụgharị image na docker-compose.yml. Jiri Z3ZEBRAIMAGE, Z3ZAINOIMAGE, ma ọ bụ Z3ZALLETIMAGE dochie ya ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ tag ọzọ. --- Otu nke a si dị iche na zcashd zcashd Z3 --- --- --- Asụsụ C++ (fork Bitcoin) Ọrụ Rust, nke Docker Compose na-ahazi Ụdị usoro Otu binary: node + e-akpa ego Containers node na e-akpa ego dị iche Consensus Alala ezumike nka (EOS 18 Julaị 2026) Zebra (ma ọ bụ node ọzọ kwekọrọ) E-akpa ego wallet.dat arụnyere n'ime ya Zallet, datadir e ji age zoo Ndị ahịa light Ọtụtụ mgbe lightwalletd dị iche Profile Zaino nhọrọ Config zcash.conf Faịlụ maka netwọkụ ọ bụla n'okpuru config/ / tinyere faịlụ env Compose Netwọkụ n'otu host Mkpọkọta port na-esiri ike Ọkwa mbụ: z3-mainnet, z3-testnet, z3-regtest Ọ bụrụ na ị ka nwere e-akpa ego zcashd, jiri ndu mbufe nke ZecHub migration guide na iwu migrate-zcashd-wallet nke Zallet kama idetuo wallet.dat n'ime volume Z3. --- Netwọkụ Z3 bụ ọrụ Compose atọ nọọrọ onwe ha. Ha anaghị ekerịta ports ma ọ bụ volumes. Netwọkụ Aha ọrụ Jiri ya maka Mmekọrịta mbụ Ezigbo ego --- --- --- --- --- mainnet z3-mainnet Mmepụta awa 24–72 Ee testnet z3-testnet Nhazi tupu mmepụta na netwọkụ ule ọha awa 2–12 Mba (ule ZEC) regtest z3-regtest Omume mpaghara: blocks ozugbo, enweghị peers Sekọnd Mba Ndị ọrụ ọhụrụ kwesịrị ịmalite na regtest, gosi na RPC na usoro e-akpa ego na-ar

title: Usoro Nkwenye ZAP1 [ZAP1 Attestation Protocol]
description: ZAP1 bụ usoro nkwenye isi mmalite mepere emepe [open-source] maka Zcash. Ọ na-ede ihe omume nhazi nke usoro ndụ na osisi Merkle BLAKE2b ma na-edobe mgbọrọgwụ…
text: Usoro Nkwenye ZAP1 [ZAP1 Attestation Protocol] ZAP1 bụ usoro nkwenye isi mmalite mepere emepe [open-source] maka Zcash. Ọ na-ede ihe omume nhazi nke usoro ndụ na osisi Merkle BLAKE2b ma na-edobe mgbọrọgwụ osisi ahụ on-chain site na memo nke e chebere echebe nke Orchard. Enwere ike ikwenye proof n'ihu ọha. Data ihe omume na-anọgide na nzuzo. Otu o si arụ ọrụ Ndị na-arụ ọrụ na-edebanye ụdị ihe omume (mbugharị, Kwụọ ụhwọ, nnyefe, wdg.) ma nyefee ha na instans ZAP1. Ihe omume ọ bụla na-emepụta hash akwụkwọ site n'iji BLAKE2b-256 ekewapụtara na ngalaba. Akwụkwọ ndị ahụ na-agbakọta n'ime osisi Merkle. Mgbe e rutere n'ókè e setịpụrụ, a na-etinye mgbọrọgwụ osisi ahụ dị ka memo ZAP1:09 ma debe ya na Zcash n'ime Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe. Onye ọ bụla nwere hash akwụkwọ nwere ike ikwenye ụzọ zuru ezu site n'akwụkwọ ruo na mgbọrọgwụ, ruo na nkwado on-chain, na-enweghị ịtụkwasị onye na-arụ ọrụ obi. Njirimara ndị bụ isi Na-arụ ọrụ n'agbanyeghị ngwa: onye na-arụ ọrụ Zcash ọ bụla nwere ike ịkọwa ụdị ihe omume na eriri nhazi nke ya Na-echekwa Nzuzo: a na-eme hash nke payload ihe omume tupu e debe ya. Naanị hash na-aga on-chain. Enwere ike ikwenye n'onwe ya: ikwenye chọrọ naanị ngwugwu proof na ịnweta chain. Ọ dịghị mkpa ịtụkwasị onye na-arụ ọrụ obi. Dabara na ZIP 302: ZAP1 na-abịarukwu nso na ZIP 302 partType maka payload nkwenye Ihe dị ugbu a Ntinye aka ntụaka (Rust, nwere ikikere MIT) SDK ikwenye na crates.io (Rust + 83KB WASM) SDK JavaScript na npm Ihe ngbanwe memo zuru ụwa ọnụ (na-achọpụta ZAP1, ZIP 302 TVLV, ederede, ọnụọgụ abụọ, na memo efu) Ngwa nnabata nwere nyocha API 29 na nyocha usoro 14 Nhazi mbinye aka ókè FROST 2-n'ime-3 maka mgbasa nkwado ọtụtụ ndị otu PR #1243 nke ZIP ka a na-enyocha Nkwado mainnet 4 nwere akwụkwọ 14 ruo Maachị 2026 Nhazi Onye na-arụ ọrụ ọ bụla na-agba instans ZAP1 nke ya, yana mkpịsị ugodi nke ya, osisi Merkle, na nkwado. Enweghị ọnọdụ a na-ekekọrịta n'etiti ndị na-arụ ọrụ. Ebe ị ga-amụtakwu Isi mmalite: github.com/Frontier-Compute/zap1 SDK ikwenye: crates.io/crates/zap1-verify Ihe ngbanwe memo: crates.io/crates/zcash-memo-decode Nkọwa usoro: ONCHAINPROTOCOL.md Edemede ZIP: PR #1243 API dị ndụ: pay.frontiercompute.io/protocol/info Nduzi onye na-arụ ọrụ: OPERATORGUIDE.md

title: zecd — Sava e-akpa ego nke Ebu Ụzọ na Nke E Chebere Echebe
description: zecd bụ sava e-akpa ego nke ebu ụzọ mee maka nke e chebere echebe maka Zcash, nke e wuru n'elu librustzcash ma wepụta ya site n'olumba JSON-RPC nke Bitcoin…
text: zecd — Sava e-akpa ego nke Ebu Ụzọ na Nke E Chebere Echebe zecd bụ sava e-akpa ego nke ebu ụzọ mee maka nke e chebere echebe maka Zcash, nke e wuru n'elu librustzcash ma wepụta ya site n'olumba JSON-RPC nke Bitcoin Core. Ọ na-enye ndị onye mmepụta [developers] na ndị na-ejikọta Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] API maara nke ọma, nke dakọtara na Bitcoin, maka iso Zcash emekọrịta — ebe ọ na-eme Orchard (pool [pool] nke nwere Nzuzo [privacy] kacha elu) ka ọ bụrụ nke ndabara. zec.rocks mepụtara ya, a haziri zecd iji dochie ọrụ e-akpa ego nke zcashd n'ime nrụnye oge a nke sitere n'igwe ojii. Ụdị ugbu a: 0.5.0-rc3 (Julaị 13, 2026) — nwere nkwado Ironwood (NU6.3). Wụnye site na cargo install zecd ma ọ bụ jiri onyonyo Docker gọọmentị. --- Nkọwa nkenke zecd bụ daemon e-akpa ego (sava) — ọ bụghị full node. Ọ na-ahụ maka mkpịsị ugodi, nyocha, ịnye ihe akaebe, na RPC na-enweghị ikwu usoro P2P nke Zcash. Ọ na-ekwu olumba JSON-RPC nke Bitcoin Core: otu aha usoro, ụdị ogige, nkwenye, na koodu njehie — ọtụtụ ndị ahịa Bitcoin RPC na-arụ ọrụ na Zcash ozugbo n'enweghị nhazi ọzọ. Adreesị Orchard (nke e chebere echebe) bụ nke ndabara; nkwado Oha [transparent] (t-address) na Sapling chọrọ ka e nyere ya ikike n'ụzọ doro anya maka e-akpa ego ọ bụla. Ọ na-ejikọ na full node Zebra nke ị kwadoro n'onwe gị site na JSON-RPC mpaghara — ọ dịghị lightwalletd achọrọ. Ọ nweghị ọnọdụ e debere n'ichepụta ya: enwere ike iweghachi e-akpa ego dum site na Mkpuru mgbake [seed phrase] naanị, nke na-eme ka ndekọ data bụrụ ihe a pụrụ ịtụfu. Ọ bụghị nnọchi ozugbo maka zcashd: ọ na-arụ naanị obere akụkụ nke usoro RPC Zcash, nwere ọdịiche nhazi e bu n'obi maka Nzuzo na nchekwa. Ugwo [fee] na-agbaso ZIP-317 (ngụkọta ugwo ekpebiela); a na-ajụ ugwo onye ọrụ kọwara. Ọ na-akwado memo [memo] ndị e chebere echebe (ZIP-302) site n'elu RPC Bitcoin a maara nke ọma. --- Kedu Nsogbu Ka zecd Na-edozi? zcashd bụ node mbụ na e-akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ nke Zcash — nke e kewapụtara n'usoro koodu C++ nke Bitcoin na 2016. Ka oge na-aga, nke a kpatara ihe isi ike: koodu ahụ siri ike idobe, e-akpa ego ahụ jikọtara node ahụ nke ọma, a na-egosipụtakwa adreesị Oha dị ka nhọrọ klaasị mbụ n'akụkụ ndị e chebere echebe. zecd na-ekewa ọrụ e-akpa ego na consensus [consensus]. Ọ bụ ọkwa e-akpa ego pụrụ iche nke na-anọdụ n'etiti ngwa na full node Zebra, ma na-enye: Mmejuputa Rust dị ọcha, nke oge a, nke e wuru n'elu librustzcash (ọbá akwụkwọ ahụ nke na-enye Zodl na Zingo ike) Nhazi Nzuzo-ka-ọ-bụ-nke-ndabara (adreesị Orchard ma e wezụga ma ahaziri ya n'ụzọ ọzọ) Ntinye RPC dakọtara na Bitcoin nke na-ewepụ mkpa ịmụ ngwá ọrụ pụrụ iche nke Zcash Nhazi na-enweghị ọnọdụ edobere, nke Mkpuru mgbake nwere ike iweghachi, dabara maka nrụnye container na igwe ojii --- Nhazi zecd na-arụ ọrụ n'ụdị ọkwa atọ: zecd na-ekwurịta okwu na Zebra naanị site na JSON-RPC mpaghara — enweghị netwọkụ peer-to-peer, enweghị indexer nke ndị ọzọ, enweghịkwa lightwalletd. Ejiri nlezianya mee njikọ Zebra ka ọ bụrụ naanị nke mpaghara: zecd ga-ajụ iziga nzere na host enwere ike ịga n'ụwa niile ma e wezụga ma ahaziri ya n'ụzọ doro anya maka ọwara echekwara n'èzí usoro (dịka WireGuard ma ọ bụ SSH). --- Njirimara Ndị Dị Mkpa Nke E Chebere Echebe Mbụ, Orchard Dị Ka Ndabara zecd na-eji Adreesị Njikọrịta Orchard dị ka ụdị adreesị ndabara. Pool Sapling na Oha (t-address) chọrọ nhazi doro anya maka e-akpa ego ọ bụla. Nhazi a na-ebelata ihe ize ndụ nke izipu Oha na mberede — ọnyà Nzuzo a na-ahụkarị n'ngwá ọrụ Zcash ochie. A pụrụ ịhazi iwu Nzuzo maka oku ọ bụla ma ọ bụ n'ụwa niile na [spend] privacypolicy: Iwu Omume -------- ---------- AllowRevealedRecipients (ndabara) Na-ekwe ka e ziga ndị nnata Oha; na-ekpughe ego na onye nnata on-chain AllowRevealedAmounts Na-ekwe ka e ziga n'etiti pool (Sapling↔Orchard) mana na-ajụ ndị nnata Oha FullPrivacy Naanị izipu e chebere echebe kpamkpam n'ime otu pool; na-ajụ ndị nnata Oha na izipu n'etiti pool AllowFullyTransparent Na-ekwekwa ka e ziga t→t site na UTXO Oha kwadoro Ndakọrịta Bitcoin Core RPC zecd na-emejuputa olumba JSON

title: Zaino Onye ndepụta
description: Zaino bụ onye ndepụta [indexer] Rust maka Zcash blockchain. Ọ na-agụ data chain sitere na Zebra full node ma na-enye data ndị e-akpa ego [wallet], ndị nyocha…
text: Zaino Onye ndepụta Zaino bụ onye ndepụta [indexer] Rust maka Zcash blockchain. Ọ na-agụ data chain sitere na Zebra full node ma na-enye data ndị e-akpa ego [wallet], ndị nyocha, faucet, na ọrụ ndị ọzọ chọrọ, na-enweghị ime ka Zebra n'onwe ya bụrụ onye na-ahụ maka ndepụta ọ bụla chere ndị ahịa ihu. Na nkenke Zebra na-akwado chain Zcash. Zaino na-edepụta data chain nke Zebra ma na-ekpughe API ndị chere ndị ahịa ihu. Zallet bụ akụrụngwa e-akpa ego na nchịkọta Z3. N'ime nhazi Z3 ndabara, Zallet na-ekwurịta okwu na Zebra ozugbo, ọ dịghịkwa achọ ọrụ Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya. Ọrụ Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya bara uru mgbe ndị na-arụ ọrụ chọrọ njedebe gRPC kwekọrọ na lightwalletd, proxy JSON-RPC, ma ọ bụ akụrụngwa maka e-akpa ego dị mfe, ndị nyocha, faucet, na ọrụ ndị yiri ya. Zaino bụ akụrụngwa na-arụ ọrụ, mana ndị na-arụ ọrụ kwesịrị ilele akwụkwọ Zaino gọọmentị na nke Z3 maka nkọwa mbugharị dị ugbu a tupu ha agba ya n'ime mmepụta. Ihe Zaino Na-eme Zaino nọ n'etiti Zebra na sọftụwia onye ahịa. Zebra bụ consensus node: ọ na-ebudata, na-enyocha, ma na-esochi Zcash blockchain. Zaino na-eji Zebra dị ka ebe data chain ya si abịa, wee kwadebe echiche ndị edepụtara nke ngwa ndị ahịa pụrụ ịjụ nke ọma. Nkewa a na-eme ka ọrụ ndị ahụ doo anya: Akụrụngwa Ọrụ :-- :-- Zebra Full node na onye nkwado Zaino Onye ndepụta na ọrụ API chere ndị ahịa ihu Zallet Ọrụ e-akpa ego lightwalletd Sava e-akpa ego dị mfe ochie nke e mere Zaino iji dochie ma ọ bụ kwado Zaino na-enye arụmọrụ maka light client, full client ma ọ bụ e-akpa ego, na ndị nyocha block. Ọ na-enye ohere ịnweta chain emechara, chain kacha mma nke emechabeghị, na data mempool nke Zebra jidere. Otu O Si Daba n'Usoro Zcash Dị Ugbu A A na-ewu usoro Z3 dị ugbu a gburugburu Zebra, Zallet, na Zaino nhọrọ. N'ime mbugharị Z3 ndabara, Zebra na Zallet na-agba ọnụ. Zallet na-eru Zebra ozugbo, yabụ onye na-arụ ọrụ nke na-agba naanị nchịkọta e-akpa ego mpaghara adịghị mkpa ịmalite ọrụ Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya. A na-agbakwunye Zaino mgbe onye na-arụ ọrụ chọrọ ijere ndị ahịa mpụga ozi. Na Z3, ọ na-agba n'azụ profaịlụ Compose indexer ma na-agbakwunye: njedebe gRPC kwekọrọ na lightwalletd maka ndị ahịa e-akpa ego dị mfe proxy JSON-RPC maka ndị nyocha, faucet, na azụ ọrụ nchekwa data onye ndepụta dị iche na ọnọdụ chain nke Zebra Nke a na-eme Zaino ka ọ dị mkpa karịsịa maka azụ ọrụ e-akpa ego, ndị na-arụ akụrụngwa ọha, ndị nyocha, faucet, na ndị mmepụta na-anwale ọrụ chọrọ data chain Zcash edepụtara. Zaino na lightwalletd lightwalletd bụ sava e-akpa ego dị mfe mbụ. Zaino bụ ụzọ onye ga-anọchi ya dabere na Rust maka ọrụ a. Ebumnuche ya bụ inye API kwekọrọ ebe o kwere omume, ka e-akpa ego na ọrụ nwee ike ịkwaga n'enweghị idegharị ha kpamkpam n'otu oge. Nke ahụ apụtaghị na mbugharị lightwalletd ọ bụla akwagala na Zaino. Ndị na-arụ ọrụ kwesịrị iwere Zaino dịka akụkụ nke usoro dabere na Zebra dị ugbu a ma lelee akwụkwọ ọrụ kachasị ọhụrụ, mwepụta, na dashboard ọrụ tupu ha ahọrọ ihe ha ga-agba. Ihe Ndị Na-arụ Ọrụ Kwesịrị Ịmara Ụzọ mbugharị kachasị mfe na nke nwere ikike bụ ebe nchekwa Z3. Z3 gụnyere Zaino dịka ọrụ nhọrọ: Buru ụzọ gbaa nhazi Z3 nkịtị ma chere ka Zebra mekọrịta tupu ịmalite ọrụ ndị dabere na ya na mainnet ma ọ bụ testnet. Zaino na-ekpughe ụdị ọrụ netwọk abụọ. Ọrụ gRPC bụ API chere e-akpa ego dị mfe ihu. Ọrụ JSON-RPC bụ maka loopback ma ọ bụ netwọk nzuzo a tụkwasịrị obi, ọ gwụla ma oyi akwa mpụga na-enye nchebe. Ekwela ka njedebe JSON-RPC na-enweghị nkwenye ma ọ bụ na-enweghị nzuzo pụta n'ihu ịntanetị ọha. Ụfọdụ eserese na-egosi otu Zaino si arụ ọrụ Ihe Owuwu Ime Zaino Ihe Owuwu Ọrụ Dị Ndụ Zaino Ihe Owuwu Usoro Zaino Njehie A Na-ahụkarị Iwere Zaino dị ka full node. Zaino abụghị onye nkwado. Zebra na-akwado chain; Zaino na-edepụta data sitere na Zebra. Iche na mbugharị Z3 ọ bụla chọrọ Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya. Zallet nwere ike iru Zebra ozugbo n'ime usoro Z3 ndabara. Malite Zaino mgbe ịchọrọ ọrụ onye ndepụta kwụụrụ onwe ya maka ndị ahịa mpụga. Igosipụta atụmatụ e zubere dịka ndị ebularị. A na-emepụta Zaino n'ọrụ, yabụ lelee nd

title: Zakura Node
description: Zakura bụ mmejuputa full node mepere emepe, nke a na-akwụghị ụgwọ maka Zcash, e wuru ya maka nnukwu ogo. E kewapụrụ ya na Zebra ma mepụta ya site na mmekorita…
text: Zakura Node Zakura bụ mmejuputa full node mepere emepe, nke a na-akwụghị ụgwọ maka Zcash, e wuru ya maka nnukwu ogo. E kewapụrụ ya na Zebra ma mepụta ya site na mmekorita dị n'etiti Valar Group na Project Tachyon, Zakura na-enye mmekọrịta ngwa ngwa nke ukwuu, mbelata block nke e wuru n'ime ya, na oyi akwa ndakọrịta maka ngwaọrụ ochie nke zcashd. E wepụtara ụdị 1.0.0 na Julaị 15, 2026. --- Nchịkọta Zakura bụ full node Zcash nke dakọtara na consensus — nhọrọ ọzọ karịa Zebra na zcashd, nke e kewapụrụ na Zebra. Mmekọrịta blockchain dị ihe dịka ugboro 5 ngwa ngwa karịa Zebra; ịmalite site na snapshot na-ewe erughị nkeji 2. Mbelata block e wuru n'ime ya na-enye ndị na-arụ ọrụ ohere ịgba full node site na obere oghere diski karịa nke ukwuu (11 GB snapshot e belatara ma e jiri ya tụnyere 300 GB maka node Zebra zuru ezu). Ụdị ndakọrịta RPC nke zcashd na-eme ka e-akpa ego [wallet] na njikọta ndị dị adị rụọ ọrụ n'enweghị mgbanwe. Oyi akwa nnwale maka mbufe P2P (agbanyụrụ ya na ndabara) na-achọ mgbasa block n'okpuru 500ms nke gossip na-eguzogide DoS. Ọ dakọtara na Ironwood (NU6.3), network upgrade nke Zcash a rụrụ ọrụ n'etiti 2026. Zakura Common (v1.3.0, Ọgọst 2026) na-eme ngwa ngwa cryptography e-akpa ego ji arụ Azụmahia nzuzo: site n'ihe karịrị sekọnd 3 ruo n'okpuru 200 ms n'ọtụtụ ọnọdụ, dịka nyocha Zakura siri kwuo. Ndị na-edu ya bụ Sean Bowe (onye hibere Zcash ọnụ, Project Tachyon) na Dev Ojha (Valar Group). --- Gịnị bụ Zakura? Zakura bụ full node Zcash e mere site na ntọala ka ọ dị njikere maka mmepụta n'ogo buru ibu. Ọ bụ ezie na ọ na-ekerịta ndakọrịta consensus na Zebra — nke pụtara na ọ na-enyocha ma na-agbaso otu iwu protocol nke Zcash — Zakura na-eweta nkwalite injinia dị mkpa nke ebumnuche ha bụ ibelata ihe mgbochi dị n'ịgba full node Zcash. Ọrụ a bụ njikọ aka n'etiti Project Tachyon (nke Sean Bowe na-edu, otu n'ime ndị injinia cryptographic mbụ nke Zcash) na Valar Group (nke Dev Ojha na-edu). Ha abụọ na-elekwasị anya na nkwalite protocol ọgbọ na-esote nke Zcash, ma Zakura na-arụ ọrụ dị ka node ntụaka maka ọrụ ahụ. --- Akụkụ Ndị Dị Mkpa Mmekọrịta Chain Ngwa Ngwa Ugboro 5 Zakura na-enweta mmekọrịta blockchain dị ihe dịka ugboro 5 ngwa ngwa ma e jiri ya tụnyere Zebra. Nke a na-eme ka ọ baa uru karịa nke ukwuu maka ndị na-arụ ọrụ chọrọ ịmalite node ngwa ngwa ma ọ bụ nwetaghachi mgbe nkwụsị ọrụ gasịrị. Ịmalite Site na Snapshot Zakura na-ebipụta snapshot chain arụgoro nke na-ebelata oge mmekọrịta mbụ nke ukwuu: Usoro Bootstrap Oge ----------------- ------ Snapshot archive 37 nkeji Snapshot e belatara N'okpuru nkeji 2 Zebra (mmekọrịta zuru ezu) awa 20 Snapshot e belatara dị ihe dịka 11 GB, na-eme ka ịmalite node bụrụ ugboro 680 ngwa ngwa ma e jiri ya tụnyere mmekọrịta site na genesis. Mbelata Block E Wuru N'Imé Ya Zakura na-akwado mbelata block a pụrụ ịhazi, na-enye ndị na-arụ ọrụ node ohere ikpebi ole akụkọ chain ha ga-edobe. Nke a na-eme ka ịgba full node dị irè n'ọrụ na hardware nwere nchekwa pere mpe — bara uru maka validators, ndị mmepụta, na ndị na-eweta akụrụngwa na-adịghị mkpa chain akụkọ ihe mere eme zuru ezu. Ụdị Ndakọrịta RPC nke zcashd Zakura gụnyere ụdị ndakọrịta nke na-emepụtaghachi interface JSON-RPC ochie nke zcashd. E-akpa ego, exchanges, na njikọta ndị dị adị na-adabere na RPC zcashd nwere ike ịgbanwee gaa na Zakura na-enweghị mkpa mgbanwe koodu. Oyi Akwa Nnwale Maka Mbufe P2P Zakura ji oyi akwa mbufe peer-to-peer ọgbọ na-esote abịa, nke ugbu a agbanyụrụ na ndabara. Mgbe agbanyere ya, ọ na-achọ: Mgbasa block kachasị njọ n'okpuru 500ms n'ofe network Ịkpakọba mempool maka ibufe Azụmahia nke ọma karị Protocol gossip na-eguzogide DoS iji meziwanye nkwụsi ike network Oyi akwa a bụ nhụchalụ nke nkwalite ọkwa network Zcash n'ọdịnihu a na-emepụta n'okpuru Project Tachyon. Dakọtara na Ironwood (NU6.3) Zakura dakọtara nke ọma na network upgrade Ironwood (NU6.3), nke arụpụtara na mainnet Zcash n'etiti 2026. --- Zakura Common: Cryptography E-akpa Ego Ngwa Ngwa Karị N'Ọgọst 2026, otu Zakura wepụtara Zakura Common, otu fork e mer

title: Zallet
description: Zallet bụ e-akpa ego [wallet] Zcash nke full node, e dere ya na Rust. Ọ bụ nke dochiri e-akpa ego nke a na-etinyebu n'ime zcashd. Mgbe zcashd ruru nkwụsị…
text: Zallet Zallet bụ e-akpa ego [wallet] Zcash nke full node, e dere ya na Rust. Ọ bụ nke dochiri e-akpa ego nke a na-etinyebu n'ime zcashd. Mgbe zcashd ruru nkwụsị Nkwụsị-Nkwado ya na 18 Julaị 2026, na ogo block 3417100, e kewara ọrụ consensus [consensus] na ọrụ e-akpa ego: Zebra ma ọ bụ Zakura na-enyocha chain, ebe Zallet na-edobe igodo, na-enyocha notes, ma na-enye wallet JSON-RPC. Zallet nọ ugbu a na beta. A nyochabeghị ya nke ọma. Mgbanwe na-emebi ndakọrịta nwere ike ịchọ ka ihichapụ ma mepụta e-akpa ego ọzọ. Ewerela ya dịka nchekwa ego nke mmepụta maka nnukwu ọnụọgụ ZEC ma ọ bụrụ na ị gụbeghị ịdọ aka ná ntị nchekwa dị na Akwụkwọ Zallet. --- Nchịkọta ngwa ngwa Zallet bụ e-akpa ego RPC nke full node, ọ bụghị e-akpa ego light nke ekwentị ma ọ bụghị node consensus. Ọ na-anọchi ọkara e-akpa ego nke zcashd. Ọkara node bụ Zebra ma ọ bụ Zakura. E dere ya na Rust, o nwere ikikere abụọ MIT / Apache-2.0, a na-elekọta ya na zcash/zallet. Mwepụta kacha ọhụrụ e bipụtara ruo ngwụcha Ọgọst 2026: v0.1.0-beta.3. Ọ na-enweta data chain site n'otu n'ime backend abụọ: zebra-state (RPC kpọmkwem [direct ReadStateService] megide zebrad dị n'ógbè) ma ọ bụ Zaino. Ọ na-enye akụkụ nke zcashd-dakọtara JSON-RPC. Ụfọdụ ụzọ gbanwere; a hapụrụ ụfọdụ n'ebumnobi. A na-ezo ihe igodo niile mgbe niile site na age. Akụkọ Azụmahia [transaction], adreesị, na viewing key dị n'enweghị nzobe na wallet.db. Ọ na-ebunye binary atọ n'otu archive e binyere aka: zallet (onye mbido), zallet-zebra, na zallet-zaino. Akwụkwọ gọọmenti: Akwụkwọ Zallet. --- Ihe kpatara Zallet ji dị zcashd jikọtara node consensus sitere na Bitcoin Core na e-akpa ego n'otu usoro. Nhazi ahụ adịkwaghị. Ọrụ Stack ochie Stack ugbu a ------ ----------- --------------- Consensus / P2P zcashd Zebra (zebrad) ma ọ bụ Zakura E-akpa ego / igodo / nha ego zcashd wallet.dat Zallet (wallet.db) Ndekọ light-client lightwalletd Zaino ma ọ bụ lightwalletd Ikewapụ e-akpa ego n'aka node pụtara: Enwere ike ịgbanwe software node (Zebra megide Zakura) n'ebughị igodo. Nyocha e-akpa ego na ikike imefu na-adị n'ime usoro nwere ike ichekwa iche. Nghọta RPC nwere ike ịga n'ihu n'ebe ZIP akaụntụ 32, Adreesị Njikọtara ọnụ, na PCZT dị, kama ịnọgide kpọchiri na agwa pụrụ iche zcashd. Zallet bụ e-akpa ego e bu n'obi maka ndị na-arụ ọrụ bụbu ndị ji zcashd eme e-akpa ego na-ekpo ọkụ, backend exchange, faucet, ma ọ bụ e-akpa ego ịkwụ ụgwọ ịgwụputa [mining]. --- Ọnọdụ Zallet nọ na beta. Nke a pụtara n'omume: Mgbanwe na-emebi ndakọrịta nwere ike ịpụta na beta ọ bụla. Ị nwere ike ihichapụ ndekọ data ma malite ọzọ. Ọ bụghị RPC e-akpa ego zcashd niile ka e bugoro. Nghọta nke ụfọdụ ụzọ e bugoro dị iche na zcashd. Ngwakọta ga-agụrịrị ibe nke nghọta gbanwere. A ka na-emepụta crates ndị a, a nyochabeghịkwa ha nke ọma. Zallet abụghị ọbá akwụkwọ Rust. Enweghị nkwa ọ bụla ma ọ bụrụ na ị dabere na ya dị ka otu. Nzaghachi na-aga na nsogbu GitHub ma ọ bụ ọwa #wallet-dev na Zcash R&D Discord. A na-eme atụmatụ ọkwa kwụsiri ike n'ọdịnihu mgbe elu RPC e bu n'obi dị. A ga-atụ anya ka ndị na-akpọ ya kwaga n'ụzọ Zallet, tinyere ọdịiche nghọta e depụtara. --- Nhazi Zallet kewara n'ime Cargo workspaces atọ ka backend chain abụọ ahụ nwee ike iso dependency graph dị iche iche. Binary atọ ahụ niile na-emeghe otu wallet.db. Onye mbido na-ahọrọ backend n'oge ọ na-arụ ọrụ; ị gaghị achọ ịchịkọta ya ọzọ iji gbanwee. Ntinye a na-ahụkarị: Zallet bụ e-akpa ego full node: ọ chọrọ node nyocha dị n'ógbè. Ọ bụghị light client. Maka e-akpa ego light na sava compact-block, lee Zaino na Nodes Lightwallet. title: Zcash Akụ nke e chebere echebe [Shielded Assets]
description: Zcash Akụ nke e chebere echebe (ZSA) bụ mgbatị protocol a tụrụ aro nke ga-ekwe ka akụ na-abụghị ZEC — stablecoins, token Gọọmentị, ma ọ bụ akụ omenala ọ bụla…
text: Zcash Akụ nke e chebere echebe [Shielded Assets] Nchịkọta Zcash Akụ nke e chebere echebe (ZSA) bụ mgbatị protocol a tụrụ aro nke ga-ekwe ka akụ na-abụghị ZEC — stablecoins, token Gọọmentị, ma ọ bụ akụ omenala ọ bụla — biri n'ime pool nke e chebere echebe nke Zcash, ebe a na-edobe onye zitere, onye natara, na ego ahụ na Nzuzo [privacy]. Ihe ọ bụ: Akụ omenala n'ụdị ERC-20, mana nke e chebere echebe na ndabara. Onye na-ewu ya: QEDIT, n'okpuru ikike sitere na Zcash Foundation, na mmekorita ya na Electric Coin Company. Otu e si kọwaa ya: ZIP 226 (mbufe na ịkụ ọkụ) yana ZIP 227 (iwepụta). Ọnọdụ: ọ dịbeghị ndụ na mainnet, ọ bụghịkwa akụkụ nke Network Upgrade 7 (NU7). ZIP 259, nke depụtara ihe niile NU7 na-ebunye, anaghị agụnye ZIP 226 ma ọ bụ ZIP 227, ma edobeghị ụbọchị mmalite ZSA. Ugwo: a na-akwụ ha mgbe niile na ZEC, n'agbanyeghị akụ a na-ebufe. --- Nkọwa Isi Zcash Akụ nke e chebere echebe (ZSA) bụ ndozi a tụrụ aro maka protocol Zcash nke ga-eme ka e nwee ike ịmepụta, ibufe, na ịkụ ọkụ nke akụ omenala na chain Zcash. Ọ bụrụ na ị maara ụkpụrụ token ERC-20 n'elu blockchain Ethereum, ZSA dị na Zcash dịka token ERC-20 dị na Ethereum. Zcash Akụ nke e chebere echebe ga-eme ka e nwee ike ịmepụta token omenala na blockchain Zcash, si otú a kwe ka token ndị ọzọ na-abụghị ZEC rite uru na amaghi onye na Nzuzo nke Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na blockchain Zcash. Otu nnukwu ojiji ZSA pụrụ inwe bụ iwepụta stablecoins na protocol Zcash. Stablecoins bụ cryptocurrencies na-ejikọta uru ha na ego fiat, dịka US Dollar ma ọ bụ Euro. Ugbu a, ụfọdụ stablecoins a na-ekesa n'ọtụtụ ebe bụ token ERC-20 dịka USDC na Dai. Ojiji ọzọ ZSA pụrụ inwe bụ iwepụta token Gọọmentị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, ZecHub (onye na-ebipụta wiki a) bụ Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO), ma nwee ike ịmepụta ma nye ndị otu ya ZSA maka ịtụ vootu maka atụmatụ na mkpebi Gọọmentị. QEDIT na-emepụta ZSA, n'okpuru nnukwu ikike sitere na Zcash Foundation na mmekorita ya na Electric Coin Company. Ebe ọ bụ na a ka na-emepụta ọrụ a nke ọma, a na-ebipụta mmelite na eriokwu a nke forum Zcash. Ngwa ikike ZSA [](https://zcashgrants.org/gallery/25215916-53ea-4041-a3b2-6d00c487917d/33106640/) nke QEDIT dị na weebụsaịtị ikike Zcash Foundation. --- Anya / Ntụnyere Akwụkwọ ozi e mechiri emechi Chee Azụmahia Zcash nke e chebere echebe n'echiche dịka akwụkwọ ozi dị larịị, e mechiri emechi, a tụbara n'ime igbe ozi ọha. Onye ọ bụla pụrụ ịhụ na e zitere akwụkwọ ozi. Ọ dịghị onye pụrụ ịhụ onye zitere ya, onye nakọtara ya, ma ọ bụ ihe dị n'ime ya — akwụkwọ ozi ọ bụla yikwara nke ọ bụla ọzọ. Taa, akwụkwọ ozi n'elu network Zcash nwere ike ibu naanị otu ihe: ZEC. ZSA anaghị agbanwe akwụkwọ ozi ahụ. Ọ na-agbanwe ihe a na-ekwe ka ọ dị n'ime ya. Mgbe ZSA gasịrị, otu akwụkwọ ozi ahụ e mechiri emechi nwere ike ibu stablecoin, token Gọọmentị DAO, ma ọ bụ isi ihe iguzosi ike n'ihe nke ụlọọrụ — ma n'èzí, ọ ga-adị ka akwụkwọ ozi ọ bụla ọzọ na network ahụ. Otu nkọwa kwesịrị ka e cheta: a na-akwụ ugwo nzipu ozi mgbe niile na ZEC, n'agbanyeghị ihe dị n'ime akwụkwọ ozi ahụ. Ihe onye na-ekiri n'èzí pụrụ ịhụ Onye na-ekiri pụrụ ịhụ... ZIP 227 na-edobe iwepụta n'Oha ụma, ka e wee nwee ike soro ọkọnọ na-ekesa nke akụ ọ bụla na on-chain. Ihe onye ọ bụla ji na Kwụọ ụhwọ nke onye ọ bụla na-anọgide na Nzuzo; ọnụ ọgụgụ token niile dị adịghị. Maka onye na-ewepụta stablecoin, nchikota ahụ bụ isi ihe karịa nkwekọrịta. title: Ịmekọrịta e-akpa ego Zcash
description: Zcash na-eji proof zero-knowledge chebe nkọwa Azụmahia pụọ n'aka ndị na-enweghị ikike. Nzuzo [privacy] a na-eme ka imekọrịta siere e-akpa ego dị ọkụ ike n'ihi…
text: Ịmekọrịta e-akpa ego Zcash Nchịkọta N'ihi na Azụmahia [transaction] nke e chebere echebe [shielded] Zcash na-ezo nkọwa ha, sava enweghị ike ịchọ nguzozi e-akpa ego n'ụzọ dị mfe dịka o nwere ike isi mee maka mkpụrụ ego Oha [transparent] dịka Bitcoin ma ọ bụ Ethereum. E-akpa ego dị ọkụ na-ebudata obere “compact blocks” site na sava pụrụ iche (lightwalletd) ma jiri igodo nzuzo ha decrypt data dị mkpa n'onwe ha. Ime decrypt na ịhazi block ndị ahụ na-ewe oge, ya mere e-akpa ego na-eji ụzọ imekọrịta ngwa ngwa eme ka ị nwee ike iji ego gị ngwa ngwa. Ụzọ ndị a ma ama: Warp Sync (YWallet), Spend-before-sync (Zcash Mobile Wallet SDK V2), Blaze Sync (Zecwallet), na DAGSync a tụrụ aro. Ụzọ ndị a na-atụkarị mgbanwe n'etiti ebe nchekwa ọzọ ma ọ bụ ike nhazi ọzọ maka imekọrịta ngwa ngwa. Nkọwa Isi Ka imekọrịta Zcash si arụ ọrụ Zcash na-eji proof zero-knowledge chebe nkọwa Azụmahia pụọ n'aka ndị na-enweghị ikike. Nzuzo [privacy] a na-eme ka imekọrịta siere e-akpa ego dị ọkụ ike n'ihi na ha anaghị echekwa blockchain [blockchain] dum n'ógbè ha, kama ha na-adabere na sava maka ozi dị mkpa. Site na Bitcoin ma ọ bụ Ethereum, sava nwere ike idekọta blockchain ma weghachite data akaụntụ ngwa ngwa. Mana site na Zcash, sava enweghị ike ịhụ nkọwa Azụmahia. Ya mere, kedu ka e-akpa ego dị ọkụ ga-esi mekota nguzozi na akụkọ ya n'ebughị ma decrypt blockchain dum n'onwe ya? Zcash na-edozi nsogbu a site n'ijikọta ụzọ dị iche iche. O nwere sava pụrụ iche, lightwalletd, nke na-enyocha data sitere na full node ma debe naanị ihe a chọrọ iji mata Azụmahia. A na-akpọ data a compact blocks, ọ dịkwa ntakịrị karịa block mbụ. E-akpa ego dị ọkụ na-ebu ụzọ ebudata compact blocks ndị a site na sava lightwalletd, wee jiri igodo nzuzo ha decrypt ha. Ọbụna ime decrypt na ịhazi compact blocks ndị a nwere ike iwe oge dị ukwuu, karịsịa mgbe enwere ọtụtụ Azụmahia n'otu block. Ya mere, e-akpa ego na-eji ụzọ dị iche iche mee ka imekọrịta dị ngwa ma mee ka ị jiri ego gị ozugbo o kwere mee. Ihe Anya / Ntụnyere Chee blockchain dịka nnukwu ụlọ nzipu ozi jupụtara n'igbe akpọchiri akpọchi. N'ihe gbasara mkpụrụ ego Oha, onye ọrụ ụlọ nzipu ozi nwere ike ịgụ aha dị n'igbe ndị ahụ ma gwa gị ozugbo ndị bụ nke gị. Site na Zcash, a na-ezo aha ndị ahụ — ya mere e-akpa ego gị ga-eji igodo ya lelee igbe ndị ahụ nwayọọ nwayọọ n'onwe ya ịchọta ndị ọ pụrụ imeghe. Ụzọ imekọrịta ndị dị n'okpuru bụ usoro dị iche iche maka ilele igbe ndị ahụ ngwa ngwa. Nkọwa Miri Emi Warp Sync Warp sync bụ atụmatụ YWallet nke na-awụli nzọụkwụ etiti nke ime decrypt na ịhazi compact block ọ bụla, wee gaa kpọmkwem na nsonaazụ ikpeazụ. Iji mee nke a, ọ na-eji mgbakọ na cryptography gbakọọ nsonaazụ ikpeazụ na-agafeghị nzọụkwụ ọ bụla. Warp sync nwere ike ịhazi ọtụtụ puku block kwa nkeji, ngwa ngwa karịa usoro imekọrịta a na-emebu. Nke a pụtara na ndị ọrụ YWallet nwere ike ịnụ ụtọ arụmọrụ ngwa ngwa ma dị larịị, ọbụna mgbe ha nwere ọtụtụ narị puku Azụmahia na note ha natara n'akaụntụ ha. Ewezuga usoro ịwụli nzọụkwụ a, YWallet nwere ike ịhazi ọtụtụ block n'otu oge, na-ekesa ibu ọrụ n'ofe hardware ị nwere iji mee ka usoro ahụ dịkwuo ngwa ngwa. Gụkwuo maka Warp Sync A kọwara Warp sync ebe a dịka usoro imekọrịta. Ywallet n'onwe ya anaghịzi enweta nlekọta, a gaghị emelitekwa ya maka Ironwood, ya mere ọ bụghị e-akpa ego ị ga-etinye taa. Spend-before-sync Spend-before-sync bụ atụmatụ ọhụrụ na Zcash Mobile Wallet SDK V2 nke na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere iji ego ozugbo ha meghere e-akpa ego ha, na-echeghị ka imekọrịta e-akpa ego dum gwụ. Atụmatụ a na-eme ka ịchọpụta nguzozi e-akpa ego a pụrụ iji kwụọ ụgwọ dị ngwa ma melite ahụmịhe onye ọrụ. Spend-before-sync na-arụ ọrụ site n'iji algorithm imekọrịta compact-blocks nke na-ahazi block sitere na sava lightwalletd n'usoro na-adịghị ahịrị kwụ ọtọ. Nke a pụtara na kama ichere ka ahazie otu block kpamkpam tupu aga n'ihu, e-akpa ego nwere ike iji ntakịrị ebe nchekwa na ike nhazi ọzọ nyochaa ngalaba dị iche iche nke blockchain. title: Zebra Full Node
description: Zebra bụ node mbụ Zcash e dere kpamkpam na Rust. Ọ nọ na netwọkụ ibe-na-ibe Zcash, ebe ọ na-enyocha ma na-agbasa Azụmahia ma na-edobe ọnọdụ blockchain. Inwe…
text: Zebra Full Node Na Nkenke Zebra (zebrad) bụ Zcash full node e dere na Rust ma Zcash Foundation na-elekọta. Ọ na-enyocha blocks na Azụmahia, na-edobe ọnọdụ chain, ma na-ekwurịta okwu na nodes ndị ọzọ site na netwọkụ ibe-na-ibe. Zebra na zcashd mejuputara otu protocol ahụ ma nwee ike ịrụkọ ọrụ ọnụ. Kemgbe e wepụrụ zcashd, Zebra na-arụ ọrụ consensus. Ụzọ abụọ e si agba ya: image zfnd/zebra Docker, ma ọ bụ iwulite ya site na source. Hardware akwadoro bụ CPU cores 4, RAM 16 GB, na diski 300 GB. Nke kacha nta bụ cores 2 na RAM 4 GB, nwere otu diski 300 GB ahụ. Nkọwa Isi Zebra bụ node mbụ Zcash e dere kpamkpam na Rust. Ọ nọ na netwọkụ ibe-na-ibe Zcash, ebe ọ na-enyocha ma na-agbasa Azụmahia ma na-edobe ọnọdụ blockchain. Inwe mmejuputa nke abụọ nọọrọ onwe ya na-eme ka akụrụngwa netwọkụ ghara ịdabere nke ukwuu n'otu codebase. Zebra na zcashd Node mbụ Zcash, bụ zcashd, ka Electric Coin Company mepụtara site na codebase Bitcoin. E dere Zebra site na mmalite na Rust, asụsụ na-echekwa nchekwa ebe nchekwa, na-elekwasị anya na nchekwa na ịrụ ọrụ nke ọma. Mmejuputa abụọ ahụ na-agbaso otu protocol, ya mere ha nwere ike ikwurịta okwu ma rụọkọ ọrụ ọnụ. zcashd ruru nkwụsị End-of-Support ya na 18 Julaị 2026 ma ọ naghị amalite ọzọ, nke na-ahapụ Zebra na Zakura dịka mmejuputa node ndị a na-eji. Lee Full Nodes maka nkọwa sara mbara. Ịgba Zebra Ị nwere ike ịgba Zebra site n'iji image Docker, ma ọ bụ ị nwere ike iji aka gị wuo ya. Biko lee ngalaba System Requirements. Ojiji Docker Iji gbaa release kachasị ọhụrụ ma mekọrịta ya ruo na tip, gbaa iwu a: Maka ntuziaka zuru ezu, gaa na akwụkwọ Docker documentation. Iwulite Zebra Iwulite Zebra chọrọ Rust, libclang, na compiler C++. Jide n'aka na ị tinyela ụdị stable kachasị ọhụrụ nke Rust, n'ihi na naanị ya ka a na-anwale Zebra. Dependencies ndị dị mkpa maka iwulite gụnyere: libclang (a makwaara dị ka libclang-dev ma ọ bụ llvm-dev) clang ma ọ bụ compiler C++ ọzọ (dịka g++ maka platforms niile ma ọ bụ Xcode maka macOS) protoc (Protocol Buffers compiler) nwere flag --experimentalallowproto3optional, ewepụtara na Protocol Buffers v3.12.0 (wepụtara na Mee 16, 2020). Wụnye ma Malite Na x8664 ma ọ bụ aarch64 Linux nwere glibc 2.34 ma ọ bụ nke ọhụrụ karịa (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, RHEL 9+, Amazon Linux 2023), ị nwere ike ịgafe dependencies iwulite ma wụnye binary a wulitere tupu oge eruo nke a bịanyere aka: A na-etinyekwa binaries ndị ahụ na release GitHub ọ bụla dịka zebrad- - .tar.gz, nke ọ bụla nwere SHA-256 checksum, Sigstore build-provenance attestation na Cosign signature. N'elu platforms ochie, jiri image Docker ma ọ bụ wuo ya site na source. Iji wuo ya site na source, nweta code ma wuo binary release: Jiri nke a malite node: Nduzi nrụnye: zebra.zfnd.org/user/install.html Nhazi Nhọrọ na Njirimara Ịmalite Faịlụ Nhazi Mepụta faịlụ nhazi site n'iji iwu: A ga-etinye zebrad.toml e mepụtara n'ime ndekọ nhọrọ ndabara nke Linux. Maka ebe ndabara OS ọzọ, gaa na documentation. Ịhazi Ogwe Ọganihu Hazie tracing.progressbar n'ime zebrad.toml gị iji gosipụta metrics dị mkpa na terminal site n'iji ogwe ọganihu. Rịba ama: E nwere nsogbu ama ama ebe atụmatụ ogwe ọganihu nwere ike ibu oke ukwuu. Ịhazi Ịgwụputa Enwere ike ịhazi Zebra maka ịgwụputa site n'ịkọwa MINERADDRESS na port mapping n'ime Docker. Enwere nkọwa ndị ọzọ na Mining support documentation. Njirimara Iwulite Omenala Jiri Cargo features ndị ọzọ, dịka Prometheus metrics, Sentry monitoring, nkwado Elasticsearch nnwale, na ndị ọzọ, gbasaa arụmọrụ Zebra. Jikọta ọtụtụ features site n'idepụta ha dịka parameters nke flag --features mgbe a na-arụ nrụnye. A na-agbanyụ ụfọdụ debugging na monitoring features na release builds iji kwalite arụmọrụ. Maka ndepụta zuru ezu nke features nnwale na nke onye mmepụta, lee API documentation. title: ZKP & ZK-SNARKS
description: Proof bụ ntọala maka mgbakọ na mwepụ niile. Proof bụ nkwupụta ma ọ bụ usoro iwu ị na-achọ igosipụta na usoro mwepụta e mere iji kwupụta na egosila usoro iwu…
text: ZKP & ZK-SNARKS N'Ikpeazụ zk-SNARKs = Arụmụka Ihe Ọmụma Dị Mkpirikpi na-enweghị Mmekọrịta nke Zero-Knowledge Ha na-eme ka otu akụkụ nwee ike gosipụta na ha maara ihe na-enweghị ikpughe ozi ahụ n'onwe ya Zcash na-eji zk-SNARKs gosipụta na azụmahia ziri ezi (ọnụọgụ ziri ezi, ntinye a na-emefubeghị) na-enweghị ikpughe onye zitere, onye natara, ma ọ bụ ọnụọgụ “Dị mkpirikpi” pụtara na proof ahụ dị nta ma dị ngwa inyocha ọbụna maka nkwupụta ndị dị mgbagwoju anya Pool nke e chebere echebe Orchard na-eji Halo 2, usoro zk-SNARK nke anaghị achọ trusted setup --- Gịnị bụ Proof? Proof bụ ntọala maka mgbakọ na mwepụ niile. Proof bụ nkwupụta ma ọ bụ usoro iwu ị na-achọ igosipụta na usoro mwepụta e mere iji kwupụta na egosila usoro iwu ahụ. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, onye ọ bụla na-enyocha (verifier) nwere ike n'onwe ya nyochaa na akụkụ niile nke triangle na-agbakọta ruo 180°. Proof Onye na-egosi ---> Na-eme Nkwupụta ---> Onye Nyocha Na-ahọrọ ---> Nabata/Jụ (Ma onye na-egosi ma onye nyocha bụ algọridim) Na sayensị kọmputa, okwu a na-eji maka proof ndị a pụrụ inyocha nke ọma bụ NP proof. Enwere ike inyocha proof ndị a dị mkpirikpi n'oge polynomial. Echiche sara mbara bụ “E nwere azịza maka usoro iwu ma nyefee ya onye nyocha ka ọ nyochaa ya”. N'asụsụ NP = ọnọdụ abụọ ga-adịrị: Njuputa: Onye nyocha ga-anabata nkwupụta eziokwu (na-enye ndị na-egosi ezi omume ohere iru nkwenye) Izi ezi: Nkwupụta ụgha agaghị enwe proof (maka atụmatụ ọ bụla nke onye na-egosi aghụghọ, ha agaghị enwe ike igosi izi ezi nke nkwupụta na-ezighi ezi). Proof mmekọrịta & nke nwere ihe ndabara Mmekọrịta: Kama naanị ịgụ proof ahụ, onye nyocha na onye na-egosi na-emekọrịta ugboro ugboro n'ọtụtụ mgbatị ozi. Ihe ndabara: Arịrịọ onye nyocha na-enye onye na-egosi bụ nke a haziri n'amaghị ama, onye na-egosi ga-enwe ike ịza nke ọ bụla n'ụzọ ziri ezi. Site n'iji mmekọrịta na ihe ndabara ọnụ, ọ ga-ekwe omume igosi nkwupụta nye onye nyocha na-ahụghị ihe n'oge Probabilistic Polynomial Time (PPT). Proof mmekọrịta hà nwere ike inyocha karịa NP proof nke ọma? NP Proof megide IP proof: Nkwupụta NP IP -------------- ----------- -------- NP ee ee CO-NP mba ee #P mba ee PSPACE mba ee NP - E nwere azịza maka nkwupụta CO-NP - Igosi na enweghị azịza maka nkwupụta #P - Ịgụ ole azịza dị maka nkwupụta PSPACE - Igosi ntụgharị nke nkwupụta dị iche iche Gịnị bụ Zero Knowledge? Ihe onye nyocha nwere ike ịgbakọ mgbe mmekọrịta gachara na ihe ha nwere ike igosi tupu ya bụ otu. Mmekọrịta a na-eme n'ọtụtụ mgbatị n'etiti onye na-egosi na onye nyocha emebeghị ka ikike mgbakọ nke onye nyocha bawanye. Nnwale Paradigm Nnwale a dị n'ime cryptography niile. Ọ na-eweta “Nlele Eziokwu” na “Nlele Emebere”. Nlele Eziokwu: Akụkọ ihe mere eme niile nwere ike ịdị nke mmekọrịta n'etiti Onye Na-egosi na Onye Nyocha (P,V) Nlele Emebere: Onye nyocha na-emegharị mmekọrịta niile nwere ike ịdị n'etiti Onye Na-egosi na Onye Nyocha Onye nkewa oge polynomial na-agbalị ikpebi ma ha na-ele nlele eziokwu ma ọ bụ nlele emebere anya, ma na-arịọ ihe atụ n'aka ha abụọ ugboro ugboro. A na-ekwu na nlele abụọ ahụ “enweghị ike ikewapụ ha site na mgbakọ” ma ọ bụrụ na maka algọridim/atụmatụ nkewa niile, ọbụna mgbe ha natara ọnụ ọgụgụ polynomial nke ihe atụ sitere na nlele eziokwu ma ọ bụ nke emebere, ihe gbasara nke puru ime karịrị 1/2. Usoro mmekọrịta bara uru mgbe e nwere naanị otu onye nyocha. Otu atụ bụ onye nyocha ụtụ isi n'ime ngwa zero-knowledge nke “proof ụtụ isi”. Gịnị bụ SNARK? text: Inweta Zcash Na nkenke Zụta ZEC n’ụlọ exchange na-akwado mwepụ nke e chebere echebe [shielded] (Gemini, BitcoinVN, flyp.me) ma ọ bụrụ na o kwe omume Ọtụtụ nnukwu centralized exchange (Coinbase, Kraken, Binance) na-akwado naanị mwepụ Oha [transparent] — chebe ZEC gị mgbe ị nwetasịrị ya decentralized exchange na-enye ohere maka Mgbawe [swap] na-enweghị Onye nlekota [custodial], mana ha na-ewepụkarị ego gaa na Adreesị akpa ego Oha Ọ dịghị gị mkpa ịzụta ZEC zuru ezu — obere akụkụ ya na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma --- Iji Zcash mee Azụmahia [transaction] nke e chebere echebe na nzuzo, ị ga-enwerịrị ZEC. Iji nweta ZEC, ị ga-azụta ya. Ị nwere ike ịzụta ZEC n’ọtụtụ exchange dị iche iche, nke anyị ga-edepụta n’okpuru. A na-atụ aro ka ị jiri exchange na-akwado mwepụ nke e chebere echebe. Ị nwekwara ike ịgwụputa [mining] ZEC, mana nke ahụ anaghị ekwekarị ndị na-azụ ahịa nkịtị. More gbasara nke ahụ ebe a na ebe a. Exchange na-akwado mwepụ nke e chebere echebe Gemini Gemini bụ cryptocurrency exchange a na-achịkwa, e-akpa ego [wallet], na onye nlekota nke na-eme ka ịzụta ZEC, Ether, na cryptocurrency ndị ọzọ dị mfe ma dị nchebe. Ị nwere ike iji ego fiat ma ọ bụ cryptocurrency ndị ọzọ zụta ZEC. BitcoinVN BitcoinVN bụ instant exchange na-enweghị Onye nlekota nke na-akwado itinye ego na iwepụ ego nke e chebere echebe (z-address) maka ZEC — otu n’ime exchange ole na ole n’ụwa niile na-akwado z-address n’uju. Ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ kemgbe 2014, ị nwere ike ịgbanwe BTC, ETH, USDT, na cryptocurrency ndị ọzọ maka ZEC ozugbo gaa n’e-akpa ego gị nke e chebere echebe. flyp.me flyp.me bụ crypto exchange na-achọghị ndebanye aha. Exchange na-akwado mwepụ Oha Ọtụtụ nnukwu exchange na-akwado Zcash. Lee ebe a maka ndepụta zuru ezu: ebe a. Coinbase decentralized Exchange na-akwado mwepụ Oha Exchange ndị a na-akwado mwepụ Oha. Nke a pụtara na mgbe ị wepụrụ ZEC gaa n’e-akpa ego gị, ị ga-eziga ya na Adreesị akpa ego Oha gị, ya bụ Adreesị akpa ego ZEC gị nke ọha. Pịa ebe a maka nkọwa ndị ọzọ. text: Zcash Pool Uru [Value Pools] Na Nkenke Zcash nwere ugbu a pool uru 5: Sprout (ochie), Sapling, Orchard (naanị maka imefu), Ironwood, na Oha. Ironwood bụ pool nke e chebere echebe bụ isi ugbu a, nke dị ndụ kemgbe network upgrade NU6.3 na 28 Julaị 2026. Orchard bụ ugbu a naanị maka imefu: uru ọhụrụ enweghị ike ịbanye na ya, ego dị adị na-akwaga na Ironwood. Sapling (z-adreesị ndị ji zs amalite) ka ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado, ma na-aga n'ihu ichebe nnukwu ọnụọgụ ZEC nke e chebere echebe. Nkwaga sitere na Orchard ruo Ironwood na-aga n'ihu, a na-enyochakwa ya n'ihu ọha site na turnstile. Maka nkwa Nzuzo kacha sie ike, ndị ọrụ kwesịrị ịnọgide na-ahọrọ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe gaa na nke e chebere echebe (z → z) mgbe ọ bụla o kwere omume. Ịghọta Pool Uru Zcash Zcash na-ekewa ego n'ime usoro ndekọ ego dị iche iche a maara dị ka pool uru. Pool nke ọ bụla nwere iwu cryptographic na àgwà Nzuzo nke ya, ebe protocol na-enyocha uru ngụkọta na-agafe n'etiti ha. Taa, network ahụ nwere pool uru isi ise: Oha — Nke ọha na eze ma na-ahụ ya kpamkpam on-chain. Sapling — Pool nke e chebere echebe nke oge a mbụ ọtụtụ ndị nakweere, nke ka na-arụ ọrụ. Orchard — Pool nke e chebere echebe bụ isi gara aga, nke bụ ugbu a naanị maka imefu. Ironwood — Pool nke e chebere echebe bụ isi ugbu a, nke NU6.3 webatara. Sprout — Pool nke e chebere echebe mbụ e malitere na Zcash n'afọ 2016. Ọ malitere ịrụ ọrụ na 28 Julaị 2026 na block 3,428,143 dị ka akụkụ nke network upgrade NU6.3, ọ bụkwa ebe uru ọhụrụ e chebere echebe bi ugbu a. Ọ dị n'ihi na achọpụtara adịghị ike n'usoro proving nke Orchard na Mee 2026. Enweghị akaebe na e jirila ya mee ihe, mana ntụpọ ahụ pụtara na enweghị ike igosi na ọkọnọ nke e chebere echebe ziri ezi site na proofs naanị. Kama idozi ya n'ebe ọ dị, network ahụ kere pool ọhụrụ nwere circuit edoziri wee bugharịa uru gafee turnstile nke na-agụta mkpụrụ ego ọ bụla n'ihu ọha. Ndekọ ego ahụ bụ ihe na-eweghachi nkwa na ọkọnọ nke e chebere echebe nwere nkwado zuru ezu. Ironwood na-ejikwa ọzọ ụdị Action nke Orchard na proofs Halo 2, ya mere ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ụzọ ahụ kwa ụbọchị. text: Gịnị Bụ Zcash Adreesị TEX? Nchịkọta Ngwa Ngwa Adreesị TEX bụ Adreesị akpa ego Oha [transparent] Zcash e dere n’ụdị ọzọ. Ọ na-amalite na tex1 ma kọwaa ya na ZIP 320. title: Azụmahia [Transactions]
description: ZEC bụ akụ dijitalụ a na-ejikarị eme Kwụọ ụhwọ [payments], nke na-enye atụmatụ Nzuzo [privacy] siri ike nke na-eme ka ọ dabara maka Azụmahia dị iche iche dịka…
text: Azụmahia [Transactions] ZEC bụ akụ dijitalụ a na-ejikarị eme Kwụọ ụhwọ [payments], nke na-enye atụmatụ Nzuzo [privacy] siri ike nke na-eme ka ọ dabara maka Azụmahia dị iche iche dịka ịkwụ enyi ego, ịzụta ihe, ma ọ bụ inye onyinye. Iji bulie Nzuzo na nchekwa elu, ọ dị mkpa ịghọta ka ụdị Azụmahia dị iche iche si arụ ọrụ n'ime Zcash. Nchịkọta Zcash na-akwado ụdị Azụmahia abụọ: nke e chebere echebe [shielded], nke na-edobe nkọwa ya na nzuzo, na Oha [transparent], nke na-edekọ ha n'ihu ọha. Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe na-amalite na u ma ọ bụ z. Adreesị akpa ego Oha na-amalite na t ma na-arụ ọrụ nke yiri Adreesị akpa ego Bitcoin. Nhọrọ ahụ bụ nke gị n'oge Kwụọ ụhwọ ọ bụla. Nzuzo bụ nhọrọ Zcash na-enye gị, ọ bụghị ntọala onye ọzọ ga-ekpebi maka gị. Ịwepụ ego n'aka exchange bụ ebe ndị mmadụ na-atụfu Nzuzo ha ọtụtụ mgbe. Ọ bụrụ na exchange ahụ na-akwado naanị iwepụ ego Oha, chebe ego ahụ n'onwe gị ozugbo ọ rutere. Ugwo [fees] na-agbaso ZIP 317 ma na-abawanye dabere n'otú Azụmahia ahụ hà. E-akpa ego ndị ka na-ezipụ ugwo ochie a kapịrị ọnụ nwere ike ịhụ Azụmahia ha ka ọ na-egbu oge. Ọtụtụ Azụmahia Zcash nwere ogo njedebe n'okpuru ZIP 203. Ọ bụrụ na Azụmahia agwụ tupu a gwupụta ya, enweghị ike ikwenye ya ma ogo njedebe ahụ gafee, ma o nwere ike ịdị mkpa iziga ya ọzọ. Azụmahia Echebere Echebe --- Azụmahia e chebere echebe na-eme mgbe ị bugara ZEC n'ime e-akpa ego gị nke e chebere echebe. Adreesị akpa ego e-akpa ego gị nke e chebere echebe na-amalite na u ma ọ bụ z. Mgbe ị na-ezipụ Azụmahia e chebere echebe, gị na ndị gị na ha na-azụkọ ahịa nwere ike idobe ọkwa Nzuzo na-agaghị ekwe omume na netwọk Kwụọ ụhwọ ndị na-eme ka ihe pụta ìhè n'ihu ọha na mbụ. Izipụ Azụmahia e chebere echebe dị mfe karịa mgbe ị na-eji e-akpa ego na-akwado netwọk Zcash ugbu a na pool e chebere echebe ugbu a. Tupu ịdabere na e-akpa ego maka Nzuzo, lelee ma ọ na-akwado izipu echebere echebe, ịnata echebere echebe, na pool ị na-ezube iji. Mgbe ị na-ewepụ ZEC n'aka exchange, lelee ma exchange ahụ na-akwado iwepụ ego echebere echebe ma ọ bụ Oha. Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-akwado naanị iwepụ ego Oha, bugharịa ego ahụ n'ime e-akpa ego nwere ike ichebe ego mgbe ọ rutere. Iji Azụmahia e chebere echebe eziga ma nata ego bụ ụzọ kacha mma isi chekwaa Nzuzo ma belata ihe ize ndụ nke ikpughe data Kwụọ ụhwọ. Azụmahia Oha Azụmahia Oha na-arụ ọrụ yiri Azụmahia Bitcoin. Nkọwa Azụmahia na-ahụ anya n'ihu ọha na blockchain, gụnyere Adreesị akpa ego Oha na uru Oha. E kwesịghị iji Azụmahia Oha mgbe Nzuzo bụ ihe kacha mkpa. Adreesị akpa ego Oha ka bara uru n'ọnọdụ ụfọdụ, karịchaa mgbe exchange ma ọ bụ ọrụ anaghị akwado Adreesị akpa ego e chebere echebe. Ọ bụrụ na ị nata ZEC n'Adreesị akpa ego Oha, tụlee ichebe ya tupu i mee Kwụọ ụhwọ ndị ọzọ. Ụzọ Dị Mfe Isi Hụta Ya N'uche Azụmahia Oha dị ka kaadị nzipu ozi. Onye na-ebuga ozi na-ebuga ya, mana onye ọbụla jidere ya n'ụzọ nwere ike ịgụ ozi ahụ, hụ onye zitere ya, ma hụ onye na-anata ya. Azụmahia e chebere echebe dị ka envelopu e mechiri emechi. Ọrụ nzipu ozi ahụ ka na-akwado na ezigbo leta nwere ezigbo stampụ gafere na sistemụ ahụ, ọ nweghịkwa onye nwere ike ịmepụta nke ụgha ma ọ bụ zipụ otu leta ahụ ugboro abụọ. Ihe dị n'envelopu ahụ na-adị n'etiti onye zitere ya na onye na-anata ya. Akụkụ dị mkpa bụ na Zcash na-ahapụ gị ikpebi nke ị ga-eziga, Kwụọ ụhwọ ọ bụla. Ugwo Zcash Kwe ka e-akpa ego gị gbakọọ ugwo netwọk, ma nyochaa ya tupu i zipu. A na-akwụ ugwo na ZEC: 1 ZEC = zatoshis 100,000,000. Ugwo a gbakọrọ na dollar US na-adaberekwa na ọnụego exchange nke ZEC. Ihe mere Kwụọ ụhwọ abụọ nwere ike inwe ugwo dị iche iche ZIP 317 na-agbakọ ugwo a na-ahụkarị site na omume ezi uche (logical actions), kama ịbụ pasentị nke ego e zitere: Omume ezi uche (logical actions) na-atụ akụkụ Azụmahia. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, Azụmahia nke na-eji naanị Orchard na-eji ọnụọgụ omume Orchard ya; Azụmahia nke na-eji naanị Sapling na-eji nke kachasị ukwuu n'etiti ọnụọgụ mmefu (spend) na mmepụta (output) ya.
