title: Ngwá ọrụ Devtool nke Zcash
description: Devtool Zcash bụ ikpo okwu maka ịnwale Zcash. Ndị mmepe wuru ya maka ndị mmepe, maka nnwale na mmepe ọrụ ọhụrụ nke Zcash; ekwesịghịkwa ile ya anya dị ka ihe dị…
text: Ngwá ọrụ Devtool nke Zcash Gịnị bụ zcash-devtool? Devtool Zcash bụ ikpo okwu maka ịnwale Zcash. Ndị mmepe wuru ya maka ndị mmepe, maka nnwale na mmepe ọrụ ọhụrụ nke Zcash; ekwesịghịkwa ile ya anya dị ka ihe dị njikere maka mmepụta. API ahịrị iwu nke ngwá ọrụ a na-enye nwere ike, ọ ga-agbanwekwa n'oge ọ bụla na-enweghị ịdọ aka ná ntị. ETINYELA nnukwu ego n’ijikwa e-akpa ego [wallet] arụnyere n'ime zcash-devtool. Nkuzi vidio banyere Devtool Zcash: Kris Nuttycombe (@nuttycom) gosipụtara ngwá ọrụ a n'oge ZconVI. --- Maka nduzi nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ banyere otu esi amalite iji ngwá ọrụ ndị a, lee nduzi a. Ọ na-edekọ nkọwa zuru ezu banyere otu esi ahazi ma jiri ngwá ọrụ zcash devtool. Ebumnuche ya bụ ịbụ nduzi maka otu esi ahazi ya na otu esi agbakwunye ọrụ nke gị na ngwá ọrụ ahụ. Mmalite ngwa ngwa A nwalere iwu ndị dị n'okpuru megide zcash-devtool main (commit 5a26ee8, Ọgọọst 2026). Ngwá ọrụ ahụ na-agbanwe na-enweghị ọkwa, ya mere jiri --help na iwu ọ bụla ma ọ bụrụ na ihe dị ebe a anaghịzi adaba. Wụnye Enweghị binary eburula ụzọ wuo. Wụnye Rust, wee wuo ya site na isi mmalite: Ihe atụ ndị dị n'okpuru na-akpọ binary e wuru, target/release/zcash-devtool. cargo run --release -- ... na-arụkwa ọrụ n'otu ụzọ ahụ. Mepụta e-akpa ego testnet Bido na testnet. Mkpụrụ ego testnet (TAZ) enweghị uru. -w bụ ndekọ e-akpa ego. Ọ na-adị mgbe wallet gachara ma tupu subcommand. -i bụ faịlụ njirimara age. A na-eji ya zoo mkpụrụokwu mnemonic nke e-akpa ego, a na-emepụtakwa faịlụ ahụ ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị. Debe ya: send, shield na iwu mmefu ego ndị ọzọ chọrọ ya iji kpọghee Mkpuru mgbake [seed phrase]. -n bụ netwọk: test ma ọ bụ main. -s na-ahọrọ sava e-akpa ego ọkụ. Ndabara, zecrocks, na-ejikọ na sava zec.rocks maka netwọk ahọpụtara. Iji weghachite e-akpa ego dị adị, jiri restore-mnemonic kama init. Ọ ga-ajụ gị maka mkpụrụokwu ahụ. balance na-edepụta pool [pool] ọ bụla iche, gụnyere Ironwood: Gbaa zcash-devtool wallet -w ./my-wallet list-addresses iji hụ Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ nke e-akpa ego ahụ, wee ziga ya ego testnet site na faucet faucet. Maka mainnet, tinye -n main na init. Jiri naanị ego ị nwere ike ịnabata ịla n'iyi. Zipu ma chebe Ọnụ ego dị na zatoshi (1 ZEC = 100,000,000 zatoshi). propose na-egosi Azụmahia [transaction] nke send ga-ewu, na-eziteghị ya. list-tx na list-unspent na-egosi akụkọ ihe mere eme na note [note] nke e-akpa ego ahụ. Iwu ọ bụla na-ekwurịta okwu na sava na-anabatakwa --connection tor, nke na-agafe njikọ ahụ site na onye ahịa Tor arụnyere n'ime ya. Nyochaa Adreesị, mkpịsị ugodi na Azụmahia inspect na-akọwa data Zcash na-enweghị ịntanetị: Adreesị akpa ego, mkpịsị ugodi, na Azụmahia raw. Tinye --lookup iji nweta ozi ndị ọzọ site na chain [chain], dịka Azụmahia site na ID ya. A na-eziga note Ironwood n'otu onye nnata Orchard n'ime Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ, yabụ Adreesị akpa ego agbanweghị na NU6.3. Wuo Azụmahia n’usoro nzọụkwụ site na PCZT PCZT (Azụmahia Zcash e mepụtara naanị akụkụ ya) na-ekewa iwu Azụmahia n'ime usoro dị iche iche: mepụta, gosi, bịanye aka, ma ziga. Usoro ọ bụla nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ n'igwe dị iche, dịka ọmụmaatụ site na onye na-abịanye aka hardware dịka Keystone. Iwu pczt ọ bụla na-agụ PCZT site na faịlụ ma ọ bụ stdin ma dee ya na faịlụ (--output) ma ọ bụ stdout, ya mere enwere ike ijikọ usoro ndị ahụ: zcash-devtool pczt --help na-edepụta usoro ndị ọzọ, gụnyere inspect, redact, combine, extract na shield. Bugharịa ego site na Orchard gaa Ironwood Kemgbe NU6.3, ego Orchard nwere ike ịkwaga naanị na Adreesị akpa ego nke e-akpa ego ahụ n'onwe ya. Iwu migration na-ebuga ha n'ime Ironwood: plan na-eleba anya n'ọdịnihu nkewa note na nhazi oge mbufe, ọ naghị agbanwe ihe ọ bụla. commit na-ewu ma bịa n'ihu bịanye aka na Azụmahia nkwadebe mbụ. Tinye --external iji hapụ ha na-enweghị mbinye aka maka onye na-abịanye aka mpụga dịka Keystone. status na-egosi ọganihu mbugharị ahụ na usoro na-esote. advance na-egosi Azụmahia na-esote nke anchor ya dị njikere. A ka na-ewu iwu mbugharị ndị a. advance na-akwụsị na Azụm

title: Zcash Ntụnye Maka Nkwalite
description: Ntụnye Maka Nkwalite [Improvement Proposal] nke Zcash (ZIP) bụ akwụkwọ nhazi nke na-enye obodo Zcash ozi, ma ọ bụ nke na-akọwa atụmatụ ọhụrụ maka Zcash ma ọ bụ…
text: Zcash Ntụnye Maka Nkwalite Gịnị bụ ZIP Ntụnye Maka Nkwalite [Improvement Proposal] nke Zcash (ZIP) bụ akwụkwọ nhazi nke na-enye obodo Zcash ozi, ma ọ bụ nke na-akọwa atụmatụ ọhụrụ maka Zcash ma ọ bụ usoro ya ma ọ bụ gburugburu ya. ZIP kwesịrị inye nkọwapụta nka dị mkpirikpi banyere atụmatụ ahụ na ihe kpatara atụmatụ ahụ. Anyị bu n'obi ka ZIP bụrụ usoro bụ isi maka ịtụpụta atụmatụ ọhụrụ, maka ịnakọta ntinye obodo banyere otu okwu, na maka idekọ mkpebi nhazi ndị e tinyegoro na Zcash. Onye nwe ZIP (na-abụkarị onye odee ma ọ bụ ndị odee) nwere ọrụ iwulite consensus [consensus] n'ime obodo na idekọ echiche ndị na-ekwenyeghị. Ebe a na-edobe ZIP dị ka faịlụ ederede n'ime ebe nchekwa nwere ụdị nsụgharị, akụkọ nsụgharị ha bụ ndekọ akụkọ ihe mere eme nke atụmatụ a tụrụ aro. -> zips.z.cash Ndị nchịkọta akụkọ ZIP Maka ZIP ọ bụla na-abata, ọ ga-agabiga usoro nyocha. Ndị nchịkọta akụkọ ZIP nwere ọrụ ịhụ na usoro na ọdịnaya nke ZIP ọ bụla kọwara nke ọma okwu, ihe kpatara ya, na mgbanwe nka ndị e mere. ZIP ndị dị mkpa ugbu a A nyochara ọnọdụ na aha ndị dị n'okpuru megide ndepụta ZIP na zips.z.cash n'ụbọchị 18 Ọgọst 2026. Ọnọdụ ZIP na-agbanwe ka oge na-aga, ya mere were ndepụta ahụ dị ka isi iyi nke eziokwu. Ndepụta mbụ: Mgbatị Zcash Oha Ndepụta mbụ: Mbufe na Ọkụ nke Akụ Zcash nke e chebere echebe Ndepụta mbụ: Mwepụta nke Akụ Zcash nke e chebere echebe Ewepụrụ: Ụdị Azụmahia Version 6 Ewepụrụ — ZIP 229 emeela ka ọ gharazie ịdị mkpa, nke na-akọwa ugbu a ụdị azụmaahịa 6. Lee ndepụta NU6.3 dị n'okpuru. Ndepụta mbụ: Nchịkọta Onye Nkọwa Azụmahia na Nkwado signature Maka Mgbatị Zcash Oha Ndepụta mbụ: Usoro Memo Ahaziri Ahazi Ndepụta mbụ: Sapling Signature Adreesị akpa ego Ndepụta mbụ: Usoro Light Client Maka Nchọpụta Kwụọ ụhwọ Ndepụta mbụ: Njirimara Nchekwa nke Viewing Key Sapling Na-arụ ọrụ: Ịkọwa Ụdị Adreesị akpa ego nke a pụrụ iziga ego na ya naanị site na Adreesị akpa ego Oha Ndepụta mbụ: Usoro Wallet.dat ZIP NU6.3 (Ironwood) A kọwara NU6.3 na ZIP 258, tinyere ZIP ndị ọzọ edepụtara ebe a. E bipụtara usoro ndị a na-atụle zuru ezu na ndepụta ZIP. Ndepụta mbụ: Mbugharị Network Upgrade NU6.3 Ndepụta mbụ: Ụdị Azụmahia Version 6 Ndepụta mbụ: Mbugharị Orchard gaa Ironwood Ndepụta mbụ: Nsonaazụ NU6.3 Maka E-akpa ego Atụpụtara: Iweghachite Quantum nke Ironwood Edebela: Ibelata Mbufe n'ime Pool Orchard A na-emelitekwa ZIP atọ gara aga maka NU6.3: ZIP 209, ZIP 213 na ZIP 317.

title: Z3: (zebrad)(zaino)(zingo-cli)
description: zingo-cli : onye ahịa zaino-proxy nke ahịrị iwu zcash (subset nke Zingolib)
text: Z3: (zebrad)(zaino)(zingo-cli) zebrad : zcash full node zaino : onye na-edepụta blockchain zcash zingo-cli : onye ahịa zaino-proxy nke ahịrị iwu zcash (subset nke Zingolib) Vidio Nchịkọta Ukwa System Architecture Zcash Onye ọrụ na-etinye/na-achịkọta Zingolib nke na-enye ohere ịnweta zingo-cli. Ha nwere ike izipu/nata ZEC dịka achọrọ. zingo-cli na-ejikọ na zaino ma n’ime mpaghara ma ọ bụ site na ọwa nchekwa n’ịntanetị (Zcash onye ọrụ anaghị eche maka otú nke a si arụ ọrụ!) Zaino na-enye ohere ịnweta ma zebrad ma ọ bụ zcashd zebrad emekọrịtara kpamkpam bụ isi iyi eziokwu (e-akpa ego ọzọ adịghị ebe a!) Ntinye Ị ga-achọ itinye ihe 3 ka nke a rụọ ọrụ nke ọma. Ana m akwado screen ma ọ bụ ihe yiri ya iji nyere aka na njikwa ihuenyo sudo apt install screen zebrad nhọrọ (mepụta nnọkọ screen maka zebrad) note: nke a ga-adị mkpa ka emekọrịta ya kpamkpam! zaino nhọrọ (mepụta nnọkọ screen maka zaino) zingo-cli nhọrọ (mepụta nnọkọ screen maka zingo-cli) note: nke a ga-adị mkpa ka emekọrịta ya kpamkpam, dịka lightwalletd mere. Ana m akwado iji draịvụ mpụga chekwaa oge :) Ịgba Ọrụ Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agba ihe ndị a na screens, screen -r ga-edepụta screen ọ bụla ka ị gaa na ya dịka achọrọ

title: Sistem zero-knowledge [Zero Knowledge] megide Sistem Dabere na Decoy
description: …Cryptocurrency na-ekpughere ọha ihe niile ị na-emefu ebe ọ dị ka Twitter na akaụntụ ụlọ akụ gị, nke a bụkwa nnukwu nsogbu a ga-edozi site n'ịnakwere Nzuzo…
text: Sistem zero-knowledge [Zero Knowledge] megide Sistem Dabere na Decoy …Cryptocurrency na-ekpughere ọha ihe niile ị na-emefu ebe ọ dị ka Twitter na akaụntụ ụlọ akụ gị, nke a bụkwa nnukwu nsogbu a ga-edozi site n'ịnakwere Nzuzo [privacy] on-chain.… - Ian Miers na Devcon4. Ụfọdụ ọrụ crypto enwetala amara maka ụzọ ha si etinye Nzuzo n'isi. Zcash bụ onye a ma ama maka iji Zero Knowledge Proofs (ZK) chebe ego Azụmahia [transaction] na Adreesị akpa ego [address]. Monero pụtara ìhè n'ihi iji ya mee ka onye na-ezipụ ego ghara ịmata nke ọma dabere na Decoy, tinyere atụmatụ Nzobe ederede [encryption] ndị ọzọ iji nweta Nzuzo onye ọrụ na blockchain [blockchain]. Ịghọta ZK Proofs na Sistem Dabere na Decoy Zero Knowledge Proofs bụ sistem cryptographic nke na-enye otu akụkụ (onye na-egosi proof) ohere igosi akụkụ ọzọ (onye na-enyocha ya) na okwu bụ eziokwu n'ekpugheghị ozi ọ bụla dị n'okpuru banyere okwu ahụ n'onwe ya. N'ọnọdụ Zcash, a na-eji ZK proofs chọpụta na Azụmahia ziri ezi n'ekpugheghị nkọwa Azụmahia dịka ONYE ZIGARA, ONYE NATABARA, ma ọ bụ EGO Azụmahia. Nke a na-eme ka Nzuzo onye ọrụ dịgide, n'ihi na Azụmahia na-anọgide na nzuzo ma a ka na-akwado na ọ ziri ezi. E mepụtara teknụzụ a iji hụ na Azụmahia ego na netwọk Zcash na-adị nzuzo. Na sistem dabere na Decoy dịka RingCT, a na-ejikọta ọtụtụ Azụmahia ọnụ, nke na-eme ka ịchọpụta ezigbo ebe ego si na ebe ọ na-aga sie ike. Algorithm ahụ na-etinye input na output Decoy n'ime Azụmahia, ma na-ejikwa Nzobe ederede nke Adreesị akpa ego eji eme input na Range proofs iji kwado na ego ebufere nwere ike imefu. Ụzọ a na-eme ka ụzọ Azụmahia ghara ịdị mfe ịmata. Iji input Decoy na-eme ka ọ sie onye ọ bụla na-enyocha blockchain ike ịchọpụta ezigbo onye zigara, onye natara, ma ọ bụ ego Azụmahia. Ihe Dị Mkpa A Ga-Ama: Usoro a nke ichekwa Nzuzo Azụmahia on-chain ka na-ekpughere input e zoro ezo nke Azụmahia ndị ọrụ niile. A ka nwere ike ịchịkọta metadata dịka MBUFỤT AZỤMAHIA n'etiti ndị ọrụ dị iche iche na netwọk. Ọ bụrụ na onye mmegide sonye n'ịmepụta Azụmahia na netwọk, nke ahụ na-eme ka input Decoy nke ndị ọrụ ndị ọzọ ghara inwe aha nzuzo. Uru ZK Nwere Karịa Sistem Dabere na Decoy Ma Zcash na Monero bụ cryptocurrency lekwasịrị anya na Nzuzo, mana ha na-enweta Nzuzo n'ụzọ dị iche iche. Ndị a bụ ụfọdụ uru zero-knowledge proofs (ZK) nke Zcash nwere karịa sistem Decoy nke Monero: 1) Mpughe ahọpụtara [Selective Disclosure]: Site na atụmatụ ZK nke Zcash, ndị ọrụ nwere nhọrọ ikpughere ndị otu kpọmkwem nkọwa Azụmahia Gụọ ECC blọọgụ gbasara Mpughe ahọpụtara. Na Zcash, ọdịnaya e zoro ezo nke Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na-enye ndị mmadụ ohere ikpughe data sitere na mbufe kpọmkwem n'ụzọ ahọpụtara. Ọzọkwa, enwere ike inye viewing key [viewing key] iji kpughee Azụmahia niile metụtara otu Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe. Njirimara a na-enye ohere irubere ụkpụrụ iwu isi na inyocha Azụmahia na-emebighị Nzuzo nke netwọk n'ozuzu ya. Ọ bụ ezie na algorithm Decoy nke Monero (ring signature) na-enyere aka inye Nzuzo, ọ naghị enye Mpughe ahọpụtara n'otu ụzọ ahụ. 2) Nlele Nhọrọ: Zcash na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ịhọrọ n'etiti Azụmahia Oha [transparent] (nke na-adịghị na nzuzo) na Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe (nke dị na nzuzo). Nke a pụtara na Zcash na-enye ndị ọrụ mgbanwe ịhọrọ idobe ozi ego ha na nzuzo (nke e chebere echebe) ma ọ bụ ime ka ọ bụrụ Oha ma onye ọ bụla hụ ya, dịka ọtụtụ blockchain ndị ọzọ, dịka akọwara na Zcash weebụsaịtị gọọmenti. Nzuzo a a na-ahọrọ itinye na-enye mgbanwe ka ukwuu na Ojiji [use case] metụtara azụmahịa/nzukọ, ebe ụfọdụ Azụmahia nwere ike ịchọ Nzuzo dị ntakịrị maka nyocha ọha, ebe ndị ọzọ na-erite uru na Nzuzo ka mma. 3) Ntọala Amaghị Aha: ntọala amaghị aha nke pool nke e chebere echebe nke zero knowledge nwere Azụmahia niile meworo mgbe ọ bụla. Nke a dị ukwuu karịa ọtụtụ usoro on-chain ndị ọzọ maka ime ka Azụmahia bụrụ Ihe na-apughi ijikọ ọnụ [unlinkable]. Rịba ama: nke a na-emetụta naanị Azụmahia dị n'ime otu pool nke e chebere echebe. Iji Decoy na-eme ka ntọala amaghị aha bawanye. Agbanye

title: Ịnyefe zcashd na Akash site na Console
description: Agwụla ojiji. Esokwala ntuziaka a iji nyefe node ị na-achọ iji.
text: Ịnyefe zcashd na Akash site na Console Agwụla ojiji. Esokwala ntuziaka a iji nyefe node ị na-achọ iji. zcashd rutere nkwụsị Nkwụsị-Nkwado ya na-akpaghị aka na Julaị 18, 2026. Node zcashd e nyefere taa agaghị emekọrịta na njedebe chain, ya mere nnyefe ahụ na-efu ego kwa ọnwa ma ghara ịmepụta ihe ọ bụla. Nyefee Zebra kama: Otu esi agba Zebra na Akash Network, nke na-ekpuchi otu usoro Akash Console ahụ ma chọọ ihe dị ka otu ụzọ n'ụzọ atọ nke diski. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ebufe nhazi dị adị, lee ntuziaka mbufe zcashd gaa Zebra na Zallet. A na-edobe ibe a dịka ndekọ akụkọ ihe mere eme nke nnyefe zcashd. Ntuziaka maka inyefe full node zcashd Zcash (mmejuputa Electric Coin Co) site na Akash Console. Lee nkuzi vidio dị n'okpuru. A pụkwara ịhụ ntuziaka zuru ezu karị n'okpuru. Ihe Ị Na-enye Full node zcashd nke ga-eme: -> Mekọrịta blockchain Zcash dum (350GB+ maka mainnet, 40GB maka testnet) -> Na-efu ihe dị ka $15/ọnwa dabere na ọnụahịa token AKT -> Were ọtụtụ awa ruo ụbọchị iji mekọrịta kpamkpam -> Jiri 4 vCPU, 16GB RAM, nchekwa 350GB (mainnet) ma ọ bụ 2 vCPU, 8GB RAM, 50GB (testnet) -> Budata paramenta kriptogafik na mbido mbụ ( 2GB, otu ugboro) zcashd megide Zebra: -> zcashd bụ mmejuputa node Zcash mbụ nke Electric Coin Co, nke kwụsịrị kemgbe Julaị 18, 2026 -> Zebra, sitere na Zcash Foundation, bụ full node a na-eji taa -> Naanị Zebra na-agbaso chain dị ugbu a; node zcashd enweghị ike iru njedebe -> E-akpa ego zcashd ejirila Zallet dochie -> Jiri zcashd ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ọrụ e-akpa ego ma ọ bụ API RPC pụrụ iche Dị Mkpa: Nhazi Ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri na Akash Mgbe ị kpughere ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri na Akash (dịka ọmụmaatụ, ọdụ 8233 maka P2P zcashd), ọ adịghị ejikọ na kpọmkwem ọdụ ahụ na IP ọha nke onye na-eweta ya. Kama, onye na-eweta ya na-ekenye ọdụ dị elu na-enweghị usoro (dịka 31234 ma ọ bụ 42567) ma jiri reverse-proxy jikọọ ya na ọdụ 8233 nke container gị. Nke a bụ atụmatụ e mere nke ọma - ndị na-eweta ya na-agba ọtụtụ nnyefe, ha ga-enwe esemokwu ma ọ bụrụ na onye ọ bụla anwaa iji ọdụ 8233 ozugbo. Ihe nke a pụtara nye gị: -> Ị na-ahazi ọdụ 8233 na SDL (ọdụ P2P ọkọlọtọ nke zcashd) -> Akash na-enye gị URI dịka provider.com:31234 -> Node Zcash ndị ọzọ na-ejikọ na gị na provider.com:31234 -> N'ime container gị, zcashd ka na-ege ntị na 8233 A na-elekọta nke a na-akpaghị aka. Jiri naanị URI Akash nyere gị. Ihe Ndị A Chọrọ Tupu Ebidoro -> Agbatị ihe nchọgharị Keplr Wallet arụnyere (Chrome/Brave/Firefox) -> Token AKT - Nweta 50-100 AKT n'aka exchange (Coinbase, Kraken, Osmosis) -> Nkeji 5 iji pịa na UI Console Nzọụkwụ 1: Jikọọ E-akpa Ego Gị -> Gaa na https://console.akash.network -> Pịa "Connect Wallet" n'akụkụ aka nri elu -> Họrọ Keplr (ma ọ bụ e-akpa ego Cosmos ị họọrọ) -> Kwenye njikọ ahụ mgbe Keplr pụtara Nguzozi AKT gị kwesịrị igosi n'akụkụ aka nri elu. Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ efu, buru ụzọ tinye ego n'ime e-akpa ego gị. Nzọụkwụ 2: Mepụta Nnyefe -> Pịa bọtịnụ "Deploy" (nnukwu bọtịnụ anụnụ, etiti ibe) -> Họrọ "Build your template" (ma ọ bụ gaa ozugbo ibugo SDL) Nhọrọ A: Bulite Faịlụ SDL (Akwadoro) Bọtịnụ a na-enye node kwụsịrị. Ọ na-akwụ ụgwọ site na nguzozi AKT gị maka node nke enweghị ike imekọrịta. Jiri ntuziaka Zebra kama. Nhọrọ B: Jiri SDL Editor Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ iji aka gị mado SDL: -> Detuo ọdịnaya zcashd-akash.yml -> Mado ya n'ime SDL editor -> Gbanwee dịka ọ dị mkpa (lee ngalaba nhazi dị n'okpuru) -> Pịa "Create Deployment" Nzọụkwụ 3: Lelee ma Kwenye Nkwụnye Ego Console ga-egosi gị: -> Nkwụnye ego nnyefe: 5 AKT (ị ga-enweta nke a azụ mgbe ị mechiri nnyefe ahụ) -> Ọnụ ego a tụrụ anya ya: Dabere na ọnụahịa SDL gị Pịa "Approve" ma bịanye aka na Azụmahia ahụ na Keplr. Nzọụkwụ 4: Họrọ Onye Na-eweta Mgbe 30 sekọnd gasịrị, ị ga-ahụ bids sitere n'aka ndị na-eweta. title: Soro Crosslink Feature Net
description: Anwalere ya na Feature Net ụdị 14 na Windows 11 (ụdị 10.0.26200.9550), site na 8 ruo 10 Ọktoba 2026. Akụrụngwa a bụ prototype ma na-agbanwe n'oge ntọhapụ ọ…
text: Soro Crosslink Feature Net Na nkenke Feature Net bụ netwọk nnwale ọha nke Shielded Labs maka Crosslink, oyi akwa ikpeazụ a tụrụ aro nke na-agbakwunye Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ n'akụkụ proof-of-work nke Zcash. Ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'ego nnwale, cTAZ. Ọ dịghị ihe ị na-eme na ya na-ebufe ma ọ bụ tinye ZEC nke mainnet n'ihe ize ndụ. Otu ngwa desktọọpụ bụ node, onye na-egwụputa, e-akpa ego, na finalizer. Ọ na-egwupụta cTAZ na ndabara ma nwee bọtịnụ faucet. Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ, iwepụ ego a kpọchiri, na ịwepụta ego na-arụ ọrụ naanị n'oge "Ụbọchị Mkpọchi Ego", otu ụbọchị n'ime ụbọchị atọ ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ịhapụ ya, ị ga-echere nke na-esote. Iji kpọchie ego, ị na-anyado njirimara finalizer ma pịa ọnụọgụ ego. Ntuziaka a ji finalizer nke ZecHub dị ka ọmụmaatụ. Oku RPC abụọ na-egosi ọnọdụ gị: walletstakingpositions na gettflrecencystatus. Anwalere ya na Feature Net ụdị 14 na Windows 11 (ụdị 10.0.26200.9550), site na 8 ruo 10 Ọktoba 2026. Akụrụngwa a bụ prototype ma na-agbanwe n'oge ntọhapụ ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ihe ị hụrụ dị iche na peeji a, tụkwasị obi n'ihe ị mere ma biko mepee PR. Ihe Feature Net bụ Crosslink bụ atụmatụ, ọ bụghị akụkụ nke Zcash taa. FAQ nke Shielded Labs Crosslink kwuru na ọ "ga-achọ ịgafe usoro Gọọmentị [governance] ọkọlọtọ nke Zcash" tupu o nwee ike iru mainnet. Peeji Protocol nke Crosslink kọwara nhazi ahụ. Iji nwalee nhazi ahụ na ndị ọrụ n'ezie, Shielded Labs na-agba ihe ọ kpọrọ incentivized feature nets: "usoro testnet ndị nwere mkpali". Ọrụ atọ dị na netwọk ahụ, ngwa desktọọpụ ahụ nwekwara ike ịrụ ha niile: Ọrụ Ihe ọ na-eme --- --- Onye na-egwụputa Na-emepụta block proof-of-work, dịka na Zcash taa Onye na-akpọchi ego Na-akpọchi cTAZ n'ime bond nnọchiteanya ma tinye ya n'aka finalizer Finalizer Na-atụ vootu iji mee block ikpeazụ. Ike vootu ya bụ ego a kpọchiri nke e nyefere ya Repository dị n'azụ ya malitere site n'ịdọ aka ná ntị kwesịrị ịgụ tupu ịwụnye ihe ọ bụla: ọ "dị iji gosi echiche, ọ bụghị iji gosi injinia mmepụta" ma bụrụ "koodu na-adịbeghị njikere maka mmepụta" (README). Gbaa ya n'igwe ebe nke ahụ nabatara. Ihe ụdị 14 gbanwere Version 14 pụtara na 1 Ọktoba 2026. Netwọk ya na-amalite dị ka proof-of-work nkịtị ma na-agbanye Crosslink n'ime usoro atọ (source, egosikwara na ctaz.cash): Block Ihe na-eme --- --- 20,736 Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ mepere 34,560 A na-ewere ndepụta mbụ nke finalizer site n'ego ndị a kpọchiri na chain 36,288 Ikpeazụ BFT amalite, tinyere ụgwọ ọrụ Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ Ụgwọ ọrụ Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ malitere na block ikpeazụ n'ime ndị ahụ. Bond e mere tupu ahụ anaghị enweta ihe ọ bụla ruo mgbe ahụ (source). Otu ntọhapụ ahụ belatara ndepụta na-arụ ọrụ gaa na finalizer 12 nwere ego a kpọchiri kacha ukwuu (source) ma, dịka okwu dị na ndetu ntọhapụ ya si kwuo, nye ha commission: "10% nke PoS Rewards niile n'ime block na-aga na commission ndị a, ebe 90% na-ekesa n'etiti bond Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ niile". cTAZ na ZEC n'ezie cTAZ ("Crosslink TAZ") bụ ego nnwale nke Feature Net. Ị na-akpọchi cTAZ, ọ bụghị ZEC. ZEC n'ezie na-abata naanị na ngwụcha. Shielded Labs edobela ZEC 500 maka feature nets, ndetu ntọhapụ nke [](https://github.com/ShieldedLabs/crosslinkmonolith/releases/tag/v14) kwukwara na a na-akwụ ya "dabere n'oke òkè, naanị n'ụdị ọnụọgụ cTAZ onye so na ya nwetara site n'ịgwụputa ma ọ bụ Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ". Nsonaazụ abụọ so na nke a: Ego faucet anaghị agụta. cTAZ e nyere gị, site na faucet ma ọ bụ n'aka onye ọ bụla ọzọ, anaghị enweta ihe ọ bụla site n'ịnọdụ n'e-akpa ego gị. Naanị ụgwọ ọrụ block sitere n'ịgwụputa na Mkpọchi ego dijitalụ ka a na-agụta. A na-arịọ ịkwụ ụgwọ, ọ bụghị akpaka. Shielded Labs na-ekwupụta agba ọ bụla na forum thread. Maka Round 2, ọ rịọrọ ndị sonyere ka ha ziga viewing key nke e-akpa ego ha na Adreesị akpa ego mainnet tupu 4 Ọktoba 2026 (post 94). Ekwupụtara netwọk ụdị 14 na-agba, nke ntuziaka a na-esonyere, dịka Round 3 (post 101). Tupu ịmalite Kọmpụta ị nwere ike ịhapụ ka ọ na-agba. text: Ịgbasa ozi na Free2Z Ndewo, kedu ka ọ dị? ZecHub na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'ezie ma a bịa n'ihe banyere wiki. Taa, obi dị anyị ụtọ ịkọrọ unu ụfọdụ mmelite gbasara ikpo okwu Free2Z. Ọ bụrụ na unu anụbeghị banyere ya, ntuziaka a ga-eme ka unu ghọta ikpo okwu ahụ na otu o si arụ ọrụ. Gịnị bụ Free2Z? Free2Z pụtara dịka ikpo okwu gbadoro ụkwụ na Nzuzo [privacy], nke e wuru iji nye ndị okike ike igosi ụwa ọdịnaya ha ma nweta onyinye site na Zcash, ego dijitalụ a ma ama maka atụmatụ Nzuzo ya pụrụ iche. Kedu ka m ga-esi sonye na Obodo? Nke mbụ, mepụta akaụntụ na weebụsaịtị gọọmentị ha https://free2z.cash. Chọta bọtịnụ nbanye n'akụkụ aka nri elu nke ibe ahụ. Tinye nkọwa nbanye gị. Ị nwekwara ike iji adreesị email gị ma ọ bụ akaụntụ X mepụta akaụntụ. Nnukwu ekele maka ịbụ akụkụ nke obodo ahụ\! Ugbu a, oge eruola ịhazi profaịlụ gị site n'ibugo avatar, banner, na nkọwa gbasara onye ị bụ na ihe ị na-eme. Jide n'aka na ị tinyekwara adreesị Zcash gị n'ọhịa e-akpa ego [wallet] maka onyinye na ndụmọdụ sitere n'aka ndị na-akwado gị. ATỤMATỤ ZPages: ZPages na-enye ndị okike ohere ịkọrọ obodo sara mbara ọrụ ha dere. Otu akụkụ na-adọrọ mmasị karịsịa nke ide ihe n'elu ikpo okwu a bụ na ndị na-ege gị ntị nwere ike iji onyinye kwado ọrụ gị, nke bụ ụzọ magburu onwe ya isi gosi ekele. Ịmata 2Zs Ndị a bụ isi ruru $0.01 n'elu ikpo okwu ahụ. Site na 2Zs, ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu nwere ike iji onyinye na ndenye aha kwado ndị okike kacha amasị ha. Ha nwekwara ike isonye n'ihe omume obodo dịka ịtụ vootu, ikwu okwu na ZPages, ịkwalite ọdịnaya, na atụmatụ mgbasa ozi dị ndụ. Site na onyinye, ndenye aha, na mgbasa ozi dị ndụ a na-akwụ ụgwọ maka ikiri, ị nwere ike irite 2Zs. Ị nwekwara ike zụta ụfọdụ isi site na ZEC naanị site n'ịnyocha QR code gị. Otu esi amalite Mgbasa Ozi Dị Ndụ Pịa akara profaịlụ gị, ndepụta ndapụ ga-apụta. Họrọ "Stream", ị ga-ahụkwa nhọrọ mgbasa ozi dị ndụ anọ. Naanị họrọ nke dabara mkpa gị wee pịa bọtịnụ ịmalite mgbasa ozi. Nye Free2Z ikike iji kamera na igwe okwu gị. Free2Z ga-arịọ gị ka ị tinye aha mkpirikpi ị ga-achọ iji n'oge mgbasa ozi dị ndụ. Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, pịa bọtịnụ Join iji malite mgbasa ozi dị ndụ. Ndị debanyere aha gị nwere ike sonye na mgbasa ozi ahụ. Ị nwekwara ike idetuo URL mgbasa ozi dị ndụ site na nchọgharị gị wee kesaa ya ndị enyi ka ha sonye. https://free2z.cash/Cjfrankie/broadcast Beta Nkeonwe Nhọrọ a na-ekwe nkwa inye Nzobe ederede [encryption] site n'otu nsọtụ ruo n'otu nsọtụ, nzukọ nkeonwe, na njikọ nzukọ pụrụ iche a pụrụ iziga ndị sonyere. Kedu ihe ọzọ ị nwere ike inweta site na mgbasa ozi dị ndụ? Mgbasa ozi dị ndụ nke Free2Z na-enye ụfọdụ uru pụrụ iche, dịka ntuli aka maka ime mkpebi na plugins dịka ikesa akwụkwọ na bọọdụ ọcha, ndị zuru oke maka ngosi, ịkekọrịta ihuenyo, mkparịta ụka, na ọtụtụ ihe ndị ọzọ! Nke a bụ otú nnọkọ mgbasa ozi dị ndụ si dị na Free2Z

title: Ledger Nke e chebere echebe [Shielded] ZEC Nduzi Onye Ọrụ
description: Jide, nata ma zipu ZEC nzuzo (nke e chebere echebe) [private (shielded)] site na hardware wallet Ledger gị na Ledger Wallet Desktop.
text: Ledger Nke e chebere echebe [Shielded] ZEC Nduzi Onye Ọrụ Jide, nata ma zipu ZEC nzuzo (nke e chebere echebe) [private (shielded)] site na hardware wallet Ledger gị na Ledger Wallet Desktop. Na nchịkọta Kemgbe 23 Septemba 2026, Ledger Wallet Desktop na-akwado ZEC nke e chebere echebe [shielded]. Otu akaụntụ Zcash nwere nguzozi Oha [transparent] na nguzozi nzuzo n'ime pool Ironwood. Maka Desktop naanị ugbu a. Ekwuputala nkwado Mobile dị ka …na-abịa n’oge adịghị anya…. Ị chọrọ Nano S Plus, Nano X, Stax ma ọ bụ Flex (ọ bụghị Nano S mbụ), Ledger Wallet Desktop 4.21+ na ngwa Zcash kachasị ọhụrụ. Pịa Kwado nke e chebere echebe otu ugboro: Ledger gị na-ebupụ viewing key ka ngwa desktop wee nwee ike ịchọta ego nzuzo gị. Igodo ego [spending keys] anaghị ahapụ ngwaọrụ ahụ. Nata ego na Adreesị akpa ego nzuzo (u1...) mgbe ị nwere ike. Ibufe ZEC site na nguzozi Oha gị gaa na nke nzuzo na-arụ ọrụ, mana ọ na-ejikọta ha abụọ. A na-enyocha ma bịanye aka na izipu ọ bụla na ihuenyo Ledger. Lelee Adreesị akpa ego ebe ahụ, mkpụrụedemede site na mkpụrụedemede. Nkọwa Isianyịahịa Zcash nwere ụdị nha ego abụọ. Oha [Transparent] ZEC (t1 Adreesị akpa ego) na-arụ ọrụ dịka Bitcoin: ego ole na Adreesị akpa ego bụ nke ọhaneze. Nke e chebere echebe [Shielded] ZEC dị na pool nke e chebere echebe, ebe a na-ezo onye zitere, onye natara na ego ole na on-chain. Ledger na-edobe Igodo ego gị na ngwaọrụ hardware. Iji gosi nguzozi nzuzo, Ledger Wallet Desktop chọrọ Unified Full Viewing Key (UFVK). Ngwaọrụ ahụ na-ebupụ ya otu ugboro, ngwa desktọọpụ ahụ ejiri ya nyochaa blockchain maka note gị nke e chebere echebe. viewing key nwere ike ịhụ akụkọ ihe mere eme gị nke e chebere echebe ma enweghị ike imefu ego, ya mere were ya dịka ozi nzuzo. Nzọụkwụ ndị dị n'okpuru na-ekpuchi itinye ngwa Zcash, ịgbakwunye akaụntụ, ime ka nguzozi nzuzo rụọ ọrụ, ịnata, ichebe ZEC Oha [transparent], na izipu site na nguzozi nzuzo. Nchịkọta N'ụbọchị 23 Septemba 2026, Ledger gbakwụnyere ZEC nke e chebere echebe n'onwe ya na Ledger Wallet Desktop. Otu akaụntụ Zcash na-ejide ugbu a nguzozi Oha na nguzozi nzuzo n'ime pool Ironwood nke Zcash. Igodo nzuzo gị na-anọgide na Ledger gị, a na-enyochakwa ma bịanye aka na Azụmahia [transaction] ọ bụla n'elu ngwaọrụ ahụ. Naanị Desktop. Ọkwa Ledger na-ekwu na ZEC nke e chebere echebe bụ "dị naanị na Ledger Wallet Desktop. Nkwado mkpanaka adịghị ugbu a, mana ọ na-abịa n'oge adịghị anya." Ngwa desktop ahụ na-egosikwa otu ọkwa ahụ. Enyochara ya n'ụbọchị 15 Ọktoba 2026. Nkwadebe Ngwaọrụ Ledger nke na-agba ngwa Zcash: Nano S Plus, Nano X, Stax ma ọ bụ Flex. Ewubereghị ngwa Zcash ugbu a maka Nano S mbụ. Ledger Wallet Desktop 4.21 ma ọ bụ nke ka ọhụrụ, ebudatara naanị site na ledger.com. Nduzi a jiri ụdị 4.24.0. Ngwa Zcash kachasị ọhụrụ dị na Ledger gị (3.9.4 mgbe edere nduzi a). Obere ego ZEC iji nwalee. Emere nzọụkwụ ọ bụla dị n'okpuru na mainnet na 0.001 ZEC. Azụmahia ọ bụla na-efu obere ugwo netwọk (0.00015 ZEC n'ule anyị). Nkebiokwu mgbake mkpụrụokwu 24 gị ga-anọgide n'akwụkwọ. Etinyela ya n'ime kọmputa ma ọ bụ kesaa ya. Nduzi Nzọụkwụ site na Nzọụkwụ (Ledger Wallet Desktop) 1. Wụnye ma ọ bụ melite ngwa Zcash Mepee Ledger Wallet, jikọọ ma kpọghee Ledger gị, ma mepee My Ledger. Kwe ka njikọ ahụ dị na ngwaọrụ. Chọọ Zcash n'ime katalọgụ ngwa, wee pịa Install, ma ọ bụ Update ma ọ bụrụ na arụnyelarị ya. Mepee ngwa Zcash na Ledger gị. Ihuenyo ahụ na-agụ "ngwa Zcash dị njikere". Pịgharịa gaa n'aka nri ruo App info iji lelee ụdị ahụ. 2. Tinye akaụntụ Zcash Na Ledger Wallet, họrọ Add account. Na Select asset, chọọ Zcash ma họrọ Zcash (ZEC), ọ bụghị token e kechiri ekechi dịka Binance-Peg Zcash Token. Mgbe ngwa Zcash meghere na Ledger gị, Ledger Wallet na-achọta akaụntụ gị. Kanye ya n'okpuru Select the accounts you want to add wee pịa Confirm. Ibe akaụntụ ahụ na-egosi Available balance, Transparent balance na Private balance, tinyere bọtịnụ Enable shielded. 3. Mee ka nguzozi nzuzo rụọ ọrụ Pịa Enable shielded. Windo Enable Zcash private balance nwere nzọụkwụ anọ: Birthd

title: Akwụkwọ Ọrụ [Workbook] mbụ m nke Zcash
description: My First Zcash bụ akwụkwọ ọrụ mmụta e kere iji nyere ndị mmụta ọhụrụ aka, karịsịa ndị ntorobịa na ndị mbido na crypto, ịghọta isi ihe dị na Zcash, Nzuzo…
text: Akwụkwọ Ọrụ [Workbook] mbụ m nke Zcash --- Mmalite My First Zcash bụ akwụkwọ ọrụ mmụta e kere iji nyere ndị mmụta ọhụrụ aka, karịsịa ndị ntorobịa na ndị mbido na crypto, ịghọta isi ihe dị na Zcash, Nzuzo [privacy] nke ego, ego dijitalụ, na usoro ndị dị n'azụ teknụzụ ahụ. Ọ bụ otu ndị nyere aka dị iche iche ma nwee ịnụ ọkụ n'obi sitere n'akụkụ ụwa niile nke obodo Zcash mepụtara ya, na-ejikọta mmepe sọftụwia, imewe, nchọpụta, mmụta, na nkwado Nzuzo. Ntuziaka a na-enye nkọwa gbasara usoro mmụta bụ isi nke akwụkwọ ọrụ a, nke e kewara n'ime ngalaba ukwu itoolu. Ọ bụghị ihe nnọchi maka akwụkwọ ahụ n'onwe ya, kama ọ bụ akụ enyemaka na-esonyere ya nke na-achịkọta usoro mmụta ma na-eme ka ozi dị mkpa pụta ìhè maka ndị nkuzi, ụmụ akwụkwọ, na ndị nkuzi obodo. A na-enye akwụkwọ ọrụ a n'efu ka ebudata ya dị ka PDF: Ndepụta GitHub Ebe nchekwa Repo --- Gịnị bụ Zcash? Ngalaba mbụ a na-ewebata ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ n'echiche nke ego dijitalụ na ihe mere Nzuzo ji dị mkpa n'obodo dijitalụ nke oge a. Ọ na-atụnyere usoro ego ọdịnala na blockchain Oha [transparent], na-eme ka o doo anya na ọtụtụ akwụkwọ ndekọ ọha na-ekpughe ọrụ ndị ọrụ. A kọwara Zcash dịka ego dijitalụ ọzọ na-echekwa Nzuzo nke na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ime mgbanwe n'enweghị nsogbu na-enweghị ikpughe ozi ego nke onwe ha. Akwụkwọ ọrụ ahụ na-ekwusi ike na Nzuzo abụghị maka izochi omume ọjọọ, kama ọ bụ ichebe mmadụ nkịtị pụọ n'ikpughe na-enweghị isi, nleba anya, na irigbu data. A na-eduga ndị mmụta n'ihe atụ dị mfe nke na-egosi otú e si kee Zcash iji nye ndị mmadụ ikike n'ezie n'ahụ ndụ ego ha, na otú Azụmahia ego nkịtị si ekpughe ozi nke onwe karịa ka anyị na-aghọta. --- Ònye wuru Zcash, gịnịkwa mere o ji dị? Ngalaba a na-akọwa mmalite nke Zcash site n'echiche nke nchọpụta sayensị na cryptography. Ọ na-ewebata proof zero-knowledge, kpọmkwem "zk-SNARKs", dịka teknụzụ ọhụụ mere ka Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe kwe omume. Akwụkwọ ọrụ ahụ na-emetụtakwa akụkọ mmalite nke Zcash, ụkpụrụ ntọala ya, na obodo ụwa niile nke na-elekọta ma na-akwado ecosystem ahụ taa. A kọwara ebumnuche ya dịka inye ndị mmadụ ike, inye ohere iguzogide mmachibido maka ego dijitalụ, na ịkwalite teknụzụ Nzuzo maka mmadụ niile. --- Otu Zcash si arụ ọrụ Akụkụ a na-akọwa ntọala teknụzụ nke protocol Zcash n'asụsụ dị mfe ịghọta. Echiche ndị bụ isi gụnyere: Adreesị akpa ego Oha na nke e chebere echebe Viewing key na ikpughe a na-achịkwa Ọrụ ndị onye na-egwụputa/ndị nkwado Otu proof zero-knowledge si akwado Azụmahia Otu e si echekwa Nzuzo ọbụna mgbe a na-ahụ na network ahụ ka bụ decentralized ma dị nchebe Eserese na ihe atụ anya n'ime akwụkwọ ọrụ ahụ na-enyere aka ime ka echiche ndị a dị mfe maka ndị mbido. --- Iji Zcash na ndụ kwa ụbọchị Ngalaba nke anọ na-elekwasị anya n'ihe atụ iji ya eme ihe n'ezie. Ọ na-egosi otú mmadụ pụrụ isi jiri e-akpa ego mkpanaka ziga ma nata Zcash, otú koodu QR si eme Kwụọ ụhwọ dị mfe, na otú ndị ọrụ si eji Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe maka nchedo onwe, nzuzo azụmahịa, ma ọ bụ mbufe gafere ókèala. Ihe atụ na-egosi ọnọdụ ụwa n'ezie, gụnyere inye ndị nka ego nta, izigara ndị ikwu nọ ná mba ọzọ ego, iji amaghị aha kwado NGO, ma ọ bụ iji Zcash dị ka ego dijitalụ nzuzo nke onye ntorobịa. --- Iwulite na Zcash Ngalaba a na-eme ka o doo anya otú ndị mmepụta, ndị na-emewe, ndị nchọpụta, na ndị nkuzi si enwe ike iwulite na Zcash. Ọ na-ewebata echiche dịka: e-akpa ego Zcash SDK ndị onye mmepụta Otu ọrụ obodo Ọrụ ndị nyere aka n'imepe open-source Otu network upgrade Zcash si eme ka protocol ahụ ka mma Ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ na-enweta nghọta banyere otú Zcash si agbanwe ka oge na-aga, na otú ndị nyere aka n'ụwa niile si enyere ịgbasa ngwá ọrụ, akụrụngwa, ngwa, na akụ mmụta. --- Nchekwa, nchekwa onwe, na omume kacha mma Ngalaba a na-akụzi omume nchekwa dijitalụ ndị bụ isi: Ichekwa igodo na Mkpuru mgbake Izere aghụghọ Ịghọta e-akpa ego Onye nlekota na ndị na-abụghị Onye nlekota Ịmụ ịdị ọcha siri ike n'iji okwuntughe Izere ikesa ozi e-akpa ego dị mkpa n'ihu ọha Ihe ọmụmụ ndị a na-enye ndị ọrụ ọhụrụ omume dị mkpa na-agafe

title: Nduzi Raspberry Pi 4 Maka Ịgba Zebra
description: Ịgba sọftụwia node [node] nke Zebra na Raspberry Pi 4 na-enye gị ohere isonye na netwọk Zcash dịka node nọọrọ onwe ya, nke dakọtara na consensus [consensus]…
text: Nduzi Raspberry Pi 4 Maka Ịgba Zebra Ịgba sọftụwia node [node] nke Zebra na Raspberry Pi 4 na-enye gị ohere isonye na netwọk Zcash dịka node nọọrọ onwe ya, nke dakọtara na consensus [consensus]. Nduzi a ga-akọwara gị usoro iji hazie ma gbaa Zebra na Raspberry Pi 4 gị. Ihe Achọrọ Tupu Ebidoro Raspberry Pi 4 (a na-atụ aro 2GB RAM ma ọ bụ karịa). Kaadị MicroSD (a na-atụ aro 16GB ma ọ bụ karịa) nke arụnyere Raspberry Pi OS (Raspbian). Njikọ ịntanetị kwụsiri ike. Kiibọdụ, òké, na ihuenyo (maka nhazi mbụ). Onye ahịa SSH (nhọrọ, maka ịnweta ya n'ebe dị anya). Ntinye Melite Sistemụ Gị Mepee terminal ma ọ bụ jiri SSH banye na Raspberry Pi gị, ma hụ na sistemụ gị dị ọhụrụ site n'ịgba: sudo apt update sudo apt upgrade Wụnye Ihe Ndabere Ị ga-achọ ịwụnye ụfọdụ ihe ndabere dị mkpa iji wuo ma gbaa Zebra: sudo apt install build-essential cmake git clang libssl-dev pkg-config Kpoo Ebe Nchekwa Zebra Mepee terminal ma kpoghee ebe nchekwa Zebra na Raspberry Pi gị: git clone https://github.com/ZcashFoundation/zebra.git cd zebra Wuo Zebra Iji wuo Zebra, jiri iwu ndị a: cargo build --release Usoro a nwere ike iwe oge. Gbaa mbọ hụ na Raspberry Pi gị jụrụ oyi nke ọma, n'ihi na ịchịkọta koodu nwere ike ịmepụta okpomọkụ. Nhazi Mepụta faịlụ nhazi maka Zebra. Ị nwere ike iji nhazi ndabara dị ka ebe mmalite: cp zcash.conf.example zcash.conf Dezie faịlụ zcash.conf iji hazie ntọala node gị. Ị nwere ike ịkọwapụta netwọk, mee ka ịgwụputa [mining] rụọ ọrụ, hazie njikọ ndị ọgbọ, na ihe ndị ọzọ. Bido Zebra Ị nwere ike ugbu a ibido Zebra site na nhazi ahaziri gị: ./target/release/zebrad -c zcash.conf git comment Iwu a ga-ebido node Zebra, ọ ga-amalite ịmekọrịta na blockchain [blockchain] Zcash. Nlekota Ị nwere ike ileba anya n'ọganihu na ọnọdụ node Zebra gị site n'imepe ihe nchọgharị weebụ gaa na http://127.0.0.1:8233/status. Ịchọpụta Nsogbu Ọ bụrụ na ị zutere nsogbu ọ bụla mgbe ị na-ewu ma ọ bụ na-agba Zebra, lelee akwụkwọ Zebra maka ndụmọdụ ịchọpụta nsogbu na ozi ndị ọzọ. Hụ na Raspberry Pi gị na-adị jụụ, n'ihi na ịgba node nwere ike ịmepụta okpomọkụ. Ị nwere ike ịchọ iji ihe ngwọta ime ka ọ jụọ oyi, dịka fan ma ọ bụ heat sink. Mmechi Site n'ịgbaso nduzi a, ị gaara ahazie ma gbaa Zebra nke ọma na Raspberry Pi 4 gị. Ugbu a ị na-atụnye aka na netwọk Zcash dịka node nọọrọ onwe ya, na-enyere aka ichekwa Nzuzo [privacy] nke Azụmahia [transaction] Zcash.

title: ShapeShift na Zcash: Ahịa Decentralized nke Nzuzo Buru Ụzọ
description: Nzuzo [Privacy] na idobe ego n'onwe [self-custody] bụ ụkpụrụ ntọala nke cryptocurrency, ma ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ ka na-adabere na exchange etiti nke chọrọ nkwenye…
text: ShapeShift na Zcash: Ahịa Decentralized nke Nzuzo Buru Ụzọ --- Mmalite Nzuzo [Privacy] na idobe ego n'onwe [self-custody] bụ ụkpụrụ ntọala nke cryptocurrency, ma ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ ka na-adabere na exchange etiti nke chọrọ nkwenye njirimara ma jide ego ndị ọrụ. Njikọta dị n'etiti ShapeShift na Zcash na-ejikọta ikpo okwu exchange decentralized zuru oke na otu n'ime cryptocurrency kacha dị elu nke na-echekwa Nzuzo, na-enye ndị ọrụ ụzọ iji zụọ ahịa ZEC na-enweghị ịchụ Nzuzo ma ọ bụ ikike ijikwa akụ ha n'àjà. Edemede a na-akọwa ihe ShapeShift bụ, otú Zcash si arụ ọrụ, otú ị ga-esi gbawee ZEC na ShapeShift, na ihe mere mmekọrịta a ji dị mkpa maka ọdịnihu nke ego decentralized nke onwe. --- Gịnị bụ ShapeShift? ShapeShift bụ ikpo okwu cryptocurrency decentralized, nke mepere emepe, nke na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ịzụ ahịa, soro, ma jikwaa akụ dijitalụ n'ofe ọtụtụ blockchain na-enweghị ịmepụta akaụntụ, inye akwụkwọ njirimara, ma ọ bụ inyefe onye ọzọ nlekọta ego ha. Akụkọ Dị Mkpirikpi ShapeShift bụ Erik Voorhees hibere na mbụ na 2014 dị ka exchange cryptocurrency etiti dị na Switzerland. Ikpo okwu a ghọrọ onye a ma ama ngwa ngwa n'ihi interface ya dị mfe nke nyere ndị ọrụ ohere ịgbawe otu cryptocurrency maka nke ọzọ na-enweghị ịmepụta akaụntụ. Na 2021, ShapeShift gbanwere n'ụzọ dị ukwuu. Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kagburu nhazi ụlọ ọrụ ya wee ghọọ Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO), nke ndị ji FOX token na-achị. Dị ka akụkụ nke mgbanwe a, e kesara ihe dị ka token FOX nde 340 nye ihe karịrị nde mmadụ otu, nke mere ka ọ bụrụ otu n'ime airdrop kasị ukwuu n'akụkọ ihe mere eme crypto. Kemgbe oge ahụ, mkpebi niile dị mkpa gbasara ikpo okwu a na-esite na atụmatụ Gọọmentị [governance] obodo na ntuli aka. Njirimara Ndị Dị Mkpa Na-enweghị Onye nlekota [Non-Custodial]: Ndị ọrụ na-azụ ahịa ozugbo site na e-akpa ego [wallet] nke ha. ShapeShift anaghị ejide ego gị. KYC Adịghị Achọrọ: Enweghị nkwenye njirimara, enweghị imepụta akaụntụ, na enweghị nchịkọta data onwe. Nkwado Multichain: Ịnweta ihe karịrị akụ 10,000 n'ofe blockchain 15+, gụnyere Bitcoin, Ethereum, Cosmos, na Zcash. Nchịkọta DEX: ShapeShift na-eziga azụmahịa site na protocol decentralized dị ka THORChain, 0x, na ndị ọzọ iji chọta ọnụego kacha mma. Mgbawe [swap] Cross-Chain: Gbanwee akụ n'etiti blockchain dị iche iche n'ụzọ ọdịnala na-enweghị iji token a kechiri ekechi ma ọ bụ bridge etiti. Mepere Emepe Zuru Oke: Ikpo okwu dum, gụnyere ngwa mkpanaka, bụ nke mepere emepe ma enweghị backend nke onye nwe ya karịa data blockchain. --- Otu Zcash Si Arụ Ọrụ Zcash (ZEC) bụ cryptocurrency e wuru n'elu ntọala cryptographic siri ike nke na-enye ndị ọrụ ikike ime Azụmahia [transaction] na nzuzo. E wepụtara ya na 2016, Zcash bụ fork nke Bitcoin nke na-agbakwunye teknụzụ Nzuzo dị elu, ma na-edobe ọnụọgụ mkpụrụ ego Bitcoin a kapịrị ọnụ nke nde 21 na consensus proof-of-work. Azụmahia Nke E Chebere Echebe na Proof Zero-Knowledge Nrụpụta bụ isi nke Zcash bụ iji zero-knowledge proofs (karịsịa, ụdị a kpọrọ zk-SNARKs). Proof cryptographic ndị a na-enye otu onye ohere igosi onye ọzọ na nkwupụta bụ eziokwu na-enweghị ikpughe ozi ọ bụla karịa na nkwupụta ahụ n'onwe ya dị irè. N'ọrụ, nke a pụtara na Azụmahia Zcash nwere ike ịbụ nke e chebere echebe: Adreesị akpa ego nke onye zitere, Adreesị akpa ego nke onye nnata, na ego Azụmahia bụcha nke Nzobe ederede [encryption] na blockchain. Netwọk ahụ ka nwere ike ikwenye na Azụmahia ahụ dị irè (enweghị imefu ugboro abụọ, nguzozi ziri ezi) na-ahụghị nkọwa ndị ahụ mgbe ọ bụla. Ụdị Azụmahia Zcash na-akwado ụdị Adreesị akpa ego abụọ: Adreesị Oha [Transparent addresses] (t-addresses): Ndị a na-arụ ọrụ dị ka Adreesị Bitcoin, ebe nkọwa Azụmahia na-ahụ n'ihu ọha na blockchain. Adreesị nke e chebere echebe [Shielded addresses] (z-addresses): Ndị a na-eji zero-knowledge proofs mee ka nkọwa Azụmahia bụrụ nke onwe. Ndị ọrụ nwere ike izipu ZEC n'etiti Adreesị Oha na Adreesị nke e chebere echebe. Maka Nzuzo kachasị, Azụmahia site na otu Adreesị nke e chebere echebe gaa na nke ọzọ anaghị ekpughe ozi ọ

title: Ịkwado [Verifying] Mwepụta Zcash
description: E kwadoro megide Zebra v6.3.0 na Zallet v0.1.0-beta.2 na 2026-08-18.
text: Ịkwado [Verifying] Mwepụta Zcash Na nkenke Ịbudata ọnụọgụ abụọ [binary] Zcash abụghị otu ihe dịka inweta nke ọrụ ahụ bipụtara. Nkwado bụ otú ị ga-esi amata ihe dị iche. Checksum na-egosi na faịlụ bịarutere n'enweghị mmebi. signature na-egosi onye mepụtara ya. Ị chọrọ ha abụọ, checksum naanị ya na-egosikwa ntakịrị ihe. Zebra na-ebipụta faịlụ SHA256SUMS tinyere ngwugwu Sigstore nke jikọtara mwepụta ahụ na workflow GitHub Actions, tag na commit kpọmkwem — enweghị mkpa ijikwa igodo. Zallet na-ebipụta GPG signature ndị e kewapụrụ (.asc) n'akụkụ SLSA provenance na SBOM. Igodo mbinye-aka Zcash gbanwere na 2026 site na Electric Coin Company gaa na Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL). Ọ bụrụ na ị kwadoro mwepụta ochie, ị chọrọ igodo ọhụrụ ahụ — nkwupụta nnyefe ahụ ka igodo abụọ ahụ bịanyekwara aka, ya mere ị nwere ike ịkwado ntụgharị ahụ n'onwe ya. gpg na-akọpụta subkey bịanyere faịlụ aka, ọ bụghị igodo isi a kpọrọ aha n'ịkpọsa. Fingerprint nke yiri ihe na-ezighi ezi na-abụkarị subkey, ọ bụghị mwakpo. Ọ bụrụ na nkwado adaada, agbagbula ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ. E kwadoro megide Zebra v6.3.0 na Zallet v0.1.0-beta.2 na 2026-08-18. Gịnị mere nke a ji dị mkpa karịa maka Zcash Ọnụọgụ abụọ e-akpa ego nke emebiri emebi nwere ike izipu Igodo ego ma ọ bụ viewing key gị pụọ. N'adịghị ka paswọọdụ e mebiri, mfu ahụ na-adịgide: enweghị rollback, enweghị chargeback, ọ nweghịkwa desk nkwado. Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na-echebe ihe na-eme on-chain — ha anaghị enye nchebe ọbụla mgbe e dochiri software ị na-agba tupu ọ rute gị. Nke a bụ otu n'ime ụzọ mwakpo ole na ole ebe nkwa Nzuzo nke protocol na-adịghị emetụta nnọọ. Nkwado bụ oyi akwa na-ekpuchi ya. Ụdị egwu — ihe nkwado na-achọpụta na ihe ọ na-adịghị achọpụta Na-achọpụta: Mirror e mebiri emebi ma ọ bụ faịlụ agbanwere e si ebe ọzọ na-abụghị peeji mwepụta ọrụ ahụ nye. Mgbanwe man-in-the-middle n'oge nbudata. CDN e mebiri ma ọ bụ host nkesa a hijackara. Mmebi mberede n'oge mbufe. Anaghị achọpụta: Onye na-elekọta ọrụ nke bịanyere koodu ọjọọ aka. signature ahụ ga-akwado nke ọma; ọ na-egosi ebe o siri bịa, ọ bụghị ebumnuche. Host owuwu e mebiri nke na-emepụta artifact nwere signature ma dịkwa njọ. Nke a bụ ihe reproducible builds na provenance attestation dị iji belata. Igodo i nwetara n'otu ebe e mebiri emebi e si nwetakwa ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na onye mwakpo na-achịkwa faịlụ ahụ na igodo ị jiri elele ya, nkwado anaghị agwa gị ihe ọ bụla. Isi okwu ikpeazụ ahụ bụ nke ọtụtụ nduzi na-awụli elu. Ebe ị nwetara igodo ahụ dịkwa mkpa dịka ịgba iwu ahụ. --- Akụkụ 1 — Zebra: checksum na Sigstore Zebra na-ebipụta assets ndị a maka mwepụta ọ bụla: Asset Ebumnuche --- --- zebrad- - .tar.gz archive ọnụọgụ abụọ zebrad- - .tar.gz.sha256 checksum kwa-faịlụ SHA256SUMS checksum maka architectures niile SHA256SUMS.sigstore.json ngwugwu Sigstore na-abịanye SHA256SUMS aka Nzọụkwụ 1 — Budata Nzọụkwụ 2 — Lelee checksum Mwepụta n'ezie: A chọrọ --ignore-missing ebe a n'ihi na SHA256SUMS na-ekpuchi architecture ọ bụla ma ị budatara naanị otu. Enweghị ya, sha256sum na-akọpụta archive aarch64 na-adịghị dịka ọdịda, ị nwekwara ike ịghọta nnabata dịka ọdịda. Ụdị kwa-faịlụ na-arụkwa ọrụ: Nzọụkwụ a naanị ya ezughị. Ị budatara checksum ahụ n'otu ebe ahụ ọnụọgụ abụọ ahụ si. Onye ọ bụla nwere ike dochie otu nwere ike dochie nke ọzọ. Checksum na-egosi izi ezi; nzọụkwụ sochirinụ na-egosi ebe o siri bịa. Nzọụkwụ 2b — Otu nlele ahụ na Windows PowerShell enweghị ọnọdụ verify nke -c, ya mere ị ga-atụnyere aka: Mwepụta n'ezie: Tụnyere nke ahụ na nsonaazụ Linux dị n'ihu na peeji a: Ụkpụrụ ndị ahụ yitere kpamkpam. Hex enweghị mkpụrụedemede ukwu ma ọ bụ nta, nke a bụkwa mkpu ụgha a na-ahụkarị na Windows. Ọnyà abụọ ọzọ kpọmkwem maka Windows: Enweghị exit code ị ga-enyocha. Na Linux, sha256sum -c na-eweghachi 1 mgbe ọ dara, script nwekwara ike ime ihe dabere na ya. Get-FileHash na-ebipụta naanị hash — ntụnyere bụ nke gị ime, nke gị kwa imehie site n'ile anya ngwa ngwa. title: Mbupụ Akụkọ Azụmahia site na Viewing Key
description: Ọtụtụ mbupụ e-akpa ego [wallet] dị ntakịrị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, mbupụ ụtụ isi nke ZODL na-enye gị ụbọchị, ego ole, na ugwo [fees] maka afọ kalenda gara aga, ma ọ…
text: Mbupụ Akụkọ Azụmahia site na Viewing Key Ọtụtụ mbupụ e-akpa ego [wallet] dị ntakịrị. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, mbupụ ụtụ isi nke ZODL na-enye gị ụbọchị, ego ole, na ugwo [fees] maka afọ kalenda gara aga, ma ọ naghị enye ID Azụmahia [transaction], memo, ma ọ bụ Adreesị akpa ego [addresses]. Nke ahụ ezughị maka idebe akwụkwọ ego, ịlele mbugharị e-akpa ego, ma ọ bụ ịchọpụta ihe mere n'otu Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment]. Ị chọghị Mkpuru mgbake [seed phrase] gị iji hụ nkọwa zuru ezu. Unified full viewing key (UFVK, na-amalite na uview1) nwere ike ịhụ Azụmahia ọ bụla na-abata na nke na-apụ n'ime akaụntụ, ngwá ọrụ [tools] abụọ nwekwara ike ime ka nke a bụrụ faịlụ ị na-edobe: sava GraphQL nke Zkool na zingo-cli. Ntuziaka a na-achịkọta ụzọ ndị dị na mkparịta ụka forum a ma na-emelite ha maka nsụgharị dị ugbu a. A nwalere ya na Septemba 2026 na Zkool 6.30.0 na zingo-cli sitere na zingolib 6.0.0. Tupu ịmalite Ị chọrọ ihe abụọ: UFVK maka akaụntụ ahụ. Viewing Keys na-akọwa ihe ọ na-ekpughe na otu esi ebupụ otu. Ogologo ọmụmụ, ya bụ block [block] a ga-amalite nyocha site na ya. Jiri ogo dị tupu Azụmahia mbụ gị. Ọ bụrụ na ịtọọ ya elu nke ukwuu, akụkọ ochie ga-efu nwayọ nwayọ. Ọ bụrụ na ịtọọ ya ala nke ukwuu, nyocha ahụ ga-ewe ogologo oge karịa. Mmegharị Sapling (419200) na-adị mma mgbe niile ma o nwere ike iwe awa iji nyochaa. Debe ya na nzuzo Viewing key enweghị ike imefu ego, mana ọ na-egosi onye ọ bụla jidere ya akụkọ gị dum. Etinyela ya na weebụsaịtị ma ọ bụ block explorer. Bubata ya n'ime sọftụwia ị na-agba n'onwe gị. Sava ị na-emekọrịta na ya na-ahụ adreesị IP gị na Azụmahia ndị ị na-ebudata nke ọma. Ngwá ọrụ abụọ dị n'okpuru na-enweta Azụmahia gị nke ọ bụla site na ID iji gụọ memo na ugwo, na ZIP 307 na-ekwu na nke a na-agwa sava ahụ Azụmahia ndị bụ nke gị. Iji node nke Zebra gị na Zaino ma ọ bụ lightwalletd emekọrịta na-ezere nke ahụ. Zingolib na Zaino Nkuzi na-akọwa usoro nhazi. zingo-cli 6 na-ezipụ Kwụọ ụhwọ site na Nym mixnet, mana mmekọrịta ya ka na-ejikọ na sava ozugbo, ya mere isi okwu dị n'elu metụtara ya kwa. Nye ngwá ọrụ ndị a viewing key, ọ bụghị seed. Sava GraphQL nke Zkool enweghị nbanye na ndabara, API ya ga-eweghachikwa seed nke akaụntụ ọ bụla e sitere na otu kee, ma nwee ike izipu ego. Debe sava ahụ n'igwe nke gị. Iwu Docker dị n'okpuru na-ege ntị naanị na 127.0.0.1. Ngwá ọrụ abụọ ahụ na-echekwa key na akụkọ gị na-enweghị Nzobe ederede [encryption]. Hichapụ data ọrụ ahụ mgbe ị mechara ma debe mbupụ ahụ n'ebe e zoro ezo. Nhọrọ 1: GraphQL nke Zkool zkoolgraphql bụ engine e-akpa ego nke Zkool dịka sava nọọrọ onwe ya. Ọ bụ mmemme dị iche na ngwa Zkool. Ụzọ kachasị mfe isi gbaa ya bụ image Docker gọọmenti (amd64 na arm64). E nwekwara binary x86-64 nke Linux na ibe mwepụta Zkool; ọ chọrọ glibc 2.38 ma ọ bụ nke ọhụrụ, yabụ Ubuntu 24.04 na-arụ ọrụ ebe Debian 12 anaghị arụ ọrụ. Malite sava ahụ Ọ na-emekọrịta site na https://zec.rocks ma ọ gwụla ma ị tinye --lwd-url na sava nke gị. Na mbido mbụ, ọ na-ebudata parampat Sapling (ihe dị ka 50 MB). Ọ bụrụ na nke ahụ ada, docker start zkool-export na-agbalị ọzọ. Mepee http://127.0.0.1:8000/graphiql na ihe nchọgharị. Ị nwere ike itinye usoro nke ọ bụla na-esote ebe ahụ ma gbaa ya. Bubata key Ọ na-eweghachite ID akaụntụ ọhụrụ ahụ, nke bụ 1 n'ọrụ sava ọhụrụ. Tọọ birth mgbe niile. Enweghị ya, Zkool na-amalite site na block dị ugbu a ma ọ dịghị achọta ihe ọ bụla. useInternal: true na-eme ka Zkool lelee Adreesị akpa ego mgbanwe Oha [transparent] kwa. Debe ya maka key sitere na ZODL, otu ntọala ahụ Iweghachite Ego ji maka seed ZODL. Mekọrịta Nke a na-agba ruo mgbe mmekọrịta gwụsịrị. Etinyela fast: true. Ọ na-awụpụ ibudata Azụmahia zuru ezu, nke bụ ebe memo, ugwo na outputs si abịa. Nọmba ọ na-eweghachite bụ ogo ọ na-achọ iru, ọ bụghị proof [proof] na ọ ruru ebe ahụ. Njehie netwọk nwere ike ịkwụsị mmekọrịta ahụ n'oge na-enweghị ịkọ ihe ọ bụla, ya mere lelee: Ọ bụrụ na height akaụntụ ahụ dị n'azụ currentHeight, gbaa mmekọrịta ahụ ọzọ. Ọ ga-aga n'ihu site n'ebe ọ kwụsịrị. Mbupụ Chekwaa nke a dịka history.graphql: Ha

title: Ntuziaka Bara Uru: Zcash Node RPC na Ndepụta Blockchain
description: Ibe a bụ akwụkwọ ntuziaka maka ịgwa Zcash full node na-arụ ọrụ okwu site na JSON-RPC na maka ijikọ indexer nke e-akpa ego dị mfe na ndị nchọgharị nwere ike ịjụ…
text: Ntuziaka Bara Uru: Zcash Node RPC na Ndepụta Blockchain Ibe a bụ akwụkwọ ntuziaka maka ịgwa Zcash full node na-arụ ọrụ okwu site na JSON-RPC na maka ijikọ indexer nke e-akpa ego dị mfe na ndị nchọgharị nwere ike ịjụ ajụjụ n'aka ya. Ọ bụghị ntuziaka nrụnye nke abụọ. Maka otu esi amalite stack mgbe-zcashd (Zebra + Zallet, Zaino nhọrọ, ports, volumes, mbido nke usoro abụọ), jiri ibe Stack Z3 na ebe nchekwa Z3. Maka ndabere gbasara consensus node, lee Full Nodes na Zebra Full Node. zcashd ruru njedebe ndụ ya n'ụbọchị 18 Julaị 2026. Ọrụ onye na-arụ ọrụ ọhụrụ kwesịrị ilekwasị anya na Zebra (ma ọ bụ Zakura) yana e-akpa ego/indexer, ọ bụghị zcashd. --- Na nkenke JSON-RPC bụ ụzọ ndị na-arụ ọrụ na e-akpa ego si ajụ node gbasara chain tip, peers, na (n'ime usoro e-akpa ego) ego fọdụrụ. Na Z3, Zebra na-enye node RPC; Zallet na-enye wallet RPC. Regtest bụ ebe kwesịrị ekwesị iji mụta calls ndị a. Rpc-router Z3 dị na http://127.0.0.1:8181 na-anabata zebra / zebra ma na-ebufe ụzọ node gaa Zebra na ụzọ wallet gaa Zallet. Mainnet na testnet na-eji cookie auth na Zebra. Edegharịla aha njirimara/password regtest n'elu node ọha. Ndepụta [Indexing] bụ ọrụ dị iche na nkwado iwu [validation]. Zebra na-akwado iwu. Zaino (Z3 --profile indexer) na-enye gRPC kwekọrọ na lightwalletd. Ztreamer bụ indexer dabere na Zakura; ọ bụghị ihe Z3 na-ebunye. JSON-RPC Zaino na indexer gRPC nhọrọ nke Zebra bụ maka loopback ma ọ bụ netwọk a tụkwasịrị obi. Ewepụla ha n'enweghị nkwenye na ịntanetị ọha. --- Usoro nke ọ bụla na-aza call nke ọ bụla Ihe ị chọrọ Gwa Port onye nnabata Z3 mainnet Ihe edeturu --- --- --- --- Chain tip, peers, getblockchaininfo Zebra JSON-RPC 8232 Cookie auth Ego fọdụrụ n'e-akpa ego, adreesị, izipu Zallet RPC 28232 Usoro dị iche; sọftụwia beta Compact blocks maka e-akpa ego dị mfe Zaino gRPC 8137 Naanị ya na --profile indexer; plaintext h2c Explorer / faucet JSON-RPC proxy Zaino JSON-RPC 8237 Naanị netwọk a tụkwasịrị obi Mee ihe niile dị n'elu n'enweghị sync Z3 regtest rpc-router 8181 Aha njirimara zebra / password zebra Mgbakọ port na aha ọrụ Compose: Stack Z3 na z3-contract.yaml. --- Buru ụzọ mụọ na regtest Site na checkout Z3, mgbe ./scripts/regtest-init.sh na docker compose --env-file .env.regtest up -d gachara: Nsonaazụ getblockchaininfo dị mma gụnyere "blocks" na map "upgrades". Ọ bụrụ na curl kwụgidere, router amalitebeghị; ọ bụrụ na ị nweta 401, ị na-akpọ Zebra ozugbo kama router (Zebra kpọmkwem na regtest bụ 29232 ma ka na-atụ anya nzere router ma ọ bụrụ na ị gbanweghị ha). Usoro regtest zuru ezu, gụnyere ịgwụputa blocks mmalite: Z3 docs/regtest.md. --- Mainnet / testnet JSON-RPC (cookie auth) Na mainnet na testnet, Zallet na ọrụ Zaino nhọrọ na-agụ shared cookie volume. A na-emepụta cookie ahụ ọzọ mgbe a malitere usoro; ọ bụghị ebe nchekwa ndabere. Ewepụla Zebra JSON-RPC na ịntanetị ọha. Kpọọ ya site na netwọk Compose (zebra:8232) ma ọ bụ site n'aka onye nnabata naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị kegidere ya na loopback. Nlele ndị onye na-arụ ọrụ na-emekarị mgbe Zebra bụ /ready: getblocktemplate / getmininginfo bụ mining RPCs. Pools ka na-atụ anya otu usoro zcashd chọrọ Zebra (ma ọ bụ Zakura) maka templates yana e-akpa ego ọ bụla ha ji maka coinbase. Lee Zcash Mining Pools na ntụziaka mbugharị. --- Jikọọ indexer Nkwado iwu na ndepụta bụ ọrụ dị iche. Zaino (ihe Z3 na-ebunye) Zaino na-agụ Zebra ma na-enye API gRPC kwekọrọ na lightwalletd yana JSON-RPC proxy. Zallet achọghị container Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya; ọ na-etinye libraries Zaino n'ime ya ma na-agwa Zebra okwu site na JSON-RPC. Malite Zaino kwụụrụ onwe ya mgbe ịchọrọ e-akpa ego dị mfe nke mpụga, explorers, ma ọ bụ faucets: Chere ruo mgbe Zebra mechara sync tupu i duzie clients gaa Zaino. Indexer nnukwu nke na-agbalị iru ọnọdụ ugbu a ma nwee fetch concurrency dị elu nwere ike ime ka verifier nke Zebra jiri nwayọọ; debe fetchconcurrency n'ime obere ọnụọgụ otu-digit ruo mgbe indexer ruru ọnọdụ ugbu a. Regtest gRPC (plaintext; port 28137): gRPC Zaino bụ plaintext h2c na netwọk niile. Kwụsị TLS na reverse p

title: Nara onyinye ZEC nke nzuzo dịka ụlọ ọrụ anaghị akwụ ụtụ isi nke US
description: Ibe a bụ ozi izugbe, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ iwu ma ọ bụ ụtụ isi. Iwu ụtụ isi US na-agbanwe, ya mere jiri onye na-ahụ maka akaụntụ gị ma ọ bụ onye ndụmọdụ ụtụ isi…
text: Nara onyinye ZEC nke nzuzo dịka ụlọ ọrụ anaghị akwụ ụtụ isi nke US Ọkwa etiti - nkeji 10 Ibe a bụ ozi izugbe, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ iwu ma ọ bụ ụtụ isi. Iwu ụtụ isi US na-agbanwe, ya mere jiri onye na-ahụ maka akaụntụ gị ma ọ bụ onye ndụmọdụ ụtụ isi nyochaa usoro ọ bụla. Iwu ọ bụla dị n'okpuru a jikọtara na isi mmalite IRS ya, nke enyochara n’Ọktoba 2026 megide Publication 526 (maka nkwụghachi ụtụ isi 2025) na Form 8283 (ntụgharị Disemba 2025). Edere FAQ ego mebere IRS maka Azụmahia tupu 2025, ya mere nyochaa ya megide nduzi dị ugbu a. Na nkenke Debe onyinye n’e-akpa ego [wallet] nke e chebere echebe nke nzukọ gị na-achịkwa, ọ bụghị e-akpa ego nkeonwe nke onye ọrụ IRS na-ewere ZEC dịka akụ, ya mere onyinye ZEC bụ onyinye na-abụghị ego nkịtị Maka onyinye $250 ma ọ bụ karịa, ziga onye nyere onyinye nkwenye edere ede nke kọwara ZEC mana etinyeghị uru dollar na ya Maka onyinye karịrị $5,000, onye nyere onyinye chọrọ nyocha ọnụ ahịa ruru eru, ị ga-abịanyekwa aka na Form 8283 ha Ọ bụrụ na ị ree ZEC n’ime afọ atọ ị natara ya ma ị bịanyere aka na Nkebi B nke Form 8283 onye nyere onyinye, nyefee Form 8282 Onye nyere onyinye nke na-amaghị aha ya n’ebe ị nọ n’ozuzu enweghị ike ịrịọ mwepụ ụtụ isi nke $250 ma ọ bụ karịa Ònye ka nke a bụ maka ya? Ndị ọrụ ebere US 501(c)(3), ụka, na otu obodo chọrọ ịnakwere ZEC Ndị njikwa Ebe nchekwa ego, ndị na-edebe akwụkwọ ego, na ndị otu bọọdụ na-ahazi inye crypto Ndị nyere onyinye chọrọ ịma ihe nzukọ anaghị akwụ uru chọrọ n'aka ha Maka ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu na ndị okike, lee Nata Onyinye na Nzuzo. Nsogbu ahụ Ọtụtụ ọrụ onyinye crypto maka ndị ọrụ ebere US na-enye gị Adreesị akpa ego Oha, ma ọ bụ gbanwee onyinye ahụ maka gị site n'otu. N’Adreesị akpa ego Oha, onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịhụ onyinye ọ bụla, ego ya, na nguzozi gị. Onye nyere onyinye n’ezube inye ya na nzuzo na-atụfu Nzuzo ahụ ozugbo onyinye ahụ rutere. Nzukọ anaghị akwụ uru nwekwara akwụkwọ ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu enweghị: nnata onye nyere onyinye, fọm IRS maka onyinye buru ibu, na nkwụghachi kwa afọ. Nzuzo na akwụkwọ ndị ahụ nwere ike ịrụkọ ọrụ, ma ọ bụrụ na ị hazie ha tupu onyinye mbụ abịa. Adreesị na-agbanwe, ya mere ibe a na-ejikọ na ibe onyinye kama idetuo adreesị. Na-edetu Adreesị akpa ego site na saịtị nke otu ahụ n'onwe ya mgbe niile. Ihe ndị e kwuru banyere ụtụ isi bụ ihe otu ọ bụla kwuru gbasara onwe ya, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ gbasara ụtụ isi. TL;DR Òtù anaghị akwụ uru itoolu na-ebipụta Adreesị akpa ego ZEC. Ise n'ime ha na-eji Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe [shielded], ya mere onyinye gị na-anọgide na Nzuzo [privacy] on-chain Òtù anaghị akwụ uru anọ a maara nke ọma na-anabata ZEC naanị na Adreesị akpa ego Oha [transparent]: EFF, Freedom of the Press Foundation, Tor Project na Internet Archive Ikpo okwu onyinye dịka The Giving Block na Every.org na-anabata ZEC maka ọtụtụ puku òtù ebere, ma ọ dịghị nke ọ bụla n'ime ha kwuru na ọ na-akwado ZEC nke e chebere echebe Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ nnata ụtụ isi, lelee nkọwa otu ọ bụla dị n'okpuru tupu ị nye onyinye Ònye ka nke a bụ maka ya? Ndị ji ZEC chọrọ inye onyinye maka ihe ha ji kpọrọ ihe Ndị na-enye onyinye chọrọ ka onyinye ha nọrọ na Nzuzo Onye ọ bụla na-achọ ndepụta òtù ọ ga-eji ZEC kwado Ọ bụrụ na ị na-elekọta òtù anaghị akwụ uru ma chọọ ịnakwere ZEC, lee Ịnakwere Onyinye Nke Onwe site n'aka Òtù anaghị akwụ uru nke US. Nke e chebere echebe ma ọ bụ Oha: ihe mere o ji dị mkpa Mgbe ị zipụrụ ZEC site na e-akpa ego [wallet] nke e chebere echebe gaa na Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, ego ole ahụ, onye zipụrụ ya na onye natara ya na-anọgide na Nzuzo. Mgbe ị zipụrụ na Adreesị akpa ego Oha, onyinye ahụ na-ahụ anya na blockchain: onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịhụ ego ole ọ bụ, mgbe ọ bịarutere na nguzozi ego nke otu ahụ. Ọrụ ndị ọzọ nke e-akpa ego gị nke e chebere echebe na-anọgide na Nzuzo, mana onyinye ahụ n'onwe ya bụ nke ọha. Lee The Turnstile maka ihe na-aghọ nke ọha mgbe ZEC hapụrụ pool nke e chebere echebe. Ha abụọ ka na-akwado òtù ahụ. Nke e chebere echebe na-edobe onyinye ahụ na Nzuzo. Òtù anaghị akwụ uru na-anabata ZEC nke e chebere echebe Òtù Ihe ọ na-eme Ibe onyinye Adreesị akpa ego Nkọwa --- --- --- --- --- Zcash Foundation Òtù anaghị akwụ uru nke US na-ewu akụrụngwa Zcash dịka Zebra na FROST Ụdị onyinye Nke e chebere echebe (Unified) Ọ sịrị na ọ bụ 501(c)(3) nakwa na onyinye ZEC bụ ndị a pụrụ iwepu n'ụtụ isi. Ụdị ahụ na-ajụ ụbọchị, ego ole na uru USD ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ nnata Mothers Against Cruel Sentencing Òtù US na-arụ ọrụ megide ntaramahụhụ ụlọ mkpọrọ na-ezighị ezi Nye onyinye Nke e chebere echebe (Unified) Ọ sịrị na ọ bụ 501(c)(3) nakwa na onyinye bụ ndị a pụrụ iwepu n'ụtụ isi ZecHub Ebe mmụta obodo dị n'azụ wiki a Nye onyinye Nke e chebere echebe (Unified) Ekwughị ọnọdụ ụtụ isi Open Privacy Research Society Òtù anaghị akwụ uru nke Canada dị n'azụ ozi nzuzo Cwtch Nye onyinye Nke e chebere echebe (Sapling) Ọ bụ otu Canada; ọ sịrị na onyinye anaghị ebelata ụtụ isi. Adreesị akpa ego ahụ bụ Sapling, ọ bụghị Unified Shielded Labs Òtù Switzerland nke onyinye na-akwado, na-arụ ọrụ na protocol Zcash Ụdị kọntaktị Nke e chebere echebe Saịtị ya enweghị Adreesị akpa ego ma rịọ ndị na-enye onyinye ka ha kpọtụrụ ha. E bipụtara Adreesị akpa ego na forum na 2023; kwado ha tupu izipu Òtù anaghị akwụ uru na-anabata naanị ZEC Oha Òtù Ihe ọ na-eme Ibe onyinye Nkọwa --- --- --- --- Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) Òtù US anaghị akwụ uru maka nnwere onwe dijitalụ nke ụmụ amaala Ụzọ ndị ọzọ isi nye onyinye (ngalaba Onyinye Cryptocoin) Ọ sịrị na ọ nweghị ike inye nkwenye ụtụ isi, onyinye ma ọ bụ ịbụ onye otu maka onyinye crypto Freedom of the Press Foundation Òtù US anaghị akwụ uru na-echebe ndị nta akụkọ, nọ n'azụ SecureDrop Cryptocurrency Kpọtụrụ ha tupu inye onyinye ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ nnata ụtụ isi The Tor Project Òtù US anaghị akwụ uru nọ n'azụ Tor na ihe nchọgharị Tor Cryptocurrency Ọ sịrị na ọ bụ 501(c)(3). Maka nnata, zitere ha email nke nkọwa azụmaahịa gị mgbe i nyesịrị onyinye. Nhọrọ BTCPay ya na-ana na BTC, ya mere jiri Adreesị akpa ego ZEC I

title: Dash Integration of Zcash Orchard
description: In February 2026, the Dash network announced the integration of Zcash's Orchard shielded pool into the Dash Evolution chain. This marked one of the most significant cross chain privacy collaborations in the cryptocurrency space, as Dash ado
text: Mmekọrịta nke Dash na Zcash Orchard Okwu Mmalite N’ọnwa Febrụwarị 2026, netwọk Dash kwupụtara ijikọta pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded] Zcash Orchard n’ime chain Dash Evolution. Nke a ghọrọ otu n’ime mmekọrịta Nzuzo [privacy] cross-chain kachasị mkpa n’oghere cryptocurrency, n’ihi na Dash nakweere cryptography zero-knowledge [zero-knowledge] ọgbara ọhụrụ nke Zcash iji kwado usoro Nzuzo ya dị ugbu a nke dabere na CoinJoin. Mmekọrịta a na-akwado ọnọdụ Zcash dịka onye ndu na teknụzụ Nzuzo ma mepee isi ọhụrụ maka mmekọrịta Nzuzo cross-chain. Edemede a na-akọwa ihe protocol Orchard bụ, otu Dash si arụ ya, ihe mere o ji dị mkpa maka ecosystems abụọ ahụ, na ihe ọ na-egosi maka ọnọdụ ka ukwuu nke mkpụrụ ego Nzuzo. Gịnị Bụ Protocol Zcash Orchard? Orchard bụ pool nke e chebere echebe kacha elu nke Zcash, nke arụpụtara mgbe Network Upgrade 5 (NU5) mere n’etiti afọ 2022. Ọ na-anọchi njedebe nke ọtụtụ afọ nyocha cryptographic na Electric Coin Company (ECC) na obodo Zcash. Teknụzụ Isi: Halo 2 E wuru Orchard n’elu usoro proving Halo 2, mmejuputa zk-SNARK na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma e dere na Rust. Halo 2 wetara nnukwu ọganihu abụọ: Enweghị Trusted Setup: Pool nke e chebere echebe mbụ nke Zcash (Sprout na Sapling) dabere na emume mgbakọ ọtụtụ ndị sonyere iji mepụta parameters cryptographic. Ọ bụrụ na e mebighị randomness nzuzo ahụ (“toxic waste”) nke sitere n’emume ndị a nke ọma, a pụrụ iji ya mepụta token nke e chebere echebe adịgboroja n’echiche. Halo 2 na-ewepụ mkpa a kpamkpam site n’ụzọ a na-akpọ nested amortization, nke na-ejikọta ọtụtụ instances nke nsogbu siri ike ọnụ n’elu cycles nke elliptic curves ka proofs mgbakọ wee nwee ike ịtụgharị uche banyere onwe ha. Nhazi Proof Ntughari: Otu proof nwere ike ịgba akaebe maka izi ezi nke proofs ndị ọzọ fọrọ nke nta ka ha ghara inwe oke, na-akpakọba nnukwu mgbakọ n’ụdị dị nta nke a pụrụ inyocha. Nke a dị mkpa maka scaling na upgrades n’ọdịnihu. Otu Nzuzo Orchard Si Arụ Ọrụ N’Azụmahia blockchain ọdịnala, onye zitere, onye natara, na ego ha niile na-ahụ anya on-chain. N’Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe Orchard, proofs zero-knowledge na-ekwe nkwa na mgbakọ na mwepụ na: Azụmahia ahụ ziri ezi (ntinye ha na mmepụta ha, ọ nweghị token e kere n’enweghị ihe) Onye zitere ego nwere ego zuru ezu Ọ nweghị mmefu ugboro abụọ mere A na-enyocha ihe ndị a niile n’ekpugheghị onye zitere ego, onye natara ya, ma ọ bụ ego ole e bufere. Dịka CTO Dash Samuel Westrich si kwuo ya, kama izochi ụzọ Azụmahia site na ịgwakọta ha, proofs zero-knowledge na-ahụ na “ọ dịghị ụzọ dị adị na mbụ.” Actions Na-anọchi Ntinye na Mmepụta Orchard wetara echiche nke Actions iji dochie usoro ntinye/mmepụta ọdịnala. Action ọ bụla na-ejikọta mmefu na mmepụta ọnụ, nke na-ebelata oke metadata Azụmahia a na-agbapụta. Nke a na-eme ka o sikwuoro ndị na-ekiri ike ime nyocha traffic ma ọ bụ mwakpo heuristic n’Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe. Gịnị Bụ Chain Dash Evolution? Iji ghọta mmekọrịta a, ọ dị mkpa ịghọta architecture nke Dash. Architecture Chain Abụọ Dash na-arụ usoro chain abụọ: Dash Core (Layer 1): Blockchain proof-of-work mbụ, nke ndị na-egwụputa [miners] na masternodes na-echekwa. Nke a bụ ebe token DASH nke obodo dị na ebe nzuzo CoinJoin na-arụ ọrụ. Dash Evolution (Platform Layer): Chain nke abụọ e wuru n’akụkụ Core nke na-akwado ọrụ smart contract, applications decentralized, na njikwa njirimara. Evolution na-eji usoro consensus Tendermint e gbanwere akpọrọ Tenderdash, Evolution Masternodes na-enyochakwa ya ma na-echekwa chains abụọ ahụ n’otu oge. Chain Evolution bụ ebe mmekọrịta Orchard na-eme. Nhọrọ imewe a na-enye Dash ohere iweta Nzuzo cryptographic dị elu n’agbanweghị chain Core e gosipụtara na ọ na-arụ ọrụ. Otu Mmekọrịta ahụ Si Arụ Ọrụ Architecture Tekinụzụ Dash mere fork nke crate open-source Zcash Orchard Rust ma gbanwee ya maka chain Evolution. Mmekọrịta ahụ na-agbaso usoro pool kredit e chebere: Kpọchie: Ndị ọrụ na-akpọchi assets DASH ha na Dash Core Mepụta: A na-emepụta token “Credits” ndị ejikọrọ na uru ya na chain Evolution Bufee: Enw

title: FROST & Viewing Keys: Nchịkọta Nnyocha Mmekọrịta Zcash/Dash
description: Edebere maka ZecHub · E degharịrị ya 27 Septemba 2026 · E tinyere ebe isi okwu nkwado maka nkwupụta niile
text: FROST & Viewing Keys: Nchịkọta Nnyocha Mmekọrịta Zcash/Dash Edebere maka ZecHub · E degharịrị ya 27 Septemba 2026 · E tinyere ebe isi okwu nkwado maka nkwupụta niile Nchịkọta nchịkwa ZecHub welitere ajụjụ a mgbe ọ gbakwụnyere Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe DASH dị ka nhọrọ onyinye wiki: à ga-enwe ike ịtụgharị viewing keys nke ụdị Zcash, ma ọ bụ signature oke FROST, gaa na Dash? Nnyocha ahụ gbanwere usoro e si ele ya anya. Viewing keys abụghị ajụjụ mepere emepe — Dash etinyela pool nke e chebere echebe Zcash Orchard n'ime Evolution chain ya, na usoro nhazi igodo Orchard nwere viewing keys site na nhazi ya. Dash's roadmap na-etinye ha maka mpughe nye onye nyocha na irube isi n’Iwu Njem. E tinyela ọkara ahụ n’ọrụ, ọ bụghị echiche naanị. FROST bụ ebe ọdịiche n’ezie dị. Dash na-agba BLS signature oke site na Long-Living Masternode Quorums, mana ndị a na-eje ozi consensus n’ogo netwọkụ — ChainLocks na InstantSend. ZIP 312 na-elekwasị anya n’ihe dị iche: nnabata imefu ego nke ọtụtụ mmadụ kwekọrịtara maka otu akaụntụ nke e chebere echebe nke obere ìgwè ndị ji igodo n’otu n’otu nwere. Ha abụọ anaghị anọchi ibe ha. Ebe ZIP 312 ka bụ Draft, enweghị mmejuputa ntụaka n’otu chain ọ bụla a ga-ebufe, ya mere nke a ga-abụ ọrụ ọhụrụ n’agbanyeghị akụkụ ga-ewu ya. --- Usoro oge: ihe mere ntụnyere a ji bụrụ ihe pụrụ iche ugbu a Ihe omume abụọ metụtara pool e chebere echebe mere n’ime izu ole na ole n’etiti 2026. Zcash si na Orchard pụọ. Onye nchọpụta Taylor Hornby kpughere adịghị ike circuit dị na Orchard nke a pụrụ iji bulie ọnụọgụ akụ n’amaghị ama. Zcash zara site n’ịgbalite Ironwood (NU6.3) na 28 Julaị 2026, ma webata pool ọhụrụ e chebere echebe nke nwere usoro mbugharị turnstile. Dash batara na Orchard. Dash kwupụtara atụmatụ ahụ na 19 Febrụwarị 2026 — “Anyị na-atụ anya na anyị ga-enwe ike iwepụta mbufe e chebere echebe n’oge adịghị anya, dabere n’ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị na nyocha nchekwa na nyocha koodu ọzọ.” Dash's roadmap depụtara Shielded Balances dị ka ihe emechara na Julaị 2026 site na Dash Platform v4.0, na Dash bipụtara “Azụmahia e chebere echebe amalitela na Dash Evolution mainnet” na 4 Ọgọọst 2026. Ndetu gbasara usoro. Ụfọdụ akụkọ tinyeela ịgbalite mainnet Dash na 17 Julaị 2026, nke ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ tupu Ironwood. Ụbọchị ahụ yiri ka o sitere n’akụkọ mgbasa ozi banyere ọkwa ahụ kama ịbụ ịgbalite ya. N’ebe isi mmalite nke Dash n’onwe ya dị, emechara atụmatụ ahụ na Julaị ma kpọsa na ọ dị ndụ na 4 Ọgọọst — mgbe Ironwood gasịrị. Chain abụọ ahụ gbakọrọ n’ime izu ole na ole; usoro ziri ezi dabere n’akara ngosi a gụrụ, nchịkọta a anaghị ekwu na otu dị tupu nke ọzọ. N’ụzọ dị oke mkpa, Dash eketaghị ntụpọ ahụ. Ọkwa ha doro anya: “anyị mejuputara ụdị Orchard nke enweghị ntụpọ mmụba a maara. Ụdị gara aga nwere ntụpọ a pụrụ iji bulie akụ Zcash n’amaghị ama.” Ya mere Dash ugbu a na-agba fork emeziworo nke cryptography nke Zcash n’onwe ya siri na ya pụọ n’ogo ntọala, ebe pool ọgbọ ọzọ Zcash (Ironwood) na usoro nnabata imefu ego ọgbọ ọzọ (FROST) ka dị ọhụrụ n’ọrụ ma ka bụ Draft n’otu n’otu. --- Viewing keys: etinyelarị n’ọrụ, ọ bụghị oghere nyocha Pool e chebere echebe Dash bụ Orchard, nke e wuru n’elu Halo 2 zk-SNARKs nke na-achọghị trusted setup. Usoro nhazi igodo Orchard na-enwe Full Viewing Keys na Incoming Viewing Keys kemgbe mbụ dịka akụkụ nke nhazi ya, ọ bụghị ihe agbakwunyere — ya mere ike ahụ bịara na koodu, ọ bụghị dịka mbugharị chain ọ bụla ga-akparịta ụka. Roadmap Dash na-ekwu nzube ahụ kpọmkwem: “N’adịghị ka usoro Nzuzo iwu kwadoro nke chere nsogbu iwepu na exchange na esemokwu usoro iwu ihu, Shielded Balances na-akwado Mpughe ahọpụtara site na view keys — na-enye ndị ọrụ na azụmahịa ohere ịkekọrịta nkọwa Azụmahia na ndị nyocha ma ọ bụ irube isi n’ihe Iwu Njem chọrọ mgbe ọ dị mkpa, na-emebighị Nzuzo maka ojiji kwa ụbọchị.” Nleba anya abụọ kwesiri idekọ: Dash na-edobe viewing keys n’akụkụ Ojiji mmepụta doro anya karịa ebe ngwaọrụ Zcash n’onwe ya ruru. Ngwaọrụ mpughe Kwụọ ụhwọ nke Zcash ka nọkarị na nnwale ma bụrụ ihe onye ọrụ họọrọ n’ofe e-akp

title: Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH)
description: Zcash ebidoghị ETF. Grayscale mere, site n'ịgbanwe ego nchikota ọ na-elekọta kemgbe 2017. Zcash bụ protocol — o nweghị ụlọ ọrụ, Ebe nchekwa ego ma ọ bụ bọọdụ…
text: Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) Zcash ebidoghị ETF. Grayscale mere, site n'ịgbanwe ego nchikota ọ na-elekọta kemgbe 2017. Zcash bụ protocol — o nweghị ụlọ ọrụ, Ebe nchekwa ego ma ọ bụ bọọdụ nke pụrụ iwepụta ego nchikota. Grayscale bụ onye njikwa akụ nọọrọ onwe ya nke na-azụta ZEC n'ahịa mepere emepe dịka onye ọ bụla ọzọ. Ọdịiche ahụ bụ otu ihe ndị mmadụ na-akọwahiekarị gbasara ZCSH, ọ bụkwa ebe ibe a malitere. Na 25 Ọgọọst 2026, ego nchikota ahụ malitere ịzụ ahịa na NYSE Arca dịka The Zcash ETF, ngwaahịa mbụ US spot Zcash a na-azụ n'exchange, ma ọ bụzi otu n'ime ndị ji ZEC kacha ukwuu dị. Otu ego nchikota ahụ, ọkwa atọ Mgbe Ihe gbanwere --- --- Ọktoba 2017 Ebido dịka itinye ego nzuzo, naanị ndị itinye ego akwadoro Ọktoba 2021 A kpọrọ mbak ọnụahịa na OTCQX n'okpuru ticker ZCSH, ma na-azụ ahịa n'okpuru NAV 25 Ọgọọst 2026 Ọ ghọrọ ETP a pụrụ ịgbapụta na NYSE Arca ma wepụ "Trust" n'aha ya Nzọụkwụ nke 2026 abụghị naanị maka ọdịdị. Trust a kpọrọ ọnụahịa na OTC enweghị usoro mgbapụta, ya mere mbak ya nwere ike ịkwaga n'elu ma ọ bụ n'okpuru uru akụ ndị na-akwado ha, mgbe ụfọdụ nke ukwuu — nke bụ kpọmkwem ihe mere n'etiti 2021 na 2026. Ngwaahịa a na-azụ n'exchange nke nwere imepụta na mgbapụta na-arụ ọrụ nwere ụzọ arbitrage nke na-eme ka ọnụahịa mbak daba n'ọrụ na net asset value. Ịgbanwe site n'otu gaa na nke ọzọ na-agbanwe otú ihe ahụ si arụ ọrụ dịka nchekwa ego. Onye na-eme ihe Ọrụ Ndị otu --- --- Onye nkwado Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC Onye ntụkwasị obi CSC Delaware Trust Company Onye nchịkwa na onye nnọchi anya mbufe The Bank of New York Mellon Prime broker Coinbase, Inc. — na-achọta ZEC maka trust Ndị sonyere enyere ikike Jane Street, Virtu — na-emepụta ma na-agbapụta mbak Onye nnọchi anya ahịa Foreside Fund Services Onye nlekota Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC — naanị ebe ZEC n'ezie dị Ọ dịghị otu n'ime ndị otu ndị a bụ ego nchikota ahụ. Nhazi ahụ bụ nkwekọrịta dị n'etiti ha, nke bụ ihe eserese dị n'elu na-akọwa. Ọtụtụ n'ime ọrụ ndị a efuola ma ọ bụ kọrọ n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi na akụkọ mgbe e depụtara ya; ndepụta ebe a na-agbaso nkwupụta ndebanye Form S-3 nke Grayscale na EDGAR. Otu esi emepụta ma gbapụta mbak Naanị Ndị Sonyere Enyere Ikike — ndị broker-dealer e debanyere aha n'okpuru nkwekọrịta na Onye Nkwado — nwere ike ịmepụta ma ọ bụ gbapụta mbak, naanị na ngọngọ nke 10,000, a na-akpọ Baskets. Onye itinye ego nkịtị anaghị emetụ usoro a aka; ọ na-azụta ma na-ere mbak ndị dị adị na exchange dịka nchekwa ego ọ bụla e depụtara. Usoro ahụ ugbu a bụ ego, ọ bụghị in-kind. Onye Sonyere Enyere Ikike na-etinye ego n'ime, ma ọ bụ nata ego site na, akaụntụ ego, ma onye na-eweta liquidity nke atọ bụ onye n'ezie na-enweta ma ọ bụ na-ewepụ ZEC. Nkwupụta ndebanye ahụ kọwakwara usoro in-kind, nke Onye Sonyere Enyere Ikike ga-etinye ZEC ozugbo n'aka Trust ma ọ bụ nata ZEC n'aka ya — mana ọ na-ekwu n'ụzọ doro anya na "In-Kind Regulatory Approval has not been obtained," ma o nwere ike ghara inweta ya. Ya mere, n'okpuru usoro ego, ZEC na-agbanwe aka n'etiti onye na-eweta liquidity na ahịa, ọ bụghị n'etiti onye itinye ego na Trust. Ọ dịghị onye n'okporo ụzọ retail na-emetụ Adreesị akpa ego Zcash aka. A na-akwụ ugwo ahụ na ZEC Ugwo onye nkwado bụ 2.5% kwa afọ, dịka ọ dị mgbe e depụtara ya. Ọ na-agbakọta kwa ụbọchị dịka pasent nke net asset value, ma, n'okwu nkwupụta ndebanye ahụ, bụ "payable in ZEC to the Sponsor daily in arrears." Ihe si na ya pụta bụ nke nhazi, ọ bụghị ihe ntakịrị. Ugwo ahụ na-esite na ZEC ego nchikota ahụ, ya mere ọnụego ZEC na-akwado mbak ọ bụla na-agbada ntakịrị kwa ụbọchị. Mba abụghị ọnụọgụ ZEC a kapịrị ọnụ a na-ejide ruo mgbe ebighị ebi; ọ bụ ikike n'elu nke na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-ebelata. Onye ọ bụla na-atụnyere itinye ego ogologo oge na ZCSH na ijide ZEC ozugbo kwesịrị itinye nke a n'ịtụnyere ahụ. Maka nkọwa, 2.5% dị ihe dị ka ugboro iri n'ugwo ETF spot bitcoin a na-ahụkarị.
