title: Ọrụ Obodo
description: Chọpụta ngwá ọrụ, e-akpa ego [wallets], ngwa, ọba akwụkwọ, na atụmatụ gburugburu ebe obibi nke obodo Zcash na gburugburu zero-knowledge sara mbara wuru.
text: Ọrụ Obodo Chọpụta ngwá ọrụ, e-akpa ego [wallets], ngwa, ọba akwụkwọ, na atụmatụ gburugburu ebe obibi nke obodo Zcash na gburugburu zero-knowledge sara mbara wuru. --- Agụmakwụkwọ, Mgbasa Ozi, na Obodo My First Zcash Akwụkwọ ọrụ agụmakwụkwọ nke obodo zuru ụwa ọnụ Zcash mepụtara. Gaa leta ZECPublish Mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta nke na-eguzogide mmachibido, nke Zcash blockchain na-akwado. Ọ gụnyere ndekọ aha ndị ọrụ Zcash na bọọdụ ozi na-enweghị aha. (Saịtị ahụ anaghị arụ ọrụ ugbu a kemgbe Septemba 2026.) ZK Radio Ụlọ ọrụ redio n'ịntanetị iji gwa, kuzie, ma mee obodo Zcash obi ụtọ. Ọ bụ Zcash en Español na ZKAV Club mepụtara ya. Gaa leta ZShieldHer Saịtị agụmakwụkwọ Zcash maka ndị lanarịrị ime ihe ike n'ime ụlọ. Gaa leta ZecForge Ebe nrụpụta maka ndị okike n'ime gburugburu ebe obibi Zcash, lekwasịrị anya n'ịnabata ndị ọhụrụ, mmepe ndị okike, na nkesa ọdịnaya. Gaa leta Usoro Vidio Mastering Zcash Usoro agụmakwụkwọ zuru ezu na-ekpuchi teknụzụ Zcash, cryptography, akụnụba, na Gọọmentị [governance]. Gaa leta Zcast Podcast Zcash nke asụsụ Spanish nwere mmelite kacha ọhụrụ gbasara gburugburu ebe obibi. Gaa leta Zero-knowledge Audiovisual Club (ZKAV) Otu ọrụ ọnụ nke ọdịyo na onyonyo na-ebute Nzuzo [privacy] ụzọ, nke na-azụ, na-ekekọta ihe, ma na-enye nkwado AV afọ ofufo maka mmemme obodo teknụzụ open-source na decentralized. Gaa leta Ụlọ Akwụkwọ Netwọkụ Zcash Ọdịnaya agụmakwụkwọ ahaziri ahazi maka ndị ọrụ na ndị onye mmepụta [developer] Zcash ọhụrụ. Nzukọ Zectastic Saịtị mmekọrịta nke nwere egwuregwu nwere isiokwu Zcash na mmemme obodo na-eme ozugbo. Gaa leta Ngwa ZEC Ngwa ekwentị nke na-achịkọta akụkọ ZEC, ọrụ obodo, ozi netwọkụ, e-akpa ego, exchange [exchange], na akụrụngwa gburugburu ebe obibi n'otu ebe. Nzukọ Obodo PGPZ Ebe obodo maka Pretty Good Policy for Zcash (PGPZ), atụmatụ iwu Washington D.C. lekwasịrị anya n'ego dijitalụ na-echekwa Nzuzo, nrubeisi bara uru, na ọrụ Zcash maka ọdịmma ọha. Gaa leta Gleyo Ikpo okwu maka itinye obodo n'ọrụ na inye ụgwọ ọrụ, e mere ya maka obodo Zcash, ọrụ Web3, na òtù Web2. Ọ na-enyere obodo aka ịnabata ma tinye ndị òtù n'ọrụ site n'ajụjụ, nkata, na ụgwọ ọrụ, ebe ọ na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere irite ma wepụ ZEC nke e chebere echebe [shielded] na nzuzo. Gaa leta Ebe Ikike Zcash Dashboard ikike [grants dashboard] lekwasịrị anya n'obodo, e mere iji mee ka ụzọ e si achọpụta, soro, ma nyochaa ikike Zcash dị mfe. Ọ na-achịkọta arịrịọ ikike, ihe dị ịrịba ama, mmefu ego, mkparịta ụka, na nyocha n'otu ebe site n'ịdọpụta data dị ndụ site na ebe nchekwa Zcash Community Grants GitHub. Ikpo okwu a chọrọ inye ahụmịhe doro anya ma dị mfe iji maka ndị na-achọ itinye akwụkwọ, ndị òtù kọmitii, na ndị nleba anya obodo. Gaa leta --- E-akpa Ego na Ngwá Ọrụ Kwụọ Ụhwọ CipherPay Ụgwọ na nzuzo maka ịntanetị. Ọ bụghị Onye nlekota [custodial], enweghị KYC. Ndị ahịa azụmahịa na-anata ZEC ozugbo na Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe. Gaa leta eZcash E-akpa ego Zcash nke ọtụtụ nyiwe, dị mfe iji ma nwee atụmatụ zuru ezu, nke na-akwado autoshielding. Gaa leta E-akpa ego Nozy E-akpa ego Zcash nke Orchard na-ebute ụzọ, e wuru maka zebrad na lightwalletd. Ọ na-akwado izipu na ịnata nke e chebere echebe kpamkpam, njikwa igodo mpaghara dị nchebe, note Ironwood (NU6.3), na mbufe site na Orchard gaa Ironwood. A na-ajụ Adreesị akpa ego Oha [transparent] n'usoro Kwụọ ụhwọ ndị ọrụ na-ahụ. Gaa leta Overpay.com Ọnụ ụzọ Kwụọ ụhwọ nke na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere iji ZEC e chebere echebe zụta ihe n'ezi ụwa (ugbu a nọ na alpha). Gaa leta ZcashToCash ZcashToCash (zcashto.cash) — ZEC gaa Cash App, Chime, Monzo, Revolut, Venmo, ma ọ bụ Zelle site na Peer. A na-atụgharị ZEC gaa USDC (NEAR), mgbe ahụ iwu Peer na Base na-ewepụta USDC mgbe onye nnata gosịrị na e kwụọla ego fiat. Onye nnata na-ahụ aha njirimara ngwa ịkwụ ụgwọ. Ọ bụghị CEX, ọ bụghị ZEC n'ime escrow. Gaa leta E-akpa ego Zafu E-akpa ego Nzuzo open-source maka Zcash na Penumbra. title: Zcash Ogwe Ndụmọdụ Obodo [Community Advisory Panel]
description: Ogwe Ndụmọdụ Obodo Zcash, ma ọ bụ ZCAP, bụ ogwe nke ndị otu Obodo Zcash mejupụtara, nke e guzobere iji tinye obodo ahụ aka ma rịọ ndụmọdụ ha mgbe ọ bụla Zcash…
text: Zcash Ogwe Ndụmọdụ Obodo [Community Advisory Panel] Ogwe Ndụmọdụ Obodo Zcash, ma ọ bụ ZCAP, bụ ogwe nke ndị otu Obodo Zcash mejupụtara, nke e guzobere iji tinye obodo ahụ aka ma rịọ ndụmọdụ ha mgbe ọ bụla Zcash Foundation chọrọ ime mkpebi gbasara ma ọ bụ nke na-emetụta obodo ahụ. Kemgbe e guzobere ya na 2018, ogwe ahụ enyela aka ịkọwa ụzọ a ga-esi aga n’ọtụtụ mkpebi dị mkpa maka Zcash Foundation, ụfọdụ n’ime ha gụnyere: Akara ahịa Zcash: Ntuliaka a gbasara ma Zcash Foundation kwesịrị ịchọ nkwekọrịta iwu na Electric Coin Company (ECC) iji kesaa nwe na njikwa akara ahịa Zcash Amụma ego Monetary Policy: Ntuliaka a gbasara ma Zcash Foundation kwesịrị ịkwado mgbanwe ọ bụla n’amụma ego Zcash, dịka ọnụego mbupụta, usoro halving, ma ọ bụ ọnụego mbuli ọnụ ahịa Nguzogide ASIC ASIC Resistance: Ntuliaka a gbasara ma Zcash Foundation kwesịrị ibute nguzogide ASIC ụzọ dị ka uru na ebumnuche maka netwọk Zcash Ntuliaka Kọmitii Zcash Community Grants: Ntuliaka a gbasara ịhọpụta mmadụ abụọ so na kọmitii Zcash Community Grants (ZCG), nke ọrụ ya bụ inyocha ma kwado ego maka atụmatụ ikike maka ọrụ metụtara Zcash Mmemme Ikike Obere Zcash: Ntuliaka a gbasara ịnakwere ma ọ bụ ịjụ arịrịọ ikike maka obere ọrụ Zcash ndị rịọrọ ego n’aka Zcash Foundation [Ịnakwere na mmepe Akụ nke e chebere echebe [Shielded Assets] Zcash](https://vote.heliosvoting.org/helios/elections/5dd57b92-01ed-11ec-a0a8-ae3066fac55d/view), nke na-eme ka e jiri akụ DeFi izugbe n’ime gburugburu Zcash nke nzuzo bụ ọnọdụ ndabara. Ntuliaka ndị otu Kọmitii Ndị Isi Zcash Foundation Echiche dị n’azụ ZCAP bụ na ndị otu obodo dị iche iche, nwere mba, ọrụ na echiche dị iche iche, mejupụtara ya, iji hụ na ọ na-anọgide na-agbaso ebumnuche ya nke ịnọchite anya olu na mmasị ndị ọrụ na ndị nwere oke na Zcash, ebe ọ na-edobe netwọk mepere emepe ma dị iche iche. Ruo Ọktoba 2023, mmadụ 188 mejupụtara ZCAP, a na-agbasakwa ya ugboro ugboro. Ọzọkwa, Zcash Foundation “agbasawanyela ụkpụrụ ntozu maka isonye na ZCAP, gụnyere ụkpụrụ ndị ndị otu obodo Zcash tụrụ aro”. description: E guzobere ọrụ Onye Ndu Nchekwa nke usoro gburugburu nke Zcash site n'ikike [grant] ZCG iji nye injinia nchekwa pụrụ iche maka usoro gburugburu Zcash sara…
text: Zcash Nchekwa nke usoro gburugburu [Ecosystem Security] Onye Ndu Nchekwa nke usoro gburugburu E guzobere ọrụ Onye Ndu Nchekwa nke usoro gburugburu nke Zcash site n'ikike [grant] ZCG iji nye injinia nchekwa pụrụ iche maka usoro gburugburu Zcash sara mbara — karịsịa ndị natara ikike ZCG — na-abụghị ECC na ZF. 2022–2023: earthrise jere ozi dị ka Onye Ndu Nchekwa nke usoro gburugburu mbụ. Mụtakwuo na zecsec.com. 2024–2025: ZCG họpụtara Least Authority ka ọ gaa n'ihu n'ọrụ ahụ site na RFP ọhụrụ. Enwere ike ịhụ mmelite ebe a. 2026: Shielded Labs were Taylor Hornby dịka onye ndụmọdụ nchekwa iji kwado ikike nchekwa nke Zcash. ZCG Mmemme Nchekwa na Mkpughe Adịghị Ike Mmemme Nchekwa na Mkpughe Adịghị Ike nke ZCG na-enye usoro maka mkpughe a haziri ahazi nke adịghị ike nchekwa n'ofe usoro gburugburu Zcash. Mmelite Nchekwa Ndị Na-adịbeghị Anya (2026) Zebra 4.4.1 (Mee 2026): E wepụtara ndozi nchekwa dị oke mkpa. A na-agba ndị ọrụ node niile ume ka ha kwalite ozugbo. Zebra 4.3.1 (Eprel 2026): E wepụtara [ndozi nchekwa dị oke mkpa, ịgwọpụta [mining] nke ejiri Docker rụọ na ime ka CI sie ike](https://forum.zcashcommunity.com/t/zebra-4-3-1-critical-security-fixes-dockerized-mining-and-ci-hardening/55389). Edozila Ọtụtụ Adịghị Ike (Eprel 2026): E mechiri nke ọma ọtụtụ adịghị ike Zcash na-enweghị imetụta ego ndị ọrụ ma ọ bụ Nzuzo [privacy]. Ndụmọdụ zcashd (Eprel 2026): Ndụmọdụ iji belata ebe mwakpo zcashd site n'ịduzi okporo data gafee Zebra. Mkpughe Nwere Ọrụ Electric Coin Company na Zcash Foundation ha abụọ na-agbaso ụkpụrụ Mkpughe Nwere Ọrụ a, ma e wezụga ihe ndị a: "Zcash bụ teknụzụ nke na-enye Nzuzo siri ike. A na-eji Nzobe ederede [encryption] zoo note [note] ruo ebe ha na-aga, ma a na-echekwa ntọala ego ahụ site na proof zero-knowledge [zero-knowledge] e mere ka naanị onye ji Zcash n'ezie nwee ike ịmepụta ha. Ọ bụrụ na nke a ada ada, ma ahụhụ ịkpụ ego adịgboroja apụta, enwere ike irigbu ahụhụ ịkpụ ego adịgboroja ahụ n'enweghị ụzọ ndị na-enyocha blockchain [blockchain] ga-esi mata onye mere ya ma ọ bụ data dị na blockchain ejirila rigbuo ahụhụ ahụ. Ya mere, iweghachi ọnọdụ azụ tupu oge ahụ, dịka e mere n'ọrụ ndị ọzọ ụfọdụ n'ọnọdụ ndị dị otu a, agaghị ekwe omume. Ụkpụrụ ahụ na-akọwa na ndị na-akọ adịghị ike ga-agụnye nkọwa zuru ezu banyere nsogbu, iji mepụtaghachi ya. Nke a dị mkpa, dịka ọmụmaatụ, mgbe onye nyocha nọ n'èzí na-egosi ma na-egosikwa proof na nsogbu nchekwa dị n'ezie, nakwa na nsogbu nchekwa ahụ nwere mmetụta ọ sịrị na o nwere — na-enye ndị otu mmepe ohere ibute nsogbu ahụ ụzọ nke ọma ma dozie ya. Otú ọ dị, n'ihe banyere ahụhụ ịkpụ ego adịgboroja, dịka ọ dị na CVE-2019-7167, anyị nwere ike ikpebi ịghara itinye nkọwa ndị ahụ na akụkọ anyị na-ezigara ndị mmekọ tupu mwepụta a haziri ahazi, ma ọ bụrụhaala na anyị ji n'aka na ha nwere ike imetụta." title: Cypherpunk Zero
description: Cypherpunk Zero bụ usoro akụkọ gbadoro ụkwụ na Zero, onye na-agba mbọ na cypherpunk na onye na-alụ ọgụ maka nnwere onwe. Zero bi ugbu a n'ime ajọ ụwa dystopia…
text: Cypherpunk Zero Cypherpunk Zero bụ usoro akụkọ gbadoro ụkwụ na Zero, onye na-agba mbọ na cypherpunk na onye na-alụ ọgụ maka nnwere onwe. Zero bi ugbu a n'ime ajọ ụwa dystopia, ọ na-ejikwa koodu alụso ndị nche ọnụ ụzọ etiti na-agbụ ọha mmadụ ọgụ. Akụkọ a sitere n'ike mmụọ nsọ nke Zcash na nkà Nzobe ederede [cryptography] nke Halo. Ọrụ okike a bụ mbọ nkwado n'etiti ECC, Stranger World, Might Jaxx, na ụfọdụ ndị mmekọ ecosystem ahọpụtara. Ọrụ okike a lekwasịrị anya karịchaa n'usoro NFT, e wepụtakwala ihe egwuregwu a na-anakọta. Obodo NFT, nke na-arụsi ọrụ ike karịsịa na Twitter, emepụtala ọbụna otu decentralized (DAO) iji hazie ma mezue ọrụ na-akwado mkpọsa ahụ, yana obodo Zcash sara mbara. Roadmap Na-emegide Roadmap Anyị ahụla ọtụtụ ọrụ na-ekwe nkwa gabigara ókè ma na-eweta ihe na-erughị nkwa na roadmap NFT ha. Ya mere, roadmap iwu adịghị. Tụkwasịnụ obi na anyị nwere ụfọdụ uru pụrụ iche dị ịtụnanya n'usoro maka ndị ji NFT, ụfọdụ a tụrụ anya ha, ụfọdụ a na-atụghị anya ha. Kpachapụ anya ma soro anyị n'ọgụ a. Gọọmentị Snapshot — e wepụrụ portal pụrụ iche nke DAO ahụ na vote.cypherpunkzero.com, ngalaba ya anaghịkwa aza; nke a bụ oghere Snapshot fọdụrụ. Guild Commonwealth Ònye bụ Stranger Wolf? Chain nke NFT ndị ahụ dị na ya bụ nke aṅaa? Ethereum Kedu ka e si kee token ndị ahụ? Nchịkọta mkpokọta: NFT 10,000 pụrụ iche, ndị a na-emepụta n'onwe ha, na Ethereum Mainnet E kenyere 4% nke mkpokọta ahụ (NFT 400 mbụ) n'efu nye ndị nkwado mbụ nke ọrụ ahụ zụtara Zcash X Mighty Jaxx: Cypherpunk Zero Genesis Edition Toy 59. A ga-ewepụta 72% nke mkpokọta ahụ (NFT 7,200) nye ọha mmadụ site n'iji usoro whitelisting ọhụrụ nke chọrọ iji e-akpa ego [wallet] Zcash na-akwado memo ezoro ezo (nkọwa ndị ọzọ dị n'okpuru). ECC ga-edobe 24% nke mkpokọta ahụ (NFT 2,400) n'ime Cypherpunk Reserve, maka iji mee atụmatụ n'ọdịnihu na-akwalite Zcash na Nzuzo n'ime oghere Web3. title: Jiri IPFS nye GitHub Repo
description: N'ime nduzi a, anyị ga-amụta otu esi emepụta URL nke a pụrụ iji git clone maka ebe nchekwa [repository] GitHub gị, nke a na-enye site n'iji IPFS CID. Nke a…
text: Jiri IPFS nye GitHub Repo Mmalite N'ime nduzi a, anyị ga-amụta otu esi emepụta URL nke a pụrụ iji git clone maka ebe nchekwa [repository] GitHub gị, nke a na-enye site n'iji IPFS CID. Nke a bara uru iji hụ na ọdịnaya dị n'agbanyeghị mpaghara ala, iguzogide mmachibido, nakwa dị ka nkwado ndabere na-adịgide adịgide maka ozi bara uru! Note: Data e tinyere na IPFS dịịrị ndị ọrụ netwọk [network] niile. Ị nwere ike ịchọ iji Nzobe ederede [encryption] zoo data nkeonwe/nwere mmetụta n'ógbè gị. Wụnye IPFS Kubo Soro ntuziaka nrụnye e nyere ebe a N'ihe atụ a, anyị na-eji Linux, ụdị OS ndị ọzọ dịkwa. Lelee na nrụnye gara nke ọma site n'iji "ipfs --version" Clone Ebe nchekwa Iji malite, họrọ ebe nchekwa Git ịchọrọ ịnabata ma mee clone ya: Gbaa Iwu: "git clone https://github.com/zechub/zechub" Ugbu a, iji mee ka ọ dị njikere ka e mee clone ya site na IPFS. cd zechub git update-server-info Kọwaa objects Git: mv objects/pack/.pack . git unpack-objects < .pack rm -f .pack objects/pack/ Ime nke a ga-ekwe ka IPFS wepụ ihe ndị oyiri ma ọ bụrụ na ị melite ebe nchekwa Git ma emechaa. Tinye na IPFS Ozugbo i mechara nke ahụ, ebe nchekwa ahụ adịla njikere ka e nye ya. Ihe fọdụrụ bụ itinye ya na IPFS: $ pwd /code/myrepo $ ipfs add -r . CID sitere na ya: Qmbgqox5g3614gjTb43s5mdSmmk95aGWWA9EHksL2T91A2 Ọmarịcha! Ugbu a e tinyela ebe nchekwa gị na netwọk. Clone site na IPFS Ị ga-enwe ike ugbu a iweghachite ebe nchekwa github site n'iji: git clone http://ipfs.io/ipfs/"yourCID" N'aka nke ọzọ, ị nwere ike ịchọ ma weghachite ya site n'iji node IPFS dị n'ógbè gị. Note ikpeazụ: Folda repo dị na IPFS anaghị anata mmelite n'otu oge na ebe nchekwa github n'ezie. A na-atụ aro ka itinyeghachi folda ahụ n'oge oge.

title: Bipụta Weebụsaịtị na IPFS
description: IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) bụ protocol na netwọkụ peer-to-peer e mere iji wulite usoro decentralized nke ịchekwa na ikekọrịta faịlụ.
text: Bipụta Weebụsaịtị na IPFS Mmalite banyere IPFS IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) bụ protocol na netwọkụ peer-to-peer e mere iji wulite usoro decentralized nke ịchekwa na ikekọrịta faịlụ. N'adịghị ka usoro client-server ọdịnala nke ịntanetị, IPFS na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ịkekọrịta faịlụ ozugbo n'etiti onwe ha, kama ịdabere na sava etiti iji chekwaa ma kesaa ọdịnaya. A na-eji ịkpọ aha dabere n’ọdịnaya [content-addressing] achọpụta faịlụ dị na IPFS, nke pụtara na a na-enye faịlụ ọ bụla hash pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ NJIRIMARA ỌDỊNAYA (CID) dabere n’ọdịnaya ya, a na-ejikwa hash a weghachite faịlụ ahụ n’ime netwọkụ. IPFS na-echekwa ọdịnaya dịka blocks a na-amata site na CIDs. Itinye faịlụ na-echekwa ya na node gị; ọ naghị eji aka ya depụta ya gaa na nodes ndị ọzọ. Debe otu mbipụta a na-enweta n’ịntanetị, ma ọ bụ hazie ntụtụ n’ebe dị anya (remote pinning), ka ndị ọzọ na-agụ ya nwee ike weghachite ya. Lee IPFS ịdịgide (persistence). Gụọ Mmalite banyere IPFS Ịmepụta Saịtị Gị Maka ihe atụ a, anyị na-emepụta weebụsaịtị dị mfe. Saịtị Ihe Nlereanya Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị nke ọma maka imewe weebụ, dee ọdịnaya bụ isi maka weebụsaịtị gị, tinyere Aha, Akụkụ ederede bụ isi, njikọ gaa na ibe/saịtị ndị ọzọ na footer. Nzọụkwụ 2: Jiri template HTML!. Tapawa ederede ị dere n’ebe kwesịrị ekwesị. Ị nwekwara ike ịmepụta stylesheet .CSS maka weebụsaịtị gị. Nzọụkwụ 3: Tinye ibe mbụ (homepage) gị n'ime index.html na mgbọrọgwụ (root) folda saịtị ahụ. Tinyekwa onyonyo ya na CSS ya. Jiri ụzọ mmekọ (relative paths) dị ka style.css ka ha rụọkwa ọrụ n'okpuru URL gateway IPFS. Ịtọlite Node IPFS Desktop na-elekọta node ahụ maka gị. Biko hapụ ya ka ọ na-arụ ọrụ mgbe ị na-ekesa saịtị gị. Maka ụzọ command-line (command-line route), malite repository ọhụrụ otu ugboro: Mgbe ahụ, malite node ahụ ma hapụ terminal a ka ọ nọrọ na-emeghe: Gbaa iwu ndị fọdụrụ na terminal nke abụọ. Ebidola daemon nke abụọ ma ọ bụrụ na IPFS Desktop na-elekọta repository a ugbu a. Tinye Folder Saịtị na IPFS: Na IPFS Desktop, họrọ folda nwere faịlụ weebụsaịtị gị site n'iji nhọrọ Add Folder. -- Maka ụzọ CLI (command-line interface, ihe ntanetị nke ị na-eji ederede enye iwu), gbaa nke a site na ndekọ nne (parent directory) nke folda saịtị gị: Dochie foldername na aha folda gị (tinye aha nwere oghere n'ime akara ngụkọ). Chekwaa CID dị n'ahịrị added ... foldername ikpeazụ: ọ na-amata ndekọ (directory) ahụ dum, ọ bụghị naanị index.html. Tinye Pin na Saịtị na IPFS: CLI ipfs add command na-ama pin (ịkpachi) ọdịnaya ndị a bubatara n'ime kọmputa gị na ndabara. Lelee pin nke folder ahụ site na: Dochie YOURFOLDERCID na CID sitere na nzọụkwụ gara aga; ihe ga-apụta kwesịrị ịsị recursive. Ịpịn (pinning) na-echebe mbipụta node a ka a ghara ihichapụ ya site na nhicha ebe nchekwa (garbage collection), mana ọ naghị eme ka kọmputa gbanyụrụ agbanyụ nọrọ n'ịntanetị. Ka ọ dịrị mgbe node gị anọghị n'ịntanetị, hazie ịpịn n'ebe dị anya ma gbaa mbọ hụ na ọrụ ahụ dị n'ebe dị anya emechaala ịpịn. Nweta weebụsaịtị gị na IPFS: Buru ụzọ lelee saịtị gị site na ọnụ ụzọ mpaghara (local gateway) dị na http://127.0.0.1:8080/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ (jiri port nke ọnụ ụzọ ahụ daemon gị bipụtara ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị iche). Akara slash dị na njedebe na-eme ka njikọ ndị metụtara (relative links) dozie n'ime ndekọ ahụ. Ọnụ ụzọ ọha (public gateway) dịka https://ipfs.io/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ nwere ike inye ya ozugbo ọ nwere ike iweta ọdịnaya ahụ site na node a na-enweta. Nlele mbụ na mpaghara gị (local preview) gara nke ọma egosighị na ọ dị maka ọha. N’ọnọdụ anyị, CID = "QmW2UEfap1vrRRvS5H9wed8qmsx4WsvXBk3GPGVVfWx3r3" IPNS Interplanetary Naming System (IPNS) na-enye gị ohere imelite CID IPFS ndị jikọtara na weebụsaịtị gị, ma ka na-enye njikọ kwụụrụ onwe ya. A na-enye ya dịka igodo. N’ime menu settings maka foldre saịtị gị na ngwa IPFS desktọpụ, họrọ Publish to IPNS. Igodo: "k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfxn5p9ypcu8jbzgnj4n" A pụkwara iji ya lee saịtị anyị site na gateway: https://ipfs.io/ipns/k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfx

title: Nchịkọta Ego na Gọọmentị Zcash
description: Ụdị ego on-chain nke Zcash, usoro ọrụ ụgwọ ọrụ block, na ọrụ nke nnukwu òtù dị iche iche
text: Nchịkọta Ego na Gọọmentị Zcash Ụdị ego on-chain nke Zcash, usoro ọrụ ụgwọ ọrụ block, na ọrụ nke nnukwu òtù dị iche iche Otu Ụgwọ Ọrụ Block nke Zcash Si Arụ Ọrụ Zcash bụ cryptocurrency nke Proof-of-Work. Block ọ bụla a gwupụtara na-ekesa enyemaka block ya (ZEC ọhụrụ e kere) tinyere ugwo Azụmahia, dịka iwu protocol kwụụrụ onwe ya nke network upgrade kpebiri. Ụdị dị ugbu a (NU6.1 / site na Nọvemba 24, 2025 gaa n'ihu) Nkesa ya bụ: Onye nnata Pasent Ihe ọ na-akwado / ọkwa -------------------------------- ------------ ------------------------------------------------------------- Ndị na-egwụputa 80% Ụgwọ ọrụ block a na-enye ndị na-egwụputa ozugbo Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) 8% Ikike obodo (ga-adịgide ruo ihe dịka 2028) Ego ndị nwe coin na-achịkwa (Coinholder-Controlled Fund) 12% Lockbox mbụ malitere ya; ndị nwe coin na-atụ votu maka ikike (ZIP 1016) Ego mmepe akụkọ ihe mere eme tupu NU6 (2020–Nọvemba 2024) 20% nke enyemaka block ọ bụla gara ozugbo n'òtù mmepe: 7% -> Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Ọrụ Bootstrap 5% -> Zcash Foundation (ZF) 8% -> Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) Eji ụdị 8% ZCG + 12% lockbox dochie "ego mmepe" 20% a site na ZIP 1015 (NU6, Nọvemba 2024). Site na Nọvemba 2024 ruo Nọvemba 2025, 12% ahụ chịkọbara n'ime Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox, na-enweghị ụzọ ọ bụla e nwere ike isi mefuo ya. Ụdị dị ugbu a: ZIP 1016 - Ụdị Ego Obodo na Ndị Ji Mkpụrụ Ego ZIP 1016 (e kere na Febrụwarị 2025) bụ NU6.1 mere ka ọ malite ọrụ na mainnet na block 3,146,400 na Nọvemba 24, 2025 (ZIP 255). Ọ: Na-aga n'ihu na nkesa 8% nye ZCG. Gbanwere 12% lockbox ka ọ bụrụ “Ego Ndị Ji Mkpụrụ Ego Na-achịkwa” (nke ego lockbox dị adị na-akụ mkpụrụ + enyemaka block 12% na-aga n'ihu). Na-arụ ọrụ ruo halving nke atọ (ZIP na-ekwe ka ụbọchị ahụ gbanwee ma ọ bụrụ na NU7 agbanwee oge block). Na-ekwe ka ndị ji mkpụrụ ego ZEC tụọ vootu maka ikike (ọtụtụ dị mfe, opekata mpe 420,000 ZEC tụrụ vootu). Na-achọ ka Òtù Ndị Ji Igodo (nke ugbu a gụnyere ZF na Shielded Labs, ebe a kpọrọ Bootstrap/ECC n'ọnọdụ ikike) lekọta nnyefe ego site na multisig, nke nkwekọrịta iwu na mkpebi ndị ji mkpụrụ ego ji. Na-edebe ihe niile ZIP 1015 chọrọ maka ojiji lockbox (ịkwado ikike gburugburu ebe obibi). Ụdị a na-esi na Gọọmentị nke òtù na-achịkwa kwaga na Gọọmentị ozugbo nke ndị ji mkpụrụ ego maka nkesa 12%. Ọ naghị agbanwe usoro ZIP ma ọ bụ iwu trademark. Òtù Isi na Isi Mmepụta Ego Ha Electric Coin Company (ECC) / Ọrụ Bootstrap Ndị kere Zcash mbụ (2016). N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, natara ihe dịka 7% nke ego mmepe ruo Nọvemba 2024. Na Jenụwarị 2026, ndị otu injinịa na ngwaahịa isi hapụrụ Bootstrap/ECC n'ihi esemokwu Gọọmentị wee hiwe Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL). ECC/Bootstrap anaghịzi enweta ego protocol ozugbo, ọ naghịkwa arụ ọrụ ndị otu mmepe mbụ. Ọ dabere n'onyinye, nkwado, na Ebe nchekwa ego nke ya. Ọ nwere mkpa akụkọ ihe mere eme ma ọ bụghịzi òtù mmepe protocol na-arụsi ọrụ ike. -> Lee profaịlụ zuru ezu: Electric Coin Company Zcash Open Development Lab (ZODL) Ndị mmepe protocol mbụ nke Zcash (ndị otu injinịa na ngwaahịa isi nke ECC) hiwere ya na Jenụwarị 2026 mgbe ha hapụsịrị Bootstrap/ECC. Welitere ihe karịrị nde $25 n'ego mmalite sitere n'aka nnukwu ndị itinye ego gụnyere a16z Crypto na Coinbase Ventures. Ndị otu a, nke mejupụtara ndị chepụtara na ndị mmepụta mbụ nke protocol Zcash, na-aga n'ihu na mmepe protocol isi, onyinye ZIP, na ngwá ọrụ lekwasịrị anya na Nzuzo gụnyere e-akpa ego mkpanaka Zodl (e meregharịara aha site na Zashi). Enweghị ego protocol on-chain ozugbo; ọ na-arụ ọrụ dịka ụlọ nyocha nọọrọ onwe ya nke VC kwadoro, lekwasịrị anya n'ịkwalite akụrụngwa Nzuzo Zcash. -> Lee profaịlụ zuru ezu: ZODL -> Saịtị gọọmentị: zodl.com Zcash Foundation (ZF) Òtù anaghị akwụ uru 501(c)(3) nọọrọ onwe ya, lekwasịrị anya n'akụrụngwa, sọftụwia node, nyocha, na ahụike gburugburu ebe obibi. N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, natara 5% nke ego mmepe. Ọ naghịzi enweta ego protocol ozugbo mgbe NU6 gasịrị. Ọ dabere n'onyinye na ikike. Ọ na-ejide trademark Zcash (nke ECC nyere na 2019) ma na-arụ ọrụ dị mkpa na Gọ

text: Ihe ndị a bụ nchịkọta nke mgbasa ozi metụtara Zcon Vozes, n’ebe dị mfe ịchọta. Zcon Vozes Zcon Vozes bụ ọgbakọ a na-eme kwa afọ nke Zcash Brazil zcashbrasil.com.br na-ahazi. Zcon Vozes Brasil Emume Zcash mbụ e mere n’èzí United States, nke Zcash Foundation kwadoro, mere na Machị 18, 2023. E mere ya na Museum of Tomorrow a ma ama, nke mere ka kọntinent ahụ bụrụ ebe obibi nke obodo Zcash nke abụọ kachasị ukwuu n’ụwa. 💛 Ndepụta egwu Zcon Vozes 1 Zcon Vozes 2 Emume a raara nye ikwurịta teknụzụ, Nzuzo [privacy], blockchain [blockchain], akụ crypto, akụrụngwa ego, mmepụta ọhụrụ, na ọdịnihu nke ịntanetị mepere emepe. Anyị na-akpọkọta mkparịta ụka na ndị ọkachamara, ndị prọfesọ, ndị onye mmepụta [developer], ndị nchọpụta, na ndị otu obodo iji nyochaa isiokwu dịka Zcash, Nzuzo ego, RWAs (Akụ Ezi Ụwa), itinye token n’akụ, Web3, nchekwa, ọchịchị dijitalụ, na ngwa ọhụrụ nke teknụzụ blockchain. Ebumnuche Zcon Vozes bụ ịbụ bridge [bridge] n’etiti ọmụma teknụzụ, nghọta ahịa, na agụmakwụkwọ dị mfe inweta, na-eme ka obodo Brazil bịaruo nso na arụmụka kachasị mkpa gbasara Nzuzo, decentralization, na ọdịnihu ego dijitalụ. title: ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab)
description: ZODL na-ahụ ụwa na-enweghị nlekota ego n'ọtụtụ ebe, ebe ndị na-erube isi n'iwu nwere ike ime azụmahịa n'enweghị mgbochi na na nzuzo. Òtù a kwenyere na e nweghị…
text: ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab) Weebụsaịtị - GitHub - X/Twitter - Discord Nkwupụta Ebumnuche ZODL na-ahụ ụwa na-enweghị nlekota ego n'ọtụtụ ebe, ebe ndị na-erube isi n'iwu nwere ike ime azụmahịa n'enweghị mgbochi na na nzuzo. Òtù a kwenyere na e nweghị ọchịchị onwe onye na-enweghị Nzuzo [privacy], nakwa na Nzuzo ego kwesịrị ịbụ ọnọdụ ndabara, ebe ịnweta ahịa bụ ikike mmadụ. Nzụlite na Akụkọ Ihe Mere Eme ZODL (Zcash Open Development Lab) hiwere na mbido 2026 site n'aka Josh Swihart, onye bụbu CEO nke Electric Coin Company (ECC). Na Jenụwarị 2026, ndị otu injinịa na ngwaahịa nke ECC niile gbara arụkwaghịm mgbe esemokwu Gọọmentị [governance] na Bootstrap gasịrị, bụ bọọdụ enweghị uru 501(c)(3) nke na-ahụ maka ECC. Ndị otu isi bụ ndị haziri, mejuputa, ma lekọta usoro kacha dị mkpa nke Zcash na mbụ kwagara ZODL ka ha gaa n'ihu n'ọrụ ha n'onwe ha. E-akpa ego Zashi, nke e mepụtara ma lekọta n'okpuru ECC na mbụ, gbanwere aha ya ka ọ bụrụ ZODL n'okpuru òtù ọhụrụ ahụ. Ọ dịghị ihe ndị ọrụ kwesịrị ime, ebe ngwa ahụ gbanwere aha ya ozugbo n'oge mmelite sochirinụ. Ego Nkwado Na Maachị 2026, ZODL nwetara ihe karịrị nde $25 n'ego nkwado mmalite n'aka otu ndị itinye ego a ma ama, gụnyere: Paradigm a16z crypto Winklevoss Capital Coinbase Ventures Cypherpunk Technologies (itinye ego $5M) Chapter One David Friedberg Balaji Srinivasan Ndị ọzọ na-etinye ego angel sitere na ngalaba crypto na teknụzụ A na-eji ego a agbasawanye mmepe nke protocol Zcash na e-akpa ego ZODL. Ndị Ndú Josh Swihart - CEO & Onye Hibere Ya (onye bụbu CEO nke Electric Coin Company) Ndị otu sara mbara mejupụtara ndị mepụtara protocol Zcash mbụ na ndị onye mmepụta [developer] rụrụ ma lekọta Zcash na ECC na mbụ. Nke a gụnyere nka miri emi n'ihe gbasara cryptography, zero-knowledge proofs, na injinịa protocol. Ngwaahịa E-akpa ego ZODL (nke a na-akpọbu Zashi) ZODL bụ e-akpa ego mkpanaka onye nwe ya na-achịkwa n'onwe ya, e mere maka Azụmahia [transaction] Zcash nkeonwe. Ọ na-ejikọta ihe ọmụma miri emi nke ọkwa protocol na nhazi dị mfe maka ndị ọrụ, na-ezo mgbagwoju anya ma na-edobe nchekwa. Platform: iOS (App Store) Android (Play Store) F-Droid GitHub Njirimara Ndị Isi: Nke e chebere echebe [shielded] na Ndabara: Azụmahia niile na-eji pool nke e chebere echebe nke Zcash, na-ezo onye zitere, onye natara, na ọnụọgụ Azụmahia site n'iji cryptography zero-knowledge Ichebe n'Otu Pịa: Jiri otu pịa gbanwee ZEC Oha [transparent] ka ọ bụrụ ego nkeonwe CrossPay: Ziga ZEC nke e chebere echebe ebe ndị nnata na-enweta akụ ha họọrọ (BTC, stablecoins, wdg.) Mgbawe [swap] Nkeonwe: Mgbawe arụnyere n'ime ya nke NEAR Intents na-akwado, na-ezere exchange etiti Njikọ Keystone: Nkwado hardware wallet maka nchekwa oyi nke ZEC nke e chebere echebe site na ịbịanye aka Azụmahia n'enweghị njikọ Ịkwụ Ụgwọ Flexa: Jiri ZEC kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] n'ebe ndị na-ere ahịa ukwu gụnyere GameStop, Chipotle, Sheetz, na Barnes & Noble Njikọ Coinbase: Zụta ZEC ozugbo n'ime e-akpa ego na-enweghị ndebanye exchange dị iche Ozi Ezoro Ezo: Nzuzo nke ọkwa Zcash maka memo nke e chebere echebe n'akụkụ Azụmahia ma ọ bụ n'adabereghị na ya Adreesị Akpa Ego [address] Ejikọtara Ọnụ: Nlekọta Adreesị akpa ego dị mfe n'ofe pool Oha, Sapling, na Orchard Nkwado Tor: Nzuzo ọkwa netwọk emelitere maka mgbasa Azụmahia Nkwenye Nzuzo: Enweghị nsonye nke ọrụ e-akpa ego, akụkọ Azụmahia, ma ọ bụ omume onye ọrụ Naanị akụkọ ọdịda ezoro aha ka a na-anakọta, na-enweghị ike ijikọ data na ndị ọrụ kpọmkwem Ọrụ na Mmetụta Kemgbe mmalite mbụ ya dịka Zashi na 2024, e-akpa ego ahụ ewetaala uto dị ịrịba ama na gburugburu Zcash: Mere ka pool nke e chebere echebe Orchard too site n'ihe dị ka 1M ZEC ruo 4M ZEC n'oge 2025 (mmụba karịrị 400%) Haziela Mgbawe ZEC karịrị nde $600 kemgbe Ọktoba 2025 Ọrụ Ya na Gburugburu Zcash ZODL na-arụ ọrụ abụọ na gburugburu Zcash: Mmepe Protocol: Ndị otu ahụ na-aga n'ihu n'ịkwalite sọftụwia protocol isi Zcash na ngwá ọrụ [tools], na-arụkọ ọrụ na ndị otu gburugburu ndị ọzọ dịka Zcash Foundation na Zingo Labs Ngwaahịa Maka Ndị Ọrụ: Iwulit

title: Electric Coin Company (Ọdịda Anyanwụ)
description: Banyere njikọ GitHub ahụ. Ebe nchekwa ECC dị na zodl-inc. Nke ahụ bụ otu nzukọ ahụ, nke a gbanwere aha ya mgbe ndị otu ahụ kwagara ZODL. Ndị ọzọ na-enweghị…
text: Electric Coin Company (Ọdịda Anyanwụ) Weebụsaịtị - GitHub - X/Twitter Banyere njikọ GitHub ahụ. Ebe nchekwa ECC dị na zodl-inc. Nke ahụ bụ otu nzukọ ahụ, nke a gbanwere aha ya mgbe ndị otu ahụ kwagara ZODL. Ndị ọzọ na-enweghị njikọ debara aha ochie github.com/Electric-Coin-Company na Mee 2026, ọ nweghịkwa ihe jikọrọ ya na ECC ma ọ bụ ZODL, ya mere atụkwasịla koodu e bipụtara ebe ahụ obi. Nkwupụta Ebumnuche Ebumnuche na ECC bụ ime ka nnwere onwe akụ na ụba sie ike. Nzuzo ego [financial privacy] bụ isi nke mbọ a, ma dị mkpa iji chebe ùgwù mmadụ, nchekwa, ikike mmadụ ịchị onwe ya, na nkwenye. Inweta Nzuzo ego kwesịkwara ịdị mfe dịka imechi ákwà mgbochi n'ụlọ gị. Ma mgbe Web2 pụtara, ike aghọọla nke etinyere n'aka mmadụ ole na ole, ndị na-achịkwa ya abanyeworị n'ime ime ụlọ gị. Ị nweghị ike imechi ákwà mgbochi ahụ. Anyị ga-ewu ihe ọhụrụ. Usoro ọhụrụ a nke ngwá ọrụ ego, nke mmadụ niile nwere ike iji, ga-adị mfe maka ndị ọrụ, nwee Nzuzo zuru ezu ma nwee nhọrọ maka ikpughe ozi, akụrụngwa na-akwado ya ga-agbasakwa ma sie ike. Zodl, nke a na-akpọbu Zashi: iOS - Android - F-Droid E wuru maka Kwụọ ụhwọ Nzuzo [Private Payments]. Zashi bụ e-akpa ego [wallet] ZEC nke e chebere echebe [shielded] maka Azụmahia dijitalụ nwere Nzobe ederede [encrypted digital transactions], nke ECC wuru ma wepụta na 2024. E mere ya iji kpọbata ndị enyi na ezinụlọ n'ime Zcash na ịkwụ ụgwọ dijitalụ nke Nzuzo, site na njirimara dị mfe nke ga-eme ka ndị na-enwebughị ahụmịhe crypto nwee ike ịhazi e-akpa ego, nweta ZEC, ma malite Azụmahia n'ime nkeji ole na ole. A gbanwere aha e-akpa ego ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Zodl na Febrụwarị 2026 mgbe ndị otu ahụ kwagara ZODL. Ndị ọrụ dịbu adịghị mkpa ime ihe ọ bụla, ebe ngwa ahụ gbanwere aha ya n'oge mmelite ya ọzọ, nke mere njikọ ụlọ ahịa ndị dị n'elu ji emeghe Zodl. A na-elekọta ya ugbu a n'ebe ahụ kama ịbụ ECC, ya mere lee ibe ZODL ahụ maka ozi ugbu a. Njikọta e wuru n'oge afọ ECC: Coinbase: ndị ọhụrụ na crypto nwere ike ịzụta ZEC ozugbo n'ime e-akpa ego ahụ, na-enweghị nsogbu nke ịdebanye aha akaụntụ, KYC, na iwepụ mkpụrụ ego na exchange. Flexa: na-eme ka iji ZEC n'ezie dị mfe, na-enye ndị ọrụ ọhụrụ ohere imefu ya n'ọtụtụ puku ebe azụmaahịa dịka Barnes & Noble, GameStop, na Chipotle. Keystone: bụ nnukwu ọganihu maka obodo Zcash nke e jirila ọtụtụ afọ wulite. Njikọta a na-egosi nnukwu mmalite ọhụrụ n'ịdị mfe iji Zcash, site n'ikwe ka e debe ZEC nke e chebere echebe n'ebe nchekwa oyi. Nnyocha na Mmepe Ndị otu ahụ edugola ọganihu ndị a ma ama n'ọtụtụ oge, nke mbụ bụ mwepụta Zcash dịka ojiji azụmahịa mbụ n'ụwa nke Zero-Knowledge Proofs. Ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ sochiri, dịka Sapling network upgrade nke na-enye Azụmahia dị mfe karị, nke e chebere echebe, yana mbelata oge nke 90% maka iwulite Azụmahia, na mbelata ebe nchekwa karịrị 97%, nke mere ka Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe kwe omume na ngwaọrụ mkpanaaka maka oge mbụ. Ọganihu kachasị mkpa bụ nke kachasị ọhụrụ. Ịmepụta na itinye n'ọrụ usoro proof halo2 na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi na Network Upgrade 5 maka Zcash. Nke a wepụrụ trusted setup ma malite oge ọhụrụ maka Zcash. Kemgbe 2022, nke a na-arụ ọrụ na Mainnet Zcash ma na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere iji usoro dị nchebe karịa ma dị mfe imelite maka protocol Kwụọ ụhwọ ha. Mmekọrịta & Mmekorita Ndị otu ECC na-akwado ma na-atụnye aka n'usoro ndụ Zcash n'ọtụtụ ụzọ, na-esokwa ndị otu dị n'ime na ndị dị n'èzí arụkọ ọrụ mgbe niile iji nyere aka lekọta ma melite protocol Zcash. Mmekọrịta gụnyere iso Gemini arụ ọrụ iji mee Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe n'elu ikpo okwu ha, Flexa iji mee ka ịkwụ ụgwọ mkpanaaka Zcash dị mfe n'ebe azụmaahịa, ụlọ ọrụ hardware wallet dịka Keystone iji mee nchekwa oyi nke ZEC nke e chebere echebe, Brave maka nkwado Zcash na ihe nchọgharị, na ndị otu ndị ọzọ n'usoro ndụ Zcash iji wetara Zcash nkwalite. ECC bụkwa onye nkwado mpako nke PGPforCrypto, usoro nzukọ na-achịkọta ndị ọkachamara, ndị nwere mmasị, na ndị ọzụzụ na mpaghara cryptocurrency iji kparịta mmepe, kesaa nghọta, ma kwalite ntinye aka obodo. Onye otu Board na VP of Strategic Alliance

title: Zcash Foundation
description: Ebumnuche anyị na ZF bụ imepụta ngwá ọrụ [tools] ndị na-enyere aka ịkwado netwọk mepere emepe, na-eme ka onye ọ bụla nwee ike ichekwa Nzuzo [privacy] nke ya…
text: Zcash Foundation Nkwupụta Ebumnuche Ebumnuche anyị na ZF bụ imepụta ngwá ọrụ [tools] ndị na-enyere aka ịkwado netwọk mepere emepe, na-eme ka onye ọ bụla nwee ike ichekwa Nzuzo [privacy] nke ya n’usoro nke aka ya. Ihe bụ isi nke Nzuzo n’onwe ya bụ inwe ike ịhọrọ ihe a ga-ekekọrịta ma ọ bụ nke a gaghị ekekọrịta ndị ọzọ. Nzuzo gụnyere ma nnwere onwe ime mkpebi na nkwenye; ọ dị mkpa maka ugwu mmadụ na ịdịgide nke ọma nke ọha mmadụ. Ndị mmadụ na Otu Zcash Foundation nwere ihe dị ka ndị ọrụ 12 ndị gbasara n’ụwa niile. Ha na-elekwasị anya na mmepe protocol, nchekwa protocol, Gọọmentị [governance] protocol, mmepe akụrụngwa na ịhazi mmemme obodo Zcash. Zcash Foundation ejedebeghị n’ịrụ ọrụ naanị na Zcash, ya mere ọ na-etinyekwa aka n’ịmepụta teknụzụ na-echekwa Nzuzo maka enyemaka mmadụ na maka ọdịmma ọha n’ozuzu. Ikike [grant] Zcash Foundation na-enye ecosystem ụzọ isi kwado ego maka oru ngo ndị na-atụnye aka na ecosystem Nzuzo, dị ka Zebra (mmejuputa node onwe ya maka Zcash) & FROST, yana ọrụ ngo dị iche iche ọzọ site na Kọmitii Zcash Community Grants. Foundation na-emekwa Zcon, ogbako ihu-na-ihu kwa afọ nke lekwasịrị anya na ecosystem Zcash, ma na-akwado atụmatụ obodo sitere n’ala, dịka Zcon Vozes, ogbako kpọmkwem maka mpaghara, Zcash Foundation A/V Club, nke ugbu a bụ Zero Knowledge Audio Visual Club, yana oku obodo mepere emepe dị iche iche, mmemme obodo na AMA's. Zcash Foundation na-ahụ na a na-emezu iwu ụghalaahịa Zcash dịka ọnọdụ emelitere nke onyinye ya sitere n’aka Electric Coin Co. Nke a na-enyere aka “ichekwa aha ọma nke Zcash, ụlọ ọrụ ndị metụtara ya, na obodo Zcash” site n’“ịchọpụta isi mmalite ozi gọọmentị, na ibelata ohere nke ozi aghụghọ ma ọ bụ nke ezighi ezi” na “ịchọpụta ngwa na ọrụ gọọmentị, na ibelata ohere nke ọrụ aghụghọ.” Nhazi Òtù Zcash Foundation bụ ọrụ ebere 501(c)(3) na-adịghị akwụ ụtụ isi, nke anaghị achọ uru ọrụ ebere. Na mgbakwunye na Otu ha, ha nwere Kọmitii Ndị Isi Ndị nduzi ma na-eme ka ntuli aka Gọọmentị obodo kwe omume site n’ịjụ Zcash Otu Ndụmọdụ Obodo. Ego Zcash Foundation anaghịzi enweta ego site na Zcash ego mmepe [](https://zips.z.cash/zip-1014) kemgbe Nọvemba, 2024. A na-enweta ego maka Foundation ugbu a site n’onyinye [](https://www.jotform.com/form/251874383638065) ọdịnala nke a pụrụ iwepụ n’ụtụ isi. A pụrụ ịhụ otu ha si eji ego ha eme ihe na akụkọ Ngosipụta nke ha kwa nkeji afọ. Mmemme Zcash Community Grants https://zcashcommunitygrants.org/ Mmemme a na-enye ndị otu nọọrọ onwe ha ego iji rụọ nnukwu mmepe na-aga n’ihu (ma ọ bụ ọrụ ọzọ) nke na-abara ecosystem Zcash uru. Kọmitii mmadụ ise nke Otu Ndụmọdụ Obodo Zcash họpụtara na-ahọrọ ikike ndị a. A na-agba ndị otu na òtù nwere mmasị ịkwalite mfe iji, nchekwa, Nzuzo na nnabata nke Zcash ume ka ha tinye akwụkwọ maka Ikike Obodo Zcash! Verret Arti: ZF + ZCG Oku ya na Ọrụ Tor Oku Obodo maka Ntuli Aka ZCAP AMA ya na Onye Nduzi Isi ZF, Jack Gavigan Akụrụngwa Zcash mmepe na Gọọmentị

title: Zcash Community Grants
description: Mmemme Zcash Community Grants na-enye ndị otu nọọrọ onwe ha na-abanye n'usoro ihe dị ndụ nke Zcash ego, ka ha rụọ nnukwu mmepe na-aga n'ihu (ma ọ bụ ọrụ ọzọ)…
text: Zcash Community Grants Nkwupụta Ebumnuche Mmemme Zcash Community Grants na-enye ndị otu nọọrọ onwe ha na-abanye n'usoro ihe dị ndụ nke Zcash ego, ka ha rụọ nnukwu mmepe na-aga n'ihu (ma ọ bụ ọrụ ọzọ) maka ọdịmma ọha nke usoro ihe dị ndụ nke Zcash. Ndị mmadụ na Ndị otu Otu kọmitii, nke mmadụ ise mejupụtara ugbu a, na-ahụ maka Zcash Community Grants. Obodo a na-enyocha ma na-akwado akwụkwọ arịrịọ ikike sitere n'aka ndị otu nke atọ chọrọ iwulite n'elu protocol nke Zcash. Ozi ndị ọzọ gbasara Ndị otu Ọrụ ndị e kwadoro n'oge na-adịbeghị anya site na ZCG bụ Zcash Ngwá akụ nke e chebere echebe (ZSA) nke ndị otu QEDIT na-edu. Iwebata DeFi na ZEC site na Zcash, yana protocol Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] ọhụrụ na-agbakwunye atụmatụ ndị ọzọ na mainnet nke Zcash. Akwụkwọ ngosi dị mkpirikpi nke Zcash Media, nke nwere ndị Zcasher a ma ama dịka Edward Snowden, Zooko na Deirdre Connolly, nwere ebumnuche imepụta vidio dabara adaba, na-atọ ụtọ, na-akụzi ihe ka e kesaa ya n'ọtụtụ ebe. Mmekọrịta hardware wallet nke Ledger iji kwado Azụmahia [transaction] nke e chebere echebe nke Sapling n'uju; nke a na-enye ohere ka echekwa Zcash na nzuzo na n'enweghị nsogbu. Ndị otu Zondax rụrụ nke a. SDK maka usoro Kwụọ ụhwọ nke e chebere echebe, nke dị mfe iji otu pịa, na usoro ebe a na-ere ahịa maka ụlọ ahịa nkịtị, nke ZGo na-arụ. Mmemme Onye nnọchi anya zuru ụwa ọnụ na-enyere Zcash aka inweta nnọchite anya sara mbara n'ụwa niile nakwa maka mmemme obodo a na-eme n'onwe mmadụ gburugburu ụwa. Kọmitii ikike nke Zcash enyochala ọtụtụ ọrụ ndị ọzọ; lee Ndepụta zuru ezu, emelitere nke ọrụ ndị e nyefere. Nhazi Ọgbakọ Zcash Community Grants bụ ọgbakọ nọọrọ onwe ya na Electric Coin Company na Zcash Foundation. Ego Zcash Community Grants na-enweta 8% nke onyinye block, n'okpuru usoro ego e guzobere na NU6.1 site na ZIP 1016. Mgbasa ahụ malitere mgbe mgbasa mbụ nke ZIP 1015 kwụsịrị, ma ọ ga-adị ruo halving nke atọ nke Zcash na block 4,406,400 n'okpuru oghere block dị ugbu a. ZCG na-eji ego ndị a akwado ndị otu nọọrọ onwe ha n'ofe usoro ihe dị ndụ nke Zcash. Akụrụngwa Zcash mmepe na Gọọmentị governance Otu esi enyefe akwụkwọ arịrịọ ikike site na ZCG (GitHub + Forum Obodo) Nzọụkwụ 1: Kwadebe Aro Gị Mepụta aro doro anya gụnyere: Aha ọrụ na nkọwa onye na-achọ arịrịọ Nkwupụta nsogbu na azịza a tụrụ aro Ihe a ga-ebunye, usoro oge, na ihe ịrịba ama nke ọganihu Mmefu ego na arịrịọ maka ego Ahụmịhe dị mkpa na ihe ize ndụ --- Nzọụkwụ 2: Nyefee na GitHub Gaa na Zcash Community Grants ebe nchekwa GitHub Mepee taabụ Issues ma pịa New Issue Họrọ template akwụkwọ arịrịọ ikike kwesịrị ekwesị Dejupụta oghere niile achọrọ ma nyefee ya Issue nke GitHub bụ ndekọ gọọmentị nke akwụkwọ arịrịọ. --- Nzọụkwụ 3: Mepụta Post na Forum Obodo Gaa na Forum Obodo nke Zcash Mepụta thread ọhụrụ n'ụdị Zcash Community Grants Jiri otu aha ahụ dị na issue nke GitHub Tinye nchịkọta dị mkpirikpi ma tinye njikọ gaa na issue nke GitHub --- Nzọụkwụ 4: Soro na Nnyocha Nyochaa issue nke GitHub na thread forum Zaa ajụjụ na nzaghachi sitere na Kọmitii ZCG na obodo --- Nzọụkwụ 5: Nsonaazụ Aro a kwadoro na-aga n'ihu n'inweta ego na ịkọ akụkọ Aro a na-akwadoghị NWERE IKE idegharị ma nyefee ọzọ --- Rịba ama: GitHub bụ isi mmalite nke ndekọ; forum bụ maka mkparịta ụka ọhaneze.

title: Financial Privacy Foundation (FPF)
description: Financial Privacy Foundation (FPF) bụ òtù na-adịghị akwụ ụgwọ e hibere na Cayman Islands. Ebumnuche bụ isi FPF bụ ịkụziri na inye ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu na…
text: Financial Privacy Foundation (FPF) Banyere FPF Financial Privacy Foundation (FPF) bụ òtù na-adịghị akwụ ụgwọ e hibere na Cayman Islands. Ebumnuche bụ isi FPF bụ ịkụziri na inye ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu na obodo ike ka ha chịkwaa Nzuzo ego [financial privacy] na nchekwa ha. FPF kwenyekwara n'ịkwalite usoro ego ziri ezi na nke nhatanha nke na-akwanyere Nzuzo onwe onye ùgwù. Ọrụ bụ isi FPF metụtara Nzuzo ego bụ inye ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu na obodo ozi, akụrụngwa na nkwado iji chebe ma bulie Nzuzo ego ha elu. Financial Privacy Fund (FPF) na-emepụta ugbu a mmemme ikike [grant] akpọrọ FPF X FPF. Ozi gbasara FPF X FPF FPF X FPF gbasara mmemme ikike nnwale mbụ FPF, Financial Privacy Fund (FPF x FPF). Mmemme a ga-akwado ego maka ọrụ injinịa dị n'ime usoro gburugburu ebe obibi Zcash ndị fọrọ obere ka ha gwụchaa, ma ọ bụ ọrụ ndị ga-enye aka ozugbo na usoro gburugburu ebe obibi ahụ ma nwee ike gwụchaa n'ime oge na oke ego akọwapụtara. FPF X FPF ji ego pere mpe malite iji mee ka usoro inye ikike dị mma, ma nwee olileanya ịmalite agba n'ọdịnihu. Mmemme Ọrụ Ọgwọ FPF x ZecHub - Edemede Blọọgụ Nkọwa Mmemme FPF X FPF Nkọwa Mmemme FPF X FPF: FPF nwere ọtụtụ nkọwa n'ime mmemme ya, ndị a bụ: Ọnụ Ego: Ruo $50,000 USD Arịrịọ Kachasị Elu: $25,000 USD Ihe KYC Chọrọ: Ọ dịghị Ụdị Ọrụ: Naanị ọrụ injinịa ndị nwere ike ịbara usoro gburugburu ebe obibi Zcash uru kpọmkwem ma nwee ike gwụchaa nke ọma ka a ga-atụle. Kwụọ ụhwọ [Payment]: Mgbe arụchara ọrụ ahụ nke ọma Ụbọchị Mmalite: March 18, 2024 Usoro Itinye Akwụkwọ Maka Ikike Usoro itinye akwụkwọ maka ikike FPF X FPF gụnyere ọtụtụ usoro. Nke mbụ, ndị na-achọ itinye akwụkwọ ga-etinye akwụkwọ maka ikike ahụ site n'ụdị echekwara enyere. Mgbe ahụ, FPF ga-enyocha akwụkwọ arịrịọ ahụ maka ntozu, a ga-agwakwa ndị na-achọ itinye akwụkwọ ọnọdụ ha n'ime ụbọchị kalenda 5 mgbe oge njedebe itinye akwụkwọ gachara. Ọzọ, kọmitii nyocha pụrụ iche ga-enyocha ma kpebie maka onyinye ikike n'ime ụbọchị kalenda 20 mgbe oge njedebe nnyefe gachara. A ga-ebipụta nkọwa ikike e nyere na webụsaịtị FPF maka nghọta na ịza ajụjụ. Ozi Ndị Ọzọ Banyere FPF X FPF Enwere ike ịhụ ozi ndị ọzọ gbasara FPF X FPF na webụsaịtị Financial Privacy Fun (FPF) ebe a; ọ bụrụkwa na ị ka nwere mmasị ịmata gbasara mmemme FPF X FPF, ị nwere ike ịga na akwụkwọ Ajụjụ A Na-ajụkarị ebe a: Ajụjụ A Na-ajụkarị. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere mmasị ịbụ Onye Nyocha Afọ Ofufo maka agba a nke mmemme FPF X FPF, biko gaa na njikọ a. Maka ajụjụ ndị ọzọ gbasara Mmemme Ikike FPF X FPF, ị nwere ike ịjụ ozugbo site n'iziga ozi-e FPF. Akụrụngwa Financial Privacy Fund

title: Shielded Labs
description: Shielded Labs bụ òtù nkwado Zcash nọọrọ onwe ya, nke onyinye na-akwado, nke dị na Switzerland. Ebumnuche ya bụ iwulite ego nkeonwe a na-apụghị ịkwụsị akwụsị…
text: Shielded Labs Shielded Labs bụ òtù nkwado Zcash nọọrọ onwe ya, nke onyinye na-akwado, nke dị na Switzerland. Ebumnuche ya bụ iwulite ego nkeonwe a na-apụghị ịkwụsị akwụsị nke na-enye nnwere onwe mmadụ na ikike ịchị onwe ya ike, na-elekwasị anya n'ọrụ na-akwalite ịdịgide adịgide, nchekwa, na scaling [scaling] nke netwọk Zcash. Shielded Labs na-agbakwunye ikike injinịa nọọrọ onwe ya n'usoro ihe omume Zcash. Ọ bụghị akụkụ nke Electric Coin Company, Zcash Foundation, ma ọ bụ Zcash Community Grants, ma ọ na-akọwa onwe ya dịka òtù mbụ n'usoro ihe omume Zcash nke na-enwetabeghị ego ozugbo ma ọ bụ n'ụzọ na-apụtaghị ìhè site na Development Fund ma ọ bụ ụgwọ ọrụ block [block]. Ebumnuche na Ọrụ Shielded Labs na-elekwasị anya n'ọrụ protocol na akụrụngwa nke pụrụ ime ka Zcash sie ike karị n'ime ogologo oge. Ihe ndị ọ na-ebipụta n'ihu ọha na-ekwusi ike na: Nnwere onwe mmadụ na Nzuzo [privacy] nke ego Ego nkwado nọọrọ onwe ya na-abụghị nke Development Fund Ịkwanyere ndị ji ZEC na ntinye echiche ndị ji coin ugwu Ikike ndị ọrụ ịchị onwe ha na ikike ịchị onwe onye Nrụpụta teknụzụ maka ịdịgide adịgide, nchekwa, na scaling Isonye ndị ntinye aka Zcash ndị ọzọ Òtù a na-enye aka site n'injinịa ozugbo, nyocha ọha, nkwado akụrụngwa, na ịhazi usoro ihe omume. Ọ na-edobekwa akụrụngwa ọha maka nyocha echiche Gọọmentị [governance] na ego ndị ji coin na-eduzi, na-enyere ndị otu obodo Zcash aka ịghọta mgbe na otú ha nwere ike isi sonye n'echiche Gọọmentị. Ọrụ Ndị Dị Ugbu a Shielded Labs na-edepụta n'ihu ọha ọtụtụ ebe ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ: Usoro Ịdịgide Adịgide nke Netwọk - Nhazi mgbanwe ndị a tụrụ aro iji kwado mmefu ego nchekwa ogologo oge nke Zcash ma na-echekwa oke nnyefe ZEC nke nde 21. Ọrụ NSM gụnyere ọkụ ZEC nke afọ ofufo, ime ka mwepụta dị nro, na atụmatụ ọkụ ugwo [fee] ndị akọwara na ZIP 233, 234, na 235. Crosslink - Network upgrade [network upgrade] consensus [consensus] ngwakọ a tụrụ aro nke ga-ejikọta mmepụta block proof-of-work nke Zcash na njedebe proof-of-stake, ka ndị ji ZEC wee nyere aka ichekwa netwọk ahụ ebe ndị na-egwụputa [miner] na-aga n'ihu na-emepụta block. Ugwo Na-agbanwe Agbanwe - Nnyocha na ngwaọrụ maka ugwo Azụmahia [transaction] Zcash nke a pụrụ ịkọ amụma nke ọma, dịrị ndị ọrụ mfe, ma sie ike ka netwọk ahụ na-agbanwe. Zero - Ngwugwu a kwadoro nke sọftụwia akụrụngwa Zcash mepere emepe maka exchange [exchange], pool [pool] ịgwụputa [mining], ndị na-enye e-akpa ego [wallet], na òtù ndị ọzọ dabere n'akụrụngwa Zcash. Ironwood - Network upgrade na pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded] Zcash e kere na nzaghachi nye adịghị ike ịgha ego ụgha Orchard, nke e mere iji weghachite izi ezi a pụrụ ikwenye n'onwe ya nke nnyefe ego na-ekesa nke Zcash. Epoch - Ọrụ nyocha na injinịa ekwuputara na Ọktoba 2026 iji mepụta cryptography post-quantum dị njikere maka mmepụta, nke nwere mmesi obi ike dị elu maka Zcash, ma gbasaa nkwenye n'ụdị iwu nke akụkụ cryptographic dị mkpa. Ọrụ a na-achọ mmejuputa dị njikere maka mmepụta tupu ngwụcha 2027 nke pụrụ ịbụ ntọala network upgrade n'ọdịnihu. Ọ na-akwado Project Tachyon na mgbalị post-quantum ndị ọzọ n'ofe usoro ihe omume. Epoch na otu cryptography N'Ọktoba 2026, Shielded Labs malitere Epoch, mgbalị pụrụ iche iji kwadebe Zcash maka ọdịnihu megide mgbakọ quantum, mwakpo AI na-enyere aka, na iyi egwu ndị ọzọ dị elu. title: Valar Group
description: Valar Group bụ nzukọ injinia nwere onwe ya nke lekwasịrị anya na scaling Zcash, ime ka Gọọmentị ndị ji coin sie ike, na imezi Nzuzo, arụmọrụ, na nkwụsi ike…
text: Valar Group Gaa na weebụsaịtị Nkwupụta Ebumnuche Valar Group bụ nzukọ injinia nwere onwe ya nke lekwasịrị anya na scaling Zcash, ime ka Gọọmentị ndị ji coin sie ike, na imezi Nzuzo, arụmọrụ, na nkwụsi ike ogologo oge nke protocol. Ọrụ ya gbadoro ụkwụ na akụrụngwa n'ọkwa protocol: ịtụ vootu nzuzo nke ndị ji token, ngwanrọ full node na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma, teknụzụ mmekọrịta e-akpa ego, na network upgrade ndị na-eme ka Azụmahia Zcash nke e chebere echebe dị mfe iji n'ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ka ukwuu. Nzukọ a chọrọ inye ndị ji ZEC ụzọ ha ga-esi kwupụta mmasị ha na nzuzo, inye ndị na-arụ node ngwanrọ dị ngwa ma nwekwuo ikike, ma nye e-akpa ego ngwá ọrụ na-echekwa Nzuzo ndị ọrụ ebe ha na-ebelata ọnụ ahịa isonye na network. Ndabere Valar Group bụ Dev Ojha (ValarDragon) na-edu ya, onye bụ otu n'ime ndị hibere Osmosis na onye so n'òtù malitere Cosmos. N'ime afọ iri gara aga, ọ rụrụ ọrụ n'akụkụ zk-SNARKs, consensus BFT, na sistemụ DeFi eji eme ihe n'ezie. Ọrụ ọha otu a na Zcash ghọrọ nke a ma ama mgbe ecosystem gbanwere gaa n'òtù protocol nwere onwe ha mgbe nhazigharị mmepe bụ isi nke 2026 gasịrị. Valar Group pụtara dịka otu n'ime nzukọ ndị na-ewu ọgbọ ọzọ nke akụrụngwa Zcash n'akụkụ Project Tachyon, Shielded Labs, ZODL, na Zcash Foundation. Isiokwu na-alọghachi n'ọrụ ya bụ na njirimara Nzuzo nke Zcash kwesịrị ịgafe Kwụọ ụhwọ. Ọ bụrụ na a gwa ndị ji ego ka ha tụọ vootu gbasara issuance, oge block, ma ọ bụ oke network upgrade, ha kwesịrị inwe ike ime nke a site na balances nke e chebere echebe na-ekpugheghị njirimara, balances, ma ọ bụ vootu onye ọ bụla. Ihe a chọrọ mere ka Valar Group chepụta ma wepụta chain pụrụ iche maka ịtụ vootu ndị ji coin. Otu ndabere ahụ n'ihe gbasara scaling na cryptography kpụkwara ọrụ node na sync ya. A na-ahụ block ngwa ngwa, mmekọrịta e-akpa ego dị mfe, na full node nwere ikike ka ukwuu dịka ihe dị mkpa maka ego nzuzo nwere ike iji n'ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ network Kwụọ ụhwọ, kama ịbụ naanị ụlọ nchekwa uru. Ọhụụ Ihe ndị Valar Group bipụtara n'ihu ọha na ọrụ ya na-atụ aka n'ebe network Zcash nwere ike: Ịkwado ịtụ vootu nzuzo nke ndị ji coin, nke a pụrụ inyocha, dịka usoro Gọọmentị a na-eme ugboro ugboro. Ime ka Kwụọ ụhwọ proof-of-work buru ibu n'achụghị Nzuzo nke e chebere echebe n'àjà. Ibelata ihe na-egbochi e-akpa ego na node site na PIR, pruning, na mgbasa block ngwa ngwa. Ịbawanye ịdị iche nke implementation site n'iwepụta stack full node nwere onwe ya. Inye aka n'ịdị njikere post-quantum na network upgrade protocol a nyochara n'ụzọ iwu kwadoro. Nzukọ a na-arụ ọrụ dịka onye ntinye aka nwere onwe ya, ọ bụghị dịka onye nwe protocol. Mgbanwe protocol ka na-agafe na ZIP, implementation, nyochaa, na mgbaama obodo. Ọrụ Valar Group bụ ichepụta, imejuputa, ịrụ ọrụ, na imeghe isi mmalite nke sistemụ ndị na-eme ka usoro ndị ahụ baa uru n'ezie. Mpaghara Atụmatụ Ọrụ Valar Group gbakọtara gburugburu mpaghara anọ. Gọọmentị Nzuzo nke Ndị Ji Coin Zcash anaghị eji njikwa protocol on-chain akpaka. Ntuli aka ndị ji coin bụ mgbaama ndụmọdụ na-abanye n'usoro consensus sara mbara. Valar Group wuru Tokenholder Voting Chain ka e wee nwee ike ịnakọta mgbaama ndị ahụ site na balances nke e chebere echebe n'ekpugheghị njirimara onye ntuli aka ma ọ bụ nha vootu onye ọ bụla. Nhazi dị ugbu a ji: Chain ngwa SDK pụrụ iche nke Cosmos iji hazie gburugburu ịtụ vootu. Snapshot proof megide note Ironwood enwere ike imefu. Nzobe ederede homomorphic nke oke vootu. Private Information Retrieval maka proof na nullifier abụghị onye otu. Multisig onye nhazi na ikike ntuli aka kesara ekesa. Ebumnuche bụ iji sistemụ a pụrụ iji ọzọ, a nyochara, ma e-akpa ego nwere ike ijikọ dochie usoro ịtụ vootu ndị ji token gara aga, nke nzukọ ndị ọzọ nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ ma gụọ ngụkọta ya n'onwe ha. title: Zcash Labs
description: Zcash Labs bụ otu nzukọ nọọrọ onwe ya nke lekwasịrị anya n'itinye n'ọrụ, ijikọta, na ịnabata Zcash na akụ dijitalụ ya, ZEC. Zcash Labs na-enyere azụmahịa, ụlọ…
text: Zcash Labs --- Zcash Labs bụ otu nzukọ nọọrọ onwe ya nke lekwasịrị anya n'itinye n'ọrụ, ijikọta, na ịnabata Zcash na akụ dijitalụ ya, ZEC. Zcash Labs na-enyere azụmahịa, ụlọ ọrụ, ndị mmepụta, na ọrụ nọọrọ onwe ha chọrọ iji teknụzụ Zcash na ngwaahịa, ọrụ, usoro Kwụọ ụgwọ, ma ọ bụ ngwa ndị a pụrụ iji n'ọnọdụ ụwa n'ezie. Zcash Labs na-akọwa onwe ya dị ka nzukọ go to market maka Zcash. N'ọnọdụ go to market, nke a pụtara inyere aka ibuga teknụzụ Zcash site n'ikike nka dị ugbu a ruo n'itinye ya n'ọrụ nke azụmahịa na ndị ọrụ pụrụ iji. Iji mezuo ebumnuche a, Zcash Labs na-ejikọta ndụmọdụ, injinịa ngwọta, njikọta nka, ịrụ ọrụ akụrụngwa, njikwa ngwaahịa, ego mmalite, nkwado ego, na ịre ahịa ọnụ n'otu usoro lekwasịrị anya na mmalite ngwaahịa na ojiji n'ụwa n'ezie. Zcash Labs na-ekwu na nzukọ a nọọrọ onwe ya, ọ bụghịkwa onye mmekọ nke Zcash Foundation. Ọnọdụ nnwere onwe a na-enye Zcash Labs ohere ikpebi n'onwe ya ọrụ, njikọta, na akụrụngwa ọ chọrọ ịkwado site n'iji ihe onwunwe na ego dị n'okpuru ọrụ nzukọ a. --- Ndabere E webatara Zcash Labs n'ihu ọha site na weebụsaịtị gọọmentị ya na August 6, 2026. Na August 12, 2026, Zcash Labs wee webata ọrụ ya n'obodo site na Zcash Community Forum n'ọkwa a kpọrọ Announcing Zcash Labs A Zcash Go To Market Company. N'agbanyeghị na e mere ọkwa ọha na August 2026, Zcash Labs na-ekwu na ọrụ ya amalitelarị tupu ọkwa ahụ. Zcash Labs na-arụkọ ọrụ na ọrụ ndị ji Zcash ma na-enyere na usoro mmepe tupu ewebata njirimara Zcash Labs n'ụzọ sara mbara. Otu ihe atụ mbụ e mechara kpọsaara ọha bụ itinye aka ya na mmepe zcashtocash. Mpụta nke Zcash Labs metụtara mkpa iji belata oghere dị n'etiti teknụzụ Zcash dị ugbu a na ikike azụmahịa ma ọ bụ ndị mmepụta iji ya. Otu ụlọ ọrụ pụrụ inwe mkpa kwekọrọ na Zcash mana ọ maghị teknụzụ a chọrọ, otu esi ejikọta ya, ma ọ bụ akụrụngwa iji ya. N'otu oge ahụ, ọrụ ọhụrụ pụrụ inwe echiche na-ekwe nkwa mana chọọ enyemaka nka, njikwa ngwaahịa, ego mkpụrụ, ma ọ bụ nkwado iji ruo n'ogo mmepụta. Zcash Labs na-arụ ọrụ n'ebe ahụ site n'inye nkwado nke na-ejikọta mkpa azụmahịa na ndị mmepụta na teknụzụ Zcash. Usoro Zcash Labs na-amalite site n'ịghọta nsogbu ma ọ bụ mkpa otu nzukọ. Ozugbo aghọtara mkpa ndị ahụ, Zcash Labs na-enyocha ma Zcash bụ teknụzụ dabara adaba. Ọ bụrụ na ha kwekọrọ, Zcash Labs na-enyere aka ikpebi usoro nka a pụrụ iji wuo njikọta ahụ. Oge a pụrụ ịgụnye ịhọrọ teknụzụ Zcash dị, ịmepụta nhazi usoro, ikpebi mkpa akụrụngwa, na imepụta akụkụ ndị ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na ngwọta ndị dị ugbu a ezughị. Site n'usoro a, Zcash Labs pụrụ itinye aka site na mkparịta ụka mbụ gbasara Ojiji ruo mgbe usoro na-arụ ọrụ n'ezie. Nke a bụ ntọala ọnọdụ Zcash Labs dị ka nzukọ nọọrọ onwe ya n'ime gburugburu Zcash nke na-abanye n'ahịa, n'ihi na ọrụ ya anaghị akwụsị na nhazi ma ọ bụ mmepe nka, kama ọ gụnyekwara usoro iweta ngwọta n'ojiji ụwa n'ezie. --- Ebumnuche Kacha Mkpa nke Zcash Labs Ebumnuche bụ isi Zcash Labs nwere bụ ịkwalite nnabata sara mbara nke Zcash site n'inye nkwado ndị na-ewu ọrụ pụrụ iji ozugbo. A na-achụ ebumnuche a site n'ọtụtụ ụzọ dị mkpa: inyere azụmahịa na ụlọ ọrụ aka ikpebi ma Zcash dabara mkpa ha, inyere aka na usoro njikọta nka, inye nkwado akụrụngwa, na inye ego mkpụrụ maka ọrụ nwere ike ịgbasa nnabata Zcash. Zcash Labs na-achọ ọ bụghị naanị ịbawanye ọnụ ọgụgụ ọrụ ndị ji Zcash, kamakwa ibelata ihe mgbochi ntinye maka ndị enweghị ahụmịhe nka miri emi. Maka nke ahụ, ha na-enye usoro zuru ezu nke na-amalite n'ịnata ndụmọdụ, soro ya bụ mmepe atụmatụ, itinye nka n'ọrụ, ma, ọ bụrụ na ewere ọrụ ahụ dị ka nke na-ekwe nkwa, nkwado ego. --- Mpaghara Ọrụ Isi nke Zcash Labs Dị ka weebụsaịtị gọọmentị ya si kwuo, Zcash Labs depụtara ụzọ anọ isi akwado iji Zcash. Nke mbụ, ọ na-enye ndụmọdụ na ntụziaka iji nyochaa ma Zcash kwekọrọ na mkpa azụmahịa ma ọ bụ ọrụ otu nzukọ. Nke abụọ, ha na-enye nkwado nka na ngwọta itinye n'ọrụ maka ụlọ ọrụ ndị na-ejikọta ugbu a ma ọ bụ na-eme atụmatụ ijikọta Zcash. Nke atọ, ha na-ekesa ikike mkpụrụ ma na-enyere aka ịhazi ịre ahịa ọnụ ka ọrụ wee ruo ndị na-ege ntị kwes

title: Ikike [Grants] Nlaghachi Azụ nke Ndị Jidere Mkpụrụ Ego Na-eduzi
description: Mmemme Ikike Nlaghachi Azụ nke Ndị Jidere Mkpụrụ Ego Na-eduzi na-akwado ọrụ e mechara nke wetaworo uru a pụrụ ịchọpụta n'ime usoro gburugburu ebe obibi Zcash.
text: Ikike [Grants] Nlaghachi Azụ nke Ndị Jidere Mkpụrụ Ego Na-eduzi Mmemme Ikike Nlaghachi Azụ nke Ndị Jidere Mkpụrụ Ego Na-eduzi na-akwado ọrụ e mechara nke wetaworo uru a pụrụ ịchọpụta n'ime usoro gburugburu ebe obibi Zcash. Ọ na-enweta ego site na Ego Ndị Jidere Mkpụrụ Ego Na-achịkwa (12% nke ụgwọ ọrụ block + mkpụrụ nchekwa Deferred Dev Fund Lockbox), nke ZIP 1016 hibere ma rụọ ọrụ na NU6.1 (Nọvemba 2025). Mmemme a na-agba kwa nkeji afọ ruo halving nke 3 (2028). A na-edobe ego ahụ na multisig site n'aka Otu Ndị Ji Igodo (dịka, Shielded Labs, FPF). --- Ikike ndị a bụ naanị nke nlaghachi azụ - ha na-akwụghachi onyinye emere n'oge gara aga (dịka, mmepe, njikọta, iwulite obodo). Ọrụ a ga-arụ n'ọdịnihu kwesịrị itinye akwụkwọ na Zcash Community Grants (ZCG, 8% nke ụgwọ ọrụ). --- Ngwa Ndị Tozuru Ezu Nlebara anya: Ọrụ e mechara, nke ọha nwere ike ịchọpụta, nke na-abara Zcash uru (Nzuzo [privacy], nnabata, ngwaọrụ ọrụ, nchekwa). Ụkpụrụ (ndị jidere mkpụrụ ego na-enyocha): Mmetụta egosipụtara na uru e wetara. Nkwado ụkpụrụ Zcash (Nzuzo, decentralization [decentralization]). Ihe akaebe doro anya (koodu, akụkọ, metrik). Enweghị mmachi: Onye ọ bụla (ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu, otu, òtù) nwere ike itinye akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ka a họpụta ya. Atụmatụ na-asọ mpi: A na-atụ vootu maka nke ọ bụla iche; nkwado ZEC kachasị elu na-emeri. Enwere ike ịjụ: Ndị Ji Igodo nwere ike ịjụ maka okwu iwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ nye ndị ọrụ/obodo (nke a na-adịkarị ụkọ, yana ihe kpatara ya). Otu Esi Eziga Akwụkwọ Ngwa Kwadebe Atụmatụ: Kọwaa ọrụ e mechara, mmetụta, ihe akaebe (njikọ, ihe e nyere). Kọwaa ego a rịọrọ (ZEC/nha USD) na ihe kpatara ya. Tinye Adreesị akpa ego maka ịkwụ ụgwọ na kọntaktị. Nyefee: Bipụta na Zcash Community Forum (forum.zcashcommunity.com) n'ime ngalaba Ikike. Aha: "[Ikike Nlaghachi Azụ] - [Aha Ọrụ]". Jiri usoro markdown doro anya. Oge Ikpeazụ: Kwa nkeji afọ; a na-ekwupụta ya na forum/X (dịka, Q4 2025: Ọktoba 12, 2025, 11:59 PM UTC). Akwụkwọ ezitere n'azụ oge: Zigharịa ya na okirikiri ọzọ ma ọ bụ tinye akwụkwọ na ZCG. Soro na Mkparịta ụka: Zaa ajụjụ obodo n'oge nyocha ụbọchị 30. note: FPF na-ahụ maka nchịkwa (nnabata iwu, nkwurịta okwu); a na-achịkọta atụmatụ na GitHub maka ịhụ ha n'ụzọ doro anya. Usoro na Oge Ntuli Vootu Oge Kwa Nkeji Afọ (dịka, Q4 2025, Q1 2026): Oge Ikpeazụ Maka Nyefe: N'etiti nkeji afọ (a na-ekwupụta ya). Nyocha Ụbọchị 30: Ọ na-amalite mgbe oge ikpeazụ gachara; mkparịta ụka/nzaghachi na eriri forum (a na-emekarị eriri nchịkọta). Oge Ntuli Vootu: Ọ na-esote nyocha (dịka, izu 1-2 na Nọvemba maka Q4). Nsonaazụ na Ịkwụ Ego: N'oge na-adịghị anya mgbe e mesịrị; a na-akwụ ikike akwadoro dịka usoro si dị (KYC maka >$50k). Ntuli Vootu: Ndị jidere mkpụrụ ego na-eji njide ZEC ha atụ vootu (enweghị mkpọchi; pool Orchard tozuru eru). Usoro: Ntuli nke decentralized (dịka, site n'aka ndị ikike ntuli vootu). Nkwado: opekata mpe mmadụ 420,000 ZEC maka quorum [quorum] + ọtụtụ dị mfe kweta. Ntuli vootu onwe ha; enwere ike iji mkpụrụ ego ọzọ n'ofe atụmatụ. Nsonaazụ ọha na eze, doro anya. note: Okirikiri Ugbu a (ka ọ dị na Jenụwarị 5, 2026): Q4 2025 akwụsịla (ntuli vootu Nọvemba); a na-atụ anya ngwa Q1 2026 n'oge adịghị anya - na-enyocha forum maka ọkwa. Mmelite Kacha Ọhụrụ: Lelee ngalaba Ikike nke Zcash Community Forum. Usoro a nwere ike ịgbanwe dabere na nzaghachi obodo.

title: Sovright
description: Sovright bụ òtù na-enweghị uru US 501(c3) raara onwe ya nye ịkwado nnwere onwe mmadụ. Malite n'ilekwasị anya na akụrụngwa Zcash, ịgwụputa, mmepe protocol, na…
text: Sovright Sovright bụ òtù na-enweghị uru US 501(c3) raara onwe ya nye ịkwado nnwere onwe mmadụ. Malite n'ilekwasị anya na akụrụngwa Zcash, ịgwụputa, mmepe protocol, na nkwado ecosystem, ọrụ a na-ewu ngwá ọrụ na ọrụ ezubere iji wusie akụrụngwa ego dijitalụ nkeonwe ike ma kwado nguzogide ogologo oge nke netwọk Zcash. A maara Sovright na mbụ dị ka Bootstrap. Aha mbụ ahụ gosipụtara ebumnuche mbụ nke òtù ahụ ịmalite ụlọ ọrụ akụrụngwa Zcash site na mmalite. Gaa na saịtị Aha Aha Sovright bụ ngwakọta nke sovereign na right. Ọ na-egosipụta ilekwasị anya nke òtù ahụ na ọchịchị onwe onye, Nzuzo [privacy], na ikike ịhọrọ otú e si achịkwa data onwe onye, ego, nkwukọrịta, compute, na ọrụ ịntanetị. Ọrụ Sovright malitere na Zcash, cryptocurrency na-echekwa Nzuzo nke na-eji cryptography zero-knowledge akwado Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe. Ka oge na-aga, ilekwasị anya nke òtù ahụ gbasapụrụ karịa ego nkeonwe iji tinye nchegbu akụrụngwa sara mbara, gụnyere nkwukọrịta echekwara, netwọk na-adịgide adịgide, compute nkeonwe, na mmekorita AI echekwara. Pool Ịgwụputa Sovright na-arụ ọrụ pool ịgwụputa Zcash na: mining.sovright.com E mere Pool Ịgwụputa Sovright iji kwado ọchịchị onwe onye nke onye na-egwụputa ma belata itinye uche pool ịgwụputa n'otu ebe. Itinye uche pool ịgwụputa n'otu ebe bụ nchegbu na-emegharị emegharị n'ime netwọk proof-of-work n'ihi na ọnụ ọgụgụ nta nke pool nwere ike mechaa chịkwaa nnukwu akụkụ nke hashrate [hashrate] netwọk. Nke a nwere ike ime ka decentralized ghara ịdị ike ma mụbaa ịdabere n'omume ndị na-ahụ maka nnukwu pool. Pool Ịgwụputa Sovright bụ maka ndị na-egwụputa naanị ha, ndị ọrụ nta, na ndị sonyere ọzọ chọrọ ịkwado ecosystem ịgwụputa Zcash nke decentralized karịa. Pool ahụ na-emesi ike n'usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ Oha, ikike nyocha, na ugwo ọrụ dị ntakịrị. Ụdị testnet dị ugbu a anaghị enye ịkwụ ụgwọ ma ọ bụ naanị maka nnwale. (Na-abịa n'oge adịghị anya) Nkwụsi Ike Netwọk Nkwụsi ike netwọk na-ezo aka n'ịdabere na ike nke akụrụngwa na-ebufe Azụmahia Zcash. Azụmahia nkeonwe anaghị adabere naanị na cryptography, kama ọ daberekwa na nnweta na ntụkwasị obi nke akụrụngwa netwọk dị n'okpuru ha. Sovright na-achọpụta nkwụsi ike netwọk dị ka mpaghara ọrụ ntọala maka ijigide nchekwa na ojiji bara uru nke Zcash. Ọchịchị Onwe Ego Ọchịchị onwe ego na-ezo aka n'ikike ndị mmadụ nwere ịchịkwa ma nweta ego nke ha n'enweghị ịdabere na nkwenye sitere n'aka ndị etiti. N'ọnọdụ Zcash, nke a gụnyere Kwụọ ụhwọ nkeonwe, ijide ego n'onwe, na akụrụngwa nke na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ime Azụmahia n'usoro nke ha. Sovright na-ewere inweta ego na ego ndị ọrụ na-achịkwa dị ka akụkụ bụ isi nke ọchịchị onwe onye.

title: Obscura Labs
description: Obscura Labs bụ otu nọọrọ onwe ya edebanyere aha na Nigeria, nke lekwasịrị anya n'ụzọ atụmatụ na Africa na ahịa ndị ọzọ na-apụta.
text: Obscura Labs Gaa na weebụsaịtị Nkwupụta Ebumnuche Obscura Labs bụ otu nọọrọ onwe ya edebanyere aha na Nigeria, nke lekwasịrị anya n'ụzọ atụmatụ na Africa na ahịa ndị ọzọ na-apụta. Ebumnuche ya bụ iwulite akụrụngwa, ngwá ọrụ [tools], na ụzọ bara uru nke ikwado nnabata, nke na-eme ka ịnweta, uru, decentralized [decentralization], na iguzogide ogologo oge nke usoro gburugburu Zcash kawanye mma n'ofe Africa. Otu a na-achọ ịkwado iji teknụzụ ego na-echekwa Nzuzo [privacy] site n'ime ka ịnweta akụrụngwa a pụrụ ịdabere na ya kawanye mma, ịkwado ndị mmepụta [developers] na azụmahịa, ịkụziri ndị ọrụ ihe, na ime ka obodo Zcash dị n'ógbè ahụ sie ike. Ndabere Obscura Labs bụ Chidi Olisa hiwere, onye ndu Zcash Nigeria. Tupu o hiwe Obscura Labs, Chidi nyere aka na usoro gburugburu Zcash site n'iwulite obodo, agụmakwụkwọ, nkwado, imepụta ọdịnaya dabara n'ógbè, ịkwado ndị ọrụ, na atụmatụ e mere iji webata ndị nọ na Nigeria na akụkụ ndị ọzọ nke Africa na Nzuzo ego na Zcash. Mmekọrịta ya na ndị ọrụ, ụmụ akwụkwọ, ndị mmepụta, azụmahịa, na ndị otu obodo mere ka a mata ọtụtụ ihe mgbochi nye nnabata Zcash sara mbara n'ofe Africa. Ndị a gụnyere akụrụngwa pere mpe, ihe isi ike n'inweta ZEC site na ego obodo, nkwado ezughị ezu maka ndị mmepụta, ụkọ ihe mmụta edoziri maka ógbè, na njikọta pere mpe na usoro Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] a na-eji kwa ụbọchị. E kere Obscura Labs iji zaghachi ihe ịma aka ndị a. Otu a dabere n'echiche na ịmara ihe naanị ya ezughị maka nnabata na-adịgide adịgide. Obodo chọkwara akụrụngwa a pụrụ ịdabere na ya, ngwaahịa dị mfe ịnweta, ngwá ọrụ onye mmepụta, ohere ego, agụmakwụkwọ, na nkwado ụlọ ọrụ ogologo oge. Ọhụụ Ọhụụ Obscura Labs bụ inyere Africa aka ịbụ otu n'ime mpaghara kachasị ike maka akụrụngwa Zcash, nnabata, na uto nke usoro gburugburu. Otu a na-achọ ịghọ onye na-enye aka n'Africa nke ndu na usoro gburugburu Zcash site na: Ịrụ akụrụngwa Zcash a pụrụ ịdabere na ya. Ime ka ịnweta ZEC na Kwụọ ụhwọ na-echekwa Nzuzo kawanye mma. Ịkwado ndị ọrụ, ndị mmepụta, azụmahịa, na òtù obodo. Iwulite ngwá ọrụ na ọrụ bara uru. Ịgba ume mmepe nke obodo Zcash na-adịgide adịgide. Ịbawanye ụdị dịgasị iche iche nke mpaghara ala nke akụrụngwa Zcash na ikere òkè n'usoro gburugburu. Mpaghara Atụmatụ Obscura Labs na-eme atụmatụ ilekwasị ọrụ ya anya na mpaghara atụmatụ anọ na mbụ. Mmepe Akụrụngwa Akụrụngwa a pụrụ ịdabere na ya dị mkpa ka e-akpa ego [wallets], ngwa, ndị mmepụta, exchange, ọrụ Kwụọ ụhwọ, na ndị ọrụ nwee ike iso netwọk Zcash emekọrịta. Obscura Labs na-arụ ma na-emepụta akụrụngwa Zcash n'ime Africa iji mee ka ịnweta netwọk, ụdị dịgasị iche iche nke mpaghara ala, ntụkwasị obi, na ike iguzogide kawanye mma. E bu n'uche na ọrụ a ga-ebelata ịdabere n'ọnụ ọgụgụ ole na ole nke ndị na-arụ akụrụngwa ma nye ndị ọrụ na ndị mmepụta nọ n'ahịa Africa ọrụ a pụrụ ịdabere na ya. Atụmatụ akụrụngwa nwere ike ịgụnye: Ebe njedebe RPC mainnet ọha nke Zcash. Ebe njedebe RPC testnet ọha nke Zcash. full node Zebra. Ọrụ lightwalletd. Ndị na-akụ mkpụrụ DNS. Nlekọta akụrụngwa ọha. API ndị lekwasịrị anya na onye mmepụta. Ngwá ọrụ njikọta na akwụkwọ. Ọrụ ndị ọzọ na-ebelata ihe mgbochi n'iwulite na Zcash. Site n'ime ka akụrụngwa dị mfe ịnweta, Obscura Labs chọrọ ịkwado ndị mmepụta, e-akpa ego, ngwa, azụmahịa, na ọrụ ndị na-ejikọta na usoro gburugburu Zcash. Nnabata na Ịnweta Ego Ka Zcash wee baa uru n'ọnọdụ kwa ụbọchị, ndị mmadụ ga-enwe ike inweta, chekwaa, jiri, ma gbanwee ZEC n'enweghị esemokwu na-enweghị isi. Obscura Labs na-akwado atụmatụ e bu n'uche ime ka ihe ndị a kawanye mma: Ịnweta n'etiti ZEC na ego obodo Africa. Ụzọ ịbanye na ịpụ na ego fiat. Nnabata nke ndị ahịa. Njikọta Kwụọ ụhwọ. Kwụọ ụhwọ gafere ókèala. Ịnabata ndị ọrụ. Ịnweta e-akpa ego. Ojiji bara uru nke ZEC site n'aka ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu na azụmahịa. A na-elekọta ọrụ ndị na-edozi nsogbu a na-ahụkarị n'ahịa Africa nke ọma, gụnyere enweghị nkwụsi ike ego, mwepu ego, nnyefe gafere ókèala dị ọnụ, ịnweta usoro Kwụọ ụhwọ zuru ụwa ọnụ pere mpe, na nlekota ego na-arị elu. title: ZingoLabs
description: ZingoLabs bụ otu ndị ọhụụ nke raara onwe ha nye ime ka ahụmahụ mmadụ ka mma. Anyị kwenyere na teknụzụ kwesịrị ịbara mmadụ uru nakwa na anyị na-enwe ọganihu…
text: ZingoLabs Weebụsaịtị gọọmentị - GitHub - X/Twitter - Instagram ZingoLabs bụ otu ndị ọhụụ nke raara onwe ha nye ime ka ahụmahụ mmadụ ka mma. Anyị kwenyere na teknụzụ kwesịrị ịbara mmadụ uru nakwa na anyị na-enwe ọganihu site n'emekọrịta ihe e kwenyere na ya. Anyị na-achọpụta ụkpụrụ ndị na-eme ka nke a kwe omume. Zingo Lab Cyan na-arụ ọrụ dị ka DAO nke e chebere echebe [Shielded DAO]. Anyị na-echekwa ego anyị n'Ebe nchekwa ego [treasury] ebe onye ọ bụla so na ya nwere viewing key [view key]. A na-emefu ego site n'Ebe nchekwa ego mgbe ndị òtù tozuru oke kwado atụmatụ. Ọrụ Zingo! e-akpa ego [Wallet] (GitHub) Zingo e-akpa ego bụ e-akpa ego Zcash nwere atụmatụ zuru ezu, nke e mere ka ọ dịrị ndị ọrụ mfe, ọ bụ ezie na o nwere ụfọdụ atụmatụ dị elu maka ndị ọrụ toro eto karị. Ọ na-akwado pool Oha [transparent], nke e chebere echebe [shielded], na Sapling na Ironwood, nwere akwụkwọ Adreesị akpa ego maka Kwụọ ụhwọ ugboro ugboro, ma dị n'asụsụ dị iche iche. Ọ bụ e-akpa ego mbụ kwadoro Orchard ma mejuputa usoro NU5. Otu n'ime atụmatụ bụ isi nke Zingo! bụ ikike ya iji mpaghara memo [Memo field] nye nghọta bara uru gbasara Azụmahia [transactions] gị. Zingo! dị maka ngwaọrụ mkpanaka na PC. Ị ga-ahụ nbudata niile ebe a Zingolib (GitHub) API na ngwa nnwale nke na-ekpughe arụmọrụ zcash maka ngwa iji. Zingolib na-enye ma ọbá akwụkwọ maka zingo-mobile, yana ngwa cli agụnyere a na-akpọ zingo-cli, e-akpa ego light sitere n'ahịrị iwu nke na-agwa chain indexer dịka Zaino okwu. Zaino Ndepụta (GitHub) Zaino bụ indexer Rust maka blockchain Zcash, nke otu Zingo mepụtara. Ọ bụ indexer dị na Z3 stack: ọ na-edepụta data chain site na validator Zebra ma na-enye e-akpa ego, ndị na-enyocha, na ndị ahịa ndị ọzọ ozi. Ọ bụ ụzọ ga-anọchi lightwalletd. Zaino na-enye atụmatụ dị mkpa maka ma light client, dịka e-akpa ego na ngwa ndị na-adịghị achọ akụkọ ihe mere eme blockchain zuru ezu, na ndị ahịa zuru ezu ma ọ bụ e-akpa ego. Ọ na-akwado ndị na-enyocha block, na-enye ohere ịnweta ma blockchain emechara na chain kacha mma a na-emechabeghị na mempool nke validator zuru ezu Zebra na-elekọta. zcashd ruru nkwụsị Njedebe Nkwado ya na 18 Julaị 2026 na block 3,417,100 ma ọ naghị akwado Ironwood (NU6.3). Zaino na-agụ validator Zebra. ZLN (zcash-local-net) (GitHub) Otu ngwá ọrụ na-ebido ma na-achịkwa usoro Zcash. A na-eji nke a maka nnwale njikọta n'ime mmepe nke: lightclients indexers validators Ebumnuche ya bụ inye gburugburu nnwale na-agbanwe agbanwe nke ukwuu ma sie ike maka core nodes (validators) dịka Zebra, indexers dịka Zaino, na e-akpa ego light client dịka zingo-cli. Stack ndabara ọ na-ebido bụ Zebrad, zainod, na zcash-devtool. Usoro ochie zcashd na lightwalletd nọ n'azụ atụmatụ legacy-stack a naghị akwado ma ahaziri ka e wepụ ha. Na mgbakwunye n'inye ngwá ọrụ iji bido, chekwaa, na bubata data chain Zcash (maka mainnet, testnet, na regtest), a na-eji zcash-local-net site na nnwale Zaino iji nyochaa ọrụ Lightwallet RPC ndị a kwadoro na Zaino (lee Zaino akwụkwọ nnwale).

title: ZKAV Club

text: ZKAV Club Weebụsaịtị - GitHub - X/Twitter - YouTube N'ịkwado site n'aka The Zcash Foundation, ọrụ a dị oke ọchịchọ nke sitere n'ala gbadoro ụkwụ na ime mmetụta zuru ụwa ọnụ site n'omume ime obodo na nke mpaghara. Ọ na-akpọ obodo ndị okike ka ha mụta ma rụkọọ ọrụ ọnụ iji bulie ma kesaa akụkọ na akụkọ ndụ ndị na-akpali akpali, na-akụziri ihe, ma na-ekekọrịta nkwa nke Zcash na Nzuzo ego (financial privacy). Nkwupụta Ebumnuche Anyị bụ mkpokọta zuru ụwa ọnụ nke ndị na-emepụta ọdịnaya na-eche banyere Nzuzo, Zcash, na iwulite obodo. Anyị ga-arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ wulite oghere iji kesaa ozi, nkà na akụrụngwa ga-enyere mmepụta na ibipụta ọdịnaya nke metụtara isiokwu ndị anyị na-eche banyere ha. Anyị chọrọ ka ndị kacha nso n'ihe na-eme kọọ akụkọ, na-ekekọrịta mmasị na ahụmịhe ha biri ndụ iji wetara agụmakwụkwọ Nzuzo na Zcash n'akụkụ ụwa niile. Ebumnuche ogologo oge nke Zk Av Club bụ iguzobe netwọk nke ndị na-emepụta mgbasa ozi ruru eru, dị njikere ma nwee ego iji gbasaa ma kesaa akụkọ banyere Zcash na Nzuzo nke bara uru n'obodo ma na-eru ndị mmadụ n'ụwa niile. Mmekọrịta na Njikọ Aka Zk Av Club ga-anabata nzukọ ịntanetị mgbe niile ma soro mmemme ime obodo rụkọọ ọrụ iji mee ka mkparịta ụka gbasara isiokwu ndị masịrị obodo Zcash na Nzuzo nke ụwa niile dị mfe. N'ilekwasị anya anyị na mmepụta ọdịyo/onyonyo n'ịntanetị, nke a ga-abụ oge na ebe a ga-amụtakwu mkpa mgbasa ozi na nchegbu nke obodo Zcash na obodo ndị lekwasịrị anya na Nzuzo gburugburu ụwa, ma mee ihe. Mmemme Mmemme ga-emeghe ma bụrụ n'efu, ma nwee ike ịgụnye ọtụtụ usoro dịka ngosi, Q+A, AMA, ọzụzụ aka, idozi nsogbu, ịtụpụta echiche, ma ọ bụ ihe ọzọ kpamkpam. Mkparịta ụka ọ bụla, n'agbanyeghị usoro ya, ga-edobe nlebara anya Zcash na Nzuzo dịka isiokwu na dịka omume. A pụghị iwere nkwenye dị ka ihe e nyere. Ndị Anyị Bụ Anyị bụ obodo zuru ụwa ọnụ nke olu na ahụmịhe. Site n'obodo, anyị ga-enye onye ọ bụla ike ma mee ka olu ya dịkwuo ukwuu iji kọọ akụkọ Zcash site n'echiche nke ya, n'okpuru usoro nke ya. Anyị ga-akwalite akụrụngwa na njikọ ndị na-akpali ma na-akwado ndị na-emepụta ọdịnaya ka ha wee weta olu pụrụ iche ha na mkparịta ụka Nzuzo zuru ụwa ọnụ. Anyị na-ahụ netwọk njikọ nke na-ekwu okwu ma na-emepụta n'asụsụ dị iche iche, ndị niile na-enweta site na, ma na-atụnye ụtụ na, ozi na ọdịnaya Zk Av Club kesara. Anyị ga-ebulite ibe anyị elu, ma ọnụ anyị ga-ewulite ume a chọrọ iji wetara Zcash na Nzuzo n'ụwa. Soro anyị! A kpọrọ onye ọ bụla òkù ma nabata ya ịbụ akụkụ nke Zk Av Club! Onye ọ bụla nwere mmasị na Nzuzo ma nwee mmasị ịchọpụta teknụzụ ọdịyo/onyonyo na ịntanetị ọhụrụ nwere ike ịga nzukọ ma sonye ruo n'ókè ọ na-adị ya mma. title: Mgbasa ozi nke obodo [Community Broadcasting] site na VDO.Ninja na OBS Studio
description: E mepụtara nkuzi mkpirikpi a n'oge DWeb Camp 2023 site n'aka otu ndị ọrụ ibe na ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo. Ebumnuche nke mmemme a bụ iji ngwaọrụ ekwentị amamihe [smart…
text: Mgbasa ozi nke obodo [Community Broadcasting] site na VDO.Ninja na OBS Studio E mepụtara nkuzi mkpirikpi a n'oge DWeb Camp 2023 site n'aka otu ndị ọrụ ibe na ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo. Ebumnuche nke mmemme a bụ iji ngwaọrụ ekwentị amamihe [smart phone devices] ejikọrọ na netwọkụ MESH na-anọghị n'ịntanetị mee ndekọ vidiyo na mgbasa ozi ọnụ. Anyị na-eji ngwanrọ mepere emepe abụọ OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster software) na VDO.Ninja. Enwere ike ibudata ngwanrọ ndị a ma jiri ha rụọ ọrụ n'ime kọmputa gị. OBS Studio (Open Boardcaster software) OBS Studio bụ ngwanrọ n'efu ma mepere emepe maka ndekọ na mgbasa ozi ndụ [live streaming], nke dị maka sistemụ arụmọrụ dị iche iche. E wepụtara ngwanrọ a mbụ na 2012, ọ nwekwara ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado ya n'etiti obodo mgbasa egwuregwu na ndị na-emepụta ọdịnaya vidiyo nọọrọ onwe ha. Ihu onye ọrụ OBS Studio nwere ike iyi ihe na-atụ egwu nye ndị na-eji ya nke mbụ. E kewara OBS Studio n'ime windo abụọ, “Nlele [Preview]” na “Mgbasa [Broadcast]”. Windo nlele na-egosi vidiyo dị (kamera dị iche iche dịka webcam, Iriun Webcam, OBS Virtual Camera, Video na Browser source) a na-akpọ “Scenes”, ebe “Broadcast” na-egosi mgbasa ozi ndụ. Iji bubata mgbasa kamera dịpụrụ adịpụ site na VDO.ninja n'ime OBS Studio, bido site n'ịgbakwunye “Browser Source” ọhụrụ site na “Sources > Add > Browser”. N'ime windo ọhụrụ ahụ, ị nwere ike inye URL isi mmalite sitere na VDO.Ninja ma họrọ “Make source visible”. Ugbu a, ị nwere ike ịmalite ịgbasa mgbasa dịpụrụ adịpụ. VDO.Ninja VDO.Ninja bụ ngwa weebụ n'efu ma mepere emepe nke na-enye gị ohere ịgbanwe ngwaọrụ mkpanaka gị ka ọ bụrụ kamera mgbasa ozi ndụ. Enwere ike ibudata ngwanrọ a ma tinye ya n'ime kọmputa mpaghara gị, ma ọ bụ jiri ụdị n'ịntanetị na https://vdo.ninja. ozugbo. Ihu VOD.Ninja dị mfe; naanị mepee VDO.Ninja n'ime ihe nchọgharị weebụ ngwaọrụ mkpanaka gị ma họrọ “Add your camera to OBS”. Ị ga-ahọrọzi kamera na ngwaọrụ ọdịyo gị site na ndepụta ngwaọrụ ma pịa “Start”. Mgbe ahụ, ị ga-enweta njikọ “view” nke ị nwere ike itinye na OBS Studio. Idu oku obodo site na VDO.Ninja Bido site na ịga VDO.ninja site n'ihe nchọgharị weebụ gị na desktọọpụ/laptọọpụ. Iji mepụta ime ụlọ ọhụrụ ma duzie mgbasa ozi ndụ oku obodo nke gị, pịa Create a Room. Ihuenyo na-esote ga-arịọ maka ozi ndị bụ isi iji hazie ime ụlọ gị. Ozugbo e mepụtara ime ụlọ, onye nduzi nwere ọtụtụ nhọrọ njikwa dị na ihuenyo na-esote. Mgbe ndị mmadụ sonyeere ime ụlọ gị, gị, onye nduzi, ga-ahụ nhọrọ isi mmalite na njikwa niile na-apụta yana vidiyo na ọdịyo ha. Ajụjụ a na-ajụkarị [FAQ] Kedu ụdị kaadị eserese vidiyo achọrọ maka OBS Studio? Ị nwere ike iji kọmputa nkeonwe nwere ezigbo kaadị eserese na ebe nchekwa buru ibu, ma ọ bụ jiri encoders ngwaike Teradek VidiU. OBS ọ na-enye gị ohere ịme ntụgharị asụsụ ndụ na itinye nkọwa okwu? Enwere ụfọdụ plugins ndị obodo nyere aka mepụta nke yiri ka ha na-enye ụdị atụmatụ ahụ. https://github.com/eddieoz/OBS-live-translation Ị nwere ike ịmepụta plugins nke gị maka OBS Studio? Ee, OBS na-akwado Lua na scripting Python. Ọzọkwa, JavaScript maka Overlays na webviews. Anyị ọ na-eji fade to black dị ndụ ma ọ bụ transitions? Nke ahụ dịịrị gị, onye mmepụta! Enwere latency mgbe ị na-agbasa? Nke a dabere nke ukwuu na ebe ị na-agbasa ozi. Dịka ọmụmaatụ, YouTube nwere ike inwe igbu oge nke nkeji 1 ma ọ bụ karịa n'ihi nhazi vidiyo a na-eme na sava ha tupu agbasa ya. Ọdịyo na-akwụsị mgbe a na-eji OBS na igwe nwayọ ma na-eme green-screening Jiri encoder ngwaike ma ọ bụ jiri stream yard https://support.streamyard.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056350852-How-to-Use-OBS-Virtual-Camera-with-StreamYard ma ọ bụ RiverSide.FM Ndị nyere aka [Credits] Ryan Ajay Arky Akụrụngwa [Resources] https://obsproject.com/help https://docs.vdo.ninja/ Oge Ọfịs [Office Hours]: Obodo mgbasa ozi na mmemme dijitalụ https://alex4d.com/notes/item/media-and-digital-event-community

description: Anyị nwere ike iji IPFS kesaa nnukwu faịlụ mgbasa ozi n'etiti anyị n’ụzọ Peer-to-Peer.
text: Ịkekọrịta Faịlụ P2P site na IPFS na Nchọgharị Brave Anyị nwere ike iji IPFS kesaa nnukwu faịlụ mgbasa ozi n'etiti anyị n’ụzọ Peer-to-Peer. Yabụ, gịnị bụ nsogbu ahụ: ọnụ ụzọ IPFS [IPFS gateways] anaghị arụ ọrụ maka nnukwu faịlụ; oge ha ga-agwụ. Ihe achọrọ: IPFS Desktop + Brave Nchọgharị Browser Na nkenke, vidio ahụ dị na njedebe. Anyị nwere ike iji nke a n'etiti anyị nọ na ZF AV Club maka izipu nnukwu faịlụ mgbasa ozi, ma depụta ya maka unu niile n’ihi na ọ na-atọ ụtọ nke ukwuu ma dị egwu!! ỌZỌ, anyị ga-arụkọ ọrụ ozugbo na otu IPFS nọ na Protocol Labs iji mepụta Ojiji [use case] a. Uru ọzọ sitere na njikọ e mere na dWeb Camp! Enweghị IPFS arụnyere n’ọrụ na igwe na-anata faịlụ MA jiri nchọgharị na-abụghị Brave: Ị ga-echere ka ọnụ ụzọ bubata faịlụ ahụ. Nke a ga-eweghachi njehie 504 maka nnukwu faịlụ. Ọzọ: Otu esi etinye faịlụ ndị ọzọ n’ọrụ na igwe gị ka anyị ghara inwe nsogbu nke otu ebe ọdịda [single point of failure] mgbe node mbụ pụsịrị n’ịntanetị [offline]. Njikọ ikekọrịta maka vidio dị na vidio a bụ [https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmU8SDV1ozFf2n7FVq52jxuQ3jKjHXj48V6k4xbDqojmNy?filename=MadBitcoinsOnABoatkaiber.mp4](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1154434684558770237/1154435234276835338/IPFSdesktopgetStartedbraveZFAV20230921.mp4) Njikọ ikekọrịta maka vidio dị na vidio a bụ https://ipfs.io/ipfs/QmU8SDV1ozFf2n7FVq52jxuQ3jKjHXj48V6k4xbDqojmNy?filename=MadBitcoinsOnABoatkaiber.mp4
