title: Bipụta Saịtị na IPFS
description: IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) bụ protocol na netwọk ibe-na-ibe e mere iji mepụta ụzọ decentralized [decentralised] maka ịchekwa na ikekọrịta faịlụ.
text: Bipụta Saịtị na IPFS Mmalite maka IPFS IPFS (InterPlanetary File System) bụ protocol na netwọk ibe-na-ibe e mere iji mepụta ụzọ decentralized [decentralised] maka ịchekwa na ikekọrịta faịlụ. N'adịghị ka usoro client-server ọdịnala nke ịntanetị, IPFS na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ịkekọrịta faịlụ ozugbo n'etiti onwe ha, kama ịdabere na server etiti iji chekwaa ma kesaa ọdịnaya. A na-enye faịlụ ndị dị na IPFS adreesị site n'iji adreesị ọdịnaya [content-addressing], nke pụtara na a na-enye faịlụ ọ bụla hash pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ NJIRIMARA ỌDỊNAYA (CID) dabere n’ọdịnaya ya, a na-ejikwa hash a weghachite faịlụ ahụ site na netwọk. IPFS na-echekwa ọdịnaya dị ka block ndị a na-amata site na CID. Itinye faịlụ na-echekwa ya na node gị; ọ naghị eji onwe ya depụtaghachi ya na node ndị ọzọ. Debe otu mbipụta a na-enweta n'ịntanetị, ma ọ bụ hazie ịpịn n'ebe dị anya (remote pinning), ka ndị ọgụgụ ndị ọzọ wee nwee ike weghachite ya. Lee ịdịgide nke IPFS. Gụọ: Mmalite maka IPFS Ịmepụta Saịtị Gị Maka ihe atụ a, anyị na-emepụta weebụsaịtị dị mfe. Saịtị Ihe Atụ Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị maka imewe weebụ, dee isi ọdịnaya maka weebụsaịtị gị, gụnyere Aha, Isi Ahụ nke ederede, yana njikọ gaa na ibe/saịtị ndị ọzọ na footers. Nzọụkwụ 2: Jiri template HTML!. Tapawa ederede ị dere n'ime ya dịka o kwesịrị. Ị nwekwara ike ịmepụta akwụkwọ ụdị .CSS maka weebụsaịtị gị. Nzọụkwụ 3: Tinye ibe mbụ (homepage) nke weebụsaịtị gị n'ime index.html na mgbọrọgwụ (root) nke folda saịtị ahụ. Tinyekwa onyonyo ya na CSS ya, jiri ụzọ mmekọ (relative paths) dịka style.css ka ha wee rụọkwa ọrụ n'okpuru URL ọnụ ụzọ (gateway) IPFS. Ịhazi Node IPFS Desktop na-elekọta node ahụ maka gị. Biko hapụ ya ka ọ na-arụ ọrụ mgbe ị na-ekesa saịtị gị. Maka ụzọ command-line (command-line route), malite repository ọhụrụ otu ugboro: Mgbe ahụ, malite node ahụ ma hapụ terminal a ka ọ ghere oghe: Mee iwu ndị fọdụrụ na terminal nke abụọ. Ebidola daemon nke abụọ ma ọ bụrụ na IPFS Desktop na-ejikwalarị repository a. Tinye Folder Saịtị na IPFS: Na IPFS Desktop, họrọ folda nwere faịlụ weebụsaịtị gị site n'iji nhọrọ Tinye Folda (Add Folder). – Maka ụzọ CLI (command-line interface), mee nke a site na ndekọ nne (parent directory) nke folda saịtị gị: Dochie foldername na aha folda gị (tinye aha nwere oghere n'ime akara nkọwa). Chekwaa CID dị n'ahịrị added ... foldername ikpeazụ: ọ na-amata ndekọ (directory) ahụ dum, ọ bụghị naanị index.html. Tụọ Saịtị na IPFS: Iwu CLI ipfs add na-atụdo (pin) ọdịnaya ebubatara n'ime kọmputa gị dị ka ndabara. Lelee pin nke folder ahụ site na: Dochie YOURFOLDERCID na CID sitere na nzọụkwụ gara aga; ihe ọ ga-egosipụta kwesịrị ịbụ recursive. Ịpịn (pinning) na-echebe mbipụta node a ka a ghara ihichapụ ya site na nhicha ihe mkpofu (garbage collection), mana ọ naghị eme ka kọmputa a gbanyụrụ agbanyụ nọrọ n'ịntanetị. Ka ihe ahụ dịrị mgbe node gị anọghị n'ịntanetị, hazie ịpịn n'ebe dị anya ma kwenye na ọrụ ahụ dị n'ebe dị anya ewechaala ịpịn ya. Nweta weebụsaịtị gị na IPFS: Buru ụzọ lelee saịtị gị site na ọnụ ụzọ mpaghara (local gateway) dị na http://127.0.0.1:8080/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ (jiri nọmba port nke ọnụ ụzọ ahụ daemon gị bipụtara ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị iche). Akara slash dị na njedebe na-eme ka njikọ ndị metụtara ya (relative links) rụọ ọrụ n'ime ndekọ ahụ (directory). Ọnụ ụzọ ọha (public gateway) dị ka https://ipfs.io/ipfs/YOURFOLDERCID/ nwere ike ijere ya ozi ozugbo o nwere ike iweta ọdịnaya ahụ site na node a na-enweta. Nlele mbụ (preview) nke na-aga nke ọma na kọmputa gị anaghị egosi na ọha mmadụ nwere ike ịnweta ya. N'ọnọdụ anyị, CID = QmW2UEfap1vrRRvS5H9wed8qmsx4WsvXBk3GPGVVfWx3r3 IPNS Interplanetary Naming System (IPNS) na-enye gị ohere imelite IPFS CID ndị ejikọtara na weebụsaịtị gị, ma ka na-enye njikọ static. A na-enye ya dịka key. N'ime menu ntọala maka folder saịtị gị na ngwa desktop IPFS, họrọ Publish to IPNS. Key: “k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyhoa2cl0qlwpfxn5p9ypcu8jbzgnj4n” A pụkwara iji ya lee saịtị anyị site na gateway: https://ipfs.io/ipns/k51qzi5uqu5di670a6uxywo17b2be1eyh

title: Jiri IPFS nye Repo GitHub
description: N'ime nduzi a, anyị ga-amụta otu esi emepụta URL a pụrụ iji git clone maka ebe nchekwa GitHub gị nke eji IPFS CID enye ọrụ.
text: Jiri IPFS nye Repo GitHub Mmalite N'ime nduzi a, anyị ga-amụta otu esi emepụta URL a pụrụ iji git clone maka ebe nchekwa GitHub gị nke eji IPFS CID enye ọrụ. Nke a bara uru iji hụ na ọdịnaya dị mgbe niile n'agbanyeghị mpaghara ala, iguzogide mmachi, nakwa dịka nkwado ndabere na-adịgide adịgide maka ozi bara uru! Note: Data ebugoro na IPFS dịrị ndị ọrụ netwọk niile. Ị nwere ike ịchọ izobe ederede data nkeonwe/nwere mmetụta n'ime ngwaọrụ gị. Wụnye IPFS Kubo Soro ntuziaka nrụnye enyere ebe a N'ihe atụ a, anyị na-eji Linux, ụdị OS ndị ọzọ dịkwa. Lelee na nrụnye gara nke ọma site n'iji ipfs –version Detuo Ebe Nchekwa Iji malite, họrọ ebe nchekwa Git ịchọrọ ịnabata ma detuo ya: Gbaa iwu a: …git clone https://github.com/zechub/zechub” Ugbu a, iji kwadebe ya ka e nwee ike idetu ya site na IPFS. cd zechub git update-server-info Kwụpụta ihe Git nwere: Ime nke a ga-ekwe IPFS ikpochapụ ihe ndị yiri ibe ha ma ọ bụrụ na ị melite ebe nchekwa Git ma emechaa. Tinye na IPFS Mgbe ị mechara nke ahụ, ebe nchekwa ahụ adịla njikere ka e nye ya ọrụ. Ihe fọdụrụ ime bụ itinye ya na IPFS: $ pwd /code/myrepo $ ipfs add -r CID e nwetara: Qmbgqox5g3614gjTb43s5mdSmmk95aGWWA9EHksL2T91A2 Ọ dị mma! Ugbu a, ebugola ebe nchekwa gị na netwọk. Detuo site na IPFS Ugbu a, ị ga-enwe ike weghachite ebe nchekwa GitHub site n'iji: git clone http://ipfs.io/ipfs/yourCID N'aka nke ọzọ, ị nwere ike ịchọ ma weghachite ya site na node IPFS dị n'ime ngwaọrụ gị. Note Ikpeazụ: Folda repo dị na IPFS anaghị enweta mmelite tinyere ebe nchekwa github n'eziokwu. A na-atụ aro ka ebugharịa folda ahụ ọzọ n'oge oge niile.

title: Ịmepụta na ịtụgharị asụsụ nke ndepụta okwu vidiyo
description: Ngwá ọrụ [Tools] e ji mee ihe n'akwụkwọ ntụziaka a:
text: Ịmepụta na ịtụgharị asụsụ nke ndepụta okwu vidiyo Ngwá ọrụ [Tools] e ji mee ihe n'akwụkwọ ntụziaka a: CapCut Mbupụ SRT nke CapCut Onye ndezi ederede Onye ntụgharị asụsụ na onye ndezi ndepụta okwu n'ịntanetị Bido site n'ibubata ndezi ikpeazụ nke vidiyo gị na CapCut. N'aka nke ọzọ, ị nwere ike iji CapCut dezie vidiyo ahụ tupu ịga n'ihu na usoro a. Mgbe ebugorola vidiyo ikpeazụ ahụ na CapCut, jiri Mbupụ SRT nke CapCut nweta faịlụ ndepụta okwu, nke nwere oge akara, site na ọrụ CapCut. Mepee faịlụ SRT ahụ n'ime onye ndezi ederede ma lelee vidiyo ahụ, ka ị na-agụ faịlụ SRT ahụ, na-eme mgbanwe na faịlụ SRT mgbe achọpụtara njehie. Jiri ọchụchọ na nnọchi dochie ha niile maka njehie ọ bụla. Ndụmọdụ: Lelee vidiyo ahụ n'ogo 2x mgbe ị na-enyocha ndepụta okwu Mgbe enyochala ma mezie ederede mbụ ahụ, bulite faịlụ SRT ahụ na Onye ntụgharị asụsụ na onye ndezi ndepụta okwu n'ịntanetị iji tụgharịa faịlụ SRT ahụ gaa n'asụsụ ọ bụla ọzọ maka ugwo dị ntakịrị. Onye ghọtara asụsụ atụgharịrị kwesịrị iji sọftụwia ndezi vidiyo nyochaa faịlụ SRT atụgharịrị. Faịlụ SRT atụgharịrị na-achọ mgbe ụfọdụ mgbanwe n'oge akara, nke dị mfe ịchọta ma dozie site n'iji ọtụtụ sọftụwia ndezi vidiyo.

text: Itinye Aka na ZecHub ZecHub na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka ịmụ gbasara Zcash. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agụ ibe a, obi dị anyị ezigbo ụtọ na ị na-atụle itinye aka! Onyinye ọ bụla ị nyere ga-apụta na zechub.wiki na mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta ndị ọzọ nke ZecHub. Ndị na-enye aka ọhụrụ Iji nweta nchịkọta gbasara ZecHub, gụọ README. Ịmalite ZecHub na-eji GitHub ejikwa onyinye nke obodo. Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ onye ọhụrụ na GitHub, echegbula! Anyị ga-akọwara gị ụzọ ị ga-esi sonye dị ka onye na-enye aka n'obodo ZecHub. Anyị na-akwụ ndụmọdụ n'ụdị ZEC nke e chebere echebe maka onyinye a nabatara. Ọnụ ego nkwụghachi anaghị akwụsi ike na ZEC — lee Otu e si ahọpụta ụgwọ ọrụ. N'ime nduzi a, ị ga-enweta nchịkọta usoro ọrụ onyinye, site n'ịmeghe nsogbu, imepụta pull request (PR), nyochaa ya, na ijikọta PR ahụ. Soro na mkparịta ụka Nke mbụ, sonye na mkparịta ụka ahụ site na njikọ obodo anyị. Nduzi Ụdị Onyinye ọ bụla na ZecHub kwesịrị ịgbaso nduzi ụdị ZecHub. Nke a gụnyere wiki, docs na ọdịnaya mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta. Ụzọ ị nwere ike isi nye aka ZecHub bụ ọrụ obodo na-edu nke na-achọ inye nkwado [support] na akụrụngwa maka ndị ọrụ na ndị onye mmepụta [developer] nke Zcash. E nwere ọtụtụ ụzọ isi sonye na ZecHub, gụnyere ide maka Akwụkwọ Akụkọ [newsletter] anyị kwa izu, itinye aka na ebe nchekwa ihe ọmụma anyị, ma ọ bụ inye aka n'ọrụ mmepe. Ndị a bụ ụdị onyinye ZecHub na-anabata ugbu a: Otu e si ahọpụta ụgwọ ọrụ A na-akwụ ndụmọdụ n'ụdị ZEC nke e chebere echebe. Ọnụọgụ ZEC ndị dịbu n'isiokwu ndị dị n'okpuru bụ foto akụkọ ihe mere eme n'oge ọnụego ZEC/USD ochie. Ewerela ha dịka ọnụego ugbu a. Otu esi ahọpụta ego: Kwekọrịta ọrụ ahụ na etiti USD dị na amụma ọnụ ego bounty. Họrọ ebumnuche n'ime oke ahụ — ọ bụghị ịwụnye aka n'elu mgbe niile. Gbanwee ya n'ọnụego ahịa ọha nke ZEC/USD ma tinye ZEC na bounty ahụ: Tụgharịa ya ruo ebe iri anọ n'ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede. Faịlụ amụma bụ naanị isi mmalite eziokwu. Ọ bụrụ na ibe a na faịlụ ahụ ekweghịkọrịta, amụma ahụ na-emeri. A na-edepụta ọrụ akwụgoro ụgwọ na ZEC Bounties. Ọnọdụ atọ na-abụghị otu: Ejikọtala — a nabatara PR n'ime ebe nchekwa. A kwadoro ụgwọ ọrụ — onye nkwado ma ọ bụ DAO ekwenyela na e ji ụgwọ ọrụ, nakwa ego ole ọ ga-abụ. A kwụọla — ZEC ruru Adreesị akpa ego [address] gị nke e chebere echebe. Onyinye ejikọtala anaghị akwado ụgwọ ọrụ n'onwe ya. Ọrụ a kwadoro akwụghịla ụgwọ ya. Ọrụ Dev Ọrụ dev ọ bụla akwadoro nke na-enyere iwulite usoro gburugburu ebe obibi nke Zcash aka. Nke a nwere ike ịgụnye wiki anyị, e-akpa ego [wallet] ọhụrụ, ma ọ bụ ngwa ọ bụla ị nwere ike iche n'echiche. Nkuzi Zcash (vidiyo) Nke a bụ nkuzi atụ dị n'okpuru: Mepụta ma kesaa nkuzi gbasara ngwa Zcash ma nweta ụgwọ ọrụ. Nyefee PR na zechub/tutorials ma ọ bụ zigara vidiyo na ọwa #video-content na Discord. Ọ bụrụ na vidiyo ahụ mezuru ụkpụrụ anyị, anyị ga-ebipụta ya ma nye gị ndụmọdụ. Wiki ZecHub - e bipụtara ibe wiki ọhụrụ Saịtị wiki anyị na-enye ihe ọmụmụ gbasara Zcash n'ụdị dị mfe nghọta ma dị mfe iri. Zcash bụ teknụzụ dị elu nke nwere obodo na-arụsi ọrụ ike, ya mere a ka nwere akwụkwọ anyị kwesịrị iwulite. Ebumnuche anyị bụ iwulite akwụkwọ gbasara: Ndị a bụ mpaghara sara mbara, ya mere e nwere ọtụtụ ihe a ga-arụ ọrụ na ha. Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ mmụọ nsọ, lelee saịtị wiki-docs anyị ugbu a ma hụ ihe na-adịghị. Ozugbo ị kpebiri ihe ịchọrọ ide, malite ime mgbanwe gị ma mụta otu esi eziga PR na repo ZecHub. A na-emepụta ma na-elekọta docs anyị niile na repo a. Soro nduzi ụdị ZecHub mgbe ị na-ede ibe wiki, ma jiri ibe dị adị n'otu ngalaba ahụ dị ka ntụaka nhazi. Mgbe ị nyefere PR, biko zigara @dismad, @squirrel, ma ọ bụ @vito ozi na ngalaba #zechub nke discord, ha ga-enyocha PR gị ma jikọta ya ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị njikere ịgbakwunye na saịtị ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na ejikọta ya, ha ga-agbakwunye doc ahụ na weebụsaịtị ZecHub. Ọ bụrụ na doc ahụ adịbeghị njikere, ha ga-atụ aro mmezi maka gị na PR ahụ. Wiki ZecHub - ibe wiki atụgharịrị Ebumnuche ZecHub bụ inye ebe mmụta open-source nke onye ọ bụla nọ n'obodo Zcash nwere ike itinye aka na ya. Otu n'ime nnukwu ihe ịga nke ọma ebe a bụ ịhụ ndị

text: ZecHub Ntuziaka ụdị edemede [Style Guide] Ụdị edemede ZecHub dị mfe ma dịrị mfe ịbịaru nso. Anyị na-anabata onye ọ bụla ma na-elekwasị anya n'obodo Zcash. Ụkpụrụ Dị njikere inye aka - Gosi ndị ọrụ Zcash na anyị nọ n'akụkụ ha. Dị mkpirikpi ma kwuo isi okwu: Nyefee ozi kachasị mfe o kwere mee. Bido n'ihe kacha mkpa. Lezie ndị ọrụ anya: Anyị na-ede maka ndị ọrụ mbụ, ndị mmepụta nke abụọ, na onye ọ bụla ọzọ nke atọ. Ihe ndị bụ isi Gaa n'isi okwu ahụ. Bido n'ihe kacha mkpa. Tinye mkpụrụokwu ndị dị mkpa n'ihu ka ọ dị mfe ilegharị anya. Mee ka nhọrọ na usoro ọzọ onye ọrụ ga-eme doo anya. Dee dịka ị na-ekwu okwu. Ndị ọrụ anyị bụ ezigbo mmadụ. Gwa ha okwu n'ede. Dị mkpirikpi. Nye ndị ọrụ ozi zuru ezu iji dozie nsogbu ma ọ bụ mee nhọrọ. Hapụ ntụpọ n'aha. Wepụ akara edemede ngwụcha n'aha, isiokwu, obere isiokwu, aha UI [UI], na ihe dị na ndepụta nwere okwu atọ ma ọ bụ ole na ole. A na-eji ntụpọ n'ahịrịokwu na n'ederede isi. Ihe atụ: Pịa bọtịnụ Zipu->Pịa bọtịnụ Zipu Mgbe ị na-enwe obi abụọ, zere iji mkpụrụedemede ukwu. Jiri mkpụrụedemede ukwu naanị n'aha pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ aha dịka Zcash, nakwa n'okwu mbụ nke isiokwu ma ọ bụ nkebiokwu. Ihe atụ: Otu esi ezipu ZEC na Adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ. → Otu esi ezipu ZEC na adreesị akpa ego jikọtara ọnụ Degharịa edemede na-esighị ike. Ọtụtụ mgbe, jiri ngwaa bido nkwupụta ọ bụla. Jiri naanị otu oghere mgbe ntụpọ na kọlụm gasịrị. Zere okwu na-abụghị Bekee dịka de facto ma ọ bụ ad hoc. Zerekwa ndebiri Latin nke nkebiokwu Bekee ndị a na-ahụkarị. Ọ metụtakwara ozi Twitter na nkwupụta ndị ọzọ dị mkpirikpi: mee ka ha dị mkpirikpi, tinye isi okwu n'ihu, ma hapụ akara edemede ngwụcha n'ahịrị dị mkpirikpi. --- Emegharịala ntuziaka ụdị edemede ZecHub site na Microsoft Ntuziaka ụdị edemede ma tinye mgbanwe. text: ZecWeekly Akwụkwọ Akụkọ [Newsletter] ZecWeekly bụ Akwụkwọ Akụkọ a na-ezipụ kwa ụtụtụ Sọnde. Ọ gụnyere akụkọ niile mere n’izu ahụ n’ime gburugburu obibi Zcash. Ndị otu obodo na-ahọpụta akụkọ ahụ kwa izu, a na-etinyekwa njikọ niile dị mkpa n’Akwụkwọ Akụkọ ahụ. Biko denye aha na Akwụkwọ Akụkọ ahụ ebe a. Nye aka Onyinye nye Akwụkwọ Akụkọ na-arụ ọrụ kacha mma mgbe otu onye na-enye aka kwadebere mbipụta maka izu ziri ezi, soro eriri mkparịta ụka gbasara bounty ma ọ bụ nhazi dị ugbu a, ma nyefee pull request mgbe njikọ izu ahụ dị njikere. Biko enyela mbipụta maka ọdịnihu tupu ZecHub ebipụta ma ọ bụ kwado ụbọchị maka mbipụta ahụ. Pull request ndị a na-ewepụta n’oge na-atụfukarị mmelite nke ngwụcha izu, na-emegide onye nhazi e kenyere, ma ọ bụ jiri oge ikpeazụ na-ezighi ezi. Kwenye mbipụta dị ugbu a Tupu ịmalite ide: Lelee ZEC Bounties maka ọrụ Akwụkwọ Akụkọ dị ugbu a. Chere ka e kenye gị ọrụ. Mbipụta Akwụkwọ Akụkọ dị na ngalaba XS nke iwu ego bounty. Ọnụọgụ ZEC dị na bounty dị ndụ bụ ego ya, ọ bụghị isiokwu ochie ọ bụla dị na ntuziaka inye aka. Fork ebe nchekwa ahụ Ọ bụrụ na ị dị ọhụrụ na GitHub, jiri usoro ọrụ a: Mepee ebe nchekwa ZecHub. Pịa Fork ma mepụta fork n’okpuru akaụntụ GitHub gị. N’ime fork gị, mepụta branch ọhụrụ maka mbipụta ahụ. Aha branch doro anya bara uru, dịka digest-may-30-2026. Gbaa mbọ hụ na pull request gị ga-eji ZecHub/zechub dịka ebe nchekwa ntọala na main dịka branch ntọala. Ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji akara iwu, otu usoro ọrụ ahụ dị ka nke a: Dochie YOUR-USERNAME na aha njirimara GitHub nke gị. URL dị n’elu bụ naanị placeholder, ọ gaghị arụ ọrụ dịka e dere ya. Mepụta faịlụ Akwụkwọ Akụkọ Jiri template Akwụkwọ Akụkọ dịka ebe ị ga-amalite. Mbipụta Akwụkwọ Akụkọ dị n’ime folda newsletter. Mgbe ị na-emepụta faịlụ ahụ: Soro usoro aha faịlụ issue rịọrọ ma ọ bụ nke e ji mee mbipụta ndị a nakweere n’oge na-adịbeghị anya. Debe otu usoro ngalaba dị na template ma ọ bụrụ na ọrụ ahụ arịghịọ usoro dị iche. Tinye naanị njikọ sitere n’izu dị mkpa. Dee nkọwa dị mkpirikpi ma doo anya maka njikọ ọ bụla ka ndị na-agụ ghọta ihe mere o ji dị mkpa. Tụgharịa ma ọ bụ chịkọta isi mmalite ndị na-abụghị Bekee n’asụsụ Bekee mgbe ọ dị mkpa. Lelee njikọ ọ bụla tupu imepe pull request. Chịkọta njikọ n’oge kwesịrị ekwesị ZecWeekly na-ekpuchikarị ọrụ gburugburu obibi Zcash maka izu dị ugbu a, a na-ebipụtakwa ya nso na ngwụcha izu. Oge kacha dị nchebe bụ: Malite ịchịkọta njikọ mgbe e bipụtara issue ma ọ bụ ọrụ Akwụkwọ Akụkọ dị ugbu a. Debe draft mgbe izu ahụ ka na-aga n’ihu. Nyefee pull request nso n’ụbọchị enyere maka nnyefe, mgbe ị lechara mmelite nke ngwụcha izu. Enyela Akwụkwọ Akụkọ nke izu n’ọdịnihu tupu ọrụ maka ụbọchị ahụ adị ma ọ bụ tupu ZecHub ekwenye na ị kwesịrị ịkwadebe ya. Ọ bụrụ na issue kwuru ka ị nyefee tupu otu ụbọchị kpọmkwem, soro ụbọchị ahụ. Ọ bụrụ na esemokwu dị n’etiti ibe a na issue dị ugbu a, soro issue dị ugbu a. Mepee pull request Mgbe faịlụ Akwụkwọ Akụkọ gị dị njikere: Commit mgbanwe gị n’ime fork gị. Mepee pull request n’ime ZecHub/zechub na branch main. Jiri aha kwekọrọ na mbipụta ahụ, dịka Zcash Ecosystem Digest May 30th. Jikọta issue ahụ n’ahụ pull request ka ndị na-enyocha nwee ike jikọta ọrụ ahụ na ọrụ e nyere. Ọmụmaatụ nke ahụ pull request: Mgbe pull request meghere, lezie anya na nkwupụta nyocha. Ọ bụrụ na ZecHub rịọ mgbanwe, melite otu branch ahụ kama imepe pull request nke abụọ maka otu mbipụta ahụ. Ọmụmaatụ ndị dị adị Jiri pull request Akwụkwọ Akụkọ ndị a ejikọtalarị dịka ọmụmaatụ nke nnyefe a nakweere: Zcash Nchịkọta gburugburu obibi Eprel 11 Zcash Nchịkọta gburugburu obibi Maachị 28 Zcash Nchịkọta gburugburu obibi Febrụwarị 14 Mgbe ị na-atụnyere ọrụ gị na ọmụmaatụ, lekwasị anya na ebe faịlụ dị, usoro aha, usoro ngalaba, nkọwa njikọ, na ma pull request ahụ ejikọtala na ọrụ ziri ezi. Mmejọ a na-ahụkarị ị ga-ezere Imepe pull request tupu ekwenye ụbọchị mbipụta ma ọ bụ ọrụ. Ịrụ ọrụ na issue nke nwere pull request ejikọtalarị na ya. title: MultiSig Demo
description: Historical. This walkthrough no longer runs.
text: MultiSig Demo Historical. This walkthrough no longer runs. Every step below depends on zcashd, which reached its automatic End-of-Support halt on 18 July 2026. The seven scripts shipped alongside this page drive it through zcash-cli, so none of them can reach a running node today. These scripts cannot be ported mechanically. They are built on the raw-transaction and wallet RPCs (createrawtransaction, signrawtransaction, createmultisig, dumpprivkey) that zcashd deprecated before the halt; Zallet replaces those with new methods that operate on PCZTs rather than raw transaction hex, and is still in beta with many zcashd methods not yet ported. For multi-party custody on Zcash today, see FROST & Threshold Custody, which includes a direct comparison with transparent multisig, and the Ywallet FROST demo. To move an existing node off zcashd, see the migration guide to Zebra and Zallet. This page is kept as a historical record of the transparent multisig workflow. This demo requires zcashd, which halted on 18 July 2026 and no longer runs. Nothing below can be completed against the live chain. Gather public keys from needed individuals https://github.com/iancoleman/bip39 If using zcashd, you can create a UA and use your transparent reciever as well. Then use getPubkey.sh to extract your public key. Create 2x Multisig (2 of 3) t3 addresses run createMultiSig.sh to generate your multisig address and redeem script. What's needed are 3 public keys ./createMultiSig.sh pubk1 pubk2 pubk3 # 1st t3 ./createMultiSig.sh pubk4 pubk5 pubk6 # 2nd t3 for the change address. NOTE: in this example pubk1,pubk4 are the same person, pubk2,pubk5 are the same person and so on ... NOTE2: the ORDER of your pubkeys matters! Pay attention to this!!!! Fund t3 address Use any wallet/facuet to fund address Create MultiSig transaction ./createMultiSigTX.sh txid voutIndex scriptPubKey redeemScript oldAmount tAddy amount changeTaddy where, ./txDetails.sh txid => will help you find the needed information Sign MultiSig TX Open signMultiSigTX.sh and add your private keys in the pk1,pk2, ... variables. I would not recommend typing these into your terminal. If you have access to all your private keys you can use them all at once to save time, but in most real world examples, the signing will be done via folks around the world so each of the required participants will need to sign, then send back the updated raxTX "hex" output which the others will use to sign to complete the signing proceedure. Who ever creates the first tx, will sign with their private key and send out the updated rawTX hex that needs to be signed by the other participants. ./signMultiSigTX.sh rawTX txid voutIndex scriptPubKey redeemScript valueInitialTX To sign this tx, at least 2 out of the three private keys need to sign it. If the public key you gave was exported using a T-address from zcashd, you can get the private key of your T address with: zcash-cli dumpprivkey "t-addr" This command halted with zcashd and returns nothing today; it is recorded here only to show how the demo obtained its keys. For this demo, I have used iancoleman's bip39 to quickly isolate the needed private keys. Broadcast signed TX ./sendMultiSignedTX.sh signedTXfromLastStep Sources https://learnmeabitcoin.com/technical/script/p2sh/ https://bitcoin.stackexchange.com/questions/6100/how-will-multisig-addresses-work https://zcash.github.io/rpc/

text: Workshop Day 3 Data Analytics The science of analyzing raw data using specialized systems, tools, and techniques to identify patterns, trends, and insights It involves: Zcash Encrypted electronic cash. The first cryptocurrency to develop zero-knowledge encryption for private peer-to-peer payments. note: If you want accurate data that you TRUST, it is recommended to run your own full node [zebrad]. You can setup the z3 infrastructure [ zebrad + zainod/lightwalletd + "wallet of choice here" ] if you want a complete and robust solution. You access the data using RPC's(Remote Procedure Calls) For a quick demostration of how this works, watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ok9Wa8FNbMA Workshop Demo This workshop will focus on collecting and transforming data from the wallet level. This level is where most folks will access the Zcash blockchain. Usecase ( Create a .csv file of all transactions for a given account in Zkool) This is a popular scenario where one would need to organize and optimize their digital personal finances. Step 1 Open Zkool and select the account you want to use note: We will be using a testnet wallet for this demo. note2: We are choosing Zkool here, but ANY wallet that has export functionality will work! https://github.com/hhanh00/zkool2 Step 2 Go to the top right menu and select "Export Transactions" Step 3 Download bash script we will use to transform our data. For Developers who are watching, I will be using bash which is standard in most Linux Distros, but you can use your language of choice. For non-devs or students getting your feet wet, use AI! Some example prompts that can get you started: "How can I use "bash/rust/python/ ... etc." to transform CSV files" note: You still need to understand the basics but running these workshops are how you understand the FLOW of the process. note2: AI is not usually private so be extra careful when using it as a student! Step 4 Setup scripts for use and run chmod +x cleanCSV.sh ./cleanCSV.sh "nameofexportBackup" Step 5 Use data Open in libreOffice or any CSV viewer for use!

text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Usoro CryptoNote [CryptoNote Protocol] Usoro: Zero to Zero Knowledge Nke na-atọ ụtọ taa! Usoro CryptoNote na-eme ka Nzuzo on-chain [on-chain privacy] sie ike. Taa, anyị ga-amụta atụmatụ ya niile bụ isi na otú ọtụtụ ọrụ Nzuzo a ma ama siri tinye ya n'ọrụ. --- Ndabere E bipụtara akwụkwọ ọcha CryptoNote mbụ n'okpuru aha nzuzo "Nicolas van Saberhagen". Bytecoin bụ cryptocurrency mbụ tinyere usoro a n'ọrụ. Ọrụ a kacha mara amara na-eji ya taa bụ Monero (XMR). Ejikwala ya na TurtleCoin, Aeon, na ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ. --- Atụmatụ Isi nke CryptoNote Usoro CryptoNote na-enye atụmatụ atọ bụ isi: Enweghị ike ịchọpụta na Ihe na-apughi ijikọ ọnụ [Untraceability and Unlinkability] nke Azụmahia [transactions] Proof Ọrụ Nhata [Egalitarian Proof of Work] (na-eguzogide ASIC) Mwepụta na-agbanwe agbanwe [Dynamic emission] --- Enweghị ike ịchọpụta - signature Mgbanaka [Ring Signatures] A na-enweta enweghị ike ịchọpụta n'ụzọ bụ isi site n'iji signature Mgbanaka. Mgbe ị na-eziga Azụmahia, a na-agwakọta igodo ọha gị n'ezie na ọtụtụ igodo aghụghọ (nke a na-akpọ "mgbanaka") - ha niile nwere otu ọnụ ọgụgụ mkpụrụ ego. Nke a na-eme ka ọ sie ezigbo ike ịchọpụta onye zigara mkpụrụ ego ahụ n'ezie. Ogo mgbanaka [Ring size] na-emetụta usoro enweghị aha [anonymity set] nke ukwuu. Mgbanaka buru ibu na-enye Nzuzo ka mma. Ntụnyere na Zcash: Usoro enweghị aha nke Zcash bụ ọnụ ọgụgụ Azụmahia niile a metụrụla n'ime pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded pool] nyere (nke buru ibu karịa ogo mgbanaka CryptoNote a na-ahụkarị). --- Ring CT (Azụmahia Nzuzo) Ụdị Ring CT mere ka Nzuzo dị na mkpụrụ ego dabere na CryptoNote ka mma nke ukwuu. Kama izochi naanị onye zitere ya, Ring CT na-eme ka ọnụ ọgụgụ Azụmahia ghara ịdị doo anya n'etiti onye zitere ya na onye natara ya. Ọ na-eji: Kriptogafị Curve Elliptic commitment Pedersen Nzobe ederede Homomorphic [Homomorphic Encryption] A na-eji proof egosi na ọnụ ọgụgụ ahụ karịrị 0 ma dị n'ime oke ziri ezi na-enweghị ikpughe ụkpụrụ ndị ahụ n'ezie. Adreesị Nzuzo [Stealth Addresses] na-agbakwụnyekwa Adreesị akpa ego eji otu ugboro maka onye natara ya. --- Proof Ọrụ Nhata (ePoW) CryptoNote chọrọ ịmepụta usoro ịgwụputa ka nha karịa site n'iguzogide ASIC. Ọ na-eji algọridim CryptoNight (ọrụ siri ike n'ihe gbasara ebe nchekwa). N'adịghị ka SHA256 nke Bitcoin, e mere CryptoNight ka ọ belata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ndị na-egwụputa CPU, GPU, na ASIC. Nzọụkwụ CryptoNight: Jiri data pseudorandom malite nnukwu mpaghara ebe nchekwa (scratchpad) Mee ọtụtụ arụmọrụ ịgụ/ide na scratchpad Hash scratchpad dum iji mepụta ụkpụrụ ikpeazụ (Rịba ama: Monero esila na CryptoNight pụọ gaa na algọridim ndị ọzọ.) --- Mwepụta na-agbanwe agbanwe Kama ihe omume halving mberede (dị ka Bitcoin), CryptoNote na-eji ụgwọ ọrụ block nke na-ebelata nwayọọ nwayọọ. Nke a na-emepụta usoro mwepụta dị nnọọ nro karịa ka oge na-aga. Njikọ Zcash: Ndị onye mmepụta Zcash atụlewo itinye usoro mwepụta dị nro karịa n'ọrụ n'ọdịnihu, ikekwe site na "Zcash Posterity Fund". --- Mmechi CryptoNote egosila na ọ bụ usoro siri ike, nke a nwalere nke ọma, maka Nzuzo on-chain. Ọtụtụ ihe ọhụrụ ya emetụtala gburugburu ebe obibi mkpụrụ ego Nzuzo sara mbara. Ụfọdụ ndị nyocha kwenyere na a pụrụ ijikọta atụmatụ CryptoNote na pool nke e chebere echebe zero-knowledge na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi n'ikpeazụ. --- Eriri Ozi Mbụ nke ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1636473585781948416 --- A chịkọtara ibe a site na eriri ozi Zero to Zero Knowledge mbụ maka wiki ZecHub.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Ọrụ Hash [Hash Functions]
description: Nnọọ na usoro ọhụrụ: Zero to Zero Knowledge!
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Ọrụ Hash [Hash Functions] Okwu Mmalite nke Usoro Nnọọ na usoro ọhụrụ: Zero to Zero Knowledge! N'ime usoro a, anyị ga-amụta ihe ndị bụ isi gbasara teknụzụ dị iche iche na-abanye n'ime ụkpụrụ anyị na-echekwa Nzuzo [privacy]. --- Akụkụ 1: Ọrụ Hash [Hash Functions] Taa, anyị na-amalite na Ọrụ Hash — akụkụ dị mkpa nke cryptography [cryptography] a na-eji na blockchain. N'ikpeazụ n'ime usoro a, anyị ga-ekpuchi ụfọdụ isiokwu ndị dabere na njirimara ha. Gịnị bụ Ọrụ Hash? Ọrụ Hash na-anata ntinye [input] nke ogologo ọ bụla ma mepụta mmepụta [output] nke ogologo edobere. Ozi a ga-eme hash = Ntinye Algọridim a na-eji = Ọrụ Hash Mmepụta na-apụta = Uru Hash [Hash Value] Nwaa ya n'onwe gị! Ka anyị jiri ngwá ọrụ a nweta nghọta bara uru! Tinye ederede ọ bụla masịrị gị iji mepụta mmepụta nwere ogologo edobere. Lelee otú mmepụta si agbanwe dabere n'algọridim hash dị iche iche. Nwaa ya: https://cryptii.com/pipes/hash-function --- Njirimara nke Ọrụ Hash Cryptographic Ọrụ Hash Cryptographic ga-enwerịrị njirimara 3 ndị a: Otu ụzọ [One-way] — Ọ ga-esiri ike nke ukwuu ịtụgharị Ọrụ Hash azụ Na-eguzogide nkukota [Collision Resistant] — Ntinye abụọ dị iche ekwesịghị ime hash gaa n'otu mmepụta Nke a pụrụ ịdabere na ya [Deterministic] — Maka ntinye ọ bụla, Ọrụ Hash ga na-enye otu nsonaazụ ahụ mgbe niile --- Ọrụ Hash A Na-ahụkarị E nwere ụdị Ọrụ Hash dị iche iche. Ụfọdụ ọmụmaatụ: Secure Hashing Algorithm (SHA-3) Message Digest Algorithm 5 (MD5) BLAKE2b — A na-eji ya na mmepụta igodo [key derivation] nke Zcash Okwu mmalite banyere BLAKE2: https://www.blake2.net --- Ojiji Ọrụ Hash N'Ezi Ụwa Hashing Maka Ịdị Mmasị Data (Nlele Ịdị Mmasị Data) Nlele ịdị mma data bụ ọmụmaatụ nke “Hashing Maka Ịdị Mmasị Data”. A na-eji ha emepụta checksums n'elu faịlụ data ma nye onye ọrụ nkwenye na data ahụ ziri ezi. Osisi Merkle (Osisi Hash) Osisi hash ma ọ bụ osisi Merkle nwere alaka na node akwụkwọ ndị e ji hash cryptographic nke block data kpọọ aha. Osisi Merkle bụ ọmụmaatụ nke atụmatụ commitment cryptographic. A na-ahụ mgbọrọgwụ osisi ahụ dịka commitment, a na-egosikwa na node akwụkwọ bụ akụkụ nke commitment mbụ. Ha na-enyocha data echekwara ma ọ bụ ebufere na netwọk P2P, na-ahụ na data enwetara n'aka ndị otu agbanwebeghị. Osisi Note Commitment na Zcash N'ime pool ndị e chebere echebe nke Zcash Sapling & Orchard, a na-eji Osisi Note Commitment enyocha na Azụmahia dị irè megide consensus, ebe a na-ezobe onye zitere ya, onye natara ya & ego e ji mee ya nke ọma. Hash Signature (block n'ụdị Bitcoin) SHA256 bụ ọmụmaatụ nke “hash signature” a na-eji eme ka block ọ bụla dị na chain Bitcoin ghara ịgbanwe agbanwe. Ndị na-egwụputa na-eji hash nke block gara aga + hash nke Azụmahia niile dị na block ugbu a (hashMerkleRoot) + Timestamp + uru enweghị usoro / ihe isi ike netwọk maka block ọhụrụ. Equihash (Ịgwụputa Zcash) Equihash bụ algọridim hashing a na-eji n'ịgwụputa Zcash. Netwọk dịka Komodo & Horizen na-ejikwa ya. Equihash: Asymmetric Proof-of-Work Based on the Generalized Birthday Problem (Biryukov and Khovratovich): https://eprint.iacr.org/2015/946 --- Ọgụgụ Ndị Ọzọ Iji wulite nghọta ka ukwuu banyere ụdị ọrụ hash dị iche iche na ojiji ha, nke a bụ akụ ọma magburu onwe ya: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hashfunction --- Eriri okwu nke ZecHub (@ZecHub) Eriri okwu X mbụ: https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1621240109663227906 --- E chịkọtara ibe a site na eriri okwu Zero to Zero Knowledge mbụ maka wiki ZecHub.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Usoro Lelantus
description: E wepụtara ya na 2019, usoro a gbadoro ụkwụ na Zerocoin. A na-eji ya na ego Firo (nke a na-akpọbu Zcoin) mee ka Azụmahia [transaction] on-chain [on-chain] bụrụ…
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Usoro Lelantus Usoro: Zero to Zero Knowledge Taa, anyị na-eleba anya na Lelantus! E wepụtara ya na 2019, usoro a gbadoro ụkwụ na Zerocoin. A na-eji ya na ego Firo (nke a na-akpọbu Zcoin) mee ka Azụmahia [transaction] on-chain [on-chain] bụrụ nke nzuzo. Ọ yitere Zcash n’ụfọdụ ụzọ, mana ọ dị nnọọ iche n’ọtụtụ akụkụ. --- Ntọala Usoro Zcash na Firo Zcash - Ọ gbadoro ụkwụ na usoro Zerocash Firo (Zcoin) - Ọ gbadoro ụkwụ na usoro Zerocoin --- Mmepe nke Usoro Nzuzo [privacy] nke Firo Dị ka Zcash, Firo na-eji Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe [shielded addresses] eme ka Kwụọ ụgwọ na-enweghị aha kwe omume. Usoro oge: Zerocoin - Agbajiela izi-ezi ya Sigma - Usoro ọnụ ego edoziri Lelantus 1.0 - Enweghị proof nchekwa ziri ezi --- Njedebe nke Usoro Sigma Usoro Σ (Sigma) e ji na nsụgharị mbụ nke Zcoin/Firo nwere nnukwu njedebe: ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịmepụta naanị ọnụ ego edoziri. Nke a mepụtara obere òtù amaghị aha ma meghee ụzọ maka mwakpo oge n'etiti ọrụ ịmepụta na ịgbapụta (tinyere nsogbu “mgbanwe emerụrụ emerụ”). --- Otu Lelantus Si Akwalite Nzuzo Lelantus na-edozi nsogbu ọnụ ego edoziri site n’ikwe ka e si n’otu nnukwu otu mepụta mkpụrụ ego. Uru ndị bụ isi: Ọ na-ewepụ òtù amaghị aha nke ọnụ ego edoziri Ọ na-ebelata mwakpo oge n’etiti ịkụ ọkụ/ịgbapụta Ọ na-ewepụ nsogbu mgbanwe emerụrụ emerụ Njedebe: A na-egbochi nha otu ugbu a na 65,000 mkpụrụ ego. --- Commitment Mkpụrụ Ego Otu commitment mkpụrụ ego [coin commitment] bụ commitment a kpochiri ugboro abụọ nke na-edobe nọmba usoro mkpụrụ ego na uru mkpụrụ ego. Ndị a na-arụ ọrụ yiri note dị na Zcash. A na-ebipụta ma debe commitment mkpụrụ ego na ledger mgbe e mepụtara mkpụrụ ego ahụ (site na Azụmahia Mint ma ọ bụ Spend). --- Ụdị Basecoin Zerocoin Lelantus na-eji ụdị basecoin zerocoin oge gboo. Njirimara dị mkpa: Ịgbapụta akụkụ ụfọdụ kwe omume ugbu a ebe a na-ezo akụkụ fọdụrụ na ọnụ ego. Dị ka Zcash, onye ọrụ ga-ahọrọrịrị Azụmahia Oha [transparent transactions] n’ụzọ doro anya. --- Proof Otu-n’ime-Ọtụtụ Lelantus na-eji Proof Otu-n’ime-Ọtụtụ [One-of-Many Proofs] wepụta uru ntinye dị mkpa iji gosi nguzozi na-enweghị ikpughe ebe ntinye si bịa — na-enweghịkwa trusted setup. A na-ejikwa proof ndị a na Triptych (a kpọrọ aha ya na eri CryptoNote anyị). --- Nzuzo Ọkwa Netwọk: Dandelion++ node Firo na-eji otu Network Magic nke Magicbean nke Zcash. Dị ka Monero, Firo tinyere Dandelion++ iji gbakwunye Nzuzo site n’izo Adreesị IP nke onye na-agbasa Azụmahia. Usoro Dandelion++: Oge Stem - A na-ebufe Azụmahia gaa na otu node enweghị usoro kama ndị ọgbọ niile Oge Fluff - A na-amalite ya n’enweghị usoro, mgbe ahụ ọ gbanwee gaa n’ụdị nkwusa nkịtị Nke a na-eme ka ịchọpụta ebe Azụmahia si bịa site na nyocha netwọk sie ike karịa. --- Ọdịnihu: Lelantus-Spark Lelantus-Spark (e mere atụmatụ maka mgbe e mesịrị na 2023) na-ewebata ọkwa abụọ nke nhụta onye ọrụ họọrọ site n’iji ZIP-32 style derivation na Adreesị akpa ego dịgasị iche. Ọ ga-agbakwụnyekwa nkwado maka: Multisig Akụrụngwa Nzuzo Onye Ọrụ Kọwara Njirimara ndị a kwekọrọ na Shielded Assets nke Zcash. --- Eri mbụ sitere n’aka ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1641902859800150017 --- E chikọtara ibe a site na eri mbụ nke Zero to Zero Knowledge maka wiki ZecHub.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Mkpuru mgbake [Mnemonic Seed Phrases]
description: Mkpuru mgbake na-akwado otu n'ime akụkụ kachasị mkpa nke cryptocurrency — nlekọta onwe [self-custody].
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Mkpuru mgbake [Mnemonic Seed Phrases] Usoro: Zero to Zero Knowledge Mkpuru mgbake na-akwado otu n'ime akụkụ kachasị mkpa nke cryptocurrency — nlekọta onwe [self-custody]. Taa, anyị ga-amụta otú e si emepụta ma jiri Mkpuru mgbake n'ime e-akpa ego [wallets]. --- Gịnị bụ Mkpuru mgbake? A kọwara ahịrịokwu mgbake site na nkọwapụta BIP-39, ụdị ahịrịokwu mgbake a na-ejikarị taa. Ike nke ịmepụta ahịrịokwu mgbake na-amalite site n'ịmepụta enweghị usoro [randomness]. Entropy ka ukwuu pụtara nchekwa ka elu. A na-ewere 128 bits nke entropy dịka nke zuru ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ. Dabere n'ogologo entropy mbụ, ahịrịokwu mgbake ahụ ga-enwe okwu 12 ruo 24. --- Nzọụkwụ site na Nzọụkwụ: Otu E Si Emepụta Mkpuru mgbake Okwu 12 Mepụta Entropy Anyị na-amalite site n'ịmepụta 128 bits nke entropy. Tinye Checksum Anyị na-eji SHA256 hash entropy ahụ. Bits ole na ole mbụ nke hash a na-aghọ checksum. Nke a na-enye anyị akara mkpịsị aka pụrụ iche maka entropy anyị. Kewaa n'ime akụkụ 11-bit A na-ekewa ngụkọta bits 132 (entropy 128 + checksum 4) n'ime akụkụ nke bits 11. Jikọta na Ndepụta Okwu A na-atụgharị usoro 11-bit ọ bụla ka ọ bụrụ nọmba decimal (0-2047). Ndepụta okwu BIP-39 nwere kpọmkwem okwu 2048 (Bekee, Spanish, Chinese, wdg.). A na-eji nọmba ndị a chọta okwu kwekọrọ na ya n'ime ndepụta okwu ahụ. Nsonaazụ: Anyị nwere ugbu a ahịrịokwu mgbake okwu 12 echekwara nke mmadụ nwere ike ịgụ! --- Site n'Ahịrịokwu Mgbake -> Seed -> Adreesị akpa ego maka Kwụọ ụhwọ [Payment Addresses] Site n'iji ahịrịokwu mgbake, e-akpa ego nwere ike ịmepụta igodo iji mepụta Adreesị akpa ego maka Kwụọ ụhwọ na akaụntụ e-akpa ego dị iche iche. Igodo ndị a na-emepụta bụ deterministic [deterministic] — ntinye otu mgbe niile na-emepụta mmepụta otu. Ịmepụta Seed A na-enweta seed e-akpa ego site n'ahịrịokwu mnemonic site n'iji Key Derivation Function (KDF): Na Bitcoin: PBKDF2 Na Zcash: Blake2b-256/512 Nke a na-emepụta seed 64-byte (512-bit). Igodo Nna-ukwu A na-ekewa seed ahụ n'ime usoro abụọ nke 32-byte: Igodo ego Nna-ukwu [Master Spending Key] Master Chain Code A na-eji ndị a n'ime Hierarchical Deterministic (HD) Wallets maka mmepụta igodo ụmụ. --- Njirimara Pụrụ Iche nke Zcash (ZIP-32) Na Zcash, enwere ike inyefe ikike nlele [viewing authority] ma ọ bụ ikike mmefu [spending authority] n'adabereghị onwe ha maka obere osisi, na-enweghị imebi master seed. ZIP-32 na-akọwa ụkpụrụ mmepụta igodo hierarchical deterministic e gbanwere maka atụmatụ Nzuzo nke Zcash. Site na Expanded Spending Key, anyị na-enweta: Full Viewing Key Incoming Viewing Key Nhazi Adreesị akpa ego maka Kwụọ ụhwọ Usoro mmepụta dị iche iche na-emepụta adreesị mpụga dabara maka inye ndị zitere ego n'ofe pool nke e chebere echebe [shielded pools] (Sapling & Orchard). Zcash na-akwado kwa adreesị ime [internal addresses] maka ọrụ e-akpa ego dịka Auto-Shielding. --- Akụrụngwa ZIP-32: E-akpa ego Hierarchical Deterministic nke e chebere echebe Nkọwapụta Protocol Zcash (NU5) Nchịkọta e-akpa ego shielded-by-default --- Thread mbụ sitere na ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1624125037945946145 --- E chikọtara ibe a site na thread Zero to Zero Knowledge mbụ maka wiki ZecHub.

title: Nchịkọta Akụkụ ZK Podcast
description: ZL;DR bụ ihe ngosi na-egosi ihe niile gbasara Zcash n’ụdị vidio. Akụkụ ndị a na-ekpuchi ọtụtụ isiokwu Zcash, obodo, mmelite ecosystem, na akụkọ.
text: Nchịkọta Akụkụ ZK Podcast Akụkụ Akụkụ 334 – Mmelite Nnyocha ZK na Joe Bonneau Ụbọchị: Julaị 31, 2024 Njikọ: https://zeroknowledge.fm/334-2 Nchịkọta: Anna na Guille zutere Joe Bonneau ọzọ, Onye Nkuzi Enyemaka na NYU na Onye Mmekọrịta Nnyocha na a16z nyocha crypto. Ha tụlere ọrụ ya mere n'oge na-adịbeghị anya gbasara Naysayer proofs, Zero-Knowledge Middleboxes, Sealed-Bid Auctions, na ọrụ nyocha ndị ọzọ metụtara ZK. Ndị ọbịa: Joe Bonneau (/josephbonneau) Ndị na-elekọta: Anna (AnnaRRose) Guille (GuilleAngeris) Akụkụ 333 – SQL Enwere Ike Ịkwado, Reckle Trees na ZK Coprocessing na Lagrange Labs Ụbọchị: Julaị 24, 2024 Njikọ: https://zeroknowledge.fm/333-2 Nchịkọta: Anna na Ismael Hishon-Rezaizadeh, Onye Guzobere na CEO na Lagrange Labs, na Charalampos (Babis) Papamanthou, Onye Isi Nnyocha na Lagrange, kparịtara ụka. Ha laghachiri na coprocessor ndị zk na-akwado, SQL Enwere Ike Ịkwado, Reckle Trees, ma tụlee ahịa prover ọhụrụ ha. Ndị ọbịa: Ismael Hishon-Rezaizadeh (ismaelhr) Charalampos (Babis) Papamanthou (chbpap) Onye na-elekọta: Anna (AnnaRRose) Akụkụ 332 – Mkparịta ụka Brussels na Hart sitere na Across Ụbọchị: Julaị 18, 2024 Njikọ: https://zeroknowledge.fm/332-2 Nchịkọta: Anna na Tarun nọdụrụ ala na Hart Lambur n'oge izu EthCC na Brussels iji tụlee ọrụ ya, Across, nke bụ ngwọta mmekọrịta cross-chain [cross-chain] na ọrụ nwanne Uma. Ha nyochara owuwu Across, ihe a ga-atụfu ma ọ bụ nweta, ma jiri ya tụnyere ngwọta mmekọrịta ndị ọzọ. title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Mpaghara Mmezu A Tụkwasịrị Obi (Trusted Execution Environments, TEEs)
description: Zero to Zero Knowledge alọtala na isiokwu ọhụrụ!
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Mpaghara Mmezu A Tụkwasịrị Obi (Trusted Execution Environments, TEEs) Usoro: Zero to Zero Knowledge Zero to Zero Knowledge alọtala na isiokwu ọhụrụ! N’izu a, anyị na-enyocha Mpaghara Mmezu A Tụkwasịrị Obi (TEEs) — otu e si eji ha na mkpụrụ ego Nzuzo [privacy] na ngwa blockchain ndị ọzọ. --- TEEs na Blockchain: Njirimara Ndị Na-akwado Onwe Ha Blockchain na TEE nwere ike dị iche iche na-akwado ibe ha nke ukwuu: Blockchain na-ekwe nkwa na ihe ga-adị, ịdịgide nke ọnọdụ, ma na-enye ohere ka ọha nyochaa ọnọdụ dum — mana ha nwere ikike mgbakọ dị ntakịrị. TEE nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ mgbakọ siri ike na nzuzo — mana ha enweghị nchekwa ọnọdụ e wuru n’ime ha. Mgbe ejikọtara ha, ha nwere ike ịmepụta usoro dị ike na-echekwa Nzuzo. --- Secret Network: Nzuzo Nke TEE Na-akwado Secret Network na-eji teknụzụ TEE (karịchaa Intel SGX) arụ mgbakọ n’elu ntinye, mmepụta, na ọnọdụ e zoro ezo. Node validator ọ bụla na-agba mgbawa Intel SGX. A na-ejikọta oyi akwa consensus na mgbakọ: A na-ahazi Azụmahia [transaction] n’ime enclaves echekwara. A na-akọwapụta data naanị n’ime TEE. Nke a dị iche na Zcash, nke na-eji zero-knowledge proof maka Nzuzo. Na Zcash, a na-ebipụta Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe [shielded] ma na-akwado ha n’ihu ọha na-enweghị ikpughere netwọkụ data ọzọ. Zcash Shielded Assets na-agbasokwa otu ụkpụrụ ahụ. Maka nkọwa zuru ezu banyere otú e si etinye TEEs n’ọrụ na Secret Network, gụọ edemede a magburu onwe ya nke @lwoetzel: https://carter-woetzel.medium.com/secret-network-tees-lets-talk-fud-vulnerability-33ca94b6df38 --- Otu Secret Network Si Echekwa Igodo na Ọnọdụ A na-echekwa mkpụrụ Nzobe ederede [encryption] consensus nke netwọkụ n’ime TEE nke validator ọ bụla. Contracts na-eji igodo Nzobe ederede pụrụ iche nke enweghị ike ịgha. Secret contracts na-agba n’elu modul mgbakọ SDK nke Cosmos mana ha na-akwado ntinye/mmepụta na ọnọdụ e zoro ezo. --- Nkwenye Ime Obodo Nkwenye Ime Obodo (Remote Attestation) bụ usoro igosi na enclave na-agba n’ezigbo gburugburu ngwaike echekwara. Ọ na-enye akụkụ dị anya ohere ịchọpụta: Na ngwa ziri ezi na-agba Na emetụbeghị ngwa ahụ n’ụzọ na-adịghị mma Na ọ na-arụ ọrụ n’enweghị nsogbu n’ime enclave Intel SGX Enclaves nwekwara igodo nzuzo maka ịbịanye aka na nkwenye nke enweghị ike ịnweta site n’èzí. --- Ikpuchi Data Ebe enclaves enweghị ọnọdụ echekwara, mgbe ụfọdụ a ga-echekwa data n’èzí, n’ebe nchekwa a na-apụghị ịtụkwasị obi. Ikpuchi Data (Data Sealing) na-eji igodo sitere na CPU zochie data n’ime enclave. Enwere ike ikpughe block e zoro ezo naanị n’otu usoro ahụ. --- Oasis Network Oasis Network na-ejikwa TEEs site na ParaTime nzuzo ya (dịka Sapphire na Cipher). Data e zoro ezo na-abanye na TEE tinyere smart contract. A na-akọwapụta ya, ahazie ya, ma zookwa ya ọzọ tupu ọ hapụ enclave. --- TEEs na Netwọkụ Proof-of-Stake Ọtụtụ blockchain Proof-of-Stake (gụnyere Secret na Oasis) na-eji Tendermint dịka usoro consensus ha. Maka validators PoS: A ghaghị ijikwa igodo n’enweghị nsogbu, ghara ikpughe ha n’edemede nkịtị. Validators ga-anọrịrị n’ịntanetị (ntaramahụhụ maka ịnọghị n’ọrụ na-adị). Ịbịanye aka n’ozi ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha nwere ike ibute mwepụ ego. TEEs dị mma maka imepụta na iji igodo validator n’enweghị nsogbu. --- Zcash na Nnyocha Proof-of-Stake Zcash na-eme nnyocha nke ọma gbasara ịkwaga na Proof-of-Stake. Gụọ nyocha ahụ: https://electriccoin.co/blog/zcash-proof-of-stake-research/ Lelee ngalaba a sitere na Community Call nke Zcash Foundation nke na-akọwa atụmatụ PoS dị iche iche na mmetụta ha na Nzuzo: --- Eriri Ozi Mbụ nke ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1633579659282587651 --- A chịkọtara ibe a site n’eriri ozi mbụ nke Zero to Zero Knowledge maka wiki ZecHub.

title: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Azụmahia Oha vs Nke e chebere echebe na Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ
description: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-amụta banyere Zcash na nke mbụ, ị ga-achọpụta na e nwere ụdị Azụmahia (transaction) abụọ dị: Oha (Transparent) na nke e chebere echebe…
text: Zero to Zero Knowledge: Azụmahia Oha vs Nke e chebere echebe na Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ Usoro: Zero to Zero Knowledge Ọ bụrụ na ị na-amụta banyere Zcash na nke mbụ, ị ga-achọpụta na e nwere ụdị Azụmahia (transaction) abụọ dị: Oha (Transparent) na nke e chebere echebe (Shielded). Taa, anyị ga-amụta gbasara ha ma kpuchie otu n'ime atụmatụ ọhụrụ dị na gburugburu #Zcash, Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ (Unified Addresses). --- Azụmahia Oha vs Nke e chebere echebe Azụmahia Oha na-eji t-addresses (nke Base58 koodu kpuchiri). Ihe niile pụtara n'ihu ọha — dịka Bitcoin. Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na-eji adreesị e koodu kpuchiri maka pool Sapling ma ọ bụ Orchard. Ndị a na-ezo onye zitere ya, onye natara ya, na ọnụ ego site n'iji zero-knowledge proofs. Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe na-ezo aka n'Azụmahia ọ bụla nwere adreesị e koodu kpuchiri maka pool Sapling/Orchard. Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ (UAs) ka e mere iji jikọta ọnụ Azụmahia nke e chebere echebe ma ọ bụ nke Oha n'ime otu adreesị. --- Ụdị Adreesị akpa ego na Zcash E nwere ụdị Adreesị akpa ego 3 a na-eji: (T) Oha – Base58 (Z) Sapling – Bech32 (UA) Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ – Bech32m Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede (ya mere nha koodu QR) na-abawanye n'ụdị nke ọ bụla. --- Otu Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ Si Arụ Ọrụ A na-ekodu adreesị na igodo dị ka usoro byte (Raw Encoding). Receiver Encoding gụnyere ozi niile dị mkpa iji bufere akụ site n'iji otu protocol kpọmkwem. Raw encoding nke Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ bụ ngwakọta encoding (typecode, length, addr) nke ndị nnata: UA: 0x03 Sapling: 0x02 Oha: 0x01 Dị mkpa: A ghaghị inwe opekata mpe otu adreesị Kwụọ ụhwọ (payment) nke e chebere echebe n'ime UA ọ bụla. (A naghị akwado adreesị Sprout ọzọ mgbe nkwalite Canopy gasịrị.) Nkọwapụta zuru ezu: ZIP-316: Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ --- Uru Adreesị akpa ego e jikọtara ọnụ Bara Ọ dịrị exchange mfe — Ha nwere ike ugbu a ịkwado nkwụnye ego/mwepụ ego nke e chebere echebe n'enweghị ihe ize ndụ karịa. Nke a kwadebere maka ọdịnihu — Enwere ike ịgbakwunye pool ọhụrụ nke e chebere echebe na-enweghị imebi e-akpa ego (wallet). Nke e chebere echebe na ndabara — UA ọ bụla nwere opekata mpe otu adreesị nke e chebere echebe, yabụ Nzuzo (privacy) na-adị mgbe niile. Nke a bụ mgbanwe bụ isi nke na-enyelarị ọtụtụ ZEC aka ịbanye na pool nke e chebere echebe. --- Azụmahia Orchard na Omume Orchard webatara echiche ọhụrụ a kpọrọ Omume (Actions): Ha na-ebelata mpụta metadata site n'iji otu anchor maka Omume niile dị n'Azụmahia. Ha na-ejikọta ubi nke (V4) Spend + Output n'ime otu value commitment. Nke a na-eme ka o kwe omume ịkwalite arụmọrụ nke usoro proof Halo2. Daira na-akọwa ọnọdụ Anchor (zcon3): --- Ntụle Uru na Nzuzo N'ọnọdụ ụfọdụ (dịka ọmụmaatụ, Azụmahia n'etiti pool), onye na-ekiri nọ n'èzí nwere ike ịhụ ọnụ ego. Otú ọ dị, valueBalanceSapling na valueBalanceOrchard na-eji homomorphic commitments gosi mkpokọta ZEC dị na pool nke e chebere echebe ma gbochie nṅomi ego. Gụkwuo: ZIP 209: Machibido Ntụle Uru Pool Chain Nke Anọghị n'Udi --- Mmelite N'ọdịnihu Otu ECC na-arụ ọrụ na ụzọ RPC ọhụrụ na zcashd (nke ga-anọchi zsendmany) nke ga-eme ka ndị ọrụ nwee ike ịhụ tupu oge eruo ma nabata/jụ Azụmahia a tụrụ aro dabere na njirimara Nzuzo ya. --- Nkwado Eriri okwu a na mbụ rụtụrụ aka na YWallet, maka atụmatụ Azụmahia ọ gosiri tupu ịpịa zitere. A naghị edozi YWallet ọzọ, a gaghịkwa emelite ya maka Ironwood, yabụ o nweghịzi ike iso chain. Họrọ e-akpa ego a na-elekọta site na ibe Wallets kama, ma họrọ nke na-agwa gị ihe Azụmahia ga-ekpughe tupu e ziga ya. Ederede magburu onwe ya gbasara Nzuzo Azụmahia: https://medium.com/@hanh.huynh/ --- Eriri okwu mbụ sitere n'aka ZecHub (@ZecHub) https://x.com/ZecHub/status/1628498645627666432 --- E jikọtara ibe a site na eriri okwu mbụ Zero to Zero Knowledge maka wiki ZecHub.

title: Nye ZEC onyinye ma nweta mwepụ ụtụ isi US
description: Ibe a bụ ozi izugbe, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ iwu ma ọ bụ ụtụ isi. Iwu ụtụ isi US na-agbanwe, yabụ lelee ọnọdụ gị na onye ndụmọdụ ụtụ isi. Iwu ọ bụla dị n'okpuru a…
text: Nye ZEC onyinye ma nweta mwepụ ụtụ isi US Etiti - nkeji 10 Ibe a bụ ozi izugbe, ọ bụghị ndụmọdụ iwu ma ọ bụ ụtụ isi. Iwu ụtụ isi US na-agbanwe, yabụ lelee ọnọdụ gị na onye ndụmọdụ ụtụ isi. Iwu ọ bụla dị n'okpuru a jikọtara na isi mmalite IRS ya, nke enyochara n'Ọktoba 2026 megide Publication 526 (maka nkwụghachi ụtụ isi 2025) na ibe IRS gbasara iwu ụtụ isi 2025. Na nkenke IRS na-ewere ZEC dị ka akụ, yabụ onyinye ZEC bụ onyinye na-abụghị ego nkịtị Ọ bụrụ na i jidere ZEC ihe karịrị otu afọ, ị nwere ike n'ozuzu wepụ uru ahịa ziri ezi ya ma ghara ịkwụ ụtụ isi uru isi obodo n'ihi mmụba ya Ọ bụrụ na i jidere ya otu afọ ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị ya, mwepụ gị bụ nke pere mpe n'etiti ihe ị kwụrụ maka ya na uru ahịa ya Maka onyinye ruru $250 ma ọ bụ karịa, ị chọrọ nkwenye edere ede sitere n'aka ọrụ ebere ahụ Ọ bụrụ karịa $500, ị ga-etinye Form 8283. Ọ bụrụ karịa $5,000, ị ga-achọkwa ntule uru sitere n'aka ọkachamara ruru eru Ị ga-enweta mwepụ ahụ naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-edepụta mwepụ gị n'otu n'otu. Mwepụ ọhụrụ maka ndị na-adịghị edepụta mwepụ n'otu n'otu, nke malitere na 2026, na-ekpuchi naanị onyinye ego nkịtị, ọ bụghị ZEC Ònye ka nke a bụ maka ya? Ndị na-akwụ ụtụ isi US chọrọ inye ọrụ ebere ZEC Ndị na-enye onyinye chọrọ ka onyinye ha nọrọ na nzuzo on-chain ma ka na-ekwu mwepụ ụtụ isi Ọ bụrụ na ị na-elekọta ọrụ ebere ahụ, lee Nabata Onyinye Nzuzo dịka Òtù Na-adịghị Maka Uru na US. Nzuzo on-chain, mana ọrụ ebere ahụ maara Onyinye nke e chebere echebe na-eme ka ego ahụ, Adreesị akpa ego gị, na nguzozi ọrụ ebere ahụ ghara ịdị n'ihe ndekọ ọha. Mwepụ ụtụ isi bụ ụdị Nzuzo ọzọ: maka onyinye ọ bụla ruru $250 ma ọ bụ karịa, ọrụ ebere ahụ ga-amarịrị onye ị bụ iji zitere gị nkwenye, ma karịa $5,000, onye na-atụle uru gị na ọrụ ebere ahụ ga-abịanye aka na Form 8283 gị. Yabụ, ị nwere ike ịnọ na nzuzo n'ihu ọha ma ka na-ekwu mwepụ ahụ. Ị pụghị ịnọ na-amaghị aha n'ebe ọrụ ebere ahụ nọ ma kwuo ya maka onyinye ruru $250 ma ọ bụ karịa. Ihe ị chọrọ E-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe nke jidere ZEC ị ga-enye Ihe ndekọ banyere mgbe ị nwetara ZEC ahụ na ihe ị kwụrụ maka ya Ọrụ ebere bụ òtù ruru eru (lelee ya na IRS Ọchụchọ Òtù Ahapụrụ Ụtụ Isi) ma nabata ZEC. Lee Ebe Ị Ga-enye Onyinye ZEC Nduzi nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ Nzọụkwụ 1: Lelee ogologo oge i jirila ZEC Ihe karịrị otu afọ: ZEC bụ akụ isi obodo, yabụ ọ bụ ihe onwunwe uru isi obodo. Ị nwere ike n'ozuzu wepụ uru ahịa ziri ezi ya n'ụbọchị ị nyere ya (Publication 526, IRS Ajụjụ A Na-ajụkarị, Q34–Q35) Otu afọ ma ọ bụ ihe na-erughị ya: mwepụ gị bụ nke pere mpe n'etiti ndabere ọnụ ahịa gị (na-adịkarị ihe ị kwụrụ) na uru ahịa ziri ezi ya n'ụbọchị ahụ (IRS Ajụjụ A Na-ajụkarị, Q35) Ọ bụrụ na ị zụtara ZEC n'oge dị iche iche, nye site na otu ị jiderela ihe karịrị otu afọ ma debe note banyere nke ị jiri. Nzọụkwụ 2: Lelee ọrụ ebere ahụ Hụ na òtù ahụ nwere ike ịnata onyinye nwere ike iwepụ ụtụ isi, ma gụọ ihe ọ na-ekwu gbasara nnata crypto. Ụfọdụ ọrụ ebere anaghị eziga nkwenye maka crypto ma ọlị. Ebe Ị Ga-enye Onyinye ZEC depụtara ihe nke ọ bụla kwuru. Nzọụkwụ 3: Zipu onyinye ahụ ma gwa ọrụ ebere ahụ onye ị bụ Detuo Adreesị akpa ego ahụ site na ibe onyinye nke ọrụ ebere ahụ n'onwe ya Zipu site na e-akpa ego gị nke e chebere echebe Ọ bụrụ na ọrụ ebere ahụ nwere Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, tinye aha na email gị na memo, ma ọ bụ jiri usoro ịkpọtụrụ dị na ibe onyinye ya Nzọụkwụ 4: Dee uru ya n'ụbọchị ahụ Dekọọ ụbọchị na oge, ọnụọgụ ZEC, uru dollar US ya n'oge ahụ, na ebe ị nwetara ọnụahịa ahụ. Chekwaa ID Azụmahia ahụ. Lee Idobe ndekọ na ZEC nke e chebere echebe. Nzọụkwụ 5: Nweta nkwenye edere ede Maka onyinye ọ bụla otu ugboro ruru $250 ma ọ bụ karịa, ị chọrọ nkwenye edere ede n'oge kwesịrị ekwesị sitere n'aka ọrụ ebere ahụ. Ọ na-akọwa ZEC ị nyere, mana ọ naghị etinye uru na ya. Ị chọrọ ya tupu ụbọchị ị tinyere nkwụghachi ụtụ isi gị, ma ọ bụ ụbọchị ikpeazụ tinyere mgbatị oge ma ọ bụrụ na nke ahụ dị tupu ya (Publication 526). Nzọụkwụ 6: Dejupụta Form 8283 Karịrị $500 ruo $5,000: dejupụta Form 8283, Nkebi A Karịrị $5,0

title: Duzie mkpọsa nchịkọta ego ZEC
description: Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ ụlọ ọrụ anaghị akpata uru nọ na US, buru ụzọ gụọ Nabata Onyinye Nzuzo dịka Ụlọ Ọrụ Anaghị Akpata Uru nke US maka akwụkwọ nnata na fọm IRS.
text: Duzie mkpọsa nchịkọta ego ZEC Ọkwa etiti - nkeji 10 Nchịkọta nkenke (TL;DR) Nye mkpọsa ahụ akaụntụ e-akpa ego (wallet) nke ya na Adreesị akpa ego (address) nke e chebere echebe (shielded), ka ọ ghara ịgwakọta ya na ego ndị ọzọ Kesaa njikọ arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ (payment) ma ọ bụ koodu QR nwere ego a tụrụ aro yana memo e dejupụtalarị Gosi ọganihu n'ekpugheghị ndị nyere onyinye: bipụta mkpokọta ego ahụ n'onwe gị, ma ọ bụ nye otu onye nyocha a tụkwasịrị obi viewing key viewing key na-ekpuchi akaụntụ ahụ dum, ọ bụghị naanị otu Adreesị akpa ego, nke a bụ ihe kpatara mkpọsa ahụ ji nwee akaụntụ nke ya Mechie mkpọsa ahụ n'ụbọchị i kwere nkwa ya, ma bipụta otú e si jiri ego ahụ mee ihe Onye ka nke a dịịrị? Otu obodo, ọrụ ngwanrọ mmeghe (open-source) na ndị okike na-achịkọta ego maka otu ebumnobi Ụlọ ọrụ anaghị akpata uru na-eme arịrịọ njedebe afọ ma ọ bụ nke mberede na ZEC Onye ọ bụla chọrọ ka ndị na-enye onyinye tụkwasị mkpọsa ahụ obi n'emeghị ka onyinye ọ bụla pụta ìhè n'ihu ọha Ọ bụrụ na ị bụ ụlọ ọrụ anaghị akpata uru nọ na US, buru ụzọ gụọ Nabata Onyinye Nzuzo dịka Ụlọ Ọrụ Anaghị Akpata Uru nke US maka akwụkwọ nnata na fọm IRS. Nsogbu ahụ Ọtụtụ mkpọsa nchịkọta ego crypto na-eji Adreesị akpa ego Oha (transparent) ka ndị na-enye onyinye nwee ike ịhụ ka mkpokọta ego ahụ si eto. Nke a na-egosikwa onyinye ọ bụla, ego ole ọ bụ, mgbe ọ bịarutere na ebe ego ahụ na-aga ọzọ. Ndị na-enye onyinye ha n'ụzọ nzuzo n'ebumnobi na-atụfu Nzuzo (privacy) ahụ, onye ọ bụla nwekwara ike ịgbaso ego ahụ mgbe mkpọsa ahụ gachara. Mkpọsa nke zuru ezu na Nzuzo nwere nsogbu nke ọzọ: ndị na-enye onyinye enweghị ike ịhụ ma e ruru ebumnobi ahụ ma ọ bụ otú e si mefuo ego ahụ. Gịnị mere Zcash? Site na ZEC nke e chebere echebe, onyinye ọ bụla na-anọgide na Nzuzo on-chain, gị onwe gị na-ekpebi ihe ị ga-egosi: mkpokọta ego, ogwe ọganihu, ma ọ bụ ohere naanị ịgụ maka onye nyocha. Ndị na-enye onyinye nwere ike itinye ozi na memo, ị nwekwara ike ikele ha n'enweghị onye ọzọ hụrụ onye nyere onyinye. Ihe ị chọrọ e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe ebe ị nwere ike imepụta akaụntụ dị iche Ibe mkpọsa: weebụsaịtị, ozi na soshal midia ma ọ bụ isiokwu na forum Ebumnobi, ụbọchị njedebe na atụmatụ maka otú a ga-esi jiri ego ahụ mee ihe Ntuziaka nzọụkwụ na nzọụkwụ Nzọụkwụ 1: Tọọ ebumnobi na iwu Dee ihe ndị a tupu ị malite: Ego ole ị na-achịkọta na ihe ọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ya Ụbọchị njedebe Ihe ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na ị chịkọtara karịa ma ọ bụ erughị ebumnobi ahụ Onye na-achịkwa ego ahụ, na ma ọ dị mkpa ka ihe karịrị otu mmadụ kwado imefu ego (lee Ijikwa Private Community Treasury) Bipụta ihe ndị a n'ibe mkpọsa ahụ. Ndị na-enye onyinye na-atụkwasị obi na mkpọsa nke na-ekwupụta site na mbido ihe ọ ga-eme. Nzọụkwụ 2: Mepụta akaụntụ dị iche maka mkpọsa ahụ Mepụta akaụntụ ọhụrụ n'ime e-akpa ego gị, nke a ga-eji naanị maka mkpọsa a, ma detuo Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe site na ya. Idebe mkpọsa ahụ iche na-eme ka ọ dị mfe ịgụ mkpokọta ego, ọ ga-adịkwa mkpa ma emechaa ma ọ bụrụ na ị kesaa viewing key, n'ihi na viewing key na-egosi ihe niile na-eme n'akaụntụ ahụ dum (Viewing Keys). Nzọụkwụ 3: Mepụta njikọ arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ na koodu QR URI arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ bụ njikọ zcash: nke na-ejupụta Adreesị akpa ego, ego a tụrụ aro na memo maka onye na-enye onyinye. Jiri ngwá ọrụ na-emepụta arịrịọ Kwụọ ụhwọ nke ZecHub mepụta otu, wee kesaa ya dịka njikọ na koodu QR. Memo dịka "Aha mkpọsa, zaghachi na: email gị ma ọ bụ aha njirimara gị" na-enyere ndị na-enye onyinye chọrọ ekele ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ nnata aka. Kwuo n'ibe ahụ na memo abụghị iwu. Nzọụkwụ 4: Malite ibe mkpọsa ahụ Tinye n'ibe ahụ: Ebumnobi, ụbọchị njedebe na iwu sitere na Nzọụkwụ 1 Adreesị akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, koodu QR na njikọ ahụ Otú e si enye onyinye site na e-akpa ego nke e chebere echebe, na ebe a ga-enweta otu Otú ị ga-esi kọọ ọganihu (Nzọụkwụ 5) Kpachie Adreesị akpa ego ahụ n'otu ebe ma gwa ndị na-enye onyinye ka ha detuo ya naanị site n'ebe ahụ. Nzọụkwụ 5: Kọọ ọganihu n'ekpugheghị ndị nyere onyinye Họrọ otu ma kwuo nke ị họọrọ n'ibe ahụ: Bipụt

title: How to run Zakura on Akash Network
description: Step-by-step path for a Zakura Zcash full node using the awesome-akash zcash-zakura template.
text: How to run Zakura on Akash Network Step-by-step path for a Zakura Zcash full node using the awesome-akash zcash-zakura template. Zakura is a consensus-compatible Zcash node (forked from Zebra) with faster sync, native pruning, and snapshot bootstrap. This template pins zakuracore/zakura:1.8.1 (digest-pinned; do not use :latest or 1.1.1). What you get Mainnet P2P: container 8233, published globally (see port mapping below) Persistent pruned state (64 GiB default) with Valar snapshot bootstrap on first start Prometheus 9999 and health 8080 (internal, no public URI) JSON-RPC 8232 internal for colocated lightwalletd; LWD listens on container 9067 and is published globally Feature flags in the SDL (true/false): ENABLEMETRICS, ENABLEHEALTH, ENABLERPC, ENABLELIGHTWALLETD. Cookie auth is off when lightwalletd is on, because lightwalletd cannot read cookie files. Which site to use (payments) The SDL is the same. The two Akash web UIs differ in how you pay. Site Payments Wallet --- --- --- console.akash.network Traditional web checkout (card / fiat rails Console offers) Console account air.akash.network Native Akash chain payments (AKT / ACT) Keplr Use Air when you want to pay with Keplr on-chain. Use Console when you want a conventional web payment flow. Do not expect Keplr native settlement on Console. Deploy Web payments (Console) Native Akash payments with Keplr (Air) Open this template on Air Open the matching link above (Console or Air). On Air, connect Keplr and confirm you have AKT/ACT for deposit and lease. On Console, complete the web checkout the UI presents. Load zcash-zakura/deploy.yaml if it is not already filled in. Deposit, accept a bid, wait for the lease. Logs should show snapshot download (first start) then zakurad start. Open Leases → URIs. Use the host:port the provider assigned, not 8233 or 9067 on the public IP. How Akash publishes ports SDL port / as (8233, 9067, 8232) are container ports. Zakura still listens on 8233; lightwalletd on 9067; RPC on 8232 for the LWD sidecar (zakura:8232). They are not the ports on the provider's public IP. Default (this template): no dedicated IP. Each global: true TCP expose is mapped to a random high port on a shared provider host. Console/Air list them as lease URIs, for example: Peers dial the 8233 URI (provider.example:31482). Compact wallets use the 9067 URI (TLS off unless you terminate TLS yourself). Set ZAKURANETWORKEXTERNALADDR to the mapped P2P URI, not :8233. Internal exposes (8232 RPC, 9999 metrics, 8080 health) stay on the deployment network. No public URI. Dedicated IPs (endpoints / kind: ip) are a paid extra and are not in this template. They can pin a public IP and sometimes the as port. Add that only if you need a stable host:8233. Archive vs pruned Default is pruned (11 GiB snapshot, 64 GiB disk). For full history set SNAPSHOTKIND=archive, raise disk to 350 GiB+, and set ZAKURASTATESTORAGEMODE=archive. Related Zebra on Akash — Zcash Foundation zebrad (full history, no snapshot) Thus Spoke Zakura on Akash — Regtest dashboard + app (v0.4.1) Zakura source: github.com/zakura-core/zakura Snapshots: zakura.com/snapshots/

text: Thus Spoke Zakura on Akash (Regtest) Run the Thus Spoke Zakura v0.4.1 stack on Akash: Zakura Regtest, lightwalletd, and the wallet dashboard / HTTP API. Test coins have no value. Do not send mainnet ZEC here. Template: awesome-akash/thus-spoke-zakura Upstream: zcashlabs/thus-spoke-zakura tag v0.4.1 Images Service Image --- --- Dashboard + API (app) ghcr.io/zcashlabs/thus-spoke-zakura-app:0.4.1 lightwalletd ghcr.io/zcashlabs/thus-spoke-zakura-lightwalletd:0.4.1 Zakura zakuracore/zakura:1.6.0 (pin compiled into the 0.4.1 launcher) Self-bootstrap On first start the app container runs ths-server init on its persistent volume, then ths-server serve. Serve retries until Zakura JSON-RPC and lightwalletd are up. You do not run ths on the provider; the SDL is the runtime. How Akash publishes ports SDL port / as are container ports. The app listens on 8080 (THSLISTEN); lightwalletd on 9067; Zakura RPC on 18232 and P2P on 18233. Inside the deployment, services already use those (http://zakura:18232, http://lightwalletd:9067). They are not the ports on the provider's public IP. Default (this template): no dedicated IP. Service Container listen SDL as How it shows up on the lease --- --- --- --- app (dashboard + HTTP API) 8080 80 (HTTP) Ingress hostname, often on 80/443 — open this URI in a browser lightwalletd 9067 9067 (TCP, global) host: random-high-port zakura RPC 18232 18232 (TCP, global) host: random-high-port zakura P2P 18233 18233 (TCP, global) host: random-high-port After the lease is ready, Leases → URIs is the source of truth. Open the app URI for the dashboard (the same UI ths opens locally). Point compact clients at the lightwalletd URI (THSLIGHTWALLETDTLS=false). Do not type :8080, :80, or :9067 on the provider IP unless a dedicated IP lease made those ports public. Dedicated IPs (endpoints / kind: ip) are a paid extra and are not in this template. They can pin a public IP and sometimes the as port. Leave them off unless you need that. Which site to use (payments) The SDL is the same. The two Akash web UIs differ in how you pay. Site Payments Wallet --- --- --- console.akash.network Traditional web checkout (card / fiat rails Console offers) Console account air.akash.network Native Akash chain payments (AKT / ACT) Keplr Use Air when you want to pay with Keplr on-chain. Use Console when you want a conventional web payment flow. Deploy Web payments (Console) Native Akash payments with Keplr (Air) Open this template on Air Create the deployment from the template, accept a bid, wait until app logs show ths-server serve staying up, then open the app URI for the dashboard. title: Nduzi Onye Mmepụta Zcash JS
description: zcash.js (@zcashlabs/zcash.js) bụ SDK TypeScript/JavaScript nnwale nke Zcash Labs wepụtara na 26 Ọktoba 2026. Ọ na-enye ndị mmepụta ohere iwulite e-akpa ego…
text: Nduzi Onye Mmepụta Zcash JS zcash.js (@zcashlabs/zcash.js) bụ SDK TypeScript/JavaScript nnwale nke Zcash Labs wepụtara na 26 Ọktoba 2026. Ọ na-enye ndị mmepụta ohere iwulite e-akpa ego [wallets], light client, dashboard, na ngwa na-emekọrịta ihe na netwọk Zcash site na Node.js na ihe nchọgharị weebụ. Ọnọdụ: Nnwale (v0.1.1). E-akpa ego Node na-adịgide adịgide chọrọ ugbu a Linux + flock. Iziga/nata zuru ezu na ihe nchọgharị dị ndụ na mbugharị nchekwa data e-akpa ego ochie erubeghị eru maka ojiji zuru oke. Na-enyocha akwụkwọ nkọwa gọọmentị mgbe niile tupu ojiji mmepụta. Ihe SDK Na-enye createPublicClient — ajụjụ JSON-RPC enweghị ọnọdụ na nleba anya Azụmahia [transaction] createLightClient — ajụjụ na iyi lightwallet (gRPC nke obodo na Node, gRPC-Web na ihe nchọgharị) createWalletClient — akaụntụ mpaghara, nyocha, atụmatụ, mbinye aka, ntinye, na mgbake Kwụọ ụhwọ [payment] edere Ọnụọgụ bigint ziri ezi, nkwado netwọk, ngwá ọrụ nlele/adreesị, na ngwa PCZT Igwe e-akpa ego ndabere ejikọtara ọnụ, workers, na akụ nkwado mpaghara Sapling (enweghị mkpa ịwụnye Rust iche) Ntinye Jiri Node.js 22.23.4 (ụdị nke ngwugwu kwụgidere). Họrọ TypeScript nwere ESM ("type": "module" na package.json). Ngwa ihe nchọgharị na-arụ ọrụ site n'aka bundler ESM nke oge a. Bundler ahụ ga-emepụta akụ WASM, worker, na proving na-ebute nwayọọ — a ga-ebunye ndị a na ngwa gị. Ajụjụ Chain Mbụ (Enweghị E-akpa Ego) Ịhapụ nhọrọ network na-eme ka ọ bụrụ mainnet na ndabara (nye endpoint kwekọrọ). createPublicClient dịkwa maka ojiji JSON-RPC dị ọcha. Imeghe E-akpa Ego Nhọrọ Nchekwa Gburugburu Nhọrọ nchekwa ----------------- ----------------------------------------------------- Node (na-adịgide) { kind: 'node-filesystem', path: './my-wallet' } Ihe nchọgharị { kind: 'browser-opfs', name: 'my-wallet' } Nke a ga-atụfu { kind: 'memory' } Ntọala ndabara dị mkpa (dịka na v0.1.1): Mmefu na mgbanwe bụ naanị-Ironwood na ndabara Iwu ugwo [fee]: ZIP-317 Nkwenye: 3 a tụkwasịrị obi / 3 a na-atụkwasịghị obi Kpọọ wallet.sync() mgbe niile tupu atụpụta Kwụọ ụhwọ Usoro Ọrụ E-akpa Ego Ọkwa Dị Elu Mepụta ma ọ bụ bubata akaụntụ mnemonic ma tinye onye na-edebanye aha Kpọọ wallet.sync() Rịọ adreesị nnata (họrọ Unified / Ironwood) Mepụta atụmatụ → nyochaa ya → kpọọ wallet.send() Lelee maka nkwenye ma ọ bụ jiri ọrụ ndị e dere maka mgbake mgbe ịmalitegharịrị Ngwa ahụ nwere bytes mnemonic. Hichapụ ha na ebe nchekwa mgbe ha na-adịkwaghị mkpa. Na-egosi mgbe niile UI nkwado doro anya nke na-egosi onye nnata ọ bụla, ọnụọgụ, ugwo, pool, na oge njedebe. Lee ntụziaka gọọmentị Wallet maka ọmụmaatụ zuru oke na-arụ ọrụ. Ihe Ederede Banyere Platform na Mmachi Ugbu a Ike Node Ihe nchọgharị ----------------------- ----------------------------------- ---------------------------------- Ngwugwu Node 22.23.4 + ESM Bundler ESM nke oge a + WebAssembly Ajụjụ light gRPC nke obodo gRPC-Web + CORS Nchekwa na-adịgide Linux + flock naanị OPFS (ọnọdụ echekwara) Nchekwa a ga-atụfu ebe nchekwa ebe nchekwa Mmachi ndị ọzọ: Nchekwa Node na-adịgide ugbu a bụ naanị-Linux Enwebeghị vault nzuzo ejikwa, ọrụ proving dịpụrụ adịpụ, ma ọ bụ njikọta hardware-signer A naghị akpọsa nchekwa dị ka nke Nzobe ederede [encryption] n'oge izu ike Emeghela otu nchekwa e-akpa ego site n'aka ọtụtụ usoro ma ọ bụ taabụ ihe nchọgharị n'otu oge Mechie e-akpa ego nke ọma mgbe niile site na await wallet.close() Nzọụkwụ Ndị Na-esote Ntinye gọọmentị na arịrịọ mbụ: Ntinye Imeghe na ịhazi e-akpa ego: Mepee e-akpa ego Usoro ọrụ zuru ezu: Ntuziaka e-akpa ego Ntụaka API: Ntụaka API Mmachi platform: Nhazi Node na ihe nchọgharị Akụ Gọọmentị Akwụkwọ onye mmepụta: https://zcashlabs.github.io/zcashjs/ Ebe nchekwa GitHub: https://github.com/zcashlabs/zcashjs Ngwugwu npm: @zcashlabs/zcash.js --- Ntuziaka a dabere na @zcashlabs/zcash.js@0.1.1 (Ọktoba 2026). SDK ahụ nọ n'okpuru mmepe na-arụsi ọrụ ike — họrọ akwụkwọ nkọwa gọọmentị mgbe niile maka API na mmachi kachasị ọhụrụ.
